1fcfd53125b016aa47bbaffb0f6f0f1c85a09d77.summary: 系统综述蛋白质专用大语言模型，涵盖架构、训练数据集、评测指标与应用。
key_points: Protein LLM推动蛋白质结构预测、功能注释与设计
分析100多篇文章并给出结构化分类
提供首个Protein LLM全面概览
1fcfd53125b016aa47bbaffb0f6f0f1c85a09d77.zh_abstract: 蛋白质特异性大型语言模型（Protein LLMs）通过实现更高效的蛋白质结构预测、功能注释和设计，正在革新蛋白质科学。尽管现有综述聚焦于特定方面或应用，本工作提供了Protein LLMs的首个全面概述，涵盖其架构、训练数据集、评估指标和多样化应用。通过对100多篇文章的系统分析，我们提出了最先进Protein LLMs的结构化分类法，分析它们如何利用大规模蛋白质序列数据以提高准确性，并探索它们在推进蛋白质工程和生物医学研究方面的潜力。此外，我们讨论关键挑战和未来方向，将Protein LLMs定位为蛋白质科学中科学发现的重要工具。资源维护在 https://github.com/Yij

2a8cf14e036d451f27df981a8b2b7e039b96f89a.title: A Comprehensive Survey on the Trustworthiness of Large Language Models in Healthcare
2a8cf14e036d451f27df981a8b2b7e039b96f89a.abstract: The application of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare holds significant promise for enhancing clinical decision-making, medical research, and patient care. However, their integration into real-world clinical settings raises critical concerns around trustworthiness, particularly around dimensions of truthfulness, privacy, safety, robustness, fairness, and explainability. These dimensions are essential for ensuring that LLMs generate reliable, unbiased, and ethically sound outputs. While researchers have recently begun developing benchmarks and evaluation frameworks to assess LLM trustworthiness, the trustworthiness of LLMs in healthcare remains underexplored, lacking a systematic review that provides a comprehensive understanding and future insights. This survey addresses that gap by providing a comprehensive review of current methodologies and solutions aimed at mitigating risks
2a8cf14e036d451f27df981a8b2b7e039b96f89a.zh_title: 医疗健康大模型可信性综述
2a8cf14e036d451f27df981a8b2b7e039b96f89a.summary: 综述系统梳理医疗大模型在真实性、隐私、安全、鲁棒性、公平性与可解释性等可信维度的研究现状。
key_points: 大模型在临床决策与研究中应用前景广泛
真实临床部署面临可信性多重关切
围绕真实性、隐私、安全等维度展开梳理
2a8cf14e036d451f27df981a8b2b7e039b96f89a.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医疗保健中的应用为增强临床决策、医学研究和患者护理带来了巨大希望。然而，将其整合到真实临床环境中会引发围绕可信度的关键担忧，尤其是在真实性、隐私、安全性、鲁棒性、公平性和可解释性等维度。这些维度对于确保 LLM 生成可靠、无偏见且符合伦理的输出至关重要。尽管研究人员最近已开始制定基准和评估框架来评估 LLM 的可信度，但 LLM 在医疗保健中的可信度仍未得到充分探索，缺乏能够提供全面理解和未来洞见的系统性综述。本综述通过全面回顾旨在减轻风险的当前方法和解决方案，填补了这一空白

799dcc2efd788f80770b6e829202642c5ca7e742.title: LLMEval-Med: A Real-world Clinical Benchmark for Medical LLMs with Physician Validation
799dcc2efd788f80770b6e829202642c5ca7e742.abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) in medicine is crucial because medical applications require high accuracy with little room for error. Current medical benchmarks have three main types: medical exam-based, comprehensive medical, and specialized assessments. However, these benchmarks have limitations in question design (mostly multiple-choice), data sources (often not derived from real clinical scenarios), and evaluation methods (poor assessment of complex reasoning). To address these issues, we present LLMEval-Med, a new benchmark covering five core medical areas, including 2,996 questions created from real-world electronic health records and expert-designed clinical scenarios. We also design an automated evaluation pipeline, incorporating expert-developed checklists into our LLM-as-Judge framework. Furthermore, our methodology validates machine scoring through human-machine agreem
799dcc2efd788f80770b6e829202642c5ca7e742.zh_title: LLMEval-Med：经医生验证的真实临床医学大模型基准
799dcc2efd788f80770b6e829202642c5ca7e742.summary: 提出基于真实临床场景并由医生验证的医学大模型评测基准，旨在改进题目设计、数据来源和复杂推理评估。
key_points: 现有医学基准多采用选择题设计
数据源常非真实临床场景
提出经医师验证的真实临床基准
799dcc2efd788f80770b6e829202642c5ca7e742.zh_abstract: 在医学中评估大型语言模型（LLM）至关重要，因为医学应用需要高准确性，几乎没有出错的空间。当前的医学基准主要有三种类型：基于医学考试的、综合医学的和专业评估。然而，这些基准在问题设计（大多是多项选择）、数据来源（通常并非来自真实临床场景）和评估方法（对复杂推理的评估不佳）方面存在局限性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 LLMEval-Med，一个涵盖五个核心医学领域的新基准，包括 2,996 个从真实世界电子健康记录和专家设计的临床场景中创建的问题。我们还设计了一个自动化评估流程，将专家开发的检查表纳入我们的 LLM-as-Judge 框架中。此外，我们的方法通过人机 agreem 验证机器评分

110ab0beb74ffb7ab1efe55ad36b4732835fa5c9.title: EmoAgent: Assessing and Safeguarding Human-AI Interaction for Mental Health Safety
110ab0beb74ffb7ab1efe55ad36b4732835fa5c9.abstract: The rise of LLM-driven AI characters raises safety concerns, particularly for vulnerable human users with psychological disorders. To address these risks, we propose EmoAgent, a multi-agent AI framework designed to evaluate and mitigate mental health hazards in human-AI interactions. EmoAgent comprises two components: EmoEval simulates virtual users, including those portraying mentally vulnerable individuals, to assess mental health changes before and after interactions with AI characters. It uses clinically proven psychological and psychiatric assessment tools (PHQ-9, PDI, PANSS) to evaluate mental risks induced by LLM. EmoGuard serves as an intermediary, monitoring users' mental status, predicting potential harm, and providing corrective feedback to mitigate risks. Experiments conducted in popular character-based chatbots show that emotionally engaging dialogues can lead to psychologic
110ab0beb74ffb7ab1efe55ad36b4732835fa5c9.zh_title: EmoAgent：评估与守护心理健康人机交互安全
110ab0beb74ffb7ab1efe55ad36b4732835fa5c9.summary: EMNLP 2025 提出多智能体框架 EmoAgent，用于评估与缓解人与 AI 角色交互中的心理健康风险。
key_points: EmoAgent 含评估与缓解两部分组件
EmoEval 模拟含心理脆弱人群的虚拟用户
对比交互前后心理健康变化
110ab0beb74ffb7ab1efe55ad36b4732835fa5c9.zh_abstract: LLM 驱动的 AI 角色的兴起引发了安全担忧，尤其是对患有心理障碍的脆弱人类用户。为应对这些风险，我们提出了 EmoAgent，一种多智能体 AI 框架，旨在评估并缓解人-AI 交互中的心理健康危害。EmoAgent 包含两个组件：EmoEval 模拟虚拟用户，包括那些扮演心理脆弱个体的用户，以评估与 AI 角色交互前后的心理健康变化。它使用经临床验证的心理与精神科评估工具（PHQ-9、PDI、PANSS）来评估由 LLM 引发的心理风险。EmoGuard 充当中间者，监测用户的心理状态，预测潜在伤害，并提供纠正性反馈以缓解风险。在流行角色型聊天机器人中进行的实验表明，情感投入的对话可导致心理

bddb021ee854256c521d1076d200f17b49052982.title: ReasonMed: A 370K Multi-Agent Generated Dataset for Advancing Medical Reasoning
bddb021ee854256c521d1076d200f17b49052982.abstract: Reasoning-based large language models have excelled in mathematics and programming, yet their potential in knowledge-intensive medical question answering remains underexplored and insufficiently validated in clinical contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReasonMed, the largest medical reasoning dataset to date, comprising 370k high-quality examples distilled from 1.75 million initial reasoning paths generated by complementary LLMs and curated through a cost-efficient easy-medium-difficult (EMD) pipeline. ReasonMed is built through a multi-agent generation, verification, and refinement process, in which an Error Refiner improves reasoning paths by correcting error-prone steps identified by a verifier. Using ReasonMed, we investigate effective strategies for training medical reasoning models and find that integrating detailed CoT reasoning with concise answer summaries yields the most
bddb021ee854256c521d1076d200f17b49052982.zh_title: ReasonMed：37万条多智能体生成医学推理数据集
bddb021ee854256c521d1076d200f17b49052982.summary: EMNLP 2025发布迄今最大医学推理数据集ReasonMed，含37万条高质量样本。
key_points: 由互补大模型生成175万条初始推理路径
经易中难分层筛选得到37万条样本
面向知识密集型医学问答推理验证
bddb021ee854256c521d1076d200f17b49052982.zh_abstract: 基于推理的大语言模型在数学和编程方面表现出色，但它们在知识密集型医学问答中的潜力仍未得到充分探索，并且在临床情境中未得到充分验证。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 ReasonMed，这是迄今最大的医学推理数据集，包含 37 万个高质量示例，这些示例从由互补 LLM 生成的 175 万条初始推理路径中蒸馏而来，并通过成本高效的易-中-难（easy-medium-difficult, EMD）流程进行筛选。ReasonMed 通过多智能体生成、验证和精炼过程构建，其中 Error Refiner 通过纠正由验证器识别出的易错步骤来改进推理路径。利用 ReasonMed，我们研究了训练医学推理模型的有效策略，并发现将详细的 CoT 推理与简洁的答案摘要相结合能够产生最

1585c43b9c584854bcb42ce4e56416c6b3bc54f3.title: Med-PRM: Medical Reasoning Models with Stepwise, Guideline-verified Process Rewards
1585c43b9c584854bcb42ce4e56416c6b3bc54f3.abstract: Large language models have shown promise in clinical decision making, but current approaches struggle to localize and correct errors at specific steps of the reasoning process. This limitation is critical in medicine, where identifying and addressing reasoning errors is essential for accurate diagnosis and effective patient care. We introduce Med-PRM, a process reward modeling framework that leverages retrieval-augmented generation to verify each reasoning step against established medical knowledge bases. By verifying intermediate reasoning steps with evidence retrieved from clinical guidelines and literature, our model can precisely assess the reasoning quality in a fine-grained manner. Evaluations on five medical QA benchmarks and two open-ended diagnostic tasks demonstrate that Med-PRM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improving the performance of base models by up to 13.50%
1585c43b9c584854bcb42ce4e56416c6b3bc54f3.zh_title: Med-PRM：基于指南验证式逐步过程奖励的医学推理模型
1585c43b9c584854bcb42ce4e56416c6b3bc54f3.summary: EMNLP 2025 论文提出 Med-PRM 过程奖励建模框架，利用检索增强生成对每一步推理按既有医学知识进行验证，以定位并纠正推理过程中的错误。
key_points: 现有方法难以定位并纠正具体推理步骤错误
医学场景中识别推理错误对诊疗至关重要
采用检索增强生成逐步核验医学知识
1585c43b9c584854bcb42ce4e56416c6b3bc54f3.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型在临床决策中已显示出前景，但当前方法难以在推理过程的特定步骤上定位和纠正错误。这一局限在医学中至关重要，因为识别和处理推理错误对于准确诊断和有效患者照护必不可少。我们介绍了 Med-PRM，一种过程奖励建模（process reward modeling）框架，其利用检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation）依据已确立的医学知识库验证每个推理步骤。通过用从临床指南和文献中检索到的证据验证中间推理步骤，我们的模型能够以细粒度方式精确评估推理质量。在五个医学 QA 基准和两个开放式诊断任务上的评估表明，Med-PRM 达到了最先进性能，并将基础模型的性能提升高达 13.50%

a7a2b307a05b8b4c5804e3c4601e0bd7381742c4.title: LIDDIA: Language-based Intelligent Drug Discovery Agent
a7a2b307a05b8b4c5804e3c4601e0bd7381742c4.abstract: Drug discovery is a long, expensive, and complex process, relying heavily on human medicinal chemists, who can spend years searching the vast space of potential therapies. Recent advances in artificial intelligence for chemistry have sought to expedite individual drug discovery tasks; however, there remains a critical need for an intelligent agent that can navigate the drug discovery process. Towards this end, we introduce LIDDiA, an autonomous agent capable of intelligently navigating the drug discovery process in silico. By leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models, LIDDiA serves as a low-cost and highly-adaptable tool for autonomous drug discovery. a7a2b307a05b8b4c5804e3c4601e0bd7381742c4.zh_title: LIDDiA：基于语言的智能药物发现智能体
a7a2b307a05b8b4c5804e3c4601e0bd7381742c4.summary: EMNLP 2025 提出 LIDDiA，可自主导航药物发现流程的智能体，以应对该过程耗时昂贵、依赖人类药物化学家的问题。
key_points: 自主智能体导航药物发现流程
针对药物发现耗时且昂贵的问题
基于语言与化学 AI 方法
a7a2b307a05b8b4c5804e3c4601e0bd7381742c4.zh_abstract: 药物发现是一个漫长、昂贵且复杂的过程，严重依赖人类药物化学家，他们可能花费数年时间搜索庞大的潜在疗法空间。近年来，化学人工智能的进展试图加速单个药物发现任务；然而，仍然迫切需要一种能够导航药物发现过程的智能体。为此，我们提出 LIDDiA，这是一种能够在计算机（in silico）中智能导航药物发现过程的自主智能体。通过利用大语言模型的推理能力，LIDDiA 可作为低成本且高度可适应的自主药物发现工具。我们全面检验了 LIDDiA，证明（1）它能在 30 个临床相关靶点中的超过 70% 上生成满足关键药物标准的分子，（2）它智能地平衡探索与 exploi

cd63455be2671968842016fecfbfbb5371331ddc.title: Agentic Medical Knowledge Graphs Enhance Medical Question Answering: Bridging the Gap Between LLMs and Evolving Medical Knowledge
cd63455be2671968842016fecfbfbb5371331ddc.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced medical question-answering by leveraging extensive clinical data and medical literature. However, the rapid evolution of medical knowledge and the labor-intensive process of manually updating domain-specific resources pose challenges to the reliability of these systems. To address this, we introduce Agentic Medical Graph-RAG (AMG-RAG), a comprehensive framework that automates the construction and continuous updating of medical knowledge graphs, integrates reasoning, and retrieves current external evidence, such as PubMed and WikiSearch. By dynamically linking new findings and complex medical concepts, AMG-RAG not only improves accuracy but also enhances interpretability in medical queries. Evaluations on the MEDQA and MEDMCQA benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of AMG-RAG, achieving an F1 score of 74.1 percent on MEDQA and an
cd63455be2671968842016fecfbfbb5371331ddc.zh_title: 智能体医学知识图谱增强医学问答
cd63455be2671968842016fecfbfbb5371331ddc.summary: 提出AMG-RAG框架，自动构建并持续更新医学知识图谱以增强大模型医学问答。
key_points: 医学知识快速演进影响系统可靠性
人工更新领域资源成本高
自动构建与持续更新知识图谱
cd63455be2671968842016fecfbfbb5371331ddc.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过利用大量临床数据和医学文献，显著推动了医学问答的发展。然而，医学知识的快速演进以及手动更新领域特定资源的劳动密集型过程，对这些系统的可靠性构成了挑战。为解决这一问题，我们引入 Agentic Medical Graph-RAG（AMG-RAG），一个综合框架，可自动化医学知识图谱的构建与持续更新，整合推理，并检索当前外部证据，例如 PubMed 和 WikiSearch。通过动态链接新发现和复杂医学概念，AMG-RAG 不仅提高了准确性，还增强了医学查询中的可解释性。在 MEDQA 和 MEDMCQA 基准上的评估证明了 AMG-RAG 的有效性，在 MEDQA 上达到 74.1% 的 F1 分数，以及一个

cb228905345e0ccbcaab92cd0eebc02ade943ab6.title: RadEval: A framework for radiology text evaluation
cb228905345e0ccbcaab92cd0eebc02ade943ab6.abstract: We introduce RadEval, a unified, open-source framework for evaluating radiology texts. RadEval consolidates a diverse range of metrics, from classic n-gram overlap (BLEU, ROUGE) and contextual measures (BERTScore) to clinical concept-based scores (F1CheXbert, F1RadGraph, RaTEScore, SRR-BERT, TemporalEntityF1) and advanced LLM-based evaluators (GREEN). We refine and standardize implementations, extend GREEN to support multiple imaging modalities with a more lightweight model, and pretrain a domain-specific radiology encoder, demonstrating strong zero-shot retrieval performance. We also release a richly annotated expert dataset with over 450 clinically significant error labels and show how different metrics correlate with radiologist judgment. Finally, RadEval provides statistical testing tools and baseline model evaluations across multiple publicly available datasets, facilitating reprodu
cb228905345e0ccbcaab92cd0eebc02ade943ab6.zh_title: RadEval：放射学文本评估统一框架
cb228905345e0ccbcaab92cd0eebc02ade943ab6.summary: EMNLP 2025 提出开源统一框架 RadEval，整合放射学文本的多种评估指标。
key_points: 涵盖 n-gram、上下文与临床概念类指标
含 LLM 评估器 GREEN，并做实现标准化
扩展 GREEN 支持多模态并采用更轻量模型
cb228905345e0ccbcaab92cd0eebc02ade943ab6.zh_abstract: 我们提出 RadEval，一个用于评估放射学文本的统一、开源框架。RadEval 整合了多样化的指标，从经典的 n-gram 重叠（BLEU、ROUGE）和上下文度量（BERTScore），到基于临床概念的评分（F1CheXbert、F1RadGraph、RaTEScore、SRR-BERT、TemporalEntityF1）以及先进的基于大语言模型的评估器（GREEN）。我们改进并标准化了实现，将 GREEN 扩展至支持多种成像模态并采用更轻量的模型，并预训练了一个领域特定的放射学编码器，展现出强大的零样本检索性能。我们还发布了一个标注丰富的专家数据集，包含 450 多个具有临床意义的错误标签，并展示了不同指标与放射科医生判断之间的相关性。最后，RadEval 提供了统计检验工具，并在多个公开可用数据集上给出基线模型评估，促进可复现

55acb9b8a70f4259ad58639fec9da7e57320bdd0.title: Ask Patients with Patience: Enabling LLMs for Human-Centric Medical Dialogue with Grounded Reasoning
55acb9b8a70f4259ad58639fec9da7e57320bdd0.abstract: The severe shortage of medical doctors limits access to timely and reliable healthcare, leaving millions underserved. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential solution but struggle in real-world clinical interactions. Many LLMs are not grounded in authoritative medical guidelines and fail to transparently manage diagnostic uncertainty. Their language is often rigid and mechanical, lacking the human-like qualities essential for patient trust. To address these challenges, we propose Ask Patients with Patience (APP), a multi-turn LLM-based medical assistant designed for grounded reasoning, transparent diagnoses, and human-centric interaction. APP enhances communication by eliciting user symptoms through empathetic dialogue, significantly improving accessibility and user engagement. It also incorporates Bayesian active learning to support transparent and adaptive diagnoses. The framewo
55acb9b8a70f4259ad58639fec9da7e57320bdd0.zh_title: 以耐心问诊：人本医疗对话与有据推理
55acb9b8a70f4259ad58639fec9da7e57320bdd0.summary: EMNLP 2025提出Ask Pati（Ask Patients with Patience），使LLM依据权威指南开展人本化医疗对话。
key_points: 针对医生短缺与LLM临床交互不足

1c81bb341892f03e06aa7cfa6701f0d58b3d748b.title: Subtle Risks, Critical Failures: A Framework for Diagnosing Physical Safety of LLMs for Embodied Decision Making
1c81bb341892f03e06aa7cfa6701f0d58b3d748b.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision making in embodied agents, yet existing safety evaluations often rely on coarse success rates and domain-specific setups, making it difficult to diagnose why and where these models fail. This obscures our understanding of embodied safety and limits the selective deployment of LLMs in high-risk physical environments. We introduce SAFEL, the framework for systematically evaluating the physical safety of LLMs in embodied decision making. SAFEL assesses two key competencies: (1) rejecting unsafe commands via the Command Refusal Test, and (2) generating safe and executable plans via the Plan Safety Test. 0e7ccedbbb8492732ecf08901db44a81c7885c25.title: Large Language Models with Temporal Reasoning for Longitudinal Clinical Summarization and Prediction
0e7ccedbbb8492732ecf08901db44a81c7885c25.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in clinical text summarization, but their ability to handle long patient trajectories with multi-modal data spread across time remains underexplored. This study systematically evaluates several state-of-the-art open-source LLMs, their Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) variants and chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting on long-context clinical summarization and prediction. We examine their ability to synthesize structured and unstructured Electronic Health Records (EHR) data while reasoning over temporal coherence, by re-engineering existing tasks, including discharge summarization and diagnosis prediction from two publicly available EHR datasets. 8310a74ccd1a8032daccc978f5163dd83c961f25.title: Code Like Humans: A Multi-Agent Solution for Medical Coding
8310a74ccd1a8032daccc978f5163dd83c961f25.abstract: In medical coding, experts map unstructured clinical notes to alphanumeric codes for diagnoses and procedures. We introduce Code Like Humans: a new agentic framework for medical coding with large language models. It implements official coding guidelines for human experts, and it is the first solution that can support the full ICD-10 coding system (+70K labels). It achieves the best performance to date on rare diagnosis codes (fine-tuned discriminative classifiers retain an advantage for high-frequency codes, to which they are limited). Towards future work, we also contribute an analysis of system performance and identify its `blind spots'(codes that are systematically undercoded).

8310a74ccd1a8032daccc978f5163dd83c961f25.zh_abstract: 在医学编码中，专家将非结构化临床记录映射为用于诊断和操作的字母数字代码。我们提出 Code Like Humans：一种使用大语言模型进行医学编码的新智能体框架。它实现了面向人类专家的官方编码指南，并且是首个能够支持完整 ICD-10 编码系统（+70K 标签）的解决方案。它在罕见诊断代码上取得了迄今最佳性能（微调的判别式分类器在高频代码上仍保持优势，而它们仅限于高频代码）。面向未来工作，我们还贡献了对系统性能的分析，并识别出其“盲点”（被系统性编码不足的代码）。

f704d289a3a1075ded47e554f2dc08466dd64107.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising performance on medical benchmarks; however, their ability to perform medical calculations, a crucial aspect of clinical decision-making, remains underexplored and poorly evaluated. Existing benchmarks often assess only the final answer with a wide numerical tolerance, overlooking systematic reasoning failures and potentially causing serious clinical misjudgments. In this work, we revisit medical calculation evaluation with a stronger focus on clinical trustworthiness. First, we clean and restructure the MedCalc-Bench dataset and propose a new step-by-step evaluation pipeline that independently assesses formula selection, entity extraction, and arithmetic computation. f704d289a3a1075ded47e554f2dc08466dd64107.zh_title: 从分数到步骤：诊断并改进LLM的循证医学计算

40252c9440ca7450f5a15156d2116fc3981127f2.abstract: Medical question answering requires extensive access to specialized conceptual knowledge. The current paradigm, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), acquires expertise medical knowledge through large-scale corpus retrieval and uses this knowledge to guide a general-purpose large language model (LLM) for generating answers. However, existing retrieval approaches often overlook the importance of factual knowledge, which limits the relevance of retrieved conceptual knowledge and restricts its applicability in real-world scenarios, such as clinical decision-making based on Electronic Health Records (EHRs). This paper introduces RGAR, a recurrence generation-augmented retrieval framework that retrieves both relevant factual and conceptual knowledge from dual sources (i.e., EHRs and the corpus), allowing them to interact and refine each another. 40252c9440ca7450f5a15156d2116fc3981127f2.zh_title: RGAR：面向事实感知医学问答的生成增强检索

b4d051579e765d453d8a1ce2ff32f7a131d9248e.title: 3MDBench: Medical Multimodal Multi-agent Dialogue Benchmark
b4d051579e765d453d8a1ce2ff32f7a131d9248e.abstract: Though Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are being actively explored in medicine, their ability to conduct complex real-world telemedicine consultations combining accurate diagnosis with professional dialogue remains underexplored. This paper presents 3MDBench (Medical Multimodal Multi-agent Dialogue Benchmark), an open-source framework for simulating and evaluating LVLM-driven telemedical consultations. 3MDBench simulates patient variability through temperament-based Patient Agent and evaluates diagnostic accuracy and dialogue quality via Assessor Agent. It includes 2996 cases across 34 diagnoses from real-world telemedicine interactions, combining textual and image-based data. ef9678b094c7ad6ae6efa1ed587731b19f4fb5cd.title: Empowering Healthcare Practitioners with Language Models: Structuring Speech Transcripts in Two Real-World Clinical Applications
ef9678b094c7ad6ae6efa1ed587731b19f4fb5cd.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4o and o1 have demonstrated strong performance on clinical natural language processing (NLP) tasks across multiple medical benchmarks. Nonetheless, two high-impact NLP tasks - structured tabular reporting from nurse dictations and medical order extraction from doctor-patient consultations - remain underexplored due to data scarcity and sensitivity, despite active industry efforts. Practical solutions to these real-world clinical tasks can significantly reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers, allowing greater focus on patient care. In this paper, we investigate these two challenging tasks using private and open-source clinical datasets, evaluating the performance of both open- and closed-weight LLMs, and analyzing their respective strengths and limitations. ef9678b094c7ad6ae6efa1ed587731b19f4fb5cd.zh_title: 语言模型用于真实临床语音转写结构化任务

ef9678b094c7ad6ae6efa1ed587731b19f4fb5cd.zh_abstract: 如 GPT-4o 和 o1 之类的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）已在多个医学基准的临床自然语言处理（natural language processing, NLP）任务上展现出强劲性能。尽管如此，两项高影响力的 NLP 任务——根据护士口述生成结构化表格报告，以及从医患问诊中提取医嘱——由于数据稀缺和敏感性，仍未被充分探索，尽管业界已有积极努力。针对这些真实世界临床任务的实用解决方案可以显著减轻医疗提供者的文书负担，使其能够更专注于患者照护。在本文中，我们使用私有和开源临床数据集研究这两项具有挑战性的任务，评估开放权重和闭权重 LLM 的性能，并分析它们各自的优势与局限。此外，我们提出一种代理式流水线，用于生成逼真、非敏感

cf927d5a0044eb56d203335949067c69c8184a45.title: Trustworthy Medical Question Answering: An Evaluation-Centric Survey
cf927d5a0044eb56d203335949067c69c8184a45.abstract: Trustworthiness in healthcare question-answering (QA) systems is important for ensuring patient safety, clinical effectiveness, and user confidence. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into medical settings, the reliability of their responses directly influences clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. However, achieving comprehensive trustworthiness in medical QA poses significant challenges due to the inherent complexity of healthcare data, the critical nature of clinical scenarios, and the multifaceted dimensions of trustworthy AI. In this survey, we systematically examine six key dimensions of trustworthiness in medical QA, i.e., Factuality, Robustness, Fairness, Safety, Explainability, and Calibration. cf927d5a0044eb56d203335949067c69c8184a45.zh_abstract: 医疗保健问答（QA）系统中的可信度对于确保患者安全、临床有效性和用户信心非常重要。随着大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地集成到医疗环境中，其响应的可靠性直接影响临床决策和患者结果。然而，由于医疗数据的固有复杂性、临床场景的关键性质以及可信AI的多方面维度，在医学QA中实现全面的可信度面临重大挑战。在这篇综述中，我们系统地考察了医学QA中可信度的六个关键维度，即事实性（Factuality）、鲁棒性（Robustness）、公平性（Fairness）、安全性（Safety）、可解释性（Explainability）和校准性（Calibration）。我们回顾了在现有的基于LLM的医学QA系统中每个维度是如何被评估的。我们汇编并比较了旨在评估这些 d 的主要基准。

66f9a84c44e147fdad9d983a0ca52d9284ee17f2.title: AUTOCT: Automating Interpretable Clinical Trial Prediction with LLM Agents
66f9a84c44e147fdad9d983a0ca52d9284ee17f2.abstract: Clinical trials are critical for advancing medical treatments but remain prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. Accurate prediction of clinical trial outcomes can significantly reduce research and development costs and accelerate drug discovery. In this work, we propose AutoCT, a novel framework that combines the reasoning capabilities of large language models with the explainability of classical machine learning. AutoCT autonomously generates, evaluates, and refines tabular features based on public information without human input. 66f9a84c44e147fdad9d983a0ca52d9284ee17f2.zh_title: AUTOCT：用LLM智能体自动化可解释临床试验预测

1395b448abbd77a8d7ff1bac04d09b92e5f61269.title: Assessing and Mitigating Medical Knowledge Drift and Conflicts in Large Language Models
1395b448abbd77a8d7ff1bac04d09b92e5f61269.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have great potential in the field of health care, yet they face great challenges in adapting to rapidly evolving medical knowledge. This can lead to outdated or contradictory treatment suggestions. This study investigated how LLMs respond to evolving clinical guidelines, focusing on concept drift and internal inconsistencies. We developed the DriftMedQA benchmark to simulate guideline evolution and assessed the temporal reliability of various LLMs. Our evaluation of seven state-of-the-art models across 4,290 scenarios demonstrated difficulties in rejecting outdated recommendations and frequently endorsing conflicting guidance. Additionally, we explored two mitigation strategies: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and preference fine-tuning via Direct Preference Optimization. 1395b448abbd77a8d7ff1bac04d09b92e5f61269.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医疗保健领域具有巨大潜力，但它们在适应快速发展的医学知识方面面临巨大挑战。这可能导致过时或矛盾的治疗建议。本研究调查了 LLMs 如何响应不断演变的临床指南，重点关注概念漂移和内部不一致性。我们开发了 DriftMedQA 基准来模拟指南演变，并评估了各种 LLMs 的时间可靠性。我们对七种最先进模型在 4,290 个场景中的评估表明，它们在拒绝过时建议方面存在困难，并经常认可相互矛盾的指导。此外，我们探索了两种缓解策略：检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）和通过直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization）进行偏好微调。虽然每种方法都提高了模型性能，但它们的组合带来了最一致的

da985d14eb39c71e18b35410afd844a4e5693e41.title: How Real Are Synthetic Therapy Conversations? Evaluating Fidelity in Prolonged Exposure Dialogues
da985d14eb39c71e18b35410afd844a4e5693e41.abstract: Synthetic data adoption in healthcare is driven by privacy concerns, data access limitations, and high annotation costs. We explore synthetic Prolonged Exposure (PE) therapy conversations for PTSD as a scalable alternative for training clinical models. We systematically compare real and synthetic dialogues using linguistic, structural, and protocol-specific metrics like turn-taking and treatment fidelity. We introduce and evaluate PE-specific metrics, offering a novel framework for assessing clinical fidelity beyond surface fluency. Our findings show that while synthetic data successfully mitigates data scarcity and protects privacy, capturing the most subtle therapeutic dynamics remains a complex challenge. da985d14eb39c71e18b35410afd844a4e5693e41.zh_title: 合成治疗对话有多真实？延长暴露对话保真度评估
da985d14eb39c71e18b35410afd844a4e5693e41.summary: 研究合成PTSD延长暴露治疗对话，并从语言、结构与治疗协议等指标评估其保真度。
key_points: 合成数据受隐私与标注成本驱动
对比真实与合成对话的多项指标

da985d14eb39c71e18b35410afd844a4e5693e41.zh_abstract: 医疗保健中合成数据的采用由隐私顾虑、数据获取限制和高标注成本驱动。我们探索针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）的合成延长暴露（Prolonged Exposure, PE）治疗对话，作为训练临床模型的可扩展替代方案。我们使用语言、结构和方案特定指标（如话轮转换和治疗保真度）系统比较真实对话与合成对话。我们引入并评估PE特定指标，提供了一个超越表面流畅度评估临床保真度的新框架。我们的研究结果表明，尽管合成数据成功缓解数据稀缺并保护隐私，捕捉最细微的治疗动态仍然是一个复杂挑战。合成对话成功复现真实对话的关键语言特征，例如达到相似的可读性分数（89.2 vs. 88.1），同时显示出差异

c9e40759be37d6b3d0883e79c283249380e7f852.title: Knowledge-enhanced Multimodal ECG Representation Learning with Arbitrary-Lead Inputs
c9e40759be37d6b3d0883e79c283249380e7f852.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal ECG representation learning center on aligning ECG signals with paired free-text reports. However, suboptimal alignment persists due to the complexity of medical language and the reliance on a full 12-lead setup, which is often unavailable in under-resourced settings. To tackle these issues, we propose **K-MERL**, a knowledge-enhanced multimodal ECG representation learning framework. **K-MERL** leverages large language models to extract structured knowledge from free-text reports and employs a lead-aware ECG encoder with dynamic lead masking to accommodate arbitrary lead inputs. Evaluations on six external ECG datasets show that **K-MERL** achieves state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot classification and linear probing tasks, while delivering an average **16%** AUC improvement over existing methods in partial-lead zero-shot classification.
c9e40759be37d6b3d0883e79c283249380e7f852.zh_title: K-MERL：支持任意导联输入的知识增强多模态心电表示学习
c9e40759be37d6b3d0883e79c283249380e7f852.summary: EMNLP 2025 提出 K-MERL，用大模型抽取结构化知识增强心电—文本对齐，并支持任意导联输入。
key_points: 心电与文本报告对齐效果欠佳
依赖十二导联限制资源不足场景
用大模型抽取结构化知识增强
c9e40759be37d6b3d0883e79c283249380e7f852.zh_abstract: 多模态心电图（ECG）表示学习的最新进展集中于将ECG信号与配对的自由文本报告对齐。然而，由于医学语言的复杂性以及对完整12导联设置的依赖，对齐效果仍不理想；而在资源匮乏的环境中，完整12导联设置往往无法获得。为解决这些问题，我们提出**K-MERL**，一个知识增强的多模态ECG表示学习框架。**K-MERL**利用大语言模型从自由文本报告中提取结构化知识，并采用具有动态导联掩码的导联感知ECG编码器，以适应任意导联输入。在六个外部ECG数据集上的评估表明，**K-MERL**在零样本分类和线性探测任务中取得了最先进的性能，同时在部分导联零样本分类中比现有方法平均提升**16%**的AUC。

ba1e5a5461774480a591340ee105f3e044240a87.title: Elucidating Mechanisms of Demographic Bias in LLMs for Healthcare
ba1e5a5461774480a591340ee105f3e044240a87.abstract: We know from prior work that LLMs encode social biases, and that this manifests in clinical tasks. In this work we adopt tools from mechanistic interpretability to unveil sociodemographic representations and biases within LLMs in the context of healthcare. Specifically, we ask: Can we identify activations within LLMs that encode sociodemographic information (e.g., gender, race)? We find that gender information is highly localized in MLP layers and can be reliably manipulated at inference time via patching. Such interventions can surgically alter generated clinical vignettes for specific conditions, and also influence downstream clinical predictions which correlate with gender, e.g., patient risk of depression. ba1e5a5461774480a591340ee105f3e044240a87.zh_title: 阐释医疗LLM中人口统计偏见的机制
ba1e5a5461774480a591340ee105f3e044240a87.summary: 利用机制可解释性工具，识别LLM中编码社会人口统计信息的激活，并揭示医疗场景下的偏见。
key_points: LLM编码社会偏见并体现在临床任务
采用机制可解释性方法分析
性别信息高度定位于MLP层且可推理时操纵
ba1e5a5461774480a591340ee105f3e044240a87.zh_abstract: 我们从先前工作中知道，大语言模型（LLMs）会编码社会偏见，并且这会在临床任务中显现。在这项工作中，我们采用机制可解释性工具，在医疗保健背景下揭示LLM内部的社会人口统计学表征和偏见。具体而言，我们问：我们能否识别LLM中编码社会人口统计学信息（例如性别、种族）的激活？我们发现性别信息高度集中在MLP层中，并且可以在推理时通过修补可靠地操纵。此类干预可以精准改变针对特定疾病生成的临床情景案例，也会影响与性别相关的下游临床预测，例如患者抑郁风险。我们发现患者种族的表征在某种程度上更为分散，但也可以在一定程度上进行干预。据我们所知，这是机制…的首次应用

60405001f4b8ded61c2bb2f9b64e170dd2dc0fa3.title: MedFact: A Large-scale Chinese Dataset for Evidence-based Medical Fact-checking of LLM Responses
60405001f4b8ded61c2bb2f9b64e170dd2dc0fa3.abstract: Medical fact-checking has become increasingly critical as more individuals seek medical information online. However, existing datasets predominantly focus on human-generated content, leaving the verification of content generated by large language models (LLMs) relatively unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MedFact, the first evidence-based Chinese medical fact-checking dataset of LLM-generated medical content. It consists of 1,321 questions and 7,409 claims, mirroring the complexities of real-world medical scenarios. We conduct comprehensive experiments in both in-context learning (ICL) and fine-tuning settings, showcasing the capability and challenges of current LLMs on this task, accompanied by an in-depth error analysis to point out key directions for future research. Our dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/AshleyChenNLP/MedFact.
60405001f4b8ded61c2bb2f9b64e170dd2dc0fa3.zh_title: MedFact：LLM医学回答循证事实核查中文数据集
60405001f4b8ded61c2bb2f9b64e170dd2dc0fa3.summary: 提出首个面向LLM生成医学内容的循证中文事实核查数据集，含1321个问题与7409条论断。
key_points: 首个针对LLM生成医学内容的中文事实核查数据集
包含1321个问题、7409条论断
现有数据集多聚焦人类生成内容
60405001f4b8ded61c2bb2f9b64e170dd2dc0fa3.zh_abstract: 随着越来越多的人在线上寻求医疗信息，医学事实核查已变得日益关键。然而，现有数据集主要关注人类生成的内容，使得对大型语言模型（LLMs）生成内容的验证相对未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 MedFact，这是首个基于证据的、针对 LLM 生成医学内容的中文医学事实核查数据集。它包含 1,321 个问题和 7,409 条声明，反映了真实世界医学场景的复杂性。我们在上下文学习（ICL）和微调两种设置下进行了全面实验，展示了当前 LLMs 在该任务上的能力与挑战，并辅以深入的错误分析，以指出未来研究的关键方向。我们的数据集公开可用，地址为 https://github.com/AshleyChenNLP/MedFact。

b934506667c543abd32ce9dd27b739d9eb19bb0c.title: Toward Reliable Clinical Coding with Language Models: Verification and Lightweight Adaptation
b934506667c543abd32ce9dd27b739d9eb19bb0c.abstract: Accurate clinical coding is essential for healthcare documentation, billing, and decision-making. While prior work shows that off-the-shelf LLMs struggle with this task, evaluations based on exact match metrics often overlook errors where predicted codes are hierarchically close but incorrect. Our analysis reveals that such hierarchical misalignments account for a substantial portion of LLM failures. We show that lightweight interventions, including prompt engineering and small-scale fine-tuning, can improve accuracy without the computational overhead of search-based methods. To address hierarchically near-miss errors, we introduce clinical code verification as both a standalone task and a pipeline component. b934506667c543abd32ce9dd27b739d9eb19bb0c.zh_title: 面向可靠临床编码的语言模型：验证与轻量适配
b934506667c543abd32ce9dd27b739d9eb19bb0c.summary: 分析 LLM 临床编码失败，指出层级错配占比大，并展示提示工程与小规模微调等轻量干预。

6530be9dce96386acb79a5d27ecf517b4f4e07b5.title: SuPreME: A Supervised Pre-training Framework for Multimodal ECG Representation Learning
6530be9dce96386acb79a5d27ecf517b4f4e07b5.abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are a leading cause of death and disability worldwide. Electrocardiogram (ECG) is critical for diagnosing and monitoring cardiac health, but obtaining large-scale annotated ECG datasets is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Recent ECG Self-Supervised Learning (eSSL) methods mitigate this by learning features without extensive labels but fail to capture fine-grained clinical semantics and require extensive task-specific fine-tuning. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{SuPreME}$, a $\textbf{Su}$pervised $\textbf{Pre}$-training framework for $\textbf{M}$ultimodal $\textbf{E}$CG representation learning. 6530be9dce96386acb79a5d27ecf517b4f4e07b5.zh_title: SuPreME：多模态心电图表征监督预训练框架
6530be9dce96386acb79a5d27ecf517b4f4e07b5.summary: 提出SuPreME监督预训练框架，学习多模态ECG表征，减少标注依赖。

监督预训练减少标注
提升心血管诊断性能
6530be9dce96386acb79a5d27ecf517b4f4e07b5.zh_abstract: 心血管疾病是全球范围内死亡和残疾的主要原因。心电图（ECG）对于诊断和监测心脏健康至关重要，但获取大规模带标注的ECG数据集既费力又耗时。近期的ECG自监督学习（eSSL）方法通过在没有大量标签的情况下学习特征来缓解这一问题，但未能捕捉细粒度的临床语义，并且需要大量任务特定的微调。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 $\textbf{SuPreME}$，一个用于 $\textbf{M}$ultimodal $\textbf{E}$CG 表征学习的 $\textbf{Su}$pervised $\textbf{Pre}$-training 框架。SuPreME 使用结构化诊断标签进行预训练，这些标签通过大型语言模型（LLMs）的一次性离线抽取从ECG报告实体中获得，有助于去噪、标准化心脏概念，并改善临床表征学习

62b7fa550c5af54211db695c00d64ed15dee556e.title: DischargeSim: A Simulation Benchmark for Educational Doctor–Patient Communication at Discharge
62b7fa550c5af54211db695c00d64ed15dee556e.abstract: Discharge communication is a critical yet underexplored component of patient care, where the goal shifts from diagnosis to education. While recent large language model (LLM) benchmarks emphasize in-visit diagnostic reasoning, they fail to evaluate models’ ability to support patients after the visit. We introduce DischargeSim, a novel benchmark that evaluates LLMs on their ability to act as personalized discharge educators. DischargeSim simulates post-visit, multi-turn conversations between LLM-driven DoctorAgents and PatientAgents with diverse psychosocial profiles (e.g., health literacy, education, emotion). 62b7fa550c5af54211db695c00d64ed15dee556e.zh_title: DischargeSim：出院医患沟通的模拟评测基准
62b7fa550c5af54211db695c00d64ed15dee556e.summary: 提出DischargeSim基准，通过多轮模拟对话评测大模型在出院教育场景中的沟通能力。

62b7fa550c5af54211db695c00d64ed15dee556e.zh_abstract: 出院沟通是患者护理中关键但尚未充分探索的组成部分，其目标从诊断转向教育。尽管近期的大语言模型（LLM）基准强调就诊期间的诊断推理，但它们未能评估模型在就诊后支持患者的能力。我们提出 DischargeSim，一个新颖的基准，用于评估 LLM 作为个性化出院教育者的能力。DischargeSim 模拟就诊后、由 LLM 驱动的 DoctorAgents 与具有多样心理社会特征（例如健康素养、教育、情绪）的 PatientAgents 之间的多轮对话。交互围绕六个基于临床的出院主题构建，并从三个维度进行评估：（1）通过自动评估和 LLM 作为评判者评估对话质量，（2）个性化文档生成，包括自由文本摘要和结构化的 AHRQ 检查清单，以及（3）患者

194828ad6317272dda3d7966e86f7549e33f5eef.title: Causal Representation Learning from Multimodal Clinical Records under Non-Random Modality Missingness
194828ad6317272dda3d7966e86f7549e33f5eef.abstract: Clinical notes contain rich patient information, such as diagnoses or medications, making them valuable for patient representation learning. Recent advances in large language models have further improved the ability to extract meaningful representations from clinical texts. However, clinical notes are often missing. For example, in our analysis of the MIMIC-IV dataset, 24.5% of patients have no available discharge summaries. In such cases, representations can be learned from other modalities such as structured data, chest X-rays, or radiology reports. Yet the availability of these modalities is influenced by clinical decision-making and varies across patients, resulting in modality missing-not-at-random (MMNAR) patterns. 194828ad6317272dda3d7966e86f7549e33f5eef.zh_title: 非随机模态缺失下多模态临床记录的因果表征学习
194828ad6317272dda3d7966e86f7549e33f5eef.summary: 针对临床笔记缺失问题（MIMIC-IV中24.5%患者无出院小结），提出多模态临床记录的因果表征学习。

194828ad6317272dda3d7966e86f7549e33f5eef.zh_abstract: 临床笔记包含丰富的患者信息，例如诊断或药物，这使其对患者表征学习具有价值。大语言模型的近期进展进一步提高了从临床文本中提取有意义表征的能力。然而，临床笔记常常缺失。例如，在我们对 MIMIC-IV 数据集的分析中，24.5% 的患者没有可用的出院小结。在这类情况下，可以从其他模态学习表征，例如结构化数据、胸部 X 射线或放射学报告。然而，这些模态的可用性受到临床决策的影响，并因患者而异，导致模态非随机缺失（modality missing-not-at-random, MMNAR）模式。我们提出一个因果表征学习框架，该框架利用多模态临床记录中的观测数据和有信息缺失。它包含：（1）一个 MMN

f8d35eb644443ec356e594f96c0b6454ffc6590d.title: Not What the Doctor Ordered: Surveying LLM-based De-identification and Quantifying Clinical Information Loss
f8d35eb644443ec356e594f96c0b6454ffc6590d.abstract: De-identification in the healthcare setting is an application of NLP where automated algorithms are used to remove personally identifying information of patients (and, sometimes, providers). With the recent rise of generative large language models (LLMs), there has been a corresponding rise in the number of papers that apply LLMs to de-identification. Although these approaches often report near-perfect results, significant challenges concerning reproducibility and utility of the research papers persist. This paper identifies three key limitations in the current literature: inconsistent reporting metrics hindering direct comparisons, the inadequacy of traditional classification metrics in capturing errors which LLMs may be more prone to (i.e., altering clinically relevant information), and lack of manual validation of automated metrics which aim to quantify these errors. To address these
f8d35eb644443ec356e594f96c0b6454ffc6590d.zh_title: LLM 去标识化综述：量化临床信息损失
f8d35eb644443ec356e594f96c0b6454ffc6590d.summary: 综述基于大语言模型的临床文本去标识化研究，并量化由此带来的临床信息损失。

量化去标识化的信息损失
f8d35eb644443ec356e594f96c0b6454ffc6590d.zh_abstract: 在医疗环境中，去标识化（de-identification）是自然语言处理（NLP）的一种应用，其中使用自动化算法移除患者的个人可识别信息（有时也包括提供者的信息）。随着生成式大型语言模型（LLMs）近来的兴起，将 LLM 应用于去标识化的论文数量也相应增加。尽管这些方法通常报告近乎完美的结果，但有关研究论文可重复性和实用性的重大挑战仍然存在。本文指出了当前文献中的三个关键局限：报告指标不一致，阻碍直接比较；传统分类指标不足以捕捉 LLM 可能更易犯的错误（即更改临床相关信息）；以及缺乏对旨在量化这些错误的自动化指标进行人工验证。为解决这些

bfcb3998ad89e61699fc45a5f099e916eaceb2c7.title: A Knowledge-driven Adaptive Collaboration of LLMs for Enhancing Medical Decision-making
bfcb3998ad89e61699fc45a5f099e916eaceb2c7.abstract: Medical decision-making often involves integrating knowledge from multiple clinical specialties, typically achieved through multidisciplinary teams. Inspired by this collaborative process, recent work has leveraged large language models (LLMs) in multi-agent collaboration frameworks to emulate expert teamwork. While these approaches improve reasoning through agent interaction, they are limited by static, pre-assigned roles, which hinder adaptability and dynamic knowledge integration. To address these limitations, we propose KAMAC, a Knowledge-driven Adaptive Multi-Agent Collaboration framework that enables LLM agents to dynamically form and expand expert teams based on the evolving diagnostic context. KAMAC begins with one or more expert agents and then conducts a knowledge-driven discussion to identify and fill knowledge gaps by recruiting additional specialists as needed. This supports
bfcb3998ad89e61699fc45a5f099e916eaceb2c7.zh_title: 知识驱动的LLM自适应协作提升医疗决策

bfcb3998ad89e61699fc45a5f099e916eaceb2c7.zh_abstract: 医疗决策通常涉及整合来自多个临床专科的知识，这通常通过多学科团队实现。受这一协作过程的启发，近期工作在多智能体协作框架中利用大型语言模型（LLMs）来模拟专家团队合作。尽管这些方法通过智能体交互改进了推理，但它们受限于静态、预先分配的角色，这阻碍了适应性和动态知识整合。为解决这些局限，我们提出 KAMAC，一个知识驱动的自适应多智能体协作框架，使 LLM 智能体能够基于不断演变的诊断情境动态组建并扩展专家团队。KAMAC 从一个或多个专家智能体开始，然后进行知识驱动的讨论，以识别并通过按需招募额外专家来填补知识空白。这支持

a1408bfa829144b16d38c48c456d014e3e00d8c9.title: No Black Boxes: Interpretable and Interactable Predictive Healthcare with Knowledge-Enhanced Agentic Causal Discovery
a1408bfa829144b16d38c48c456d014e3e00d8c9.abstract: Deep learning models trained on extensive Electronic Health Records (EHR) data have achieved high accuracy in diagnosis prediction, offering the potential to assist clinicians in decision-making and treatment planning. However, these models lack two crucial features that clinicians highly value: interpretability and interactivity. The ``black-box''nature of these models makes it difficult for clinicians to understand the reasoning behind predictions, limiting their ability to make informed decisions. Additionally, the absence of interactive mechanisms prevents clinicians from incorporating their own knowledge and experience into the decision-making process. a1408bfa829144b16d38c48c456d014e3e00d8c9.zh_title: 知识增强智能体因果发现：可解释可交互的EHR预测
a1408bfa829144b16d38c48c456d014e3e00d8c9.summary: 提出知识增强的智能体因果发现方法，提升基于EHR诊断预测的可解释性与交互性。
key_points: EHR诊断预测模型精度高但属黑箱
引入知识增强与智能体因果发现
强调可解释与可交互两项特性
a1408bfa829144b16d38c48c456d014e3e00d8c9.zh_abstract: 在大量电子健康记录（Electronic Health Records, EHR）数据上训练的深度学习模型在诊断预测中达到了高准确率，具有协助临床医生进行决策和治疗规划的潜力。然而，这些模型缺乏临床医生高度重视的两个关键特性：可解释性和交互性。这些模型的“黑箱”性质使临床医生难以理解预测背后的推理，限制了他们做出明智决策的能力。此外，缺乏交互机制阻止了临床医生将自己的知识和经验纳入决策过程。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 II-KEA，一个知识增强的智能体驱动的因果发现框架，它集成了个性化知识数据库和智能体大型语言模型（agentic LLMs）。II-KEA 通过显式推理增强可解释性

8270b8d8dd71bfbb366b3bf52c166fd3341ae38a.title: Factuality Beyond Coherence: Evaluating LLM Watermarking Methods for Medical Texts
8270b8d8dd71bfbb366b3bf52c166fd3341ae38a.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are adapted to sensitive domains such as medicine, their fluency raises safety risks, particularly regarding provenance and accountability. Watermarking embeds detectable patterns to mitigate these risks, yet its reliability in medical contexts remains untested. Existing benchmarks focus on detection-quality tradeoffs and overlook factual risks. In medical text, watermarking often reweights low-entropy tokens, which are highly predictable and often carry critical medical terminology. Shifting these tokens can cause inaccuracy and hallucinations, risks that prior general-domain benchmarks fail to capture. We propose a medical-focused evaluation workflow that jointly assesses factual accuracy and coherence. Using GPT-Judger and further human validation, we introduce the Factuality-Weighted Score (FWS), a composite metric prioritizing factual accuracy beyond
8270b8d8dd71bfbb366b3bf52c166fd3341ae38a.zh_title: 超越连贯性：医学文本大模型水印方法的事实性评估
8270b8d8dd71bfbb366b3bf52c166fd3341ae38a.summary: EMNLP 2025 论文评估大模型水印在医学文本中的可靠性，指出既有基准忽视事实风险。
key_points: 水印用于溯源与问责，医学场景可靠性尚未验证
现有基准只关注检测质量权衡

8270b8d8dd71bfbb366b3bf52c166fd3341ae38a.zh_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）被适配到医学等敏感领域，其流畅性带来了安全风险，尤其是在来源溯源与问责方面。水印通过嵌入可检测的模式来缓解这些风险，但其在医学语境中的可靠性仍未得到检验。现有基准关注检测质量之间的权衡，而忽视了事实性风险。在医学文本中，水印往往会重新加权低熵词元（token），这些词元高度可预测，且常常承载关键的医学术语。改变这些词元可能导致不准确和幻觉，而这些风险是先前通用领域基准无法捕捉的。我们提出了一个以医学为重点的评估工作流程，联合评估事实准确性和连贯性。使用 GPT-Judger 并进一步进行人工验证，我们引入了事实性加权分数（Factuality-Weighted Score, FWS），这是一种将事实准确性置于优先地位、超越……的复合指标

5ed877ee3a7f32af225661200516020fa1534c5f.title: ReDepress: A Cognitive Framework for Detecting Depression Relapse from Social Media
5ed877ee3a7f32af225661200516020fa1534c5f.abstract: Almost 50% depression patients face the risk of going into relapse. The risk increases to 80% after the second episode of depression. Although, depression detection from social media has attained considerable attention, depression relapse detection has remained largely unexplored due to the lack of curated datasets and the difficulty of distinguishing relapse and non-relapse users. In this work, we present ReDepress, the first clinically validated social media dataset focused on relapse, comprising 204 Reddit users annotated by mental health professionals. Unlike prior approaches, our framework draws on cognitive theories of depression, incorporating constructs such as attention bias, interpretation bias, memory bias and rumination into both annotation and modeling. Through statistical analyses and machine learning experiments, we demonstrate that cognitive markers significantly differen
5ed877ee3a7f32af225661200516020fa1534c5f.zh_title: ReDepress：社交媒体抑郁症复发检测认知框架
5ed877ee3a7f32af225661200516020fa1534c5f.summary: 提出首个经临床验证的社交媒体抑郁症复发数据集与检测框架ReDepress，应对复发检测数据稀缺与用户区分难题。
key_points: 近50%抑郁症患者面临复发风险

5ed877ee3a7f32af225661200516020fa1534c5f.zh_abstract: 几乎 50% 的抑郁症患者面临复发风险。在第二次抑郁发作后，该风险增至 80%。尽管从社交媒体进行抑郁检测已获得相当多关注，但由于缺乏经过整理的数据集以及区分复发与非复发用户的难度，抑郁复发检测在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们提出 ReDepress，首个经临床验证、聚焦复发的社交媒体数据集，包含由心理健康专业人员标注的 204 名 Reddit 用户。与先前方法不同，我们的框架借鉴抑郁症认知理论，将注意偏向、解释偏向、记忆偏向和反刍等构念纳入标注和建模。通过统计分析和机器学习实验，我们证明认知标记显著不同

447101bf2b9aa22037fa624dc561a7cd119ff8ed.title: Rethinking Text-based Protein Understanding: Retrieval or LLM?
447101bf2b9aa22037fa624dc561a7cd119ff8ed.abstract: In recent years, protein-text models have gained significant attention for their potential in protein generation and understanding. Current approaches focus on integrating protein-related knowledge into large language models through continued pretraining and multi-modal alignment, enabling simultaneous comprehension of textual descriptions and protein sequences. Through a thorough analysis of existing model architectures and text-based protein understanding benchmarks, we identify significant data leakage issues present in current benchmarks. Moreover, conventional metrics derived from natural language processing fail to accurately assess the model's performance in this domain. 447101bf2b9aa22037fa624dc561a7cd119ff8ed.zh_title: 重新思考基于文本的蛋白质理解：检索还是LLM？
447101bf2b9aa22037fa624dc561a7cd119ff8ed.summary: EMNLP 2025论文，分析基于文本的蛋白质理解现有模型与基准，探讨检索与LLM路径。

447101bf2b9aa22037fa624dc561a7cd119ff8ed.zh_abstract: 近年来，蛋白质-文本模型因其在蛋白质生成与理解方面的潜力而受到显著关注。当前的方法专注于通过持续预训练和多模态对齐，将蛋白质相关知识整合到大语言模型中，从而能够同时理解文本描述和蛋白质序列。通过对现有模型架构和基于文本的蛋白质理解基准的深入分析，我们发现当前基准中存在显著的数据泄漏问题。此外，源自自然语言处理的传统指标无法准确评估模型在该领域的表现。为解决这些局限，我们重新组织了现有数据集，并引入了一个基于生物实体的新评估框架。受我们观察结果的启发，我们提出了一种检索增强的方法，该方法……

42c50fa673658c4651022f623a09627b126ea627.title: How to Make Large Language Models Generate 100% Valid Molecules?
42c50fa673658c4651022f623a09627b126ea627.abstract: Molecule generation is key to drug discovery and materials science, enabling the design of novel compounds with specific properties. Large language models (LLMs) can learn to perform a wide range of tasks from just a few examples. However, generating valid molecules using representations like SMILES is challenging for LLMs in few-shot settings. In this work, we explore how LLMs can generate 100% valid molecules. We evaluate whether LLMs can use SELFIES, a representation where every string corresponds to a valid molecule, for valid molecule generation but find that LLMs perform worse with SELFIES than with SMILES. We then examine LLMs'ability to correct invalid SMILES and find their capacity limited. Finally, we introduce SmiSelf, a cross-chemical language framework for invalid SMILES correction. SmiSelf converts invalid SMILES to SELFIES using grammatical rules, leveraging SELFIES'mechan
42c50fa673658c4651022f623a09627b126ea627.zh_title: 如何让大语言模型生成100%合法分子？
42c50fa673658c4651022f623a09627b126ea627.summary: EMNLP 2025探讨LLM少样本生成合法分子的挑战，并评估其对SELFIES等表示的可用性。
key_points: 少样本下LLM生成SMILES合法分子困难
探索实现100%合法分子的途径

42c50fa673658c4651022f623a09627b126ea627.zh_abstract: 分子生成是药物发现和材料科学的关键，能够设计具有特定性质的新型化合物。大型语言模型（LLMs）可以仅从少量示例中学会执行广泛任务。然而，在少样本设置下，使用 SMILES 等表示生成有效分子对 LLM 具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们探索 LLM 如何生成 100% 有效的分子。我们评估 LLM 是否可以使用 SELFIES（一种每个字符串都对应一个有效分子的表示）进行有效分子生成，但发现 LLM 使用 SELFIES 的表现比使用 SMILES 更差。然后，我们检查 LLM 纠正无效 SMILES 的能力，发现其能力有限。最后，我们提出 SmiSelf，一个用于无效 SMILES 纠正的跨化学语言框架。SmiSelf 使用语法规则将无效 SMILES 转换为 SELFIES，利用 SELFIES 的机制

313a406ceb1c06d71cab6cd896ecf845ad195b12.title: "What's Up, Doc?": Analyzing How Users Seek Health Information in Large-Scale Conversational AI Datasets
313a406ceb1c06d71cab6cd896ecf845ad195b12.abstract: People are increasingly seeking healthcare information from large language models (LLMs) via interactive chatbots, yet the nature and inherent risks of these conversations remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we filter large-scale conversational AI datasets to achieve HealthChat-11K, a curated dataset of 11K real-world conversations composed of 25K user messages. We use HealthChat-11K and a clinician-driven taxonomy for how users interact with LLMs when seeking healthcare information in order to systematically study user interactions across 21 distinct health specialties. Our analysis reveals insights into the nature of how and why users seek health information, such as common interactions, instances of incomplete context, affective behaviors, and interactions (e.g., leading questions) that can induce sycophancy, underscoring the need for improvements in the healthcare support capab
313a406ceb1c06d71cab6cd896ecf845ad195b12.zh_title: “怎么了，医生？”：分析用户在大规模对话AI中寻求健康信息
313a406ceb1c06d71cab6cd896ecf845ad195b12.summary: 该研究构建HealthChat-11K数据集，分析用户通过对话AI寻求健康信息的行为。

基于临床医生分类法分析用户交互方式
313a406ceb1c06d71cab6cd896ecf845ad195b12.zh_abstract: 人们越来越多地通过交互式聊天机器人从大型语言模型（LLMs）获取医疗保健信息，然而这些对话的性质和固有风险在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们过滤大规模对话式 AI 数据集，构建了 HealthChat-11K，这是一个包含 11K 真实世界对话、由 25K 用户消息组成的精选数据集。我们使用 HealthChat-11K 以及一个由临床医生驱动的分类体系（用于描述用户在寻求医疗保健信息时如何与 LLMs 交互），系统性地研究跨 21 个不同健康专科的用户交互。我们的分析揭示了关于用户如何以及为何寻求健康信息的性质的洞见，例如常见交互、不完整上下文的情形、情感行为，以及可能诱导谄媚的交互（例如，诱导性问题），凸显了改进医疗保健支持 capab 的必要性。

2874cba89249c19d4cb57603505dfc2a7dfe5bfc.title: MedEBench: Diagnosing Reliability in Text-Guided Medical Image Editing
2874cba89249c19d4cb57603505dfc2a7dfe5bfc.abstract: Text-guided image editing has seen significant progress in natural image domains, but its application in medical imaging remains limited and lacks standardized evaluation frameworks. Such editing could revolutionize clinical practices by enabling personalized surgical planning, enhancing medical education, and improving patient communication. To bridge this gap, we introduce MedEBench1, a robust benchmark designed to diagnose reliability in text-guided medical image editing. MedEBench consists of 1,182 clinically curated image-prompt pairs covering 70 distinct editing tasks and 13 anatomical regions. It contributes in three key areas: (1) a clinically grounded evaluation framework that measures Editing Accuracy, Context Preservation, and Visual Quality, complemented by detailed descriptions of intended edits and corresponding Region-of-Interest (ROI) masks; (2) a comprehensive comparison
2874cba89249c19d4cb57603505dfc2a7dfe5bfc.zh_title: MedEBench：诊断文本引导医学图像编辑可靠性
2874cba89249c19d4cb57603505dfc2a7dfe5bfc.summary: EMNLP 2025 Findings 提出 MedEBench 基准，用于诊断文本引导医学图像编辑的可靠性。

2874cba89249c19d4cb57603505dfc2a7dfe5bfc.zh_abstract: 文本引导的图像编辑在自然图像领域已取得显著进展，但其在医学影像中的应用仍然有限，且缺乏标准化评估框架。此类编辑可以通过实现个性化手术规划、增强医学教育以及改善患者沟通来彻底改变临床实践。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 MedEBench1，一个稳健的基准，旨在诊断文本引导的医学图像编辑的可靠性。MedEBench 包含 1,182 个临床精选的图像-提示对，覆盖 70 个不同的编辑任务和 13 个解剖区域。它在三个关键方面作出贡献：（1）一个临床基础评估框架，衡量编辑准确性、上下文保持和视觉质量，并辅以对预期编辑的详细描述和相应的感兴趣区域（ROI）掩膜；（2）一项全面比较

2198a46ff2110ae50aac4a8428642823188d260c.title: ReEvalMed: Rethinking Medical Report Evaluation by Aligning Metrics with Real-World Clinical Judgment
2198a46ff2110ae50aac4a8428642823188d260c.abstract: Automatically generated radiology reports often receive high scores from existing evaluation metrics but fail to earn clinicians'trust. This gap reveals fundamental flaws in how current metrics assess the quality of generated reports. We rethink the design and evaluation of these metrics and propose a clinically grounded Meta-Evaluation framework. We define clinically grounded criteria spanning clinical alignment and key metric capabilities, including discrimination, robustness, and monotonicity. Using a fine-grained dataset of ground truth and rewritten report pairs annotated with error types, clinical significance labels, and explanations, we systematically evaluate existing metrics and reveal their limitations in interpreting clinical semantics, such as failing to distinguish clinically significant errors, over-penalizing harmless variations, and lacking consistency across error sever
2198a46ff2110ae50aac4a8428642823188d260c.zh_title: ReEvalMed：以真实临床判断对齐医学报告评价指标
2198a46ff2110ae50aac4a8428642823188d260c.summary: 作者反思医学报告自动评价指标，提出以临床为基础的元评价框架，涵盖临床一致性与区分度、鲁棒性、单调性等能力。
key_points: 指出现有指标高分但难获临床医生信任
提出临床基础的元评价框架
界定临床一致性与关键指标能力标准
2198a46ff2110ae50aac4a8428642823188d260c.zh_abstract: 自动生成的放射学报告往往在现有评估指标下获得高分，却无法赢得临床医生的信任。这一差距揭示了当前指标在评估生成报告质量方面存在的根本缺陷。我们重新思考这些指标的设计与评估，并提出了一个基于临床的元评估（Meta-Evaluation）框架。我们定义了具有临床依据的标准，涵盖临床对齐以及关键指标能力，包括区分度、鲁棒性和单调性。利用一个细粒度数据集——包含带有错误类型、临床意义标签和解释标注的真实报告与改写报告配对——我们系统评估了现有指标，并揭示了它们在解读临床语义方面的局限，例如无法区分具有临床意义的错误、对无害变体过度惩罚，以及在错误严重程度……缺乏一致性

08ee14dad60b0f36d4e2f10449eaee4d30ef43d0.title: Facts Fade Fast: Evaluating Memorization of Outdated Medical Knowledge in Large Language Models
08ee14dad60b0f36d4e2f10449eaee4d30ef43d0.abstract: The growing capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) show significant potential to enhance healthcare by assisting medical researchers and physicians. However, their reliance on static training data is a major risk when medical recommendations evolve with new research and developments. When LLMs memorize outdated medical knowledge, they can provide harmful advice or fail at clinical reasoning tasks. To investigate this problem, we introduce two novel question-answering (QA) datasets derived from systematic reviews: MedRevQA (16,501 QA pairs covering general biomedical knowledge) and MedChangeQA (a subset of 512 QA pairs where medical consensus has changed over time). Our evaluation of eight prominent LLMs on the datasets reveals consistent reliance on outdated knowledge across all models. We additionally analyze the influence of obsolete pre-training data and training strategies to e
08ee14dad60b0f36d4e2f10449eaee4d30ef43d0.zh_title: Facts Fade Fast：评估大模型对过时医学知识的记忆
08ee14dad60b0f36d4e2f10449eaee4d30ef43d0.summary: EMNLP 2025 构建两个问答数据集，评估大语言模型对过时医学知识的记忆及其在临床推理中的风险。
key_points: 指出静态训练数据带来的风险
引入两个医学问答数据集
关注过时知识导致的有害建议
08ee14dad60b0f36d4e2f10449eaee4d30ef43d0.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）不断增强的能力显示出通过协助医学研究人员和医生来提升医疗保健的巨大潜力。然而，当医学建议随着新的研究与发展而演变时，它们对静态训练数据的依赖是一个重大风险。当 LLMs 记忆过时的医学知识时，它们可能提供有害建议或在临床推理任务中失败。为研究这一问题，我们引入了两个源自系统综述的新型问答（QA）数据集：MedRevQA（16,501 个问答对，涵盖一般生物医学知识）和 MedChangeQA（512 个问答对的子集，其中医学共识随时间发生了变化）。我们在这些数据集上对八个知名 LLMs 的评估显示，所有模型都一致地依赖过时知识。我们还分析了过时的预训练数据和训练策略的影响，以……

d3e6ae1a390b97f678c906cb6b964e065e20e815.title: MultiMed-ST: Large-scale Many-to-many Multilingual Medical Speech Translation
d3e6ae1a390b97f678c906cb6b964e065e20e815.abstract: Multilingual speech translation (ST) and machine translation (MT) in the medical domain enhances patient care by enabling efficient communication across language barriers, alleviating specialized workforce shortages, and facilitating improved diagnosis and treatment, particularly during pandemics. In this work, we present the first systematic study on medical ST, to our best knowledge, by releasing MultiMed-ST, a large-scale ST dataset for the medical domain, spanning all translation directions in five languages: Vietnamese, English, German, French, and Simplified/Traditional Chinese, together with the models. With 290,000 samples, this is the largest medical MT dataset and the largest many-to-many multilingual ST among all domains. Secondly, we present the most comprehensive ST analysis in the field's history, to our best knowledge, including: empirical baselines, bilingual-multilingual
d3e6ae1a390b97f678c906cb6b964e065e20e815.zh_title: MultiMed-ST：大规模多对多医疗语音翻译数据集
d3e6ae1a390b97f678c906cb6b964e065e20e815.summary: 发布首个大规模医疗领域语音翻译数据集MultiMed-ST，覆盖全部翻译方向，并开展医疗语音翻译的系统性研究。
key_points: 首个系统性医疗语音翻译研究
数据集覆盖所有翻译方向
面向跨语言医患沟通场景
d3e6ae1a390b97f678c906cb6b964e065e20e815.zh_abstract: 医疗领域的多语言语音翻译（ST）和机器翻译（MT）通过实现跨语言障碍的高效沟通、缓解专业劳动力短缺以及促进诊断和治疗的改进（尤其是在大流行病期间），从而提升患者护理水平。在本工作中，据我们所知，我们通过发布 MultiMed-ST（一个面向医疗领域的大规模 ST 数据集，涵盖五种语言：越南语、英语、德语、法语和简体/繁体中文的所有翻译方向，并附带模型），首次对医疗 ST 进行了系统性研究。该数据集包含 290,000 个样本，是最大的医疗 MT 数据集，也是所有领域中最大的多对多多语言 ST。其次，据我们所知，我们提出了该领域历史上最全面的 ST 分析，包括：经验基线、双语-多语言

c78cd7b4b0ee6a3fdd632be70232dfcfd285b583.title: Chatbot To Help Patients Understand Their Health
c78cd7b4b0ee6a3fdd632be70232dfcfd285b583.abstract: Patients must possess the knowledge necessary to actively participate in their care. We present NoteAid-Chatbot, a conversational AI that promotes patient understanding via a novel ‘learning as conversation’ framework, built on a multi-agent large language model (LLM) and reinforcement learning (RL) setup without human-labeled data. NoteAid-Chatbot was built on a lightweight 3B-parameter LLaMA 3.2 model trained in two stages: initial supervised fine-tuning on conversational data synthetically generated using medical conversation strategies, followed by RL with rewards derived from patient understanding assessments in simulated hospital discharge scenarios. Our evaluation, which includes comprehensive human-aligned assessments and case studies, demonstrates that NoteAid-Chatbot exhibits key emergent behaviors critical for patient education—such as clarity, relevance, and structured dialog
c78cd7b4b0ee6a3fdd632be70232dfcfd285b583.zh_title: NoteAid-Chatbot：帮助患者理解健康信息
c78cd7b4b0ee6a3fdd632be70232dfcfd285b583.summary: 基于多智能体LLM与强化学习的对话式AI，采用无人工标注的“以对话学习”框架帮助患者理解健康信息。
key_points: 多智能体LLM与强化学习结合
无需人工标注数据
基于30亿参数LLaMA 3.2两阶段训练
c78cd7b4b0ee6a3fdd632be70232dfcfd285b583.zh_abstract: 患者必须掌握积极参与自身护理所需的知识。我们提出了 NoteAid-Chatbot，一种通过新颖的‘对话即学习’框架促进患者理解的对话式 AI，它基于多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）和强化学习（RL）设置构建，无需人工标注数据。NoteAid-Chatbot 基于轻量级 30 亿参数 LLaMA 3.2 模型构建，分两个阶段训练：首先在使用医学对话策略合成生成的对话数据上进行初始监督微调，然后进行 RL，其奖励来自模拟医院出院场景中的患者理解评估。我们的评估包括全面的人类对齐评估和案例研究，表明 NoteAid-Chatbot 表现出对患者教育至关重要的关键涌现行为——例如清晰性、相关性和结构化对话

5a02b00c2354acbf2144d8e12a0ac37c883677d9.title: FT-MDT: Extracting Decision Trees from Medical Texts via a Novel Low-rank Adaptation Method
5a02b00c2354acbf2144d8e12a0ac37c883677d9.abstract: Knowledge of the medical decision process, which can be modeled as medical decision trees (MDTs), is critical to building clinical decision support systems. However, current MDT construction methods rely heavily on time-consuming and laborious manual annotation. To address this challenge, we propose PI-LoRA (Path-Integrated LoRA), a novel low-rank adaptation method for automatically extracting MDTs from clinical guidelines and textbooks. We integrate gradient path information to capture synergistic effects between different modules, enabling more effective and reliable rank allocation. This framework ensures that the most critical modules receive appropriate rank allocations while less important ones are pruned, resulting in a more efficient and accurate model for extracting medical decision trees from clinical texts. Extensive experiments on medical guideline datasets demonstrate that o
5a02b00c2354acbf2144d8e12a0ac37c883677d9.zh_title: FT-MDT：用低秩适配从医学文本提取决策树
5a02b00c2354acbf2144d8e12a0ac37c883677d9.summary: 提出路径整合低秩适配方法PI-LoRA，自动从临床指南与教科书中提取医学决策树，减少对人工标注的依赖。
key_points: 医学决策树构建依赖耗时人工标注
提出PI-LoRA路径整合低秩适配
从临床指南与教科书自动提取
5a02b00c2354acbf2144d8e12a0ac37c883677d9.zh_abstract: 医疗决策过程的知识（可建模为医疗决策树（MDT））对于构建临床决策支持系统至关重要。然而，当前的 MDT 构建方法严重依赖耗时且费力的人工标注。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 PI-LoRA（Path-Integrated LoRA），一种新颖的低秩适应方法，用于从临床指南和教科书中自动提取 MDT。我们整合梯度路径信息以捕捉不同模块之间的协同效应，从而实现更有效、更可靠的秩分配。该框架确保最关键的模块获得适当的秩分配，而较不重要的模块被修剪，从而产生一个更高效、更准确的模型，用于从临床文本中提取医疗决策树。在医疗指南数据集上的大量实验表明，o

3909c57b2da1d542e8fadb1fb83f520638cb2009.title: M3Retrieve: Benchmarking Multimodal Retrieval for Medicine
3909c57b2da1d542e8fadb1fb83f520638cb2009.abstract: With the increasing use of RetrievalAugmented Generation (RAG), strong retrieval models have become more important than ever. In healthcare, multimodal retrieval models that combine information from both text and images offer major advantages for many downstream tasks such as question answering, cross-modal retrieval, and multimodal summarization, since medical data often includes both formats. However, there is currently no standard benchmark to evaluate how well these models perform in medical settings. To address this gap, we introduce M3Retrieve, a Multimodal Medical Retrieval Benchmark. M3Retrieve, spans 5 domains,16 medical fields, and 4 distinct tasks, with over 1.2 Million text documents and 164K multimodal queries, all collected under approved licenses. We evaluate leading multimodal retrieval models on this benchmark to explore the challenges specific to different medical speci
3909c57b2da1d542e8fadb1fb83f520638cb2009.summary: EMNLP 2025提出M3Retrieve，为医学文本与图像的多模态检索提供标准评测基准。
key_points: 医学多模态检索缺乏标准基准
覆盖问答与跨模态检索等任务
服务于RAG等下游应用
3909c57b2da1d542e8fadb1fb83f520638cb2009.zh_abstract: 随着检索增强生成（RAG）的使用日益增多，强大的检索模型变得比以往任何时候都更重要。在医疗保健中，结合文本和图像信息的多模态检索模型对许多下游任务（如问答、跨模态检索和多模态摘要）具有重大优势，因为医疗数据通常包含两种格式。然而，目前还没有标准基准来评估这些模型在医疗环境中的表现。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍M3Retrieve，一个多模态医学检索基准。M3Retrieve涵盖5个领域、16个医学领域和4个不同任务，拥有超过120万个文本文档和16.4万个多模态查询，全部在经批准的许可下收集。我们在此基准上评估领先的多模态检索模型，以探索不同医学专科特有的挑战

291d7063a0bfa77b960181044995e0560508270e.title: Africa Health Check: Probing Cultural Bias in Medical LLMs
291d7063a0bfa77b960181044995e0560508270e.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in global healthcare, yet their outputs often reflect Western-centric training data and omit indigenous medical systems and region-specific treatments. This study investigates cultural bias in instruction-tuned medical LLMs using a curated dataset of African traditional herbal medicine. We evaluate model behavior across two complementary tasks, namely, multiple-choice questions and fill-in-the-blank completions, designed to capture both treatment preferences and responsiveness to cultural context. To quantify outcome preferences and prompt influences, we apply two complementary metrics: Cultural Bias Score (CBS) and Cultural Bias Attribution (CBA). Our results show that while prompt adaptation can reduce inherent bias and enhance cultural alignment, models vary in how responsive they are to contextual guidance. Persistent default to
291d7063a0bfa77b960181044995e0560508270e.zh_title: 非洲健康检查：探查医学大模型的文化偏见
291d7063a0bfa77b960181044995e0560508270e.summary: 以非洲传统草药数据集评估指令微调医学大模型的文化偏见，涵盖选择题与填空任务。
key_points: 构建非洲传统草药医学数据集
设置选择题与填空两类任务
模型输出偏向西方中心知识
291d7063a0bfa77b960181044995e0560508270e.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地部署于全球医疗保健中，然而其输出往往反映以西方为中心的训练数据，并忽略本土医疗系统和区域特定治疗。本研究利用一个精心整理的非洲传统草药医学数据集，调查了经过指令调优的医疗 LLM 中的文化偏见。我们在两个互补任务上评估模型行为，即多项选择题和填空补全，旨在捕捉治疗偏好和对文化背景的响应能力。为了量化结果偏好和提示影响，我们应用两个互补指标：文化偏见分数（CBS）和文化偏见归因（CBA）。我们的结果表明，虽然提示适应可以减少固有偏见并增强文化一致性，但模型对上下文指导的响应程度各不相同。持续默认

0ab74266e48101bc842de39be4db46e8b4a43c59.title: TracSum: A New Benchmark for Aspect-Based Summarization with Sentence-Level Traceability in Medical Domain
0ab74266e48101bc842de39be4db46e8b4a43c59.abstract: While document summarization with LLMs has enhanced access to textual information, concerns about the factual accuracy of these summaries persist, especially in the medical domain. Tracing evidence from which summaries are derived enables users to assess their accuracy, thereby alleviating this concern. In this paper, we introduce TracSum, a novel benchmark for traceable, aspect-based summarization, in which generated summaries are paired with sentence-level citations, enabling users to trace back to the original context. First, we annotate 500 medical abstracts for seven key medical aspects, yielding 3.5K summary-citation pairs. We then propose a fine-grained evaluation framework for this new task, designed to assess the completeness and consistency of generated content using four metrics. Finally, we introduce a summarization pipeline, Track-Then-Sum, which serves as a baseline method
0ab74266e48101bc842de39be4db46e8b4a43c59.zh_title: TracSum：医学领域句级可溯源方面摘要基准
0ab74266e48101bc842de39be4db46e8b4a43c59.summary: 研究提出TracSum基准，为医学领域方面摘要提供句级引用溯源，便于用户核查摘要的事实准确性。
key_points: LLM摘要事实准确性在医学领域受关注
生成的摘要与句级引用相配对
支持用户回溯摘要证据来源
0ab74266e48101bc842de39be4db46e8b4a43c59.zh_abstract: 虽然使用 LLM 进行文档摘要增强了对文本信息的获取，但人们对其摘要事实准确性的担忧仍然存在，尤其是在医疗领域。追溯摘要所依据的证据使用户能够评估其准确性，从而减轻这种担忧。在本文中，我们介绍了 TracSum，一个用于可追溯、基于方面的摘要的新基准，其中生成的摘要与句子级引用配对，使用户能够追溯回原始上下文。首先，我们为七个关键医疗方面标注了 500 篇医疗摘要，产生了 3.5K 个摘要-引用对。然后，我们为这项新任务提出了一个细粒度评估框架，旨在使用四个指标评估生成内容的完整性和一致性。最后，我们介绍了一个摘要流水线 Track-Then-Sum，它作为一种基线方法

e50509fea8c0af8fe5698a13f911500be40d0a5d.title: Reframe Your Life Story: Interactive Narrative Therapist and Innovative Moment Assessment with Large Language Models
e50509fea8c0af8fe5698a13f911500be40d0a5d.abstract: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has opened new possibilities for mental health support, yet current approaches lack realism in simulating specialized psychotherapy and fail to capture therapeutic progression over time. Narrative therapy, which helps individuals transform problematic life stories into empowering alternatives, remains underutilized due to limited access and social stigma. We address these limitations through a comprehensive framework with two core components. First, INT (Interactive Narrative Therapist) simulates expert narrative therapists by planning therapeutic stages, guiding reflection levels, and generating contextually appropriate expert-like responses. Second, IMA (Innovative Moment Assessment) provides a therapy-centric evaluation method that quantifies effectiveness by tracking"Innovative Moments"(IMs), critical narrative shifts in client speech s
e50509fea8c0af8fe5698a13f911500be40d0a5d.zh_title: 用大语言模型重构生命故事：交互式叙事治疗与创新时刻评估
e50509fea8c0af8fe5698a13f911500be40d0a5d.summary: 论文构建结合大语言模型的叙事治疗框架，用于模拟专业心理治疗并评估治疗过程中的创新时刻与进展。
key_points: 现有大模型心理健康支持缺乏治疗真实性
叙事治疗受可及性与污名化限制
框架含交互式叙事治疗与创新时刻评估
e50509fea8c0af8fe5698a13f911500be40d0a5d.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的近期进展为心理健康支持开辟了新的可能性，但当前方法在模拟专门心理治疗时缺乏真实感，并且未能捕捉随时间推移的治疗进展。叙事治疗帮助个体将有问题的生活故事转化为赋权性的替代故事，但由于可及性有限和社会污名，仍未得到充分利用。我们通过一个包含两个核心组成部分的综合框架来应对这些局限。首先，INT（Interactive Narrative Therapist，互动叙事治疗师）通过规划治疗阶段、引导反思层级并生成符合情境的类专家回应，来模拟专家叙事治疗师。其次，IMA（Innovative Moment Assessment，创新时刻评估）提供一种以治疗为中心的评估方法，通过追踪“创新时刻”（Innovative Moments，IMs）——来访者言语中关键的叙事转变——来量化有效性。

e08590352647a03aa3440737b988ac9e546383c3.title: DrKGC: Dynamic Subgraph Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Knowledge Graph Completion across General and Biomedical Domains
e08590352647a03aa3440737b988ac9e546383c3.abstract: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to predict missing triples in knowledge graphs (KGs) by leveraging existing triples and textual information. Recently, generative large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly employed for graph tasks. However, current approaches typically encode graph context in textual form, which fails to fully exploit the potential of LLMs for perceiving and reasoning about graph structures. To address this limitation, we propose DrKGC (Dynamic Subgraph Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Knowledge Graph Completion). DrKGC employs a flexible lightweight model training strategy to learn structural embeddings and logical rules within the KG. It then leverages a novel bottom-up graph retrieval method to extract a subgraph for each query guided by the learned rules. Finally, a graph convolutional network (GCN) adapter uses the retrieved subgraph to enhance the structu
e08590352647a03aa3440737b988ac9e546383c3.zh_title: DrKGC：动态子图检索增强LLM的知识图谱补全
e08590352647a03aa3440737b988ac9e546383c3.summary: 提出DrKGC，以动态子图检索增强大语言模型，在通用与生物医学领域完成知识图谱补全。
key_points: 现有方法以文本编码图上下文，未充分利用LLM图结构推理
用动态子图检索增强LLM进行知识图谱补全
覆盖通用与生物医学两个领域
e08590352647a03aa3440737b988ac9e546383c3.zh_abstract: 知识图谱补全（KGC）旨在利用已有三元组和文本信息来预测知识图谱（KGs）中缺失的三元组。近来，生成式大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于图任务。然而，当前方法通常以文本形式编码图上下文，未能充分发挥 LLMs 感知和推理图结构的潜力。为解决这一局限，我们提出 DrKGC（Dynamic Subgraph Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Knowledge Graph Completion，用于知识图谱补全的动态子图检索增强 LLMs）。DrKGC 采用灵活的轻量级模型训练策略来学习 KG 中的结构嵌入和逻辑规则。随后，它利用一种新颖的自底向上图检索方法，在学习到的规则引导下为每个查询抽取一个子图。最后，图卷积网络（GCN）适配器使用检索到的子图来增强结构。

7f0ec4752c39242cfab6fd35e8b420e8ccbbc7a9.summary: 条目仅提供标题，研究针对生物医学摘要按章节层级进行文本简化。

6ec5fe52cdc5c950f937ac8d587739fe47fc1eea.title: MedTutor: A Retrieval-Augmented LLM System for Case-Based Medical Education
6ec5fe52cdc5c950f937ac8d587739fe47fc1eea.abstract: The learning process for medical residents presents significant challenges, demanding both the ability to interpret complex case reports and the rapid acquisition of accurate medical knowledge from reliable sources. Residents typically study case reports and engage in discussions with peers and mentors, but finding relevant educational materials and evidence to support their learning from these cases is often time-consuming and challenging. To address this, we introduce MedTutor, a novel system designed to augment resident training by automatically generating evidence-based educational content and multiple-choice questions from clinical case reports. MedTutor leverages a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that takes clinical case reports as input and produces targeted educational materials. The system's architecture features a hybrid retrieval mechanism that synergistically qu
6ec5fe52cdc5c950f937ac8d587739fe47fc1eea.zh_title: MedTutor：面向病例教学的检索增强大模型系统
6ec5fe52cdc5c950f937ac8d587739fe47fc1eea.summary: 提出检索增强的大模型系统 MedTutor，支持住院医师基于病例检索可靠的医学教育资料。
key_points: 面向住院医师病例学习场景
采用检索增强获取可靠证据与资料
缓解寻找教学材料耗时的问题

6136642fddb96155f65a36ae9e1dd579b4b8bb56.title: From Feedback to Checklists: Grounded Evaluation of AI-Generated Clinical Notes
6136642fddb96155f65a36ae9e1dd579b4b8bb56.abstract: AI-generated clinical notes are increasingly used in healthcare, but evaluating their quality remains a challenge due to high subjectivity and limited scalability of expert review. Existing automated metrics often fail to align with real-world physician preferences. To address this, we propose a pipeline that systematically distills real user feedback into structured checklists for note evaluation. These checklists are designed to be interpretable, grounded in human feedback, and enforceable by LLM-based evaluators. Using deidentified data from over 21,000 clinical encounters (prepared in accordance with the HIPAA safe harbor standard) from a deployed AI medical scribe system, we show that our feedback-derived checklist outperforms a baseline approach in our offline evaluations in coverage, diversity, and predictive power for human ratings. Extensive experiments confirm the checklist's r
6136642fddb96155f65a36ae9e1dd579b4b8bb56.zh_title: 从反馈到清单：AI生成临床笔记的实证评估
6136642fddb96155f65a36ae9e1dd579b4b8bb56.summary: 提出将真实用户反馈系统蒸馏为结构化清单，用于评估AI生成临床笔记质量，弥补自动指标与医生偏好不一致的问题。
key_points: 将真实用户反馈蒸馏为结构化评估清单
清单可解释、有依据且可执行
现有自动指标与医生偏好对齐不佳
6136642fddb96155f65a36ae9e1dd579b4b8bb56.zh_abstract: AI 生成的临床记录在医疗保健中越来越多地被使用，但由于专家审查高度主观且可扩展性有限，评估其质量仍然是一项挑战。现有自动化指标往往无法与真实世界中的医生偏好保持一致。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种流水线，系统性地将真实用户反馈提炼为用于记录评估的结构化清单。这些清单被设计为可解释、以人类反馈为基础，并可由基于 LLM 的评估器执行。使用来自已部署的 AI 医疗记录员系统的超过 21,000 次临床就诊的去标识化数据（按照 HIPAA 安全港标准准备），我们表明，在我们离线评估中，源自反馈的清单在覆盖率、多样性以及对人类评分的预测能力方面优于基线方法。大量实验证实了该清单的 r

5b9bed6a5f0c643c6217d5cec8a89cdb64aa1f2a.title: MADD: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Orchestra
5b9bed6a5f0c643c6217d5cec8a89cdb64aa1f2a.abstract: Hit identification is a central challenge in early drug discovery, traditionally requiring substantial experimental resources. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly large language models (LLMs), have enabled virtual screening methods that reduce costs and improve efficiency. However, the growing complexity of these tools has limited their accessibility to wet-lab researchers. Multi-agent systems offer a promising solution by combining the interpretability of LLMs with the precision of specialized models and tools. In this work, we present MADD, a multi-agent system that builds and executes customized hit identification pipelines from natural language queries. MADD employs four coordinated agents to handle key subtasks in de novo compound generation and screening. We evaluate MADD across seven drug discovery cases and demonstrate its superior performance compared to exi
5b9bed6a5f0c643c6217d5cec8a89cdb64aa1f2a.zh_title: MADD：多智能体药物发现协作系统
5b9bed6a5f0c643c6217d5cec8a89cdb64aa1f2a.summary: 面向早期药物发现中的苗头化合物识别，提出多智能体系统以降低虚拟筛选工具使用门槛。
key_points: 苗头化合物识别传统上耗费大量实验资源
LLM虚拟筛选可降本增效但工具复杂度高
多智能体结合LLM可解释性与工具能力
5b9bed6a5f0c643c6217d5cec8a89cdb64aa1f2a.zh_abstract: 命中识别（hit identification）是早期药物发现中的核心挑战，传统上需要大量实验资源。人工智能的最新进展，特别是大型语言模型（LLMs），使得虚拟筛选方法能够降低成本并提高效率。然而，这些工具日益增长的复杂性限制了湿实验室研究人员对其的可及性。多智能体系统通过结合 LLMs 的可解释性与专用模型和工具的精确性，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。在这项工作中，我们提出了 MADD，一个多智能体系统，能够根据自然语言查询构建并执行定制的命中识别流程。MADD 采用四个协调的智能体来处理从头化合物生成和筛选中的关键子任务。我们在七个药物发现案例中评估了 MADD，并证明了其相较于 exi 的优越性能。

53b9e6311e9c497d827030be2ea371877c7c7814.title: Med-VRAgent: A Framework for Medical Visual Reasoning-Enhanced Agents
53b9e6311e9c497d827030be2ea371877c7c7814.abstract: Visual Language Models (VLMs) achieve promising results in medical reasoning but struggle with hallucinations, vague descriptions, inconsistent logic and poor localization. To address this, we propose a agent framework named Medical Visual Reasoning Agent (\textbf{Med-VRAgent}). The approach is based on Visual Guidance and Self-Reward paradigms and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). By combining the Visual Guidance with tree search, Med-VRAgent improves the medical visual reasoning capabilities of VLMs. We use the trajectories collected by Med-VRAgent as feedback to further improve the performance by fine-tuning the VLMs with the proximal policy optimization (PPO) objective. Experiments on multiple medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches.
53b9e6311e9c497d827030be2ea371877c7c7814.zh_title: Med-VRAgent：医学视觉推理增强智能体框架
53b9e6311e9c497d827030be2ea371877c7c7814.summary: EMNLP 2025 提出 Med-VRAgent，结合视觉引导、自奖励与蒙特卡洛树搜索，缓解医学视觉推理中的幻觉与定位不足。
key_points: VLM在医学推理中存在幻觉与定位不足
融合视觉引导与树搜索
基于自奖励范式提升医学视觉推理
53b9e6311e9c497d827030be2ea371877c7c7814.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在医学推理中取得了有前景的结果，但在幻觉、模糊描述、逻辑不一致和定位不佳方面存在困难。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个名为医学视觉推理智能体（Med-VRAgent）的智能体框架。该方法基于视觉引导（Visual Guidance）和自奖励（Self-Reward）范式以及蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）。通过将视觉引导与树搜索相结合，Med-VRAgent 提高了 VLMs 的医学视觉推理能力。我们使用 Med-VRAgent 收集的轨迹作为反馈，通过使用近端策略优化（PPO）目标微调 VLMs 来进一步提高性能。在多个医学 VQA 基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有方法。

44db318c394fbbbc674bcac8d280c9dd25ac13ad.title: From Generation to Detection: A Multimodal Multi-Task Dataset for Benchmarking Health Misinformation
44db318c394fbbbc674bcac8d280c9dd25ac13ad.abstract: Infodemics and health misinformation have significant negative impact on individuals and society, exacerbating confusion and increasing hesitancy in adopting recommended health measures. Recent advancements in generative AI, capable of producing realistic, human like text and images, have significantly accelerated the spread and expanded the reach of health misinformation, resulting in an alarming surge in its dissemination. To combat the infodemics, most existing work has focused on developing misinformation datasets from social media and fact checking platforms, but has faced limitations in topical coverage, inclusion of AI generation, and accessibility of raw content. To address these issues, we present MM Health, a large scale multimodal misinformation dataset in the health domain consisting of 34,746 news article encompassing both textual and visual information. MM Health includes h
44db318c394fbbbc674bcac8d280c9dd25ac13ad.zh_title: 从生成到检测：健康虚假信息多模态多任务基准数据集
44db318c394fbbbc674bcac8d280c9dd25ac13ad.summary: EMNLP 2025 Findings发布多模态多任务数据集，用于对生成式AI时代健康虚假信息开展基准评测。
key_points: 生成式AI加速健康虚假信息传播
构建多模态多任务数据集用于基准评测
面向信息疫情治理的检测研究
44db318c394fbbbc674bcac8d280c9dd25ac13ad.zh_abstract: 信息疫情（infodemics）和健康错误信息对个人和社会产生了重大的负面影响，加剧了混乱并增加了采用推荐健康措施的犹豫。生成式 AI 的最新进展能够生成逼真、类人的文本和图像，显著加速了健康错误信息的传播并扩大了其影响范围，导致其传播急剧增加，令人担忧。为了对抗信息疫情，大多数现有工作专注于从社交媒体和事实核查平台开发错误信息数据集，但在主题覆盖范围、AI 生成内容的包含以及原始内容的可获取性方面面临限制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 MM Health，一个健康领域的大规模多模态错误信息数据集，包含 34,746 篇新闻文章，涵盖文本和视觉信息。MM Health 包含 h

39218fa01febf0a5c9b9a3023c1005889458cc81.title: Benchmark Profiling: Mechanistic Diagnosis of LLM Benchmarks
39218fa01febf0a5c9b9a3023c1005889458cc81.abstract: Large Language Models are commonly judged by their scores on standard benchmarks, yet such scores often overstate real capability since they mask the mix of skills a task actually demands. For example, ARC is assumed to test reasoning, while HellaSwag is designed to evaluate commonsense. However, we lack a systematic way to verify if these benchmarks actually measure these labels. We introduce Benchmark Profiling, a diagnostic framework that decomposes benchmark performance into ten cognitively grounded abilities. The method combines gradient-based importance scoring with targeted parameter ablation to compute an Ability Impact Score (AIS) that quantifies how much each ability contributes to a model's success on a given benchmark. Profiling three instruction-tuned models across ten widely used benchmarks yields four key findings: (i) most benchmarks draw on several abilities rather than

2f309775bf283045795c2bb6e2cf27383e6c03d8.title: CLEAR: A Clinically-Grounded Tabular Framework for Radiology Report Evaluation
2f309775bf283045795c2bb6e2cf27383e6c03d8.abstract: Existing metrics often lack the granularity and interpretability to capture nuanced clinical differences between candidate and ground-truth radiology reports, resulting in suboptimal evaluation. We introduce a Clinically-grounded tabular framework with Expert-curated labels and Attribute-level comparison for Radiology report evaluation (CLEAR). CLEAR not only examines whether a report can accurately identify the presence or absence of medical conditions, but also assesses whether it can precisely describe each positively identified condition across five key attributes: first occurrence, change, severity, descriptive location, and recommendation. Compared to prior works, CLEAR's multi-dimensional, attribute-level outputs enable a more comprehensive and clinically interpretable evaluation of report quality. Additionally, to measure the clinical alignment of CLEAR, we collaborate with five
2f309775bf283045795c2bb6e2cf27383e6c03d8.zh_title: CLEAR：临床落地的放射报告评估表格框架
2f309775bf283045795c2bb6e2cf27383e6c03d8.summary: 提出CLEAR表格框架，用专家标注与属性级比较评估放射报告。
key_points: 弥补现有指标粒度与可解释性不足
检查病变存在与否的识别
评估报告细节描述的准确性
2f309775bf283045795c2bb6e2cf27383e6c03d8.zh_abstract: 现有指标往往缺乏粒度和可解释性，无法捕捉候选放射学报告与真实放射学报告之间细微的临床差异，导致评估次优。我们提出 CLEAR（Clinically-grounded tabular framework with Expert-curated labels and Attribute-level comparison for Radiology report evaluation，基于临床基础、专家整理标签和属性级比较的放射学报告评估表格框架）。CLEAR 不仅检查报告能否准确识别医学状况的存在或缺失，还评估报告能否在五个关键属性上精确描述每一个被阳性识别的状况：首次出现、变化、严重程度、描述性位置和推荐。与先前工作相比，CLEAR 的多维、属性级输出能够对报告质量进行更全面且临床可解释的评估。此外，为衡量 CLEAR 的临床对齐度，我们与五位

0c703c57ef030481adb316c1e4dfc192198a7097.title: GLProtein: Global-and-Local Structure Aware Protein Representation Learning
0c703c57ef030481adb316c1e4dfc192198a7097.abstract: Proteins are central to biological systems, participating as building blocks across all forms of life. Despite advancements in understanding protein functions through protein sequence analysis, there remains potential for further exploration in integrating protein structural information. We argue that the structural information of proteins is not only limited to their 3D information but also encompasses information from amino acid molecules (local information) to protein-protein structure similarity (global information). To address this, we propose \textbf{GLProtein}, the first framework in protein pre-training that incorporates both global structural similarity and local amino acid details to enhance prediction accuracy and functional insights.
