06a7868f5c36efb66b3a00a55d72f74767f4ebbe.zh_abstract: 虚拟筛选（VS）是药物发现中的一项关键任务，重点在于识别能够结合特定蛋白质口袋的小分子配体。现有的深度学习方法，从早期回归模型到近期的对比学习方法，主要依赖结构数据，而忽视蛋白质序列；蛋白质序列更易获取，并且能够增强泛化能力。然而，由于大规模蛋白质-配体数据集中存在冗余和噪声，直接整合蛋白质序列会带来挑战。为解决这些局限，我们提出 S²Drug，一个两阶段框架，在蛋白质-配体对比表示学习中显式纳入蛋白质序列（Sequence）信息和 3D 结构（Structure）上下文。在第一阶段，我们使用基于 ESM2 的主干网络在 ChemBL 上进行蛋白质序列预训练，并结合定制的数据采样策略来减少 re

0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.title: Ambiguity-aware Truncated Flow Matching for Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.abstract: A simultaneous enhancement of accuracy and diversity of predictions remains a challenge in ambiguous medical image segmentation (AMIS) due to the inherent trade-offs. While truncated diffusion probabilistic models (TDPMs) hold strong potential with a paradigm optimization, existing TDPMs suffer from entangled accuracy and diversity of predictions with insufficient fidelity and plausibility. To address the aforementioned challenges, we propose Ambiguity-aware Truncated Flow Matching (ATFM), which introduces a novel inference paradigm and dedicated model components. Firstly, we propose Data-Hierarchical Inference, a redefinition of AMIS-specific inference paradigm, which enhances accuracy and diversity at data-distribution and data-sample level, respectively, for an effective disentanglement. Secondly, Gaussian Truncation Representation (GTR) is introduced to enhance both fidelity of predi
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.zh_title: 歧义感知截断流匹配的医学图像分割
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.summary: 提出歧义感知截断流匹配ATFM，兼顾模糊医学图像分割的准确性与多样性。
key_points: 模糊分割需兼顾准确与多样
现有截断扩散模型二者纠缠
提出歧义感知截断流匹配
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.zh_abstract: 由于固有的权衡，同时提升预测的准确性和多样性在模糊医学图像分割（AMIS）中仍然是一项挑战。尽管截断扩散概率模型（TDPMs）通过范式优化具有强大潜力，但现有 TDPMs 仍存在预测准确性与多样性相互纠缠、保真度和合理性不足的问题。为应对上述挑战，我们提出模糊感知截断流匹配（ATFM），它引入了一种新的推理范式和专门的模型组件。首先，我们提出数据分层推理（Data-Hierarchical Inference），这是对 AMIS 特定推理范式的重新定义，分别在数据分布和数据样本层面提升准确性和多样性，从而实现有效解耦。其次，引入高斯截断表示（GTR），以增强 predi 的保真度

fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.title: SculptDrug : A Spatial Condition-Aware Bayesian Flow Model for Structure-based Drug Design
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.abstract: Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) has emerged as a popular approach in drug discovery, leveraging three-dimensional protein structures to generate drug ligands. However, existing generative models encounter several key challenges: (1) Incorporating boundary condition constraints, (2) Integrating hierarchical structural conditions and (3) Ensuring spatial modeling fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose SculptDrug, a spatial condition-aware generative model based on Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs). First, SculptDrug follows a BFNs-based framework and employs a progressive denoising strategy to ensure spatial modeling fidelity, iteratively refining atom positions while enhancing local interactions for precise spatial alignment. Second, we introduce the Boundary Awareness Block, which incorporates protein surface constraints into the generative process to ensure that the generate
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.zh_title: SculptDrug：空间条件感知贝叶斯流药物设计
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.summary: 提出SculptDrug空间条件感知贝叶斯流模型，用于基于结构的三维药物分子生成设计。
key_points: 结构药物设计需满足边界约束
需融合层级结构条件
提出空间条件感知贝叶斯流模型
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.zh_abstract: 基于结构的药物设计（Structure-Based Drug Design, SBDD）已成为药物发现中一种流行的方法，其利用三维蛋白质结构来生成药物配体。然而，现有的生成模型面临若干关键挑战：（1）纳入边界条件约束；（2）整合层次化结构条件；（3）确保空间建模的保真度。为克服这些局限，我们提出 SculptDrug，一种基于贝叶斯流网络（Bayesian Flow Networks, BFNs）的空间条件感知生成模型。首先，SculptDrug 遵循基于 BFNs 的框架，并采用渐进式去噪策略以确保空间建模保真度，在迭代细化原子位置的同时增强局部相互作用，以实现精确的空间对齐。其次，我们引入边界感知模块（Boundary Awareness Block），将蛋白质表面约束纳入生成过程，以确保生成的

f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.title: Improving Cancer Gene Prediction by Enhancing Common Information Between the PPI Network and Gene Functional Association
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.abstract: Identifying cancer genes is crucial for treatment and understanding pathogenesis. Recent methods typically leverage protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks or gene functional association data from annotated gene sets. There may be some shared neighborhood structure information between these two types of gene association data. While this common information may contain more accurate gene association information, existing methods often overlook this potential. To address this gap, we introduce DISFusion, which integrates multi-omics cancer data, PPI networks, and gene functional associations to identify cancer genes. A key innovation of DISFusion is the cross-view decorrelation loss, which enhances the common information between PPI networks and gene functional associations, thereby improving prediction accuracy. Extensive experiments indicate that DISFusion outperforms state-of-the-art
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.zh_title: 增强PPI网络与基因功能关联共有信息的癌症基因预测
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.summary: 提出方法增强PPI网络与基因功能关联数据间的共有信息，以提升癌症基因预测效果。
key_points: 癌症基因识别对治疗与发病机制重要
现有方法多用PPI或基因功能关联数据
两类数据间可能存在共享邻域结构信息
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.zh_abstract: 识别癌症基因对于治疗和理解发病机制至关重要。近期方法通常利用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络或来自注释基因集的基因功能关联数据。这两类基因关联数据之间可能存在一些共享的邻域结构信息。虽然这种共同信息可能包含更准确的基因关联信息，但现有方法往往忽视这一潜力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 DISFusion，它整合多组学癌症数据、PPI 网络和基因功能关联来识别癌症基因。DISFusion 的一个关键创新是跨视图去相关损失（cross-view decorrelation loss），它增强 PPI 网络与基因功能关联之间的共同信息，从而提高预测准确性。大量实验表明，DISFusion 优于最先进的

ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.title: Expert-Inspired Multi-Agent Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a fundamental yet inherently challenging task in drug discovery, as it requires simultaneously optimizing multiple, often conflicting, molecular properties. Although recent deep learning methods have shown promise, they often lack objective-specific specialization and dynamic coordination, making them ineffective in handling competing objectives and difficult to scale in complex, high-dimensional molecular design tasks. Inspired by the division of labor among domain experts in medicinal chemistry, we propose MAMO, a multi-agent framework for molecular design that simulates expert collaboration. Each agent specializes in optimizing a single objective, and their interactions are orchestrated by a central scheduling module that dynamically reallocates tasks based on evaluation feedback. This coordination mechanism enables interpretable and goal-cond
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.zh_title: 专家启发的多智能体协同用于多目标分子优化
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.summary: AAAI 2026 提出受专家分工启发的多智能体协同方法，以应对药物发现中多目标、相互冲突的分子性质优化难题。
key_points: 面向多目标分子优化，目标间常相互冲突

ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.zh_abstract: 多目标分子优化是药物发现中一项基础但本质上具有挑战性的任务，因为它需要同时优化多个、且常常相互冲突的分子性质。尽管近期深度学习方法已显示出前景，但它们通常缺乏目标特定的专门化和动态协调，使其在处理相互竞争的目标时效果不佳，并且难以扩展到复杂、高维的分子设计任务中。受药物化学领域专家分工的启发，我们提出 MAMO，一个模拟专家协作的分子设计多智能体框架。每个智能体专门优化单个目标，它们的交互由中央调度模块编排，该模块根据评估反馈动态重新分配任务。这种协调机制能够实现可解释且目标条件（goal-cond）

ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.title: Blend the Separated: Mixture of Synergistic Experts for Data-Scarcity Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.abstract: Drug-target interaction prediction (DTI) is essential in various applications including drug discovery and clinical application. There are two perspectives of input data widely used in DTI prediction: Intrinsic data represents how drugs or targets are constructed, and extrinsic data represents how drugs or targets are related to other biological entities. However, any of the two perspectives of input data can be scarce for some drugs or targets, especially for those unpopular or newly discovered. Furthermore, ground-truth labels for specific interaction types can also be scarce. Therefore, we propose the first method to tackle DTI prediction under input data and/or label scarcity. ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.zh_title: 混合协同专家：数据稀缺下的药物-靶点相互作用预测
ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.summary: 针对药物或靶点内在数据与外在数据稀缺问题，提出混合协同专家方法预测药物-靶点相互作用。
key_points: DTI预测用于药物发现与临床应用

ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.zh_abstract: 药物-靶标相互作用预测（DTI）在包括药物发现和临床应用在内的多种应用中至关重要。DTI 预测中广泛使用两种视角的输入数据：内在数据表示药物或靶标是如何构成的，外在数据表示药物或靶标如何与其他生物实体相关联。然而，对于某些药物或靶标，尤其是那些不受关注或新发现的药物或靶标，两种视角的输入数据中的任何一种都可能稀缺。此外，特定相互作用类型的真实标签也可能稀缺。因此，我们提出首个在输入数据和/或标签稀缺情况下解决 DTI 预测的方法。为了在仅有一种视角的输入数据可用时使我们的模型能够发挥作用，我们设计两个独立的专家分别处理内在数据和外在数据，并根据 diffe 自适应地融合它们

e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.title: Reducing Alert Fatigue Through AI Ranking: A Deployed Public Health Data Monitoring System
e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.abstract:
Public health experts need scalable methods to monitor large volumes of health data (e.g., human-reported cases, hospitalizations, deaths). These methods must identify individual data points that may indicate significant events, such as outbreaks, or reveal data quality issues. Identifying, triaging, and analyzing these data points in real-time is critical for preventing downstream errors in forecasting or policy. Traditional alert-based data monitoring systems, used for decades in practice, fail to identify relevant data events for several reasons. For example, these systems may not output real-time results from large data volumes, or they may return tens of thousands of unhelpful alerts. 

We introduce a human-in-the-loop AI system for public health data monitoring that uses a ranking-based AI anomaly detection method. This system was developed through a multi-year interdisciplinary co
e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.zh_title: 以AI排序缓解告警疲劳：已部署公共卫生数据监测系统

dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.title: Transforming Healthcare Decision Making Using Artificial Intelligence
dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.abstract: Decision making is at the core of healthcare: clinicians constantly make complex decisions that span diagnosis, treatment, care coordination, and resource allocation. Yet, human decisions are never perfect, leading to suboptimal patient care. My research uses AI to augment and improve decision-making in healthcare, following a synergistic approach that combines novel AI methods with practical, real-world implementation. Here, I will explore two key themes: Application-Inspired AI Innovations, focused on novel AI methods grounded in practical healthcare problems; and Path to Deployment and Impact, which addresses AI integration into clinical workflows for real-world improvements.
dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.zh_title: 用人工智能改进医疗决策

应用启发的AI方法创新

dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.title: SVRMamba: Slice-to-Volume Reconstruction from Multiple MRI Stacks with Slice Sequence Guided Mamba
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.abstract: In fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) involves the computational creation of a 3D volume from multiple stacks of 2D slices. This process is challenging due to slice misalignment and image noise. Current state-of-the-art (SOTA) SVR methods typically employ coarse-to-fine techniques that iteratively refine slice-to-volume motion correction and 3D volume reconstruction. However, both processes are inherently inefficient, making these methods time-consuming and prone to errors. This often results in less robust and accurate outcomes, primarily due to insufficient modeling of the spatial relationships between slices. Typically, 2D fetal MRI slices are acquired using the interleave sequence, which first acquires the odd slices and then the even slices in one stack. To this end, we propose a novel Mamba-based framework called SVRMamba, which integrates
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.zh_title: SVRMamba：多MRI堆栈的切片到体积重建
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.summary: 提出切片序列引导的Mamba方法，从多堆栈胎儿MRI重建三维体积。
key_points: 面向胎儿MRI切片到体积重建
针对切片错位与图像噪声
以切片序列引导Mamba提升效率
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.zh_abstract: 在胎儿磁共振成像（MRI）中，切片到体积重建（slice-to-volume reconstruction, SVR）涉及通过计算从多个二维切片堆栈创建三维体积。由于切片错位和图像噪声，该过程具有挑战性。当前最先进（SOTA）的SVR方法通常采用由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）技术，迭代地优化切片到体积的运动校正和三维体积重建。然而，这两个过程本质上效率低下，使这些方法耗时且容易出错。这通常导致稳健性和准确性较低的结果，主要是因为对切片之间空间关系的建模不足。通常，二维胎儿MRI切片使用交错序列（interleave sequence）采集，即在一个堆栈中先采集奇数切片，然后采集偶数切片。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的基于Mamba的框架，称为SVRMamba，它整合了

d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.title: HiFusion: Hierarchical Intra-Spot Alignment and Regional Context Fusion for Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) bridges gene expression and tissue morphology but faces clinical adoption barriers due to technical complexity and prohibitive costs. While computational methods predict gene expression from H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs), existing approaches often fail to capture the intricate biological heterogeneity within spots and are susceptible to morphological noise when integrating contextual information from surrounding tissue. To overcome these limitations, we propose HiFusion, a novel deep learning framework that integrates two complementary components. First, we introduce the Hierarchical Intra-Spot Modeling module that extracts fine-grained morphological representations through multi-resolution sub-patch decomposition, guided by a feature alignment loss to ensure semantic consistency across scales. Concurrently, we present the Context-aware Cross-scale Fu
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.zh_title: HiFusion：从病理图像预测空间基因表达
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.summary: 提出HiFusion，通过位点内层次对齐与区域上下文融合，从H&E全切片图像预测空间基因表达。

捕捉位点内生物学异质性

d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（Spatial transcriptomics, ST）在基因表达与组织形态之间架起桥梁，但由于技术复杂性和高昂成本，其在临床采用方面面临障碍。尽管计算方法可从 H&E 染色的全切片图像（WSIs）预测基因表达，但现有方法往往无法捕捉 spot 内复杂的生物学异质性，并且在整合来自周围组织的上下文信息时易受形态学噪声影响。为克服这些局限，我们提出 HiFusion，一种新颖的深度学习框架，它整合了两个互补的组件。首先，我们引入层次化 spot 内建模（Hierarchical Intra-Spot Modeling）模块，其通过多分辨率子图块分解提取细粒度的形态学表征，并以特征对齐损失进行引导，以确保跨尺度的语义一致性。同时，我们提出上下文感知的跨尺度融合（Context-aware Cross-scale Fu

cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.title: Association Pattern-enhanced Molecular Representation Learning
cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.abstract: The applicability of drug molecules in various clinical scenarios is significantly influenced by a diverse range of molecular properties. By leveraging self-supervised conditions such as atom attributes and interatomic bonds, existing advanced molecular foundation models can generate expressive representations of these molecules. However, such models often overlook the fixed association patterns within molecules that influence physiological or chemical properties. In this paper, we introduce a novel association pattern-aware message passing method, which can serve as an effective yet general plug-and-play plugin, thereby enhancing the atom representations generated by molecular foundation models without requiring additional pretraining. Additionally, molecular property-specific pattern libraries are constructed to collect the generated interpretable common patterns that bind to these pro
cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.zh_title: 关联模式增强的分子表示学习
cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.summary: 提出引入分子内固定关联模式的分子表示学习方法，以补充现有分子基础模型忽略的性质相关信息。
key_points: 分子性质影响其临床应用场景

c92e5cfc6580a37c1408abc0273f0af62507c735.title: CareBot: A Pioneering Full-Process Open-Source Medical Language Model
c92e5cfc6580a37c1408abc0273f0af62507c735.abstract: Recently, both closed-source and open-source LLMs have made significant strides, outperforming humans in various general domains. However, their performance in specific professional domains such as medicine, especially within the open-source community, remains suboptimal due to the complexity of medical knowledge. In this paper, we propose CareBot, a bilingual medical LLM, which leverages a comprehensive approach integrating continuous pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF). Our novel two-stage CPT method, comprising Stable CPT and Boost CPT, effectively bridges the gap between general and domain-specific data, facilitating a smooth transition from pre-training to fine-tuning and enhancing domain knowledge progressively. c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.title: PulseMind: A Multi-Modal Medical Model for Real-World Clinical Diagnosis
c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.abstract:
Recent advances in medical multi-modal models focus on specialized image analysis like dermatology, pathology, or radiology. However, they do not fully capture the complexity of real-world clinical diagnostics, which involve heterogeneous inputs and require ongoing contextual understanding during patient-physician interactions.
To bridge this gap, we introduce PulseMind, a new family of multi-modal diagnostic models that integrates a systematically curated dataset, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, and a tailored training framework. Specifically, we first construct a diagnostic dataset, MediScope, which comprises 98,000 real-world multi-turn consultations and 601,500 medical images, spanning over 10 major clinical departments and more than 200 sub-specialties. 近期医学多模态模型的进展聚焦于皮肤病学、病理学或放射学等专科图像分析。然而，它们并未充分捕捉真实世界临床诊断的复杂性，后者涉及异质性输入，并需要在医患互动过程中进行持续的上下文理解。

b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.title: A Simple and Comprehensive Benchmark for Single-Cell Transcriptomics
b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.abstract: Single-cell transcriptomics describes complex molecular features at the individual cell level, serving various roles in biological research, such as enhancing gene expression and predicting drug responses. Due to transcriptomic data structurally resembling sequential data, many researchers have trained numerous transformers on extensive transcriptomic datasets. However, they have consistently neglected to explore the intrinsic properties of the data and the appropriateness of their chosen model architecture. In this paper, we carefully investigate the nature of transcriptomics, identifying three overlooked problems: 1) long-tailed data problem, 2) model selection problem, and 3) evaluation problem. b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.summary: 提出单细胞转录组基准，检验Transformer模型对数据内在特性与任务的适配性。

b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.title: MARE: Multimodal Analogical Reasoning for Disease Evolution-Aware Radiology Report Generation
b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.abstract: Radiology report generation from longitudinal medical data is critical for assessing disease progression and automating diagnostic workflows. While recent methods incorporate longitudinal information, they primarily rely on multimodal feature fusion, with limited capacity for explicit disease evolution modeling and temporal reasoning. To address this, we propose MARE, an end-to-end framework that formulates longitudinal radiology report generation as a multimodal analogical reasoning task. Inspired by the Abduction–Mapping–Induction paradigm, MARE models latent relational structures underlying disease evolution by aligning lesion-level visual features across time and mapping them to the textual domain for temporally coherent and clinically meaningful report generation. To mitigate the spatial misalignment caused by patient positioning or imaging variation, we introduce an Adaptive Region
b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.zh_title: MARE：面向疾病演变的类比推理放射报告生成
b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.summary: 提出端到端框架MARE，将纵向放射报告生成建模为多模态类比推理任务，以显式建模疾病演变与时间推理。

b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.title: Make Foundation Models Trustworthy Again: Causal Fine-Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation
b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.abstract: Vision foundation models (e.g., SAM2, CLIP) show strong generalization in natural image analysis but degrade significantly in specialized domains like medical imaging. This is critical for tasks such as brain tumor segmentation, where errors directly affect surgical planning and patient outcomes. In such contexts, segmentation must be highly reliable and structurally precise, underscoring the need for adaptable methods with low error tolerance. While fine-tuning is the dominant strategy, it is computationally expensive and prone to forgetting. To address this, we propose CausalBridgeNet, a causality-guided correction framework for medical image segmentation. Inspired by predictive coding theories of the Bayesian brain, our method introduces a Predictive Causal Reasoning Unit (PCRU) that estimates structured error maps and delivers targeted feedback to iteratively refine predictions. b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.zh_title: 因果微调适配提升医学图像分割基础模型的可靠性
b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.summary: 针对视觉基础模型在医学图像分割中性能显著下降的问题，提出因果微调适配方法以提升可靠性与结构精度。

af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.title: Class Incremental Medical Image Segmentation via Prototype-Guided Calibration and Dual-Aligned Distillation
af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.abstract: Class incremental medical image segmentation (CIMIS) aims to preserve knowledge of previously learned classes while learning new ones without relying on old-class annotations. However, existing methods 1) either adopt one-size-fits-all strategies that treat all spatial regions and feature channels equally, which may hinder the preservation of accurate old knowledge, 2) or focus solely on aligning local prototypes with global ones for old classes while overlooking their local representations in new data, leading to knowledge degradation. To mitigate the above issues, we propose Prototype-Guided Calibration Distillation (PGCD) and Dual-Aligned Prototype Distillation (DAPD) for CIMIS in this paper. 9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.title: BioDPP: Dynamic Prompt Policy Learning for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.abstract:
Foundational vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, are emerging as a promising paradigm in vision tasks due to their strong generalization ability. Nevertheless, adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging, especially in biomedical imaging, where scarce annotations, low-contrast features and complex patterns hinder model adaptation. Thus, prompt tuning is employed to facilitate the adaptation of VLMs. However, current prompt tuning methods like Context Optimization (CoOp) mainly learn a single yet static prompt which is applied to all images, and such one-size-fits-all prompt cannot describe the case-specific diagnostic cues in biomedical data, compromising the adaptation of VLMs.

key_points: 生物医学影像标注稀缺、特征对比度低
提示微调用于适配CLIP等视觉语言模型
指出CoOp等现有提示微调方法存在不足

9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.title: DSFedMed: Dual-Scale Federated Medical Image Segmentation via Mutual Distillation Between Foundation and Lightweight Models
9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.abstract: Foundation Models (FMs) have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse vision tasks. However, their deployment in federated settings is hindered by high computational demands, substantial communication overhead, and significant inference costs. We propose DSFedMed, a dual-scale federated framework that enables mutual knowledge distillation between a centralized foundation model and lightweight client models for medical image segmentation. To support knowledge distillation, a set of high-quality medical images is generated to replace real public datasets, and a learnability-guided sample selection strategy is proposed to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in dual-scale distillation. 9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.summary: DSFedMed在集中式基础模型与轻量客户端模型间相互蒸馏，实现双尺度联邦医学图像分割。

8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.title: Enhancing Predictive Healthcare Using AI-Driven Early Warning Systems
8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.abstract: This research proposes an AI-driven early warning system to predict patient deterioration in real-time using electronic health records (EHRs) and wearable devices. Leveraging deep learning techniques, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for sequential data and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for pattern recognition, the system adapts dynamically through reinforcement learning. Evaluation strategies include retrospective and prospective studies in clinical settings, measuring prediction accuracy and impact on patient outcomes. If successful, this system has the potential to save lives, reduce ICU admissions, and transform healthcare into a proactive, data-driven field.

开展回顾性与前瞻性评估
8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.zh_abstract: 本研究提出一种人工智能驱动的早期预警系统，利用电子健康记录（EHRs）和可穿戴设备实时预测患者病情恶化。借助深度学习技术，例如用于序列数据的循环神经网络（RNNs）和用于模式识别的卷积神经网络（CNNs），该系统通过强化学习进行动态调整。评估策略包括在临床环境中开展回顾性和前瞻性研究，测量预测准确性及其对患者结局的影响。如果成功，该系统有望挽救生命、减少ICU入住，并将医疗保健转变为一个主动的、数据驱动的领域。

In this paper, we enable the large-scale, cost-effective biomechanical analysis of joint loading via three key contributions: the development and deployment of novel instrumented insoles, the creation of a large multimodal biomechanics dataset (VidSole), and a baseline deep learning pipeline to predict internal joint loading factors. Our novel instrumented insole measures the tri-axial forces and moments across five high-pressure points under the foot. 6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.title: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts with Retrieval Augmentation for Protein Active Site Identification
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.abstract:
Accurate identification of protein active sites at the residue level is crucial for understanding protein function and advancing drug discovery. However, current methods face two critical challenges: vulnerability in single-instance prediction due to sparse training data, and inadequate modality reliability estimation that leads to performance degradation when unreliable modalities dominate fusion processes. retrieval-augmented framework for protein active site identification. MERA employs hierarchical multi-expert retrieval that dynamically aggregates contextual information from chain, sequence, and active-site perspectives through residuelevel mixture-of-experts gating. To prevent modality degradation, we propose a reliability-aware fusion strategy based on Dempster–Shaf
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.zh_title: 多模态专家混合与检索增强的蛋白质活性位点识别
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.summary: 提出结合检索增强的多模态专家混合方法，在残基级别识别蛋白质活性位点，助力功能理解与药物发现。
key_points: 残基级活性位点识别对药物发现重要
训练数据稀疏致单实例预测脆弱
模态可靠性估计不足致融合性能下降
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.zh_abstract: 在残基水平准确识别蛋白质活性位点对于理解蛋白质功能和推进药物发现至关重要。然而，当前方法面临两个关键挑战：由于训练数据稀疏，单实例预测存在脆弱性；以及模态可靠性估计不足，导致当不可靠模态主导融合过程时性能下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Multimodal Mixtureof-Experts with Retrieval Augmentation（MERA），这是首个用于蛋白质活性位点识别的检索增强框架。MERA 采用分层多专家检索，通过残基级专家混合门控动态聚合来自链、序列和活性位点视角的上下文信息。为防止模态退化，我们提出一种基于 Dempster–Shaf 的可靠性感知融合策略

5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.title: ShortageSim: Simulating Drug Shortages under Information Asymmetry
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.abstract: Drug shortages pose critical risks to patient care and healthcare systems worldwide, yet the effectiveness of regulatory interventions remains poorly understood due to information asymmetries in pharmaceutical supply chains. We propose ShortageSim, which addresses this challenge by providing the first simulation framework that evaluates the impact of regulatory interventions on competition dynamics under information asymmetry. Using Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents, the framework models the strategic decisions of drug manufacturers and institutional buyers, in response to shortage alerts given by the regulatory agency. Unlike traditional game theory models that assume perfect rationality and complete information, ShortageSim simulates heterogeneous interpretations on regulatory announcements and the resulting decisions. Experiments on self-processed dataset of historical shortage
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.zh_title: ShortageSim：信息不对称下的药品短缺仿真
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.summary: 提出首个基于大模型智能体的仿真框架，评估信息不对称下监管干预对药品供应链竞争动态的影响。
key_points: 药品短缺威胁患者照护与医疗体系
供应链信息不对称使干预效果不明
用大模型智能体建模竞争动态
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.zh_abstract: 药品短缺对全球患者护理和医疗系统构成严重风险，然而由于药品供应链中的信息不对称，监管干预的有效性仍鲜为人知。我们提出 ShortageSim，它通过提供首个模拟框架来应对这一挑战，该框架评估信息不对称下监管干预对竞争动态的影响。该框架使用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体，对药品制造商和机构买家的战略决策进行建模，以响应监管机构发布的短缺警报。与假设完全理性和完全信息的传统博弈论模型不同，ShortageSim 模拟对监管公告的异质性解读及其由此产生的决策。在自行处理的历史短缺数据集上的实验

555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.title: Multi-OphthaLingua: A Multilingual Benchmark for Assessing and Debiasing LLM Ophthalmological QA in LMICs
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.abstract: Current ophthalmology clinical workflows are plagued by over-referrals, long waits, and complex and heterogeneous medical records. Large language models (LLMs) present a promising solution to automate various procedures such as triaging, preliminary tests like visual acuity assessment, and report summaries. However, LLMs have demonstrated significantly varied performance across different languages in natural language question-answering tasks, potentially exacerbating healthcare disparities in Low and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs). This study introduces the first multilingual ophthalmological question-answering benchmark with manually curated questions parallel across languages, allowing for direct cross-lingual comparisons. Our evaluation of 6 popular LLMs across 7 different languages reveals substantial bias across different languages, highlighting risks for clinical deployment of LLM
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.zh_title: Multi-OphthaLingua：面向LMIC的多语言眼科LLM问答基准
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.summary: 提出多语言眼科问答基准，用于评估并去偏大语言模型在低收入和中等收入国家的表现。
key_points: 眼科流程存在过度转诊与长等待
LLM跨语言问答表现差异显著
构建多语言基准并尝试去偏
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.zh_abstract: 当前的眼科临床工作流程受到过度转诊、漫长等待以及复杂且异质的医疗记录的困扰。大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）为自动化各种程序（如分诊、视力评估等初步测试以及报告摘要）提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，LLMs 在自然语言问答任务中在不同语言间表现出显著差异的性能，可能加剧中低收入国家（Low and Middle-Income Countries, LMICs）的医疗保健差距。本研究引入了首个多语言眼科问答基准，其中人工策划的问题在语言间平行，允许直接的跨语言比较。我们对 7 种不同语言中的 6 个流行 LLMs 的评估揭示了不同语言间的显著偏差，突出了 LLM 临床部署的风险

5515c85a0dc05b57f3f5740a2761203f6451730e.title: Physics-Informed Multi-Task Learning for Battery State of Health Prediction with Uncertainty Quantification
5515c85a0dc05b57f3f5740a2761203f6451730e.abstract: Existing battery State of Health (SOH) prediction approaches often struggle to provide both accurate predictions and reliable uncertainty estimates. This paper presents a novel Multi-Task Learning (MTL) framework that jointly tackles SOH prediction and provides a proxy metric for uncertainty through a unified architecture. The framework combines a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) for SOH prediction with a deep autoencoding Gaussian mixture model for uncertainty modeling. Particularly, the energy score from the Gaussian mixture model serves as a proxy metric for uncertainty, where a higher score indicates potential prediction unreliability. Moreover, to enhance task-specific learning, we employ a multi-head attention mechanism that adaptively captures distinct feature relationships. Our experiments show improvements in prediction performance compared to the state-of-the-art baseline

503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.title: Sim4Seg: Boosting Multimodal Multi-disease Medical Diagnosis Segmentation with Region-Aware Vision-Language Similarity Masks
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.abstract: Despite significant progress in pixel-level medical image analysis, existing medical image segmentation models rarely explore medical segmentation and diagnosis tasks jointly. However, it is crucial for patients that models can provide explainable diagnoses along with medical segmentation results. In this paper, we introduce a medical vision-language task named Medical Diagnosis Segmentation (MDS), which aims to understand clinical queries for medical images and generate the corresponding segmentation masks as well as diagnostic results. To facilitate this task, we first present the Multimodal Multi-disease Medical Diagnosis Segmentation (M3DS) dataset, containing diverse multimodal multi-disease medical images paired with their corresponding segmentation masks and diagnosis chain-of-thought, created via an automated diagnosis chain-of-thought generation pipeline. Moreover, we propose Si
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.zh_title: Sim4Seg：区域感知视觉语言相似掩码的多疾病分割诊断
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.summary: 提出医学诊断分割任务与Sim4Seg方法，通过区域感知视觉语言相似掩码联合实现分割与可解释诊断。
key_points: 现有分割模型少联合诊断任务
提出医学诊断分割（MDS）任务
用区域感知相似掩码增强多模态
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.zh_abstract: 尽管像素级医学图像分析已取得显著进展，现有医学图像分割模型很少联合探索医学分割与诊断任务。然而，对患者而言，模型能够随医学分割结果一并提供可解释诊断至关重要。在本文中，我们引入一项名为医学诊断分割（Medical Diagnosis Segmentation, MDS）的医学视觉-语言任务，旨在理解针对医学图像的临床查询，并生成相应的分割掩膜以及诊断结果。为促进该任务，我们首先提出多模态多疾病医学诊断分割（Multimodal Multi-disease Medical Diagnosis Segmentation, M3DS）数据集，包含多样化的多模态多疾病医学图像，配有相应的分割掩膜和诊断思维链，该数据集通过自动化诊断思维链生成流程创建。此外，我们提出 Si

48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.title: Note2Chat: Improving LLMs for Multi-Turn Clinical History Taking Using Medical Notes
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.abstract: Effective clinical history taking is a foundational yet underexplored component of clinical reasoning. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise on static benchmarks, they often fall short in dynamic, multi-turn diagnostic settings that require iterative questioning and hypothesis refinement. To address this gap, we propose Note2Chat, a note-driven framework that trains LLMs to conduct structured history taking and diagnosis by learning from widely available medical notes. Instead of relying on scarce and sensitive dialogue data, we convert real-world medical notes into high-quality doctor-patient dialogues using a decision tree-guided generation and refinement pipeline. We then propose a three-stage fine-tuning strategy combining supervised learning, simulated data augmentation, and preference learning. Furthermore, we propose a novel single-turn reasoning paradigm that refr
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.zh_title: Note2Chat：用医学笔记提升多轮病史采集
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.summary: Note2Chat利用医学笔记训练大模型进行结构化病史采集与诊断，改善多轮动态问诊表现。
key_points: 从医学笔记学习结构化病史采集
面向多轮动态诊断场景
迭代提问与假设修正
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.zh_abstract: 有效的临床病史采集是临床推理中一个基础性但尚未充分探索的组成部分。尽管大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在静态基准上展现出潜力，但它们在需要迭代提问和假设细化的动态、多轮诊断场景中往往表现不足。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了 Note2Chat，一个由笔记驱动的框架，通过从广泛可得的医疗笔记中学习，训练 LLMs 进行结构化的病史采集和诊断。我们不依赖稀缺且敏感的对话数据，而是使用决策树引导的生成与精炼流水线，将真实世界医疗笔记转换为高质量的医患对话。随后，我们提出了一种三阶段微调策略，结合了监督学习、模拟数据增强和偏好学习。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的单轮推理范式，该范式 refr

41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.title: Generalizable Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via ESM-2 Representations and Progressive Contrastive Curriculum Learning
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.abstract: Predicting drug–target interactions (DTIs) is a fundamental task in computational drug discovery, yet it remains challenging under distribution shifts and limited training data. Existing approaches often suffer from poor generalization, weak cross-modal alignment between molecular and protein representations, and vulnerability to noisy supervision.We propose ESP-DTI, a unified framework designed to enhance generalization by integrating large-scale protein language models with curriculum learning and cross-modal contrastive alignment. Specifically, we leverage ESM-2 to encode context-aware protein representations and adopt a CLIP-style contrastive objective to align drug and protein embeddings in a shared latent space. To further improve learning robustness, we introduce a progressive curriculum sampling strategy that dynamically schedules training instances based on model confidence, ena
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.zh_title: ESM-2表示与渐进对比课程学习的药物-靶点预测
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.summary: 提出ESP-DTI框架，结合蛋白质语言模型与课程学习提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。
key_points: 针对分布偏移与训练数据有限下的泛化难题
融合大规模蛋白质语言模型与课程学习
关注分子与蛋白质表示的跨模态对齐
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.zh_abstract: 预测药物-靶标相互作用（drug–target interactions, DTIs）是计算药物发现中的一项基础任务，但在分布偏移和训练数据有限的情况下仍具挑战性。现有方法通常泛化能力差、分子与蛋白质表示之间的跨模态对齐较弱，并且易受噪声监督影响。我们提出 ESP-DTI，一个统一框架，旨在通过将大规模蛋白质语言模型与课程学习和跨模态对比对齐相结合来增强泛化能力。具体而言，我们利用 ESM-2 编码上下文感知的蛋白质表示，并采用 CLIP 风格的对比目标，在共享潜在空间中对齐药物和蛋白质嵌入。为进一步提高学习稳健性，我们引入渐进式课程采样策略，该策略根据模型置信度动态安排训练实例，ena

2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.title: DiA-gnostic VLVAE: Disentangled Alignment-Constrained Vision Language Variational AutoEncoder for Robust Radiology Reporting with Missing Modalities
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.abstract: The integration of medical images with clinical context is essential for generating accurate and clinically interpretable radiology reports. However, current automated methods often rely on resource-heavy Large Language Models (LLMs) or static knowledge graphs and struggle with two fundamental challenges in real-world clinical data: (1) missing modalities, such as incomplete clinical context , and (2) feature entanglement, where mixed modality-specific and shared information leads to suboptimal fusion and clinically unfaithful hallucinated findings. To address these challenges, we propose the DiA-gnostic VLVAE, which achieves robust radiology reporting through Disentangled Alignment. Our framework is designed to be resilient to missing modalities by disentangling shared and modality-specific features using a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based Vision-Language Variational Autoencoder (VLVAE).
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.zh_title: 解耦对齐视觉语言VAE用于放射报告生成
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.summary: 提出DiA-gnostic VLVAE，以解耦对齐约束的视觉语言变分自编码器应对缺失模态与特征纠缠，生成放射报告。
key_points: 面向放射报告生成，不依赖大型语言模型或静态知识图谱
针对真实临床数据中的模态缺失问题
解耦模态特有与共享特征，缓解特征纠缠
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.zh_abstract: 将医学图像与临床背景相结合，对于生成准确且临床可解释的放射学报告至关重要。然而，当前的自动化方法往往依赖资源消耗大的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）或静态知识图谱，并且在真实世界临床数据中难以应对两个基本挑战：(1) 模态缺失，例如临床背景不完整，以及 (2) 特征纠缠，即模态特定信息和共享信息混杂，导致次优融合以及临床上不忠实的幻觉发现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DiA-gnostic VLVAE，它通过解缠对齐（Disentangled Alignment）实现稳健的放射学报告生成。我们的框架通过使用基于专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）的视觉-语言变分自编码器（Vision-Language Variational Autoencoder, VLVAE）解缠共享特征和模态特定特征，被设计为对模态缺失具有韧性。

2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.title: Anatomical Knowledge Mining and Matching for Semi-supervised Medical Multi-structure Detection
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.abstract: In medical image analysis, detecting multiple structures is crucial for evaluations and diagnosis but is often limited by the lack of high-quality annotations. Semi-supervised object detection emerges as a potent methodology to enhance model performance and generalization by leveraging a vast pool of unlabeled data alongside a minimal set of labeled data. A striking observation is that both unlabelled and labeled medical images contain a priori anatomical knowledge from human screening. In this work, we introduce a novel semi-supervised approach named Semi-akmm for mining and matching anatomical knowledge in ultrasound images. We develop an Adaptive Prior Knowledge Transfer (APKT) module to mine and explore the distribution and knowledge of potential proposal boxes by proposal proportion constraint. Furthermore, within a teacher-student learning framework, we put forward an Anatomical St
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.zh_title: 解剖知识挖掘与匹配的半监督多结构检测
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.summary: 利用标注与未标注医学图像中的先验解剖知识，开展半监督医学多结构检测以缓解高质量标注不足。
key_points: 多结构检测对评估与诊断至关重要
受限于高质量标注缺乏
结合少量标注与大量未标注数据
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.zh_abstract: 在医学图像分析中，检测多个结构对于评估和诊断至关重要，但常受限于高质量标注的缺乏。半监督目标检测通过利用大量未标注数据以及少量标注数据，成为一种增强模型性能和泛化能力的有效方法。一个引人注目的观察是，未标注和标注医学图像都包含来自人工筛查的先验解剖知识。在本工作中，我们提出一种名为 Semi-akmm 的新型半监督方法，用于挖掘和匹配超声图像中的解剖知识。我们开发了一个自适应先验知识迁移（APKT）模块，通过候选框比例约束来挖掘和探索潜在候选框的分布和知识。此外，在教师-学生学习框架内，我们提出了一个 Anatomical St

260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.title: Class-Aware Active Annotation in Federated Semi-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Classification
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.abstract: In medical image classification, data privacy constraints and the high cost of expert annotations pose significant challenges to building generalizable models. Federated semi-supervised learning (FSSL), which combines the privacy-preserving nature of federated learning with the label efficiency of semi-supervised learning, offers a promising direction. However, in real-world deployments, client data often exhibits highly non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) characteristics. This distributional heterogeneity undermines the reliability of pseudo-labels generated by global models, ultimately limiting model generalization. A key limitation of existing FSSL approaches lies in their reliance on a static labeled set fixed prior to training. Such strategies lack the ability to adaptively correct pseudo-label noise or address class imbalance throughout training, particularly unde
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.zh_title: 联邦半监督医学图像分类中的类别感知主动标注
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.summary: 针对联邦半监督学习中客户端数据 Non-IID 问题，提出类别感知主动标注方法用于医学图像分类。
key_points: 结合联邦学习与半监督学习
应对客户端数据高度 Non-IID
以类别感知主动标注降低标注成本
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.zh_abstract: 在医学图像分类中，数据隐私约束和专家标注的高成本对构建具有泛化能力的模型构成了重大挑战。联邦半监督学习（Federated Semi-Supervised Learning, FSSL）将联邦学习的隐私保护特性与半监督学习的标签效率相结合，提供了一个有前景的方向。然而，在真实世界部署中，客户端数据往往呈现高度非独立同分布（Non-IID）特征。这种分布异质性削弱了全局模型生成的伪标签的可靠性，最终限制了模型泛化能力。现有 FSSL 方法的一个关键局限在于其依赖训练前固定的静态标注集。此类策略缺乏在整个训练过程中自适应纠正伪标签噪声或处理类别不平衡的能力，尤其是在 unde

120996efb7374dae87a14483ef9d186e75c117d2.title: Incident Diagnosing and Reporting System Based on Retrieval Augmented Large Language Model
120996efb7374dae87a14483ef9d186e75c117d2.abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is widely used in many applications such as smart city, transportation, healthcare, and environment monitoring. A key task of IoT maintenance is to analyze the abnormal sensor records and generate incident report. Traditionally, domain experts engage in such labor intensive tasks. Recent advances in Large Language Model (LLM) have sparked interests in developing AI based systems to automate these labor intensive processes. However, two critical problems hinder the effective application of LLM in IoTs: (1) LLM lacks background knowledge of deployed IoTs; and (2) the incidents are complex events involving many sensors and components. LLM needs to understand the sensor relationships for accurate diagnosis. In this study, we propose a Retrieval Augmented language model based Incident Diagnosing and Reporting system (RAIDR) for IoT applications. RAIDR retrieves re

0eeeefa8de7846b1eab48700207cbdaca089240a.title: Sample-specific Modality Diagnosis and Cross-modal Enhancement for Incomplete Multimodal Representations
0eeeefa8de7846b1eab48700207cbdaca089240a.abstract: In multimodal sentiment analysis, modality missingness and quality degradation are common. Existing methods often rely on batch-level modality generation, generation but neglect sample-level missingness, hence their flexibility is limited severely in real-world scenarios. To address this, Sample-specific Modality Diagnosis and Cross-modal Enhancement for Incomplete Multimodal Representations (SMCIR) is proposed. Specifically, The Dynamic Multi-feature Fusion Detector (DMFD) is presented, which detects missingness and severity at the sample-level using indicators such as information entropy, modality similarity, and mutual information. Unlike batch-based methods, the DMFD provides fine-grained detection and adaptive responses, improving sensitivity to modality disturbances. Meanwhile, the Context-aware Modality Completion Generator (CMCG) is developed to restore missing modalities through

0b9bcf4b1a5f68588f281b0670639f1d36fd97c5.title: Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Joint Cardiac and Vascular Ultrasound Analysis and Report Generation
0b9bcf4b1a5f68588f281b0670639f1d36fd97c5.abstract:
Echocardiography and vascular ultrasound are essential for comprehensive cardiovascular assessment, yet manual evaluation and writing reports are labor-intensive, time-consuming, and require expertise from both cardiology and vascular surgery departments. Current automated report generation systems mainly focus on X-ray or CT, often neglecting echocardiographic modalities and critical quantitative parameters like aortic diameter and main pulmonary artery diameter, limiting their clinical utility. Moreover, the interdependence between cardiac and peripheral vascular health necessitates cross-departmental insights, which existing methods fail to incorporate.

fec834018696a8e28a42df44ed1b4fd0ac5b37d9.abstract:
With the rapid advancement of deep learning, drug target interaction (DTI) prediction has seen substantial performance enhancements. However, existing methodologies face a critical, yet unaddressed challenge, i.e., the Modality Reliability Gap. Such a gap arises from the unpredictable variance in the informativeness and reliability of 1D sequence versus 3D structural data across different drug-target pairs, critically limiting model robustness and domain generalization capabilities.
To overcome it, we introduce DrugCMF, a novel Drug-Target interaction prediction method via Confidence-aware Multimodal Fusion framework designed specifically to bridge the Modality Reliability Gap. f939693ad805552edff335ccb93e935d3c760766.title: NICE: Neural Implicit Craniofacial Model for Orthognathic Surgery Prediction
f939693ad805552edff335ccb93e935d3c760766.abstract:
Orthognathic surgery is a crucial intervention for correcting dentofacial skeletal deformities to enhance occlusal functionality and facial aesthetics. Accurate postoperative facial appearance prediction remains challenging due to the complex nonlinear interactions between skeletal movements and facial soft tissue. Existing biomechanical, parametric models and deep-learning approaches either lack computational efficiency or fail to fully capture these intricate interactions. 
To address these limitations, we propose Neural Implicit Craniofacial Model (NICE) which employs implicit neural representations for accurate anatomical reconstruction and surgical outcome prediction. f939693ad805552edff335ccb93e935d3c760766.zh_title: NICE：正颌手术预测的神经隐式颅面模型
f939693ad805552edff335ccb93e935d3c760766.summary: 提出神经隐式颅面模型NICE，预测正颌手术后面部外观，捕捉骨骼运动与软组织的非线性交互。

f6dd0c548be2222d837f09f2085f8a89ac3be8b9.title: PDE-Driven Spatiotemporal Generative Modeling for Multilead ECG Synthesis
f6dd0c548be2222d837f09f2085f8a89ac3be8b9.abstract:
Synthesizing realistic 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) data is a complex task due to the intricate spatial and temporal dynamics of cardiac electrophysiology. Traditional generative models often struggle to capture the nuanced interdependencies among ECG leads, which are essential for accurate medical analysis. 
In this paper, we propose Physics-Inspired Partial Differential Equation GAN for Multilead ECG Synthesis (PhysioPDE-GAN), a generative framework designed to model the spatiotemporal structure of multilead ECG signals by incorporating physiological priors and spatial constraints directly into the generative process.
By embedding PDE-based representations directly into the generative process, our approach effectively captures both the temporal evolution and spatial relationships between ECG leads.

f3ecc47b53cc5115ac43003eeeead34eaeb56e67.abstract:
Cognitive diagnosis (CD), inferring student knowledge mastery based on historical response records, is crucial for personalized educational services such as adaptive practice and learning path planning. Existing CD models were built based on the assumption that student's response data is integral, overlooking the nonrandom missingness of data caused by student answering exercises selectively. 
This missingness generally leads to biased and incomplete observations, where confounders, such as selection bias and exposure bias, significantly undermine the accuracy of student knowledge modeling. 
To address missingness, we propose a Debiased Cognitive Diagnosis (DBCD) framework through the perspective of counterfactual modeling to remove exogenous confounders from the response data.

f39b6a47938105cb3f271eb9561c4d1a9e5f2002.abstract: Multimodal fusion of color fundus photography (CFP) and optical coherence tomography (OCT) B-scan images has demonstrated superior diagnostic potential for retinal diseases compared to single-modality approaches. However, existing fusion paradigms - whether through naive concatenation or attention mechanisms - treat cross-modal interactions indiscriminately, lacking adaptive modulation of modality-specific contributions under varying clinical scenarios. We propose an adaptive fusion framework that dynamically routes and refines multimodal signals for enhancing disease recognition. f243e6025264c0dd4c65ce77255e363567832090.abstract: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is pivotal for drug safety and clinical decision-making. Recently, subgraph-based methods utilizing knowledge graphs (KGs) and domain information have achieved promising results by extracting informative subgraphs for DDI prediction. However, existing subgraph extraction methods are typically coarse-grained and nonspecific, facing two key limitations: First, they are constrained by the vast and noisy nature of real-world KGs, making it challenging to identify the most informative substructures from the massive space of candidate subgraphs. Second, current methods often fail to exploit the molecular structural specificity of drugs to selectively extract relevant subgraphs, lacking effective integration of molecular structure information with knowledge graph context. f031767772d8dfce7625a4b7448a58219e5eb352.title: Medical Image Segmentation with Minimal Labeling Effort: How Far Can We Push the Limits?
f031767772d8dfce7625a4b7448a58219e5eb352.abstract: We demonstrate for the first time that a medical image segmentation model can achieve near fully supervised performance using only a single annotated image and abundant unlabeled data. We present MedSMILE, a novel framework that synergistically integrates transductive and inductive learning for this extreme one-label semi-supervised setting. Its core novelty lies in an iterative loop where a foundation model both bootstraps and refines pseudo-labels for an inductive segmentation model. This process begins with the foundation model performing transductive inference to generate an initial set of pseudo-labels for the unlabeled data pool. f031767772d8dfce7625a4b7448a58219e5eb352.zh_abstract: 我们首次证明，医学图像分割模型仅使用单张标注图像和大量未标注数据即可达到接近全监督的性能。我们提出 MedSMILE，这是一种新颖框架，可协同整合直推式学习和归纳式学习，以应对这种极端的单标注半监督设置。其核心创新点在于一个迭代循环：基础模型为归纳式分割模型引导生成并精炼伪标签。该过程首先由基础模型执行直推式推理，为未标注数据池生成一组初始伪标签。这引导了一个迭代自训练过程，其中分割模型被训练并用于生成逐步更好的标签，同时通过轮间精炼步骤重新利用基础模型来纠正不确定的 predictio 中的错误。

efeaef0ac78f4fcece0a70e2873b23ae9f6be267.abstract: Traditionally, AI research in medical diagnosis has largely centered on image analysis. While this has led to notable advancements, the absence of patient-reported symptoms continues to hinder diagnostic accuracy. To address this, we propose a Pre-Consultation Dialogue Framework (PCDF) that mimics real-world diagnostic procedures, where doctors iteratively query patients before reaching a conclusion. Specifically, we simulate diagnostic dialogues between two vision–language models (VLMs): a DocVLM, which generates follow-up questions based on the image and dialogue history, and a PatientVLM, which responds using a symptom profile derived from the ground-truth diagnosis. We additionally conducted a small-scale clinical validation of the synthetic symptoms generated by our framework, with licensed clinicians confirming their clinical relevance, symptom coverage, and overall realism. ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.title: AI in the Wild: A Meta-Analytic Evaluation of Depression Detection from Social Media Data
ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.abstract:
As AI moves into high-stakes, human-centered settings, we still lack clear evidence on when and why these systems succeed or fail. This meta-analysis synthesizes all empirical studies published between 2022 and 2025 that use social-media data to predict depression, quantifying pooled accuracy and testing study-level moderators. By showing how data sources and model architecture shape outcomes, we offer an empirical foundation for a more reliable, socially aware deployment of AI in mental health.

Across 67 studies, overall performance is strong (pooled r ≈ 0.80) and climbs even higher in 2024, driven by deep, transformer-based and multimodal systems. ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.summary: 元分析汇总2022至2025年社交媒体预测抑郁症的实证研究，量化合并准确率并检验研究层面调节因素。

ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.zh_abstract:
随着 AI 进入高风险、以人为中心的场景，我们仍缺乏明确证据说明这些系统何时以及为何成功或失败。这项荟萃分析综合了 2022 年至 2025 年间发表的所有使用社交媒体数据预测抑郁症的实证研究，量化合并准确率并检验研究层面的调节因素。通过展示数据来源和模型架构如何影响结果，我们为在心理健康领域更可靠、更具社会意识的 AI 部署提供了实证基础。

ebbdfaa64b44ee0066e6b0916e9df7928cff24e8.abstract: Specializing Large Language Models for educational domains is a key frontier in creating personalized learning tools. The central challenge is not data scarcity but its abundance: efficiently selecting a curated data subset from vast corpora to enhance specialized skills and foster generalization, without degrading existing abilities. Existing data selection paradigms, relying on superficial semantic similarity or model training dynamics, often lack a principled framework to identify data that promotes true cognitive growth. Our work proposes a paradigm shift from leveraging indirect proxies of learning value, such as semantic similarity and training dynamics, towards a framework that performs a direct, cognitive-level modeling of the learner's state. eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.title: Pairing-free Group-level Knowledge Distillation for Robust Gastrointestinal Lesion Classification in White-Light Endoscopy
eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.abstract: White-Light Imaging (WLI) is the standard for endoscopic cancer screening, but Narrow-Band Imaging (NBI) offers superior diagnostic details. A key challenge is transferring knowledge from NBI to enhance WLI-only models, yet existing methods are critically hampered by their reliance on paired NBI-WLI images of the same lesion, a costly and often impractical requirement that leaves vast amounts of clinical data untapped. In this paper, we break this paradigm by introducing PaGKD, a novel Pairing-free Group-level Knowledge Distillation framework that that enables effective cross-modal learning using unpaired WLI and NBI data. Instead of forcing alignment between individual, often semantically mismatched image instances, PaGKD operates at the group level to distill more complete and compatible knowledge across modalities. Central to PaGKD are two complementary modules: (1) Group-level Protot
eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.zh_title: 免配对组级知识蒸馏用于白光内镜胃肠病变分类
eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.summary: 提出PaGKD，无需同一病灶的NBI-WLI配对图像，即可将窄带成像知识蒸馏至白光内镜模型以提升病变分类。
key_points: 突破对配对NBI-WLI图像的依赖
释放未配对的既有临床数据价值
面向胃肠病变的白光内镜分类
eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.zh_abstract: 白光成像（White-Light Imaging, WLI）是内镜癌症筛查的标准，但窄带成像（Narrow-Band Imaging, NBI）提供更优的诊断细节。一个关键挑战是将知识从 NBI 迁移以增强仅使用 WLI 的模型，但现有方法因依赖同一病变的配对 NBI-WLI 图像而受到严重制约，这一要求成本高昂且通常不切实际，导致大量临床数据未被利用。在本文中，我们打破这一范式，提出 PaGKD，这是一种新颖的无配对组级知识蒸馏（Pairing-free Group-level Knowledge Distillation）框架，能够使用未配对的 WLI 和 NBI 数据实现有效的跨模态学习。PaGKD 不是在单个、通常在语义上不匹配的图像实例之间强制对齐，而是在组级别运作，以跨模态蒸馏出更完整且更兼容的知识。PaGKD 的核心是两个互补模块：（1）组级原型（Group-level Protot

e2927761ff7ac6b68fc76b0ddb8fd47657104ed4.title: Fault Diagnosis of Irregular Sequences by Adjoint Learning in Continuous-Time Model Space
e2927761ff7ac6b68fc76b0ddb8fd47657104ed4.abstract: Fault Diagnosis (FD) on sequential data suffers from irregular sampling (with missing values), limited training data, and varying underlying environments. In response, this paper proposes FD by adjoint learning in continuous-time model space. Model-Space Learning employs well-fitted models that capture data's dynamics (i.e., changing information) as more stable and concise representations of the original data. The Continuous-Time Reservoir Computing Network (CT-Res) is first introduced, which embeds Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) within the reservoir-based hidden layer to govern continuous-time hidden-state evolution, naturally handling irregular sampling without relying on fixed time steps and effectively capturing intrinsic data dynamics. By fitting each sequence via CT-Res and representing it with the fitted model, the original sequences are mapped from the data space into the c

cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.title: REMEDIS: A Clinical AI Framework for Retinal Disease Diagnosis with Explainable Fundus Image Analysis
cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.abstract: Timely detection of retinal diseases is crucial for preventing vision loss; yet the limited availability of ophthalmologists and disparities in access to diagnostic services continue to hinder widespread screening, particularly in primary care settings. We present REMEDIS, a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)-based clinical AI framework for the automated diagnosis of major retinal diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD), diabetic retinopathy (DR), epiretinal membrane (ERM), and glaucoma, using fundus images. The system analyzes high-resolution fundus photographs in a secure cloud environment via a Swin-Large-based multi-disease classification network, producing disease-specific probability scores. To ensure clinically meaningful decision making, Youden’s Index is applied to determine optimized sensitivity-specificity thresholds for each condition. An explainability module ba
cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.zh_title: REMEDIS：可解释眼底图像的视网膜疾病诊断AI框架
cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.summary: 提出基于SaaS的临床AI框架REMEDIS，可自动诊断AMD、糖尿病视网膜病变、视网膜前膜等主要视网膜疾病并提供可解释分析。
key_points: SaaS架构面向初级诊疗筛查场景
覆盖AMD、糖尿病视网膜病变、视网膜前膜等
强调可解释的眼底图像分析
cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.zh_abstract: 及时检测视网膜疾病对于预防视力丧失至关重要；然而，眼科医生数量有限以及诊断服务可及性的差异持续阻碍广泛筛查，尤其是在初级保健机构中。我们提出 REMEDIS，一个基于软件即服务（Software-as-a-Service, SaaS）的临床 AI 框架，用于使用眼底图像自动诊断主要视网膜疾病，包括年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）、糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）、视网膜前膜（ERM）和青光眼。该系统通过基于 Swin-Large 的多疾病分类网络，在安全云环境中分析高分辨率眼底照片，产生疾病特异性概率分数。为确保具有临床意义的决策，应用约登指数（Youden’s Index）来确定每种病症优化的灵敏度-特异度阈值。一个可解释性模块 ba

c6406e390149e7b1f386ba9213de820914d3167d.title: Enhancing Molecular Representation Learning Through the Combination of 3D and 2D Graph Machine Learning (Student Abstract)
c6406e390149e7b1f386ba9213de820914d3167d.abstract: Molecular machine learning has broad applications across multiple domains such as drug development, environmental toxicology, and materials science. Various pre-trained frameworks using self-supervised representation learning have emerged to tackle the difficulty of obtaining large molecular datasets useful for training high-performing molecular machine learning models. In this study, we explore a novel representation learning framework trained using both 2D and 3D molecular data. Specifically, a 3D invariant graph neural network to learn how to capture 3D atomic information and then pass these atomic representations into a regular 2D graph neural network which can leverage molecular topology. Results from experiments demonstrate the representations produced by our method using both 3D and 2D molecular information lead to strong performance in downstream tasks.
c6406e390149e7b1f386ba9213de820914d3167d.zh_title: 结合3D与2D图机器学习的分子表征学习
c6406e390149e7b1f386ba9213de820914d3167d.summary: 探索结合2D与3D分子数据的表征学习框架，以缓解大规模分子数据集获取困难，提升分子机器学习性能。
key_points: 结合2D与3D分子数据

be5d7c6a5a5fc2842e40ece4704ac06ad2adb4f1.title: MMPF: Multi-Modal Perception Framework for Abnormal Medical Condition Detection
be5d7c6a5a5fc2842e40ece4704ac06ad2adb4f1.abstract: As the global population ages and the incidence of chronic diseases increases, the demand for early detection of abnormal medical conditions is increasing. Traditional health monitoring methods often require significant resources and specialized personnel, limiting their widespread use. Leveraging advancements in AI technologies, this study proposes a non-invasive method for detecting abnormal medical conditions from image data. A multimodal perception framework is introduced, integrating features from various modalities, including facial expressions and body postures, to enhance detection accuracy. The framework employs a Cascaded Squeeze-Excitation (CSE) module, consisting of Adaptive and Multi-modal Squeeze-Excitation components, to capture complex feature dependencies and improve cross-modal performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach, showing im
be5d7c6a5a5fc2842e40ece4704ac06ad2adb4f1.zh_title: MMPF：异常医疗状况检测的多模态感知框架
be5d7c6a5a5fc2842e40ece4704ac06ad2adb4f1.summary: 提出非侵入式多模态感知框架MMPF，从图像数据中检测异常医疗状况，应对老龄化与慢病早筛需求。
key_points: 非侵入式异常医疗状况检测
融合多模态特征

bd108f248fa29968754940ea9f0b7319d677dadf.title: Voices, Faces, and Feelings: Multi-modal Emotion-Cognition Captioning for Mental Health Understanding
bd108f248fa29968754940ea9f0b7319d677dadf.abstract: Emotional and cognitive factors are essential for understanding mental health disorders. However, existing methods often treat multi-modal data as classification tasks, limiting interpretability especially for emotion and cognition. Although large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities for mental health analysis, they mainly rely on textual semantics and overlook fine-grained emotional and cognitive cues in multi-modal inputs. While some studies incorporate emotional features via transfer learning, their connection to mental health conditions remains implicit. To address these issues, we propose ECMC, a novel task that aims at generating natural language descriptions of emotional and cognitive states from multi-modal data, and producing emotion–cognition profiles that improve both the accuracy and interpretability of mental health assessments. We adopt an encoder–decoder architecture
bd108f248fa29968754940ea9f0b7319d677dadf.zh_title: 声音、面孔与感受：面向心理健康的多模态情绪认知描述
bd108f248fa29968754940ea9f0b7319d677dadf.summary: 提出多模态情绪-认知描述方法用于心理健康理解，提升情绪与认知层面的可解释性。
key_points: 情绪与认知因素是理解心理障碍的关键
现有方法多将多模态数据视为分类任务

b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.title: Calibrating Reliance: Addressing Misuse and Disuse in AI-Based Second-Opinion Systems for Medical Diagnosis
b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.abstract:
AI systems are widely proposed as second-opinion advisors in clinical diagnosis, offering the promise of enhancing decision accuracy and clinician confidence while preserving human oversight. However, successful deployment in real-world practice faces a critical barrier: clinicians' reliance on AI is often miscalibrated, manifesting as misuse (over-reliance driven by automation bias) and disuse (under-utilization driven by self-anchoring bias). 
This paper addresses these deployment challenges by systematically analyzing how such reliance patterns affect diagnostic accuracy, confidence, and decision-making across diverse medical specialties. b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.zh_title: 校准依赖：AI第二意见系统的误用与弃用
b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.summary: AAAI 2026针对临床AI第二意见系统的过度依赖（误用）与利用不足（弃用）提出依赖校准。
key_points: 误用源于自动化偏差
弃用源于自我锚定偏差
聚焦真实部署中的依赖校准
b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.zh_abstract: AI 系统被广泛提议作为临床诊断中的第二意见顾问，有望在保留人类监督的同时提高决策准确性和临床医生信心。然而，在真实世界实践中成功部署面临一个关键障碍：临床医生对 AI 的依赖往往校准不当，表现为误用（由自动化偏差驱动的过度依赖）和弃用（由自我锚定偏差驱动的利用不足）。本文通过系统分析此类依赖模式如何影响不同医学专科中的诊断准确性、信心和决策，来应对这些部署挑战。我们报告了涉及 300 多名医学专业人员的受控模拟结果，涵盖六种诊断场景——包括膝关节 MRI 分析、脊柱 X 光片、心脏 ECG 评估和胃肠道内镜——采用人类优先、AI 其次的 wo

b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.title: Tracing the Heart's Pathways: ECG Representation Learning from a Cardiac Conduction Perspective
b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.abstract: The multi-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) stands as a cornerstone of cardiac diagnosis. Recent strides in electrocardiogram self-supervised learning (eSSL) have brightened prospects for enhancing representation learning without relying on high-quality annotations. Yet earlier eSSL methods suffer a key limitation: they focus on consistent patterns across leads and beats, overlooking the inherent differences in heartbeats rooted in cardiac conduction processes, while subtle but significant variations carry unique physiological signatures. Moreover, representation learning for ECG analysis should align with ECG diagnostic guidelines, which progress from individual heartbeats to single leads and ultimately to lead combinations. b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.zh_title: 从心脏传导视角进行心电图表示学习
b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.summary: 提出从心脏传导过程出发的ECG自监督表示学习方法，弥补忽略心搏固有差异的不足。
key_points: 多导联心电图自监督学习
关注心脏传导过程
考虑心搏间固有差异
b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.zh_abstract: 多导联心电图（Electrocardiogram, ECG）是心脏诊断的基石。近年来，心电图自监督学习（ECG self-supervised learning, eSSL）的进展为在不依赖高质量标注的情况下增强表征学习带来了光明前景。然而，早期 eSSL 方法存在一个关键局限：它们关注导联和心搏之间的一致模式，忽视了根植于心脏传导过程的心搏固有差异，而细微但重要的变化携带独特的生理特征。此外，用于 ECG 分析的表征学习应与 ECG 诊断指南保持一致，即从单个心搏到单个导联，最终到导联组合逐步推进。然而，在将预训练模型应用于下游任务时，这种序列逻辑常常被忽视。为弥补这些空白，我们提出 CLEAR-HUG，一个两阶段 framewo

afd85a14734db7b4b2a052c34d33aa2c3c55b4ab.title: Multi-Perspective Consolidation Enhanced Cognitive Diagnosis via Conditional Diffusion Model
afd85a14734db7b4b2a052c34d33aa2c3c55b4ab.abstract: Cognitive diagnosis, which assesses the learners' competence from learners' interaction logs, plays a vital role in education. It provides a crucial reference for gauging learners' proficiency levels and tailoring future learning activities accordingly. Researchers have proposed numerous cognitive diagnosis models to address this task. Despite their success, these models continue to face the ill-posed problem because of the information loss caused by under-expressive interaction function and incomplete observations. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing a novel cognitive diagnosis model, DMC-CDM, based on the theoretical premise that cognitive states can be captured with minimal information loss by maximizing the mutual information between observed and potential observations. Specifically, DMC-CDM incorporates a semantic extractor to provide a comprehensive semantic und

abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.title: Generative Flow Networks for Lead Optimization in Drug Design (Student Abstract)
abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.abstract: This paper investigates the application of Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) to lead optimization in drug discovery. GFlowNets provide a novel framework for generating diverse molecular structures while optimizing for desired properties, addressing the limitations of traditional methods in exploring vast chemical spaces. We adapt GFlowNets to incrementally modify lead compounds, integrating domain-specific heuristics to guide the generation process. Our method employs the trajectory balance objective on a graph neural network (GNN), to learn a policy that samples fragments based on a multi-objective reward. The reward function ensures increase in cell permeability and similarity to the starting molecule. abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.zh_title: 生成流网络用于药物先导化合物优化
abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.summary: AAAI 2025 学生摘要探讨用生成流网络（GFlowNets）增量修饰先导化合物，以在庞大化学空间中生成多样分子并优化目标性质。

abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.zh_abstract: 本文研究了生成流网络（GFlowNets）在药物发现中先导化合物优化中的应用。GFlowNets 提供了一个新颖的框架，用于生成多样化的分子结构，同时针对所需性质进行优化，解决了传统方法在探索巨大化学空间时的局限性。我们调整 GFlowNets 以逐步修饰先导化合物，整合领域特定的启发式方法来指导生成过程。我们的方法在图神经网络（GNN）上采用轨迹平衡目标，学习一种基于多目标奖励采样片段的策略。奖励函数确保细胞通透性的增加以及与起始分子的相似性。在活性悬崖基准数据集上的结果表明，GFlowNets 可以生成多样化的修饰，产生优化的候选分子，并在细胞 pe 方面有所改善

a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.title: OFL-SAM2: Prompt SAM2 with Online Few-shot Learner for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.abstract: The Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) has demonstrated remarkable promptable visual segmentation capabilities in video data, showing potential for extension to medical image segmentation (MIS) tasks involving 3D volumes and temporally correlated 2D image sequences. However, adapting SAM2 to MIS presents several challenges, including the need for extensive annotated medical data for fine-tuning and high-quality manual prompts, which are both labor-intensive and require intervention from medical experts. To address these challenges, we introduce OFL-SAM2, a prompt-free SAM2 framework for label-efficient MIS. Our core idea is to leverage limited annotated samples to train a lightweight mapping network that captures medical knowledge and transforms generic image features into target features, thereby providing additional discriminative target representations for each frame and eliminating the
a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.zh_title: OFL-SAM2：在线少样本学习提示 SAM2 的医学分割
a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 OFL-SAM2，用在线少样本学习器为 SAM2 提供提示，降低医学图像分割对大量标注与人工提示的依赖。
key_points: 针对 3D 体数据与 2D 序列的医学分割
在线少样本学习器替代高质量人工提示
减少微调所需的大量医学标注数据
a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.zh_abstract: Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2）已在视频数据中展现出卓越的可提示视觉分割能力，显示出扩展到涉及 3D 体积和时间相关的 2D 图像序列的医学图像分割（medical image segmentation，MIS）任务的潜力。然而，将 SAM2 适配到 MIS 面临若干挑战，包括需要大量带标注的医学数据进行微调以及高质量的人工提示，这两者都劳动密集且需要医学专家介入。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 OFL-SAM2，一种用于标签高效 MIS 的无提示 SAM2 框架。我们的核心思想是利用有限的标注样本训练一个轻量级映射网络，该网络捕获医学知识并将通用图像特征转换为目标特征，从而为每一帧提供额外的判别性目标表示，并消除了

99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.title: Graph-Theoretic Consistency for Robust and Topology-Aware Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.abstract: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation (SSSS) is vital in computational pathology, where dense annotations are costly and limited. Existing methods often rely on pixel-level consistency, which propagates noisy pseudo-labels and produces fragmented or topologically invalid masks. We propose Topology Graph Consistency (TGC), a framework that integrates graph-theoretic constraints by aligning Laplacian spectra, component counts, and adjacency statistics between prediction graphs and references. This enforces global topology and improves segmentation accuracy. Experiments on GlaS and CRAG demonstrate that TGC achieves state-of-the-art performance under 5–10% supervision and significantly narrows the gap to full supervision.
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.zh_title: 图论一致性用于半监督病理分割
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.summary: AAAI 2025 提出拓扑图一致性框架 TGC，通过图论约束对齐预测图与参考图，改善半监督病理分割的拓扑有效性。
key_points: 针对病理分割中标注昂贵、伪标签噪声
对齐拉普拉斯谱、连通分量与邻接统计
缓解分割碎片化与拓扑错误
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.zh_abstract: 半监督语义分割（semi-supervised semantic segmentation，SSSS）在计算病理学中至关重要，因为密集标注成本高昂且数量有限。现有方法通常依赖像素级一致性，这会传播带噪声的伪标签并产生碎片化或拓扑上无效的掩码。我们提出拓扑图一致性（Topology Graph Consistency，TGC），一个通过对齐预测图与参考图之间的拉普拉斯谱、连通分量数量和邻接统计量来整合图论约束的框架。这强制实现全局拓扑并提高分割精度。在 GlaS 和 CRAG 上的实验表明，TGC 在 5–10% 监督下达到最先进性能，并显著缩小了与全监督之间的差距。

Given a pair of perturbed expression profiles, our approach decouples the perturbation representations from basal states through domain separation encoders and then cross-transfers them in the latent space. The transferred representations are then used to reconstruct the corresponding perturbed expression profiles via a shared decoder. 97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.title: Vision-Language Models Guided Graph Concept Reasoning for Interpretable Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have significantly advanced diabetic retinopathy (DR) diagnosis, yet their black-box nature limits clinical acceptance due to a lack of interpretability. Concept bottleneck model (CBM) offers a promising solution by enabling concept-level reasoning and test-time intervention, with recent DR studies modeling lesions as concepts and grades as outcomes. However, current methods often ignore relationships between lesion concepts across different DR grades and struggle when fine-grained lesion concepts are unavailable, limiting their interpretability and real-world applicability. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLM-GCR, a vision-language model guided graph concept reasoning framework for interpretable DR diagnosis. VLM-GCR emulates the diagnostic process of ophthalmologists by constructing a grading-aware lesion concept graph that explicitly models the interaction
97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.zh_title: 视觉语言模型引导图概念推理的可解释糖网诊断

key_points: 深度模型黑盒性限制糖网诊断临床接受度

97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.zh_abstract: 深度神经网络（deep neural networks，DNNs）显著推进了糖尿病视网膜病变（diabetic retinopathy，DR）诊断，然而其黑箱性质因缺乏可解释性而限制了临床接受度。概念瓶颈模型（concept bottleneck model，CBM）通过支持概念级推理和测试时干预提供了一种有前景的解决方案，近期 DR 研究将病变建模为概念、将分级建模为结果。然而，当前方法往往忽略不同 DR 分级之间病变概念的关系，并且在细粒度病变概念不可用时表现不佳，限制了其可解释性和实际适用性。为弥合这些差距，我们提出 VLM-GCR，一个用于可解释 DR 诊断的视觉-语言模型引导的图概念推理框架。VLM-GCR 通过构建分级感知的病变概念图来模拟眼科医生的诊断过程，该图明确建模了相互作用

9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.title: Multi-Level Domain Adaptation and Contrastive Domain Isolation with Bilinear Fusion for Patient Drug Response Prediction
9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.abstract: Accurate prediction of patient drug response is critical for precision cancer medicine but remains constrained by limited clinical data. While in vitro cell line data offer a scalable alternative, effective cross-domain transfer remains challenging. Many existing methods tend to overlook heterogeneous domain shifts across biological contexts, underrepresent the intrinsic differences between cell lines and patient tissues, and insufficiently capture high-order gene-drug interactions. To address these challenges, we propose MACB-DRP, a hierarchical transfer learning framework comprising three complementary stages that progressively coordinate adaptation across tissue, drug, and sample levels while enabling representation separation. The framework begins with tissue-aware domain adaptation, leveraging cancer-type classification and unsupervised alignment to preserve biologically meaningful
9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.zh_title: 多层次域适应与对比域隔离双线性融合预测药物反应

9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.zh_abstract: 准确预测患者药物反应对精准癌症医学至关重要，但仍受限于有限的临床数据。虽然体外细胞系数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但有效的跨域迁移仍然具有挑战性。许多现有方法往往忽视跨生物背景的异质域偏移，未能充分表征细胞系与患者组织之间的内在差异，并且对高阶基因-药物相互作用的捕获不足。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MACB-DRP，一个分层迁移学习框架，包含三个互补阶段，逐步协调组织、药物和样本层面的适应，同时实现表示分离。该框架从组织感知域适应开始，利用癌症类型分类和无监督对齐来保留具有生物学意义的

94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.title: SEBSFormer: A Spectral-Enhanced Bi-Stream Transformer for Robust EEG Decoding
94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) plays a vital role in clinical and cognitive applications such as epilepsy diagnosis and emotion recognition. However, the low signal-to-noise ratio, inter-subject variability, and inherent non-stationarity of EEG signals present substantial modeling challenges. While recent Transformer-based models offer promising long-range modeling capabilities, their self-attention mechanism behaves as a low-pass filter, suppressing high-frequency neural patterns critical for decoding transient events. In this work, we provide the first formal analysis demonstrating this low-pass behavior in self-attention mechanisms when applied to EEG signals, revealing a fundamental limitation of deep attention-based EEG models. To address this, we propose SEBSFormer, a spectral-enhanced bi-Stream Transformer that jointly models temporal dependencies and spectral structures. SEBSFormer

94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）在癫痫诊断和情感识别等临床和认知应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，EEG 信号的低信噪比、受试者间变异性以及固有的非平稳性给建模带来了巨大挑战。尽管最近基于 Transformer 的模型提供了有前景的长程建模能力，但其自注意力机制表现为低通滤波器，抑制了对解码瞬态事件至关重要的高频神经模式。在这项工作中，我们首次提供了形式化分析，证明了自注意力机制在应用于 EEG 信号时的这种低通行为，揭示了基于深度注意力的 EEG 模型的一个基本局限性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 SEBSFormer，一种频谱增强的双流 Transformer，它联合建模时间依赖性和频谱结构。SEBSFormer

949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.title: Aligning Time-series by Local Trends: Applications in Public Health
949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.abstract: Individual models of infectious diseases or trajectories coming from different simulations may vary considerably, making it challenging for public communication and supporting policy-making. Therefore, it is common in public health to first create a consensus across multiple models and simulations through ensembling. However, current methods are limited to mean and median ensembles that perform aggregation of scale (cases, hospitalizations, deaths) along the time axis, which often misrepresents the underlying trajectories -- e.g., they underrepresent the peak. Instead, we wish to create an ensemble that represents aggregation simultaneously over both time and scale and thus better preserves the properties of the trajectories. This is particularly useful for public health where time-series have a sequence of meaningful local trends that are ordered, e.g., a surge to an increase to a peak

92dd049eee0eb48fa3ae3300d675b3cdd1f80b50.abstract: Image-guided surgery demands adaptive, real-time decision support, yet static AI models struggle with structured task planning and providing interactive guidance. Large language models (LLMs)-powered agents offer a promising solution by enabling dynamic task planning and predictive decision support. Despite recent advances, the absence of surgical agent datasets and robust parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques limits the development of LLM agents capable of complex intraoperative reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Surgical AI Copilot, an LLM agent for image-guided pituitary surgery, capable of conversation, planning, and task execution in response to queries involving tasks such as MRI tumor segmentation, endoscope anatomy segmentation, overlaying preoperative imaging with intraoperative views, instrument tracking, and surgical visual question answering (VQA). 8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.title: IMQC: A Large Language Model Platform for Medical Quality Control
8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.abstract: Medical quality control (MQC) indicators are essential for evaluating the performance of healthcare institutions to ensure high-quality patient care. In this paper, we report the design, implementation, and deployment of the Intelligent EMR-LLM platform for Medical Quality Control (IMQC), a large language model (LLM)-empowered system for automatically computing MQC indicators for enhancing the quality of medical services in Shanghai. It consists of an LLM (i.e., EMR-LLM) for processing electronic medical records (EMRs). With EMR-LLM, IMQC translates existing MQC indicators into a standardized representation language and automatically computes them based on EMRs. Since its deployment in February 2024, IMQC has been adopted by the Shanghai Medical Quality Management Center and associated hospitals. So far, it has processed 1,245 medical quality indicators for secondary- and tertiary-level
