09d8b350c3ab43f2a7c38521299c3cf007ab28c8.zh_abstract: 病变的准确分割对于疾病诊断和治疗规划至关重要。然而，成像过程中的模糊和低对比度会影响分割结果。我们观察到，无创医学成像与低光照条件下的自然图像具有相当大的相似性，并且夜行动物拥有极强的夜视能力。受这些夜行动物暗视觉的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的即插即用暗视觉网络（DVNet），以增强模型对低对比度医学图像的感知。具体而言，通过采用小波变换，我们将医学图像分解为不同频率的子带，模拟感光细胞对不同光强度的敏感性。为了模拟水平细胞和双极细胞的拮抗感受野，我们设计了一个 Mamba 增强融合模块（Mamba-Enhanced Fusion Module）以

d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.title: SpeechHGT: A Multimodal Hypergraph Transformer for Speech-Based Early Alzheimer's Disease Detection
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.abstract: Early detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) through spontaneous speech analysis represents a promising, non-invasive diagnostic approach. Existing methods predominantly rely on fusion-based multimodal deep learning, effectively integrating linguistic and acoustic features. However, these methods inadequately model higher-order interactions between modalities, reducing diagnostic accuracy. To address this, we introduce SpeechHGT, a multimodal hypergraph transformer designed to capture and learn higher-order interactions in spontaneous speech features. SpeechHGT encodes multimodal features as hypergraphs, where nodes represent individual features and hyperedges represent grouped interactions. A novel hypergraph attention mechanism enables robust modeling of both pairwise and higher-order interactions. Experimental evaluations on the DementiaBank datasets reveal that SpeechHGT achieves stat
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.zh_title: SpeechHGT：基于语音的多模态超图 Transformer 阿尔茨海默病早期检测
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.summary: 提出多模态超图 Transformer SpeechHGT，从自发语音中建模模态间高阶交互以早期检测阿尔茨海默病。
key_points: 基于自发语音的非侵入式筛查
超图建模模态间高阶交互
融合语言与声学特征
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.zh_abstract: 通过自发语音分析对阿尔茨海默病（AD）进行早期检测是一种有前景的非侵入性诊断方法。现有方法主要依赖基于融合的多模态深度学习，有效整合语言和声学特征。然而，这些方法未能充分建模模态之间的高阶交互，从而降低了诊断准确率。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SpeechHGT，一种多模态超图 Transformer，旨在捕捉并学习自发语音特征中的高阶交互。SpeechHGT 将多模态特征编码为超图，其中节点表示单个特征，超边表示分组交互。一种新颖的超图注意力机制能够对成对交互和高阶交互进行稳健建模。在 DementiaBank 数据集上的实验评估表明，SpeechHGT 实现了 stat

e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.title: ActiveHAI: Active Collection Based Human-AI Diagnosis with Limited Expert Predictions
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.abstract: Recent studies indicate that human-AI collaboration performs better than either alone, particularly in medical diagnosis. Beyond collaboration methods that focus on assigning tasks to humans or AI, like deferral, combining human and AI decisions with their confidence scores is emerging as a promising strategy. Due to high cognitive load, doctors often struggle to provide confidence assessments, necessitating explicit human uncertainty evaluation through a limited number of additional expert predictions. There are two challenges. (1) how to actively collect limited yet representative expert predictions? (2) how to accurately evaluate human uncertainty with limited expert predictions? To address the challenges, we propose ActiveHAI, an active human-AI diagnosis method that reduces expert costs through a median-window sampling strategy that actively selects representative samples near the e
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.zh_title: ActiveHAI：有限专家预测下的人机协作诊断
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.summary: 提出ActiveHAI，通过有限次额外专家预测显式评估人类不确定性，结合人与AI决策及置信度提升医学诊断。
key_points: 人机协作优于单独一方决策
医生高认知负荷下难给出置信度
以有限专家预测量化人类不确定性
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.zh_abstract: 近期研究表明，人-AI 协作的表现优于任何单独一方，尤其是在医学诊断中。除了将任务分配给人类或 AI 的协作方法（如转交/deferral）之外，将人类和 AI 的决策及其置信度分数结合起来正成为一种有前景的策略。由于高认知负荷，医生往往难以提供置信度评估，因此需要通过有限数量的额外专家预测来显式评估人类不确定性。这里有两个挑战。(1) 如何主动收集有限但具有代表性的专家预测？(2) 如何利用有限的专家预测准确评估人类不确定性？为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ActiveHAI，一种主动人-AI 诊断方法，通过中位窗口采样策略主动选择靠近 e 的代表性样本，从而降低专家成本。

d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.title: KGCL: Knowledge-Enhanced Graph Contrastive Learning for Retrosynthesis Prediction Based on Molecular Graph Editing
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.abstract: Retrosynthesis, which predicts the reactants of a given target molecule, is an essential task for drug discovery. Retrosynthesis prediction based on molecular graph editing has garnered widespread attention due to excellent interpretability. Existing methods fail to effectively incorporate the chemical knowledge when learning molecular representations. To address this issue, we propose a Knowledge-enhanced Graph Contrastive Learning model (KGCL), which retrieve functional group embeddings from a chemical knowledge graph and integrate them into the atomic embeddings of the product molecule using an attention mechanism. Furthermore, we introduce a graph contrastive learning strategy that generates augmented samples using graph edits to improve the molecular graph encoder. Our proposed method outperforms the strong baseline method Graph2Edits by 1.6% and 3.2% in terms of the top-1 accuracy
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.zh_title: KGCL：知识增强图对比学习的逆合成预测
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.summary: 提出知识增强图对比学习模型KGCL，基于分子图编辑做逆合成预测，从官能团嵌入中融入化学知识以提升分子表示。
key_points: 逆合成预测是药物发现的关键任务
基于分子图编辑的方法可解释性较好
已有方法未有效融入化学知识
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.zh_abstract: 逆合成（Retrosynthesis）预测给定目标分子的反应物，是药物发现中的一项关键任务。基于分子图编辑的逆合成预测因具有出色的可解释性而受到广泛关注。现有方法在学习分子表示时未能有效融入化学知识。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种知识增强图对比学习模型（Knowledge-enhanced Graph Contrastive Learning model, KGCL），该模型从化学知识图谱中检索官能团嵌入，并通过注意力机制将其整合到产物分子的原子嵌入中。此外，我们引入了一种图对比学习策略，利用图编辑生成增强样本以改进分子图编码器。我们提出的方法在 top-1 准确率方面分别以 1.6% 和 3.2% 优于强基线方法 Graph2Edits。

cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.title: KnowMDD: Knowledge-guided Cross Contrastive Learning for Major Depressive Disorder Diagnosis
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.abstract: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) is a prevalent and severe mental disease. Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI)-based diagnostic methods, which analyze Functional Connectivity (FC) to identify abnormal functional connections, have shown promise as biomarker-based approaches for diagnosing depression. However, the high costs of fMRI data result in small sample sizes, hindering the effective identification of abnormal FC patterns. Moreover, existing methods often overlook the potential benefits of incorporating domain knowledge into their models. In this paper, we propose KnowMDD, a novel knowledge-guided cross contrastive learning framework for MDD diagnosis. By incorporating domain knowledge and employing data augmentation, KnowMDD addresses data sparsity while improving robustness and interpretability. Specifically, multiple atlases are used to construct complementary brain graph
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.zh_title: KnowMDD：知识引导交叉对比学习诊断重度抑郁症
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.summary: 提出知识引导的交叉对比学习方法KnowMDD，基于fMRI功能连接辅助重度抑郁症诊断。
key_points: fMRI功能连接可作为抑郁症诊断标志
fMRI成本高导致样本量小
现有方法未充分利用潜在信息
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.zh_abstract: 重性抑郁障碍（Major Depressive Disorder, MDD）是一种普遍且严重的精神疾病。基于功能磁共振成像（Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging, fMRI）的诊断方法通过分析功能连接（Functional Connectivity, FC）来识别异常功能连接，已显示出作为基于生物标志物方法用于诊断抑郁症的前景。然而，fMRI 数据的高成本导致样本量小，阻碍了对异常 FC 模式的有效识别。此外，现有方法常常忽视将领域知识纳入其模型的潜在益处。在本文中，我们提出了 KnowMDD，一种用于 MDD 诊断的新型知识引导交叉对比学习框架。通过融入领域知识并采用数据增强，KnowMDD 解决了数据稀疏性问题，同时提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。具体而言，使用多个图谱构建互补的大脑图（complementary brain graph）。

aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.title: A Medical Image Classification Network Based on Multi-View Consistent Momentum Contrastive Learning
aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.abstract: Due to variations in imaging conditions, images often exhibit discrepancies in color reproduction. Furthermore, motion-induced blur can lead to edge degradation, making color sensitivity and edge blurriness two prevalent and challenging issues in both natural image processing and medical image analysis. To address these challenges, we propose a model termed the Three-View Consistency Mo-mentum Contrastive with Sobel Operator (SVCMC). Specifically, we first design a three-view momen-tum-update architecture that employs a So-bel-augmented ResNet as the backbone. We then introduce a novel contrastive loss, referred to as the Three-View Consistency Momentum Contrastive Loss. Next, to mitigate the oscillations and slow convergence commonly observed in contrastive learning, we construct a dynamic contrastive loss function that adapts in real time over the training process. aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.zh_title: 基于多视角一致动量对比学习的医学图像分类网络
aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.summary: IJCAI 2025 提出 SVCMC，用三视角一致动量更新结合 Sobel 算子，应对医学图像颜色差异与运动模糊问题。
key_points: 颜色敏感与边缘模糊是常见挑战
设计三视角动量更新机制

aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.zh_abstract: 由于成像条件的变化，图像在颜色再现方面常常表现出差异。此外，运动引起的模糊会导致边缘退化，使颜色敏感性和边缘模糊成为自然图像处理和医学图像分析中两个普遍且具有挑战性的问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种称为基于 Sobel 算子的三视图一致性动量对比模型（Three-View Consistency Momentum Contrastive with Sobel Operator, SVCMC）。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种三视图动量更新架构，采用 Sobel 增强的 ResNet 作为骨干网络。然后，我们引入了一种新的对比损失，称为三视图一致性动量对比损失（Three-View Consistency Momentum Contrastive Loss）。接下来，为缓解对比学习中常见的振荡和收敛缓慢问题，我们构建了一个在训练过程中实时自适应的动态对比损失函数。最后，我们验证

6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.title: DFCA: Disentangled Feature Contrastive Learning and Augmentation for Fairer Dermatological Diagnostics
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.abstract: With the increasing integration of AI in medical research and applications, the issue of fairness has become as critical as diagnostic accuracy. In dermatology diagnosis, the challenge of class-imbalanced data, which is sometimes limited and contains demographic attributes, results in an imbalanced and insufficient representation within the feature space of deep learning models. Besides, feature entanglement within deep learning models confuses skin tone and disease condition information, impairing model performance among vulnerable groups. Moreover, feature entanglement often constrains the efforts to mitigate unfairness, entailing a trade-off between fairness and diagnostic accuracy. This paper introduces the Disentangled Feature Contrastive learning and Augmentation framework (DFCA), aiming to enhance fairness in dermatological diagnoses without compromising accuracy. 6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.zh_title: DFCA：解耦特征对比学习与增强用于更公平皮肤病诊断
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.summary: 提出DFCA方法，通过解耦特征对比学习与增强，缓解皮肤病诊断中的数据不平衡和特征纠缠带来的公平性问题。
key_points: AI医疗中公平性与诊断准确性同样关键
皮肤病诊断数据类别不平衡且含人口属性
特征纠缠混淆肤色与疾病信息，影响公平
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.zh_abstract: 随着 AI 在医学研究和应用中的日益融合，公平性问题已变得与诊断准确性同样关键。在皮肤病学诊断中，类别不平衡数据的挑战——这些数据有时有限且包含人口统计学属性——导致深度学习模型特征空间中的表示不平衡且不充分。此外，深度学习模型中的特征纠缠混淆了肤色和疾病状况信息，损害了模型在弱势群体中的性能。而且，特征纠缠常常制约了减轻不公平性的努力，从而导致公平性与诊断准确性之间的权衡。本文介绍了解缠特征对比学习与增强框架（Disentangled Feature Contrastive learning and Augmentation framework, DFCA），旨在不牺牲准确性的情况下提高皮肤病学诊断中的公平性。起初，DFCA

335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.title: MolHFCNet: Enhancing Molecular Graph Representations with Hierarchical Feature Combining and Hybrid Pretraining
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.abstract: Efficient molecular property prediction is crucial in bioinformatics and cheminformatics, with applications in drug discovery, materials science, and chemical engineering. This paper introduces MolHFCNet, a graph neural network designed to enhance molecular representation learning. At its core, the n-Hierarchical Features Combining (n-HFC) module aggregates information across multiple hierarchical feature spaces, effectively capturing both local and global graph structures. Unlike conventional models, n-HFC maintains computational complexity comparable to a single full-dimensional graph layer while supporting either 2D or 3D molecular graphs, ensuring flexibility across tasks. 335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.zh_title: MolHFCNet：分子图表示与混合预训练
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.summary: 提出MolHFCNet图神经网络，通过层次特征组合与混合预训练增强分子表示学习。
key_points: 面向分子性质预测任务
n-HFC聚合多层级特征
结合混合预训练策略
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.zh_abstract: 高效分子性质预测在生物信息学和化学信息学中至关重要，其应用涵盖药物发现、材料科学和化学工程。本文介绍 MolHFCNet，一种旨在增强分子表示学习的图神经网络。其核心是 n-Hierarchical Features Combining (n-HFC) 模块，该模块跨多个层次化特征空间聚合信息，有效捕获局部和全局图结构。与传统模型不同，n-HFC 保持与单个全维图层相当的计算复杂度，同时支持 2D 或 3D 分子图，确保跨任务的灵活性。此外，我们提出一种新颖的图预训练策略，该策略整合预测学习和对比学习，使模型能够捕获局部化学相互作用和全局分子背景，以获得稳健的嵌入

0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.title: InstGAN: Instant Actor-Critic-Driven GAN for De Novo Molecule Generation and Property Optimization
0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.abstract: Deep generative models, such as generative adversarial networks (GANs), have been employed for de~novo molecular generation in drug discovery. Most prior studies have utilized reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms, particularly Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), to handle the discrete nature of molecular representations in GANs. However, due to the inherent instability in training GANs and RL models, along with the high computational cost associated with MCTS sampling, MCTS RL-based GANs struggle to scale to large chemical databases. To tackle these challenges, this study introduces a novel GAN based on actor-critic RL with instant and global rewards, called InstGAN, to generate molecules at the token-level with multi-property optimization. 0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.zh_title: InstGAN：面向药物发现的即时分子生成与优化
0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.summary: 提出 InstGAN，用 actor-critic 驱动的 GAN 进行全新分子生成与性质优化，以应对 GAN 与强化学习不稳定及 MCTS 采样高成本问题。
key_points: 用于药物发现的全新分子生成
采用 actor-critic 驱动 GAN
针对 GAN/RL 不稳定与 MCTS 高成本

e01c29528fe38af9edef553ddcf4cd80c558e33b.title: Multi-Omics Analysis for Cancer Subtype Inference via Unrolling Graph Smoothness Priors

d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.title: Self-calibration Enhanced Whole Slide Pathology Image Analysis
d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.abstract: Pathology images are considered the ``gold standard" for cancer diagnosis and treatment, with gigapixel images providing extensive tissue and cellular information. Existing methods fail to simultaneously extract global structural and local detail features for comprehensive pathology image analysis efficiently. To address these limitations, we propose a self-calibration enhanced framework for whole slide pathology image analysis, comprising three components: a global branch, a focus predictor, and a detailed branch. The global branch initially classifies using the pathological thumbnail, while the focus predictor identifies relevant regions for classification based on the last layer features of the global branch. d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.zh_title: 自校准增强的全切片病理图像分析
d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.summary: 提出自校准增强框架，含全局分支与聚焦预测器，用于全切片病理图像的全局结构与局部细节分析。
key_points: 面向十亿像素级全切片病理图像
现有方法难以兼顾全局结构与局部细节

d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.zh_abstract: 病理图像被认为是癌症诊断与治疗的“金标准”，其中千兆像素图像提供了广泛的组织和细胞信息。现有方法无法高效地同时提取全局结构特征和局部细节特征，以进行全面病理图像分析。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种用于全切片病理图像分析的自校准增强框架，包含三个组成部分：全局分支、焦点预测器和细节分支。全局分支最初使用病理缩略图进行分类，而焦点预测器基于全局分支的最后一层特征识别用于分类的相关区域。细节提取分支随后评估放大区域是否对应于病灶区域。最后，全局与细节之间的特征一致性约束

c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.title: Volumetric Axial Disentanglement Enabling Advancing in Medical Image Segmentation
c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.abstract: Information retrieved from three dimensions is treated uniformly in CNN-based volumetric segmentation methods. However, such neglect of axial disparities fails to capture true spatio-temporal variations. This paper introduces the volumetric axial disentanglement to address the disparities in spatial information along different axial dimensions. Building on this concept, we propose the Post-Axial Refiner (PaR) module to refine segmentation masks by implementing axial disentanglement on the specific axis of the volumetric medical sequences. As a plug-and-play enhancement to existing volumetric segmentation architecture, PaR further utilizes specialized attention approaches to learn disentangled post-decoding features, enhancing spatial representation and structural detail. Validation on various datasets demonstrates PaR's consistent elevation of segmentation precision and boundary clarity
c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.zh_title: 体积轴向解耦提升医学图像分割

93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.title: Inferring Causal Protein Signaling Networks with Reinforcement Learning via Artificial Bee Colony Neural Architecture Search
93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.abstract: Inferring causal protein signaling networks from human immune system cellular data is an important approach to reveal underlying tissue signaling biology and dysfunction in diseased cells. In recent years, reinforcement learning (RL) methods have shown excellent performance in the field of causal protein signaling network inference. However, the complexity of RL models and the need for manual hyperparameter tuning can hinder performance. In this paper, we propose a actor-critic RL model via artificial bee colony (ABC) neural architecture search, called ABCNAS-RL. Specifically, the entire method is divided into two phases: ABC neural architecture search and actor-critic RL search. In phase one, we represent each bee as a set of hyperparameter, utilizing the ABC algorithm searching for optimal hyperparameters of the actor-critic RL model on the training set. 93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.zh_title: 强化学习结合蜂群架构搜索推断蛋白信号网络
93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.summary: 提出结合人工蜂群神经架构搜索的 actor-critic 强化学习模型，从免疫细胞数据推断因果蛋白信号网络。

913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.title: CFII-Net: Explicit Class Embeddings and Feature Maps Through Iterative Interaction for Boosting Medical Image Segmentation
913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.abstract: Prior knowledge of category structure is essential in medical image segmentation, especially with significant organ structure differences. However, current hybrid architectures primarily focus on enhancing pixel-level representation learning, often neglecting or weakening the key prior knowledge of categorical structures, which poses challenges in capturing category relationships and accurate segmenting. To address this concern, we propose a novel network using Explicit Class Embeddings and Feature Maps through Iterative Interaction (CFII-Net) for boosting medical image segmentation. CFII-Net effectively segments images by exploring the relationship between explicit class embeddings and pixels in images. Specifically, we propose an Explicit Class Embedding Generator (ECEG) to obtain high-quality class semantic embeddings, incorporating category structure priors, which are used to guide h
913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.zh_title: CFII-Net：迭代交互的类别嵌入与特征图分割
913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.summary: 通过显式类别嵌入与特征图迭代交互引入类别结构先验，提升医学图像分割对类别关系的刻画。

6689d493775b0ed4ad7acc940d662a873e202dd5.title: Fault Diagnosis in REDNet Model Space
6689d493775b0ed4ad7acc940d662a873e202dd5.abstract:
Fault Diagnosis (FD) in time-varying data presents considerations such as limited training data, intra- and inter-dimensional correlations, and constraints of training time. In response, this paper introduces FD in the Reservoir-Embedded-Directional Network (REDNet) model space. Model-oriented methods utilize well-fitted networks or functions, denoted as "models" that capture data's changing information, as more stable and parsimonious representations of the data. Our approach employs REDNet for data fitting, wherein multiple reservoirs are organized along intrinsic correlation directions to establish intra- and inter-dimensional dependencies, thereby capturing multi-directional dynamics in high-dimensional data.

6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.title: Data Poisoning Attack Defense and Evolutionary Domain Adaptation for Federated Medical Image Segmentation
6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.abstract: Federated learning has significant demonstrated potential in medical image segmentation to protect data privacy by retaining local data. However, its application is still hindered by two critical challenges: 1) the retained data poisoning attacks that severely compromise the accuracy of the global segmentation model and 2) domain gaps among clients, undermining its generalizability. To address these issues, we propose AdaShield-FL, a data poisoning attack defense and evolutionary domain adaptation for federated medical image segmentation. AdaShield-FL incorporates a disentangled reconstruction and segmentation module that purifies data in the k-space domain to mitigate the effects of adversarial attacks iteratively. Moreover, it introduces a data poisoning attack detection mechanism that analyzes abnormal patterns in training loss sequences to identify malicious clients. This method also
6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.zh_title: 联邦医学图像分割的投毒防御与域适应
6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.summary: 提出AdaShield-FL，在联邦医学图像分割中同时应对数据投毒攻击与客户端间域差距。
key_points: 联邦场景下数据投毒损害全局模型精度
客户端间域差距削弱泛化能力
单一框架兼顾防御与演化域适应
6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.zh_abstract: 联邦学习在医学图像分割中已明显展现出通过保留本地数据来保护数据隐私的巨大潜力。然而，其应用仍受两个关键挑战阻碍：1）留存数据投毒攻击会严重损害全局分割模型的准确性；2）客户端之间的域差距削弱了其泛化能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出 AdaShield-FL，一种用于联邦医学图像分割的数据投毒攻击防御与进化域适应方法。AdaShield-FL 包含一个解耦重建与分割模块，该模块在 k 空间域中净化数据，以迭代地减轻对抗攻击的影响。此外，它引入了一种数据投毒攻击检测机制，通过分析训练损失序列中的异常模式来识别恶意客户端。该方法还

2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.title: M2LLM: Multi-view Molecular Representation Learning with Large Language Models
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.abstract: Accurate molecular property prediction is a critical challenge with wide-ranging applications in chemistry, materials science, and drug discovery. Molecular representation methods, including fingerprints and graph neural networks (GNNs), achieve state-of-the-art results by effectively deriving features from molecular structures. However, these methods often overlook decades of accumulated semantic and contextual knowledge. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning abilities and prior knowledge across scientific domains, leading us to hypothesize that LLMs can generate rich molecular representations when guided to reason in multiple perspectives. To address these gaps, we propose M^2LLM, a multi-view framework that integrates three perspectives: the molecular structure view, the molecular task view, and the molecular rules view. These views are f
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.zh_title: M2LLM：多视图分子表示学习与大语言模型
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.summary: 提出M2LLM，结合多视图分子表示与大语言模型，用于分子性质预测，服务化学、材料与药物发现。
key_points: 融合多视图分子表示
利用大语言模型语义知识
提升分子性质预测性能
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.zh_abstract: 准确的分子性质预测是一个关键挑战，在化学、材料科学和药物发现中具有广泛的应用。分子表示方法，包括指纹和图神经网络（GNNs），通过有效从分子结构中提取特征，取得了最先进的结果。然而，这些方法常常忽略了数十年来积累的语义和上下文知识。大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展展示了跨科学领域的显著推理能力和先验知识，使我们假设当引导LLMs从多个角度进行推理时，它们能够生成丰富的分子表示。为弥补这些差距，我们提出M^2LLM，一个多视角框架，整合了三个视角：分子结构视角、分子任务视角和分子规则视角。这些视角是 f

03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.title: MCD-CLIP: Multi-view Chest Disease Diagnosis with Disentangled CLIP
03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.abstract: Pre-trained methods for multi-view chest X-ray images have demonstrated impressive performance in chest disease diagnosis, but there are still some limitations that need to be addressed. Firstly, many pre-trained methods require full fine-tuning pre-trained models to induce significant computational resource usage and the prior knowledge destruction. Secondly, many pre-trained methods cannot efficiently balance consistency and complementarity among views, leading to information loss and performance degradation. To tackle these issues, we propose MCD-CLIP, a CLIP-based multi-view chest disease diagnosis method. It uses visual prompts and a Prompt-Aligner to align prompts across views, along with the additional text representation for efficient transfer. Moreover, we employ Adapters to disentangle the image representation, maintaining consistency and complementarity from different views. E
03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.zh_title: MCD-CLIP：多视图胸部疾病诊断的解耦CLIP
03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.summary: IJCAI 2025提出MCD-CLIP，用解耦CLIP进行多视图胸部X光疾病诊断，兼顾视图一致性与互补性。

03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.zh_abstract: 用于多视角胸部X射线图像的预训练方法在胸部疾病诊断中已展现出令人印象深刻的性能，但仍有一些局限性需要解决。首先，许多预训练方法需要对预训练模型进行完全微调，从而导致大量计算资源消耗和先验知识破坏。其次，许多预训练方法无法有效平衡视角之间的一致性和互补性，导致信息丢失和性能下降。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MCD-CLIP，一种基于CLIP的多视角胸部疾病诊断方法。它使用视觉提示（visual prompts）和一个提示对齐器（Prompt-Aligner）来对齐跨视角的提示，并利用额外的文本表示进行高效迁移。此外，我们采用适配器（Adapters）来解耦图像表示，保持不同视角的一致性和互补性。E

d9954145c0d527aebe71b8041c5c1115f21db2f2.title: Underground Diagnosis in 3D GPR Data by Learning in CuCoRes Model Space
d9954145c0d527aebe71b8041c5c1115f21db2f2.abstract: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) provides detailed subterranean insights. Nevertheless, underground diagnosis via GPR is hindered by the fact that training data typically contain only normal samples, along with the complexity of GPR data’s wave-collection characteristics. This paper proposes subsurface anomaly detection within the Cubic Correlation Reservoir Network (CuCoRes) model space. CuCoRes incorporates three reservoirs with spatial correlation adjustment in each direction to adequately and accurately capture multi-directional dynamics (i.e., changing information) within GPR data. Fitting GPR data with CuCoRes and representing data with fitted models, the original GPR data is mapped into a category-discriminative CuCoRes model space, where anomalies could be efficiently identified and categorized based on model dissimilarities. c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.title: PAMol: Pocket-Aware Drug Design Method with Hypergraph Representation of Protein Pocket Structure and Feature Fusion
c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.abstract: Efficient generation of targeted drug molecules is crucial in the field of drug discovery. Most existing methods neglect the high-order information in the structure of protein pockets, limiting the performance of generated drug molecules. This paper proposes a pocket-aware drug design framework, namely PAMol, constructing the hypergraph to represent the spatial structure of protein pockets, effectively capturing high-order relations and neighborhood information within the pocket structures. This framework also fuses different modal embeddings from proteins and molecules, to generate high-quality molecules. In addition, a conditional molecule generation module uses the high-order structural information in protein pockets as constraints to more accurately generate molecules for specific targets. The performance of PAMol has been assessed by analyzing generated molecules in terms of vina sc
c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.zh_title: PAMol：基于口袋超图表示的药物设计方法
c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.summary: IJCAI 2025提出PAMol，用超图表示蛋白口袋空间结构并融合特征，以捕获高阶关系生成靶向药物分子。

c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.zh_abstract: 高效生成靶向药物分子在药物发现领域至关重要。大多数现有方法忽略了蛋白质口袋结构中的高阶信息，限制了所生成药物分子的性能。本文提出了一种口袋感知的药物设计框架，即 PAMol，构建超图来表示蛋白质口袋的空间结构，有效捕获口袋结构内的高阶关系和邻域信息。该框架还融合来自蛋白质和分子的不同模态嵌入，以生成高质量分子。此外，一个条件分子生成模块以蛋白质口袋中的高阶结构信息作为约束，更准确地为特定靶标生成分子。PAMol 的性能已通过从 vina sc 方面分析所生成的分子进行评估

538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.title: RPMIL: Rethinking Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Multiple Instance Learning for Whole Slide Pathology Diagnosis
538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.abstract: Whole slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel digital scans of traditional pathology slides, offering substantial support for cancer diagnosis. Current multiple instance learning (MIL) methods for WSIs typically extract instance features and aggregate these into a single bag feature for prediction. We observe that these MIL methods rely on point estimation, where each bag is mapped to a deterministic embedding. Such MIL methods based on point estimation fail to capture the full spectrum of data variability due to the reliance on fixed embedding, especially when the number of trainable bags is limited. In this paper, we rethink probabilistic modeling in MIL and propose RPMIL, an uncertainty-aware probabilistic MIL method for whole slide pathology diagnosis. 538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.zh_title: RPMIL：重思不确定性感知概率多实例学习用于全切片病理诊断
538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.summary: 该研究重思不确定性感知概率多实例学习，用于全切片病理图像诊断。

538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.zh_abstract: 全切片图像（Whole Slide Images，WSI）是传统病理切片的千兆像素数字扫描，为癌症诊断提供了重要支持。当前用于 WSI 的多实例学习（multiple instance learning，MIL）方法通常提取实例特征，并将这些特征聚合为单个包（bag）特征用于预测。我们观察到，这些 MIL 方法依赖于点估计，即每个包被映射为一个确定性嵌入。此类基于点估计的 MIL 方法由于依赖固定嵌入，无法捕获数据变异性的完整谱系，尤其是在可训练的包数量有限时。在本文中，我们重新思考 MIL 中的概率建模，并提出 RPMIL，一种用于全切片病理诊断的不确定性感知概率 MIL 方法。RPMIL 学习一个概率聚合器，将实例特征整合为动态的包特征分布，而非一个确定性

52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.title: ElaD-Net: An Elastic Semantic Decoupling Network for Lesion Segmentation in Breast Ultrasound Images
52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.abstract: Breast diseases pose a significant threat to women’s health. Automatic lesion segmentation in breast ultrasound images (BUSI) plays a crucial role in fast diagnosis. While various enhanced U-Net-based models have achieved success in multi-scale feature analysis and handling blurred boundaries, two key challenges persist that could guide the improvement of BUSI segmentation networks: 1) significant fluctuations in pixel intensity distribution similarity between the lesion and surrounding tissues, and 2) inconsistent transmission of spatial detail due to multi-scale lesion sampling. These issues highlight the necessity of semantic elasticity understanding and consistency control. To this end, we propose ElaD-Net, an Elastic Semantic Decoupling Network for lesion segmentation in BUSI. This network uses the pre-trained EfficientNet-B2 for multi-scale encoding of BUSI. 52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.zh_title: ElaD-Net：乳腺超声图像病灶分割的弹性语义解耦网络

4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.title: REVE: A Foundation Model for EEG - Adapting to Any Setup with Large-Scale Pretraining on 25,000 Subjects
4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.abstract: Foundation models have transformed AI by reducing reliance on task-specific data through large-scale pretraining. While successful in language and vision, their adoption in EEG has lagged due to the heterogeneity of public datasets, which are collected under varying protocols, devices, and electrode configurations. Existing EEG foundation models struggle to generalize across these variations, often restricting pretraining to a single setup, resulting in suboptimal performance, in particular under linear probing. We present REVE (Representation for EEG with Versatile Embeddings), a pretrained model explicitly designed to generalize across diverse EEG signals. REVE introduces a novel 4D positional encoding scheme that enables it to process signals of arbitrary length and electrode arrangement. Using a masked autoencoding objective, we pretrain REVE on over 60,000 hours of EEG data from 92
4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.zh_title: REVE：可适配任意设置的EEG基础模型

4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.zh_abstract: 基础模型通过大规模预训练减少了对任务特定数据的依赖，从而改变了 AI。尽管在语言和视觉领域取得了成功，但它们在 EEG 中的应用一直滞后，原因在于公共数据集的异质性——这些数据集是在不同的协议、设备和电极配置下收集的。现有的 EEG 基础模型难以在这些差异之间泛化，往往将预训练限制在单一设置中，导致性能欠佳，尤其是在线性探测（linear probing）下。我们提出 REVE（Representation for EEG with Versatile Embeddings，面向 EEG 的多功能嵌入表示），这是一个明确为跨多样 EEG 信号泛化而设计的预训练模型。REVE 引入了一种新颖的 4D 位置编码方案，使其能够处理任意长度的信号和电极排布。使用掩码自编码（masked autoencoding）目标，我们在来自 92 的超过 60,000 小时 EEG 数据上预训练 REVE。

5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.title: CSBrain: A Cross-scale Spatiotemporal Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding
5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.abstract: Understanding and decoding brain activity from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a fundamental challenge in neuroscience and AI, with applications in cognition, emotion recognition, diagnosis, and brain-computer interfaces. While recent EEG foundation models advance generalized decoding via unified architectures and large-scale pretraining, they adopt a scale-agnostic dense modeling paradigm inherited from NLP and vision. This design neglects a core property of neural activity: cross-scale spatiotemporal structure. EEG task patterns span a wide range of temporal and spatial scales, from short bursts to slow rhythms, and from localized cortical responses to distributed interactions. Ignoring this diversity leads to suboptimal representations and weak generalization. We propose CSBrain, a Cross-scale Spatiotemporal Brain foundation model for generalized EEG decoding. 现有EEG基础模型采用尺度无关密集建模

5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.zh_abstract: 从脑电图（EEG）信号中理解和解码大脑活动是神经科学和人工智能中的一个基本挑战，其应用涵盖认知、情绪识别、诊断和脑机接口。尽管近期的EEG基础模型通过统一架构和大规模预训练推进了泛化解码，但它们采用了继承自自然语言处理（NLP）和视觉的与尺度无关的稠密建模范式。这种设计忽略了神经活动的一个核心特性：跨尺度时空结构。EEG任务模式跨越广泛的时间和空间尺度，从短促爆发到慢节律，从局部皮层反应到分布式交互。忽视这种多样性会导致次优表征和弱泛化。我们提出CSBrain，一种用于泛化EEG解码的跨尺度时空脑基础模型。CSBrain introduc

f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.title: GEM: Empowering MLLM for Grounded ECG Understanding with Time Series and Images
f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.abstract: While recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced automated ECG interpretation, they still face two key limitations: (1) insufficient multimodal synergy between time series signals and visual ECG representations, and (2) limited explainability in linking diagnoses to granular waveform evidence. We introduce GEM, the first MLLM unifying ECG time series, 12-lead ECG images and text for grounded and clinician-aligned ECG interpretation. GEM enables feature-grounded analysis, evidence-driven reasoning, and a clinician-like diagnostic process through three core innovations: a dual-encoder framework extracting complementary time series and image features, cross-modal alignment for effective multimodal understanding, and knowledge-guided instruction generation for generating high-granularity grounding data (ECG-Grounding) linking diagnoses to measurable parameters ($e.g.$, QRS
f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.zh_title: GEM：面向心电时序与图像的循证理解多模态大模型
f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.summary: GEM 统一心电时序信号、12 导联图像与文本，实现特征可溯源、与临床医生对齐的心电图解读。

诊断与波形证据关联可解释性有限
首个统一时序、图像与文本的心电大模型
f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.zh_abstract: 尽管近期多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）推进了自动化心电图（ECG）解读，但它们仍面临两个关键局限：（1）时间序列信号与视觉ECG表示之间的多模态协同不足；（2）在将诊断与细粒度波形证据相联系方面的可解释性有限。我们提出GEM，这是首个统一ECG时间序列、12导联ECG图像和文本，用于有依据且与临床医生对齐的ECG解读的MLLM。GEM通过三项核心创新实现基于特征的分析、证据驱动推理和类临床医生诊断过程：一个提取互补时间序列和图像特征的双编码器框架、用于有效多模态理解的跨模态对齐，以及知识引导的指令生成，用于生成高粒度 grounding 数据（ECG-Grounding），将诊断与可测量参数（例如，QRS

31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.title: QoQ-Med: Building Multimodal Clinical Foundation Models with Domain-Aware GRPO Training
31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.abstract: Clinical decision-making routinely demands reasoning over heterogeneous data, yet existing multimodal language models (MLLMs) remain largely vision-centric and fail to generalize across clinical specialties. To bridge this gap, we introduce QoQ-Med-7B/32B, the first open generalist clinical foundation model that jointly reasons across medical images, time-series signals, and text reports. QoQ-Med is trained with Domain-aware Relative Policy Optimization (DRPO), a novel reinforcement-learning objective that hierarchically scales normalized rewards according to domain rarity and modality difficulty, mitigating performance imbalance caused by skewed clinical data distributions. 31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.zh_title: QoQ-Med：领域感知GRPO的多模态临床基础模型
31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.summary: 提出QoQ-Med-7B/32B，首个开放通用临床基础模型，联合推理医学图像、时序信号与文本报告。
key_points: 提出7B/32B临床基础模型
联合推理图像时序与文本
采用领域感知DRPO训练
31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.zh_abstract: 临床决策通常需要对异构数据进行推理，然而现有多模态语言模型（MLLMs）在很大程度上仍以视觉为中心，并且无法在临床专科之间泛化。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 QoQ-Med-7B/32B，这是首个开放的通用临床基础模型，可跨医学图像、时间序列信号和文本报告进行联合推理。QoQ-Med 使用领域感知相对策略优化（DRPO）训练，这是一种新颖的强化学习目标，其根据领域稀有性和模态难度分层缩放归一化奖励，从而缓解由偏斜的临床数据分布导致的性能不平衡。在涵盖 9 个临床领域的 261 万条指令调优对上进行训练后，我们表明，与其他 crit 相比，DRPO 训练在所有视觉领域上平均将诊断性能在 macro-F1 上提升 43%。

91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.title: MedAgentBoard: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Collaboration with Conventional Methods for Diverse Medical Tasks
91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has stimulated interest in multi-agent collaboration for addressing complex medical tasks. However, the practical advantages of multi-agent collaboration approaches remain insufficiently understood. Existing evaluations often lack generalizability, failing to cover diverse tasks reflective of real-world clinical practice, and frequently omit rigorous comparisons against both single-LLM-based and established conventional methods. To address this critical gap, we introduce MedAgentBoard, a comprehensive benchmark for the systematic evaluation of multi-agent collaboration, single-LLM, and conventional approaches. 91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.zh_title: MedAgentBoard：多智能体协作医学任务基准
91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.summary: 构建MedAgentBoard基准，评估多智能体协作在多样医学任务中相比单LLM和传统方法的优势。
key_points: 多智能体协作实际优势尚不明确
现有评估缺乏泛化性与严格对比
覆盖多样真实临床任务
91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展激发了人们对多智能体协作以解决复杂医学任务的兴趣。然而，多智能体协作方法的实际优势仍未得到充分理解。现有评估往往缺乏泛化性，未能覆盖反映真实临床实践的各种任务，并且经常缺少与基于单一 LLM 的方法以及已确立的传统方法之间的严格比较。为弥补这一关键空白，我们提出 MedAgentBoard，一个用于系统评估多智能体协作、单一 LLM 和传统方法的综合基准。MedAgentBoard 涵盖四个不同的医学任务类别：（1）医学（视觉）问答，（2）通俗摘要生成，（3）结构化电子健康记录（EHR）预测建模，以及（4）临床工作流 au

ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.title: PatientSim: A Persona-Driven Simulator for Realistic Doctor-Patient Interactions
ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.abstract: Doctor-patient consultations require multi-turn, context-aware communication tailored to diverse patient personas. Training or evaluating doctor LLMs in such settings requires realistic patient interaction systems. However, existing simulators often fail to reflect the full range of personas seen in clinical practice. To address this, we introduce PatientSim, a patient simulator that generates realistic and diverse patient personas for clinical scenarios, grounded in medical expertise. PatientSim operates using: 1) clinical profiles, including symptoms and medical history, derived from real-world data in the MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV datasets, and 2) personas defined by four axes: personality, language proficiency, medical history recall level, and cognitive confusion level, resulting in 37 unique combinations. ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.zh_title: PatientSim：角色驱动的医患交互模拟器
ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.summary: 提出PatientSim患者模拟器，基于医学知识生成多样化的患者人设，用于训练或评估医生LLM。
key_points: 医患咨询需多轮上下文感知沟通
现有模拟器未覆盖临床患者多样性
PatientSim生成真实多样患者人设
ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.zh_abstract: 医患问诊需要针对不同患者人设（personas）进行多轮、上下文感知的沟通。在此类环境中训练或评估医生 LLMs 需要逼真的患者交互系统。然而，现有模拟器往往无法反映临床实践中出现的全部人设范围。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 PatientSim，一种患者模拟器，可为临床场景生成逼真且多样的患者人设，并以医学专业知识为基础。PatientSim 的运行使用：1）临床档案，包括症状和病史，源自 MIMIC-ED 和 MIMIC-IV 数据集中的真实世界数据；以及 2）由四个维度定义的人设：性格、语言熟练度、病史回忆水平和认知混乱水平，产生 37 种独特组合。我们评估了八个 LLMs 的事实准确性和人设一致性。表现最佳的

15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.title: CARES: Comprehensive Evaluation of Safety and Adversarial Robustness in Medical LLMs
15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in medical contexts, raising critical concerns about safety, alignment, and susceptibility to adversarial manipulation. While prior benchmarks assess model refusal capabilities for harmful prompts, they often lack clinical specificity, graded harmfulness levels, and coverage of jailbreak-style attacks. We introduce CARES (Clinical Adversarial Robustness and Evaluation of Safety), a benchmark for evaluating LLM safety in healthcare. CARES includes over 18,000 prompts spanning eight medical safety principles, four harm levels, and four prompting styles: direct, indirect, obfuscated, and role-play, to simulate both malicious and benign use cases. 15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.zh_title: CARES：医学大模型安全与对抗鲁棒性评估
15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.summary: 提出CARES基准，从临床特异性、分级危害程度与越狱式攻击等方面评估医学大模型的安全性与对抗鲁棒性。

47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.title: Consistent Sampling and Simulation: Molecular Dynamics with Energy-Based Diffusion Models
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.abstract: In recent years, diffusion models trained on equilibrium molecular distributions have proven effective for sampling biomolecules. Beyond direct sampling, the score of such a model can also be used to derive the forces that act on molecular systems. However, while classical diffusion sampling usually recovers the training distribution, the corresponding energy-based interpretation of the learned score is often inconsistent with this distribution, even for low-dimensional toy systems. We trace this inconsistency to inaccuracies of the learned score at very small diffusion timesteps, where the model must capture the correct evolution of the data distribution. In this regime, diffusion models fail to satisfy the Fokker-Planck equation, which governs the evolution of the score. We interpret this deviation as one source of the observed inconsistencies and propose an energy-based diffusion mode
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.zh_title: 一致采样与模拟：基于能量扩散模型的分子动力学
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.summary: 针对扩散模型学习分数与能量解释不一致的问题，提出用于分子动力学采样的能量扩散模型方法。
key_points: 平衡态扩散模型可用于生物分子采样
学得分数导出的力与训练分布不一致
在低维玩具系统上追溯该不一致来源
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.zh_abstract: 近年来，在平衡分子分布上训练的扩散模型已被证明能有效用于生物分子采样。除了直接采样，此类模型的分数（score）也可用于推导作用于分子系统的力。然而，尽管经典扩散采样通常能恢复训练分布，但所学分数相应的基于能量的解释往往与该分布不一致，即使对于低维玩具系统也是如此。我们将这种不一致追溯至所学分数在非常小的扩散时间步长下的不准确性，此时模型必须捕捉数据分布的正确演化。在这种情形下，扩散模型无法满足 Fokker-Planck 方程，而该方程支配分数的演化。我们将这一偏差解释为所观察到的不一致性的一个来源，并提出一种基于能量的扩散 mode

d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.title: MIRA: Medical Time Series Foundation Model for Real-World Health Data
d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.abstract: A unified foundation model for medical time series -- pretrained on open access and ethics board-approved medical corpora -- offers the potential to reduce annotation burdens, minimize model customization, and enable robust transfer across clinical institutions, modalities, and tasks, particularly in data-scarce or privacy-constrained environments. However, existing generalist time series foundation models struggle to handle medical time series data due to their inherent challenges, including irregular intervals, heterogeneous sampling rates, and frequent missing values. To address these challenges, we introduce MIRA, a unified foundation model specifically designed for medical time series forecasting. d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.zh_title: MIRA：面向真实世界健康数据的医学时间序列基础模型
d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.summary: 提出医学时间序列基础模型MIRA，在合规医学语料预训练，提升跨机构跨任务迁移能力。
key_points: 统一医学时间序列基础模型

d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.zh_abstract: 一个统一的医学时间序列基础模型——在开放获取和伦理委员会批准的医学语料库上预训练——具有减少标注负担、最小化模型定制，并实现跨临床机构、模态和任务的稳健迁移的潜力，特别是在数据稀缺或隐私受限的环境中。然而，现有的通用时间序列基础模型由于医学时间序列数据固有的挑战，包括不规则间隔、异质采样率和频繁缺失值，难以处理这些数据。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MIRA，一个专门为医学时间序列预测设计的统一基础模型。MIRA 包含连续时间旋转位置编码（Continuous-Time Rotary Positional Encoding），可对可变时间间隔进行细粒度建模；以及一个频率特定的专家混合层（frequency-specific mixture-of-experts layer），它路由 comp

04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.title: CPathAgent: An Agent-based Foundation Model for Interpretable High-Resolution Pathology Image Analysis Mimicking Pathologists' Diagnostic Logic
04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.abstract: Recent advances in computational pathology have led to the emergence of numerous foundation models. These models typically rely on general-purpose encoders with multi-instance learning for whole slide image (WSI) classification or apply multimodal approaches to generate reports directly from images. However, these models cannot emulate the diagnostic approach of pathologists, who systematically examine slides at low magnification to obtain an overview before progressively zooming in on suspicious regions to formulate comprehensive diagnoses. Instead, existing models directly output final diagnoses without revealing the underlying reasoning process. 04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.zh_title: CPathAgent：模拟病理医生诊断逻辑的可解释病理基础模型
04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.summary: 提出基于智能体的病理基础模型，模拟病理医生由低倍到高倍逐级观察的诊断逻辑。

模仿先低倍概览再放大可疑区域

04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.zh_abstract: 计算病理学（computational pathology）的最新进展催生了许多基础模型（foundation models）。这些模型通常依赖通用编码器（general-purpose encoders）结合多实例学习（multi-instance learning）进行全切片图像（WSI）分类，或应用多模态方法直接从图像生成报告。然而，这些模型无法模拟病理学家的诊断方法：病理学家系统地在低倍放大下检查切片以获得整体概览，然后逐步放大可疑区域，从而形成全面的诊断。相反，现有模型直接输出最终诊断，而不揭示潜在的推理过程。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 CPathAgent，这是一种创新的基于智能体（agent-based）的方法，它通过基于观察到的视觉特征在 WSI 上自主导航，模拟病理学家的诊断工作流程，从而生成显著更多的 transp

5763eb443b946d72c4512b9f2863e9f82051f9ea.title: Look Before You Leap: A GUI-Critic-R1 Model for Pre-Operative Error Diagnosis in GUI Automation
5763eb443b946d72c4512b9f2863e9f82051f9ea.abstract: In recent years, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been extensively utilized for multimodal reasoning tasks, including Graphical User Interface (GUI) automation. Unlike general offline multimodal tasks, GUI automation is executed in online interactive environments, necessitating step-by-step decision-making based on real-time status of the environment. This task has a lower tolerance for decision-making errors at each step, as any mistakes may cumulatively disrupt the process and potentially lead to irreversible outcomes like deletions or payments. To address these issues, we introduce a pre-operative critic mechanism that provides effective feedback prior to the actual execution, by reasoning about the potential outcome and correctness of actions. b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.title: 3D-RAD: A Comprehensive 3D Radiology Med-VQA Dataset with Multi-Temporal Analysis and Diverse Diagnostic Tasks
b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) holds significant potential for clinical decision support, yet existing efforts primarily focus on 2D imaging with limited task diversity. This paper presents 3D-RAD, a large-scale dataset designed to advance 3D Med-VQA using radiology CT scans. The 3D-RAD dataset encompasses six diverse VQA tasks: anomaly detection, image observation, medical computation, existence detection, static temporal diagnosis, and longitudinal temporal diagnosis. It supports both open- and closed-ended questions while introducing complex reasoning challenges, including computational tasks and multi-stage temporal analysis, to enable comprehensive benchmarking. 含异常检测等六类VQA任务

b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答（Medical Visual Question Answering, Med-VQA）在临床决策支持方面具有巨大潜力，但现有工作主要集中于 2D 成像且任务多样性有限。本文提出 3D-RAD，一个旨在利用放射学 CT 扫描推进 3D Med-VQA 的大规模数据集。3D-RAD 数据集涵盖六项多样的 VQA 任务：异常检测、图像观察、医学计算、存在检测、静态时间诊断和纵向时间诊断。它支持开放式和封闭式问题，同时引入复杂推理挑战，包括计算任务和多阶段时间分析，以实现全面基准测试。大量评估表明，现有视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs），尤其是医学 VLMs，泛化能力有限，特别是在多时间任务中，凸显了真实世的挑战

2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.title: PanTS: The Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation Dataset
2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.abstract: PanTS is a large-scale, multi-institutional dataset curated to advance research in pancreatic CT analysis. It contains 36,390 CT scans from 145 medical centers, with expert-validated, voxel-wise annotations of over 993,000 anatomical structures, covering pancreatic tumors, pancreas head, body, and tail, and 24 surrounding anatomical structures such as vascular/skeletal structures and abdominal/thoracic organs. Each scan includes metadata such as patient age, sex, diagnosis, contrast phase, in-plane spacing, slice thickness, etc. AI models trained on PanTS achieve significantly better performance in pancreatic tumor detection, localization, and segmentation compared to those trained on existing public datasets. Our analysis indicates that these gains are directly attributable to the 16x larger-scale tumor annotations and indirectly supported by the 24 additional surrounding anatomical str
2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.summary: 发布PanTS大规模多中心胰腺CT数据集，含36,390例扫描与专家验证的体素级标注。
key_points: 36,390例CT扫描、145家医疗中心
逾99.3万解剖结构体素级标注
覆盖胰腺肿瘤及24种周围结构
2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.zh_abstract: PanTS是一个大规模、多机构的数据集，旨在推进胰腺CT分析的研究。它包含来自145个医疗中心的36,390张CT扫描，具有专家验证的、体素级别的超过993,000个解剖结构的标注，涵盖胰腺肿瘤、胰头、胰体和胰尾，以及24个周围解剖结构，如血管/骨骼结构和腹部/胸部器官。每次扫描包括元数据，如患者年龄、性别、诊断、对比期、平面内间距、层厚等。在PanTS上训练的AI模型在胰腺肿瘤检测、定位和分割方面，与在现有公共数据集上训练的模型相比，取得了显著更好的性能。我们的分析表明，这些收益直接归因于规模大16倍的肿瘤标注，并间接得到24个额外周围解剖结构的支持。

f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.title: Mol-LLaMA: Towards General Understanding of Molecules in Large Molecular Language Model
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.abstract: Understanding molecules is key to understanding organisms and driving advances in drug discovery, requiring interdisciplinary knowledge across chemistry and biology. Although large molecular language models have achieved notable success in task transfer, they often struggle to accurately analyze molecular features due to limited knowledge and reasoning capabilities. To address this issue, we present Mol-LLaMA, a large molecular language model that grasps the general knowledge centered on molecules and exhibits explainability and reasoning ability. To this end, we design key data types that encompass the fundamental molecular features, taking into account the essential abilities for molecular reasoning. Further, to improve molecular understanding, we propose a module that integrates complementary information from different molecular encoders, leveraging the distinct advantages of molecula
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.zh_title: Mol-LLaMA：面向分子通用理解的大型分子语言模型
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.summary: 提出Mol-LLaMA分子大语言模型，旨在提升对分子特征的分析与推理能力。
key_points: 理解分子对认识生物体和药物发现关键
现有分子大模型知识与推理能力有限
Mol-LLaMA以分子为中心获取通用知识
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.zh_abstract: 理解分子是理解生物体和推动药物发现进展的关键，这需要跨越化学与生物学的跨学科知识。尽管大型分子语言模型在任务迁移方面取得了显著成功，但由于知识和推理能力有限，它们常常难以准确分析分子特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 Mol-LLaMA，一个大型分子语言模型，其掌握以分子为中心的一般知识，并表现出可解释性和推理能力。为此，我们设计了涵盖基本分子特征的关键数据类型，同时考虑分子推理所需的基本能力。进一步，为了改进分子理解，我们提出了一个模块，该模块整合来自不同分子编码器的互补信息，利用分子编码器的独特优势。

c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.title: Better Tokens for Better 3D: Advancing Vision-Language Modeling in 3D Medical Imaging
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.abstract: Recent progress in vision-language modeling for 3D medical imaging has been fueled by large-scale computed tomography (CT) corpora with paired free-text reports, stronger architectures, and powerful pretrained models. This has enabled applications such as automated report generation and text-conditioned 3D image synthesis. Yet, current approaches struggle with high-resolution, long-sequence volumes: contrastive pretraining often yields vision encoders that are misaligned with clinical language, and slice-wise tokenization blurs fine anatomy, reducing diagnostic performance on downstream tasks. We introduce BTB3D (Better Tokens for Better 3D), a causal convolutional encoder-decoder that unifies 2D and 3D training and inference while producing compact, frequency-aware volumetric tokens. A three-stage training curriculum enables (i) local reconstruction, (ii) overlapping-window tiling, and
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.zh_title: 改进Token化以推进3D医学影像视觉语言建模
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.summary: 针对高分辨率长序列3D CT数据，改进视觉语言模型的token表示以缓解视觉编码器与临床语言的错位。
key_points: 面向高分辨率长序列3D体数据
缓解视觉编码器与临床语言错位
服务于报告生成与文本条件合成
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.zh_abstract: 三维医学影像视觉—语言建模的近期进展，得益于带有配对自由文本报告的大规模计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）语料库、更强的架构以及强大的预训练模型。这促成了自动报告生成和文本条件化三维图像合成等应用。然而，当前方法在高分辨率、长序列体数据上仍面临困难：对比预训练往往产生与临床语言不对齐的视觉编码器，而逐切片的标记化（slice-wise tokenization）会模糊精细解剖结构，降低下游任务的诊断性能。我们提出 BTB3D（Better Tokens for Better 3D），这是一种因果卷积编码器—解码器，统一了二维与三维的训练和推理，同时生成紧凑、频率感知的体素标记（volumetric tokens）。一个三阶段训练课程依次实现：(i) 局部重建，(ii) 重叠窗口分块（overlapping-window tiling），以及

8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.title: Towards Better Dental AI: A Multimodal Benchmark and Instruction Dataset for Panoramic X-ray Analysis
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on general-purpose medical tasks. However, their effectiveness in specialized domains such as dentistry remains underexplored. In particular, panoramic X-rays, a widely used imaging modality in oral radiology, pose interpretative challenges due to dense anatomical structures and subtle pathological cues, which are not captured by existing medical benchmarks or instruction datasets. To this end, we introduce MMOral, the first large-scale multimodal instruction dataset and benchmark tailored for panoramic X-ray interpretation. MMOral consists of 20,563 annotated images paired with 1.3 million instruction-following instances across diverse task types, including attribute extraction, report generation, visual question answering, and image-grounded dialogue. In addition, we present MMOral-Bench, a com
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.zh_title: 面向口腔AI：全景X线分析的多模态基准与指令数据集
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.summary: NeurIPS 2025 针对牙科全景X线，构建多模态基准与指令数据集，弥补现有医学基准在口腔领域的空白。
key_points: 大型视觉语言模型在牙科等专科表现尚待探索
全景X线结构密集、病理征象细微，解读困难
现有医学基准与指令数据集未覆盖该场景
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.zh_abstract: 近期，大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）的进展已在通用医学任务上展现出强大性能。然而，其在牙科等专业领域中的有效性仍未被充分探索。特别是，全景X射线作为口腔放射学中广泛使用的成像模态，由于密集的解剖结构和细微的病理线索而带来判读挑战，这些挑战未被现有医学基准或指令数据集所涵盖。为此，我们提出 MMOral，这是首个面向全景X射线判读定制的大规模多模态指令数据集与基准。MMOral 包含 20,563 张标注图像，并配有 130 万个遵循指令的实例，涵盖多种任务类型，包括属性提取、报告生成、视觉问答和基于图像的对话。此外，我们提出 MMOral-Bench，一个 com

4009db3a123f9771f8ef1f06cf4277ec3790afcd.title: How to Train Your LLM Web Agent: A Statistical Diagnosis
4009db3a123f9771f8ef1f06cf4277ec3790afcd.abstract: LLM-based web agents have recently made significant progress, but much of it has occurred in closed-source systems, widening the gap with open-source alternatives. Progress has been held back by two key challenges: first, a narrow focus on single-step tasks that overlooks the complexity of multi-step web interactions; and second, the high compute costs required to post-train LLM-based web agents. To address this, we present the first statistically grounded study on compute allocation for LLM web-agent post-training. Our approach uses a two-stage pipeline, training a Llama 3.1 8B student to imitate a Llama 3.3 70B teacher via supervised fine-tuning (SFT), followed by on-policy reinforcement learning. cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.title: Statistically Valid Post-Deployment Monitoring Should Be Standard for AI-Based Digital Health
cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.abstract: This position paper argues that post-deployment monitoring in clinical AI is underdeveloped and proposes statistically valid and label-efficient testing frameworks as a principled foundation for ensuring reliability and safety in real-world deployment. A recent review found that only 9% of FDA-registered AI-based healthcare tools include a post-deployment surveillance plan. Existing monitoring approaches are often manual, sporadic, and reactive, making them ill-suited for the dynamic environments in which clinical models operate. We contend that post-deployment monitoring should be grounded in label-efficient and statistically valid testing frameworks, offering a principled alternative to current practices. cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.zh_title: 立场论文：AI数字健康部署后监测应标准化
cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.summary: 该立场论文指出临床AI部署后监测不足，提出统计有效且标签高效的测试框架，并援引仅9%的FDA注册AI医疗工具含监测计划。

290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.title: EndoBench: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Modal Large Language Models for Endoscopy Analysis
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.abstract: Endoscopic procedures are essential for diagnosing and treating internal diseases, and multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to assist in endoscopy analysis. However, current benchmarks are limited, as they typically cover specific endoscopic scenarios and a small set of clinical tasks, failing to capture the real-world diversity of endoscopic scenarios and the full range of skills needed in clinical workflows. To address these issues, we introduce EndoBench, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to assess MLLMs across the full spectrum of endoscopic practice with multi-dimensional capacities. EndoBench encompasses 4 distinct endoscopic scenarios, 12 specialized clinical tasks with 12 secondary subtasks, and 5 levels of visual prompting granularities, resulting in 6,832 rigorously validated VQA pairs from 21 diverse datasets. Our multi-dimen
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.zh_title: EndoBench：内镜分析多模态大模型综合评测
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出EndoBench，针对内镜分析的多模态大语言模型综合基准，覆盖多场景与多临床任务。
key_points: 内镜诊疗中MLLM应用渐增
现有基准场景与任务覆盖有限

强调真实场景多样性与临床技能
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.zh_abstract: 内镜操作对于诊断和治疗内部疾病至关重要，而多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）正越来越多地被用于辅助内镜分析。然而，当前基准是有限的，因为它们通常覆盖特定的内镜场景和一小部分临床任务，未能捕捉内镜场景的真实世界多样性以及临床工作流程所需的全部技能范围。为解决这些问题，我们提出 EndoBench，这是首个专门设计用于评估 MLLMs 在内镜实践全谱系中多维能力的综合性基准。EndoBench 涵盖 4 个不同的内镜场景、12 项专业临床任务及 12 项二级子任务，以及 5 个级别的视觉提示粒度，从而产生来自 21 个多样化数据集的 6,832 对严格验证的 VQA 对。我们的多 dimen

bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.title: Chiron-o1: Igniting Multimodal Large Language Models towards Generalizable Medical Reasoning via Mentor-Intern Collaborative Search
bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have begun to demonstrate robust reasoning capabilities on general tasks, yet their application in the medical domain remains in its early stages. Constructing chain-of-thought (CoT) training data is essential for bolstering the reasoning abilities of medical MLLMs. However, existing approaches exhibit a deficiency in offering a comprehensive framework for searching and evaluating effective reasoning paths towards critical diagnosis. To address this challenge, we propose Mentor-Intern Collaborative Search (MICS), a novel reasoning-path searching scheme to generate rigorous and effective medical CoT data. bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.zh_title: Chiron-o1：师徒协作搜索提升医学多模态推理
bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.summary: 提出Chiron-o1，通过师徒协作搜索构建思维链数据，提升医学多模态大模型的泛化推理能力。
key_points: 医学MLLM推理仍处早期阶段
现有方法缺乏推理路径搜索评估框架
采用师徒协作搜索构建思维链数据
bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）已开始在通用任务上展现出强大的推理能力，但其在医学领域的应用仍处于早期阶段。构建思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）训练数据对于增强医学 MLLMs 的推理能力至关重要。然而，现有方法在提供用于搜索和评估通向关键诊断的有效推理路径的综合框架方面存在不足。为应对这一挑战，我们提出导师-实习生协同搜索（Mentor-Intern Collaborative Search, MICS），一种新颖的推理路径搜索方案，用于生成严谨且有效的医学 CoT 数据。MICS 首先利用导师模型逐步初始化推理，然后提示每个实习生模型沿这些已初始化的路径继续思考，最后根据整体推理

79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.title: EgoExOR: An Ego-Exo-Centric Operating Room Dataset for Surgical Activity Understanding
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.abstract: Operating rooms (ORs) demand precise coordination among surgeons, nurses, and equipment in a fast-paced, occlusion-heavy environment, necessitating advanced perception models to enhance safety and efficiency. Existing datasets either provide partial egocentric views or sparse exocentric multi-view context, but do not explore the comprehensive combination of both. We introduce EgoExOR, the first OR dataset and accompanying benchmark to fuse first-person and third-person perspectives. Spanning 94 minutes (84,553 frames at 15 FPS) of two emulated spine procedures, Ultrasound-Guided Needle Insertion and Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery, EgoExOR integrates egocentric data (RGB, gaze, hand tracking, audio) from wearable glasses, exocentric RGB and depth from RGB-D cameras, and ultrasound imagery. 79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.zh_title: EgoExOR：第一/第三人称手术室活动理解数据集
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.summary: NeurIPS 2025发布EgoExOR，首个融合第一人称与第三人称视角的手术室数据集与配套基准。
key_points: 手术室遮挡严重、需多方精确协调

首个融合第一与第三人称视角的基准
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.zh_abstract: 手术室（ORs）在快节奏、遮挡严重的环境中要求外科医生、护士和设备之间精确协调，因而需要先进的感知模型来提升安全性和效率。现有数据集要么提供部分自我中心视角，要么提供稀疏的外中心多视角上下文，但未探索两者的全面结合。我们提出 EgoExOR，这是首个用于融合第一人称与第三人称视角的手术室数据集及配套基准。EgoExOR 涵盖两种模拟脊柱手术——超声引导下针插入和微创脊柱手术——共 94 分钟（15 FPS 下 84,553 帧），整合了来自可穿戴眼镜的自我中心数据（RGB、注视、手部追踪、音频）、来自 RGB-D 相机的外中心 RGB 和深度，以及超声图像。其详细的场景图标注涵盖 36 个实体和 22 种关系（568,235 个三元组），en

5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.title: THUNDER: Tile-level Histopathology image UNDERstanding benchmark
5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.abstract: Progress in a research field can be hard to assess, in particular when many concurrent methods are proposed in a short period of time. This is the case in digital pathology, where many foundation models have been released recently to serve as feature extractors for tile-level images, being used in a variety of downstream tasks, both for tile- and slide-level problems. Benchmarking available methods then becomes paramount to get a clearer view of the research landscape. In particular, in critical domains such as healthcare, a benchmark should not only focus on evaluating downstream performance, but also provide insights about the main differences between methods, and importantly, further consider uncertainty and robustness to ensure a reliable usage of proposed models. 5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.zh_title: THUNDER：组织病理图像瓦片级理解基准
5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.summary: 提出组织病理图像瓦片级理解基准THUNDER，用于评估多种基础模型在下游任务的表现。

23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.title: Understanding protein function with a multimodal retrieval-augmented foundation model
23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) learn probability distributions over natural protein sequences. By learning from hundreds of millions of natural protein sequences, protein understanding and design capabilities emerge. Recent works have shown that scaling these models improves structure prediction, but does not seem to improve mutation understanding and representation quality for protein function prediction. We introduce PoET-2, a multimodal, retrieval-augmented protein foundation model that incorporates in-context learning of family-specific evolutionary constraints with optional structure conditioning to learn generative distributions over protein sequences. e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.title: DrVD-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Reason Like Human Doctors in Medical Image Diagnosis?
e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization on natural images and show early promise in interpretable medical image analysis. However, existing benchmarks do not systematically evaluate whether these models truly reason like human clinicians or merely imitate superficial patterns. To address this gap, we propose DrVD-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for clinical visual reasoning. DrVD-Bench consists of three modules: Visual Evidence Comprehension, Reasoning Trajectory Assessment, and Report Generation Evaluation, comprising a total of 7,789 image-question pairs. Our benchmark covers 20 task types, 17 diagnostic categories, and five imaging modalities-CT, MRI, ultrasound, radiography, and pathology. e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.title: Doctor Approved: Generating Medically Accurate Skin Disease Images through AI-Expert Feedback
e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.abstract: Paucity of medical data severely limits the generalizability of diagnostic ML models, as the full spectrum of disease variability can not be represented by a small clinical dataset. To address this, diffusion models (DMs) have been considered as a promising avenue for synthetic image generation and augmentation. However, they frequently produce medically inaccurate images, deteriorating the model performance. Expert domain knowledge is critical for synthesizing images that correctly encode clinical information, especially when data is scarce and quality outweighs quantity. Existing approaches for incorporating human feedback, such as reinforcement learning (RL) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), rely on robust reward functions or demand labor-intensive expert evaluations. Recent progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) reveals their strong visual reasoning capabilities

c88ebab24da1206956cad89aa6d444f5c7802d6d.abstract: Protein fitness optimization involves finding a protein sequence that maximizes desired quantitative properties in a combinatorially large design space of possible sequences. Recent advances in steering protein generative models (e.g., diffusion models and language models) with labeled data offer a promising approach. However, most previous studies have optimized surrogate rewards and/or utilized large amounts of labeled data for steering, making it unclear how well existing methods perform and compare to each other in real-world optimization campaigns where fitness is measured through low-throughput wet-lab assays. 886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.title: CARE-PD: A Multi-Site Anonymized Clinical Dataset for Parkinson's Disease Gait Assessment
886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.abstract: Objective gait assessment in Parkinson's Disease (PD) is limited by the absence of large, diverse, and clinically annotated motion datasets. CARE-PD supports two key benchmarks: supervised clinical score prediction (estimating Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale, UPDRS, gait scores) and unsupervised motion pretext tasks (2D-to-3D keypoint lifting and full-body 3D reconstruction). 8854d51b01a85685fab9e2fde036d53badcbdfee.title: Simultaneous Modeling of Protein Conformation and Dynamics via Autoregression
8854d51b01a85685fab9e2fde036d53badcbdfee.abstract: Understanding protein dynamics is critical for elucidating their biological functions. The increasing availability of molecular dynamics (MD) data enables the training of deep generative models to efficiently explore the conformational space of proteins. However, existing approaches either fail to explicitly capture the temporal dependencies between conformations or do not support direct generation of time-independent samples. To address these limitations, we introduce ConfRover, an autoregressive model that simultaneously learns protein conformation and dynamics from MD trajectories, supporting both time-dependent and time-independent sampling. 5a83768d4ae930d2ae8b6715604d636a24de8c66.title: Thousand Voices of Trauma: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Modeling Prolonged Exposure Therapy Conversations
5a83768d4ae930d2ae8b6715604d636a24de8c66.abstract: The advancement of AI systems for mental health support is hindered by limited access to therapeutic conversation data, particularly for trauma treatment. eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.title: AOR: Anatomical Ontology-Guided Reasoning for Medical Large Multimodal Model in Chest X-Ray Interpretation
eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.abstract: Chest X-rays (CXRs) are the most frequently performed imaging examinations in clinical settings. Recent advancements in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have enabled automated CXR interpretation, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. However, despite their strong visual understanding, current Medical LMMs (MLMMs) still face two major challenges: (1) Insufficient region-level understanding and interaction, and (2) Limited accuracy and interpretability due to single-step reasoning. eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.zh_title: AOR：解剖本体引导推理用于胸片解读

c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.title: Multiscale guidance of protein structure prediction with heterogeneous cryo-EM data
c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.abstract: Protein structure prediction models are now capable of generating accurate 3D structural hypotheses from sequence alone. However, they routinely fail to capture the conformational diversity of dynamic biomolecular complexes, often requiring heuristic MSA subsampling approaches for generating alternative states. In parallel, cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has emerged as a powerful tool for imaging near-native structural heterogeneity, but is challenged by arduous pipelines to transform raw experimental data into atomic models. Here, we bridge the gap between these modalities, combining cryo-EM density maps with the rich sequence and biophysical priors learned by protein structure prediction models. c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.zh_title: 异构冷冻电镜数据的多尺度蛋白结构预测引导
