b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.title: Prot2Text-V2: Protein Function Prediction with Multimodal Contrastive Alignment
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.abstract: Predicting protein function from sequence is a central challenge in computational biology. While existing methods rely heavily on structured ontologies or similarity-based techniques, they often lack the flexibility to express structure-free functional descriptions and novel biological functions. In this work, we introduce Prot2Text-V2, a novel multimodal sequence-to-text model that generates free-form natural language descriptions of protein function directly from amino acid sequences. Our method combines a protein language model as a sequence encoder (ESM-3B) and a decoder-only language model (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) through a lightweight nonlinear modality projector. A key innovation is our Hybrid Sequence-level Contrastive Alignment Learning (H-SCALE), which improves cross-modal learning by matching mean- and std-pooled protein embeddings with text representations via contrastive loss
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.zh_title: Prot2Text-V2：多模态对比对齐预测蛋白质功能
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.summary: 提出多模态序列到文本模型Prot2Text-V2，直接从氨基酸序列生成蛋白质功能的自由文本描述。
key_points: 序列到文本预测蛋白质功能
多模态对比对齐方法
生成自由形式功能描述
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.zh_abstract: 从序列预测蛋白质功能是计算生物学的核心挑战。尽管现有方法严重依赖结构化本体或基于相似性的技术，但它们通常缺乏表达能力，无法表达无结构的功能描述和新颖的生物功能。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 Prot2Text-V2，一种新型多模态序列到文本模型，可直接从氨基酸序列生成蛋白质功能的自由形式自然语言描述。我们的方法通过一个轻量级非线性模态投影器，将作为序列编码器的蛋白质语言模型（ESM-3B）与仅解码器语言模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct）相结合。一项关键创新是我们的混合序列级对比对齐学习（Hybrid Sequence-level Contrastive Alignment Learning，H-SCALE），它通过对比损失将均值池化和标准差池化的蛋白质嵌入与文本表示进行匹配，从而改进跨模态学习

8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.title: Protein Design with Dynamic Protein Vocabulary
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.abstract: Protein design is a fundamental challenge in biotechnology, aiming to design novel sequences with specific functions within the vast space of possible proteins. Recent advances in deep generative models have enabled function-based protein design from textual descriptions, yet struggle with structural plausibility. Inspired by classical protein design methods that leverage natural protein structures, we explore whether incorporating fragments from natural proteins can enhance foldability in generative models. Our empirical results show that even random incorporation of fragments improves foldability. Building on this insight, we introduce ProDVa, a novel protein design approach that integrates a text encoder for functional descriptions, a protein language model for designing proteins, and a fragment encoder to dynamically retrieve protein fragments based on textual functional descriptions
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.zh_title: 基于动态蛋白质词汇表的蛋白质设计
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出引入天然蛋白质片段，以提升生成模型设计蛋白质的折叠可行性。
key_points: 探索天然蛋白质片段增强折叠可行性
基于文本描述进行功能导向蛋白质设计
借鉴经典蛋白质设计方法
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.zh_abstract: 蛋白质设计是生物技术中的一项基本挑战，旨在在可能的蛋白质广阔空间中设计具有特定功能的新颖序列。深度生成模型的最新进展使得能够根据文本描述进行基于功能的蛋白质设计，但在结构合理性方面仍存在困难。受利用天然蛋白质结构的经典蛋白质设计方法启发，我们探讨了将来自天然蛋白质的片段纳入生成模型是否能增强可折叠性。我们的实证结果表明，即使是随机纳入片段也能提高可折叠性。基于这一洞见，我们提出了 ProDVa，一种新颖的蛋白质设计方法，它集成了用于功能描述的文本编码器、用于设计蛋白质的蛋白质语言模型，以及一个片段编码器，以基于文本功能描述动态检索蛋白质片段。

4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.title: ProtInvTree: Deliberate Protein Inverse Folding with Reward-guided Tree Search
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.abstract: Designing protein sequences that fold into a target 3D structure, known as protein inverse folding, is a fundamental challenge in protein engineering. While recent deep learning methods have achieved impressive performance by recovering native sequences, they often overlook the one-to-many nature of the problem: multiple diverse sequences can fold into the same structure. This motivates the need for a generative model capable of designing diverse sequences while preserving structural consistency. To address this trade-off, we introduce ProtInvTree, the first reward-guided tree-search framework for protein inverse folding. ProtInvTree reformulates sequence generation as a deliberate, step-wise decision-making process, enabling the exploration of multiple design paths and exploitation of promising candidates through self-evaluation, lookahead, and backtracking. We propose a two-stage focus
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.zh_title: ProtInvTree：奖励引导树搜索的蛋白质逆向折叠
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.summary: NeurIPS 2025论文，提出奖励引导树搜索的蛋白质逆向折叠方法，可生成多样且结构一致的序列。
key_points: 面向蛋白质逆向折叠
引入奖励引导树搜索
兼顾序列多样性与结构一致性
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.zh_abstract: 设计能够折叠成目标 3D 结构的蛋白质序列，即蛋白质逆折叠，是蛋白质工程中的一项基本挑战。尽管近期深度学习方法通过恢复天然序列取得了令人印象深刻的性能，但它们常常忽视该问题的一对多性质：多个不同的序列可以折叠成同一结构。这促使我们需要一种能够设计多样化序列同时保持结构一致性的生成模型。为了解决这一权衡，我们引入了 ProtInvTree，这是首个用于蛋白质逆折叠的奖励引导树搜索框架。ProtInvTree 将序列生成重新表述为一个审慎的、逐步的决策过程，通过自评估、前瞻和回溯，支持探索多条设计路径并利用有前景的候选。我们提出一个两阶段聚焦

f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.title: MedSG-Bench: A Benchmark for Medical Image Sequences Grounding
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.abstract: Visual grounding is essential for precise perception and reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially in medical imaging domains. While existing medical visual grounding benchmarks primarily focus on single-image scenarios, real-world clinical applications often involve sequential images, where accurate lesion localization across different modalities and temporal tracking of disease progression (e.g., pre- vs. post-treatment comparison) require fine-grained cross-image semantic alignment and context-aware reasoning. To remedy the underrepresentation of image sequences in existing medical visual grounding benchmarks, we propose MedSG-Bench, the first benchmark tailored for Medical Image Sequences Grounding. It comprises eight VQA-style tasks, formulated into two paradigms of the grounding tasks, including 1) Image Difference Grounding, which focuses on detecting chang
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.zh_title: MedSG-Bench：医学图像序列定位基准
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出MedSG-Bench，面向多模态大模型在医学序列图像中的病灶定位与跨图像语义推理评估。
key_points: 现有医学视觉定位基准多为单图场景
临床常涉及序列图像与跨模态定位
需时序追踪病变进展如治疗前后对比
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.zh_abstract: 视觉定位（visual grounding）对于多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）中的精确感知与推理至关重要，尤其是在医学影像领域。尽管现有医学视觉定位基准主要聚焦于单图像场景，真实世界临床应用常常涉及序列图像，其中跨不同模态的准确病灶定位以及对疾病进展的时间追踪（例如治疗前与治疗后比较）需要细粒度的跨图像语义对齐和上下文感知推理。为弥补现有医学视觉定位基准中图像序列代表性不足的问题，我们提出了 MedSG-Bench，这是首个为医学图像序列定位（Medical Image Sequences Grounding）量身定制的基准。它包含八个 VQA 风格的任务，被表述为定位任务的两类范式，包括 1）图像差异定位（Image Difference Grounding），其重点在于检测变化。

c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.title: Unified Guidance for Geometry-Conditioned Molecular Generation
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.abstract: Effectively designing molecular geometries is essential to advancing pharmaceutical innovations, a domain, which has experienced great attention through the success of generative models and, in particular, diffusion models. However, current molecular diffusion models are tailored towards a specific downstream task and lack adaptability. We introduce UniGuide, a framework for controlled geometric guidance of unconditional diffusion models that allows flexible conditioning during inference without the requirement of extra training or networks. We show how applications such as structure-based, fragment-based, and ligand-based drug design are formulated in the UniGuide framework and demonstrate on-par or superior performance compared to specialised models. Offering a more versatile approach, UniGuide has the potential to streamline the development of molecular generative models, allowing the
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.zh_title: 几何条件分子生成的统一引导框架
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.summary: 提出UniGuide，在推理时对无条件扩散模型进行可控几何引导。
key_points: 分子几何设计助力药物创新
现有扩散模型缺乏任务适应性
UniGuide支持推理时灵活条件控制
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.zh_abstract: 有效设计分子几何结构对于推动药物创新至关重要，这一领域因生成模型、尤其是扩散模型的成功而受到极大关注。然而，当前的分子扩散模型是针对特定下游任务定制的，缺乏适应性。我们提出 UniGuide，这是一个用于对无条件扩散模型进行受控几何引导的框架，允许在推理期间灵活地进行条件控制，而无需额外训练或网络。我们展示了如何将基于结构、基于片段和基于配体的药物设计等应用在 UniGuide 框架中表述，并证明与专用模型相比具有相当或更优的性能。UniGuide 提供了一种更通用的方法，有潜力简化分子生成模型的开发，从而允许

54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.title: Toward a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Medical Data: Multimodal Dataset and Benchmarks for Vietnamese PET/CT Report Generation
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.abstract: Vision-Language Foundation Models (VLMs), trained on large-scale multimodal datasets, have driven significant advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) by enabling rich cross-modal reasoning. Despite their success in general domains, applying these models to medical imaging remains challenging due to the limited availability of diverse imaging modalities and multilingual clinical data. Most existing medical VLMs are trained on a subset of imaging modalities and focus primarily on high-resource languages, thus limiting their generalizability and clinical utility. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel Vietnamese-language multimodal medical dataset consisting of 2,757 whole-body PET/CT volumes from independent patients and their corresponding full-length clinical reports. This dataset is designed to fill two pressing gaps in medical AI development: (1) the lack of PET/CT imaging
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.zh_title: 面向越南语PET/CT报告生成的多模态数据集与基准
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.summary: 构建越南语PET/CT多模态数据集与基准，推动医学视觉语言基础模型在低资源语言与影像模态上的应用。
key_points: 现有医学视觉语言模型多覆盖部分影像模态
聚焦高资源语言，低资源语言数据有限
提供越南语PET/CT报告生成数据集与基准
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.zh_abstract: 视觉-语言基础模型（VLMs）在大规模多模态数据集上训练，通过实现丰富的跨模态推理，推动了人工智能（AI）的重大进展。尽管它们在通用领域取得了成功，但由于多样化影像模态和多语言临床数据的可用性有限，将这些模型应用于医学影像仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有医学VLMs在影像模态的一个子集上训练，并主要关注高资源语言，从而限制了其泛化性和临床实用性。为解决这些局限，我们引入了一个新的越南语多模态医学数据集，由来自独立患者的2,757个全身PET/CT体积及其对应的完整临床报告组成。该数据集旨在填补医学AI开发中两个紧迫空白：（1）缺乏PET/CT成像

2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.title: Towards Unified and Lossless Latent Space for 3D Molecular Latent Diffusion Modeling
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.abstract: 3D molecule generation is crucial for drug discovery and material science, requiring models to process complex multi-modalities, including atom types, chemical bonds, and 3D coordinates. A key challenge is integrating these modalities of different shapes while maintaining SE(3) equivariance for 3D coordinates. To achieve this, existing approaches typically maintain separate latent spaces for invariant and equivariant modalities, reducing efficiency in both training and sampling. In this work, we propose \textbf{U}nified Variational \textbf{A}uto-\textbf{E}ncoder for \textbf{3D} Molecular Latent Diffusion Modeling (\textbf{UAE-3D}), a multi-modal VAE that compresses 3D molecules into latent sequences from a unified latent space, while maintaining near-zero reconstruction error. This unified latent space eliminates the complexities of handling multi-modality and equivariance when performin
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.zh_title: 面向3D分子扩散建模的统一无损隐空间
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.summary: NeurIPS 2025 提出统一且无损的隐空间方法，整合原子类型、化学键与3D坐标多模态，兼顾 SE(3) 等变性。
key_points: 面向药物发现与材料科学的3D分子生成
整合不同形状的多模态分子信息
保持3D坐标的 SE(3) 等变性
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.zh_abstract: 3D分子生成对药物发现和材料科学至关重要，要求模型处理复杂的多模态，包括原子类型、化学键和3D坐标。一个关键挑战是在保持3D坐标的SE(3)等变性的同时整合这些不同形状的模态。为实现这一点，现有方法通常为不变模态和等变模态维护单独的潜在空间，降低了训练和采样的效率。在这项工作中，我们提出统一变分自编码器用于3D分子潜在扩散建模（UAE-3D），一种多模态VAE，将3D分子压缩为来自统一潜在空间的潜在序列，同时保持接近零的重建误差。这种统一潜在空间消除了在执行时处理多模态和等变性的复杂性

1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.title: Prior-Guided Flow Matching for Target-Aware Molecule Design with Learnable Atom Number
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD), aiming to generate 3D molecules with high binding affinity toward target proteins, is a vital approach in novel drug discovery. Although recent generative models have shown great potential, they suffer from unstable probability dynamics and mismatch between generated molecule size and the protein pockets geometry, resulting in inconsistent quality and off-target effects. We propose PAFlow, a novel target-aware molecular generation model featuring prior interaction guidance and a learnable atom number predictor. PAFlow adopts the efficient flow matching framework to model the generation process and constructs a new form of conditional flow matching for discrete atom types. A protein-ligand interaction predictor is incorporated to guide the vector field toward higher-affinity regions during generation, while an atom number predictor based on protein pock
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.zh_title: PAFlow：可学习原子数的先验引导流匹配分子设计
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.summary: 提出面向靶点的分子生成模型PAFlow，以先验交互引导流匹配并学习原子数，缓解生成质量不稳与靶点错配问题。
key_points: 面向基于结构的药物设计生成3D分子
引入先验交互引导的流匹配机制
可学习原子数以匹配蛋白口袋几何
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.zh_abstract: 结构基药物设计（Structure-based drug design, SBDD）旨在生成对靶蛋白具有高结合亲和力的3D分子，是新型药物发现中的关键方法。尽管近期的生成模型已展现出巨大潜力，但它们面临概率动态不稳定以及生成分子大小与蛋白质口袋几何形状不匹配的问题，导致质量不一致和脱靶效应。我们提出PAFlow，一种新型的靶标感知分子生成模型，具有先验相互作用引导和可学习的原子数预测器。PAFlow采用高效流匹配框架来建模生成过程，并为离散原子类型构建了一种新形式的条件流匹配。引入了一个蛋白质-配体相互作用预测器，在生成过程中引导向量场趋向更高亲和力区域，而一个基于蛋白质口袋的原子数预测器

ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.title: MTBBench: A Multimodal Sequential Clinical Decision-Making Benchmark in Oncology
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) hold promise for biomedical reasoning, but current benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of real-world clinical workflows. Existing evaluations primarily assess unimodal, decontextualized question-answering, overlooking multi-agent decision-making environments such as Molecular Tumor Boards (MTBs). MTBs bring together diverse experts in oncology, where diagnostic and prognostic tasks require integrating heterogeneous data and evolving insights over time. Current benchmarks lack this longitudinal and multimodal complexity. We introduce MTBBench, an agentic benchmark simulating MTB-style decision-making through clinically challenging, multimodal, and longitudinal oncology questions. Ground truth annotations are validated by clinicians via a co-developed app, ensuring clinical relevance. We benchmark multiple open and closed-source LLMs and show t
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.zh_title: MTBBench：肿瘤学多模态序贯临床决策基准
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.summary: 面向分子肿瘤委员会场景的多模态序贯临床决策基准，评估多智能体环境下异构数据整合与动态推理能力。
key_points: 聚焦分子肿瘤委员会决策场景
整合多模态异构临床数据
弥补现有基准缺乏动态决策评估
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models，LLMs）在生物医学推理方面具有前景，但当前基准无法捕捉真实世界临床工作流程的复杂性。现有评估主要评估单模态、去语境化的问答，忽视了诸如分子肿瘤委员会（Molecular Tumor Boards，MTBs）等多智能体决策环境。MTBs 汇集肿瘤学领域的多元专家，其中诊断和预后任务需要整合异质性数据以及随时间演变的见解。当前基准缺乏这种纵向和多模态复杂性。我们提出 MTBBench，一个通过具有临床挑战性的、多模态和纵向的肿瘤学问题来模拟 MTB 风格决策的智能体基准（agentic benchmark）。真实标注（Ground truth annotations）由临床医生通过共同开发的应用程序进行验证，确保了临床相关性。我们对多个开源和闭源 LLMs 进行基准测试，并显示 t

3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.title: Revisiting End-to-End Learning with Slide-level Supervision in Computational Pathology
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.abstract: Pre-trained encoders for offline feature extraction followed by multiple instance learning (MIL) aggregators have become the dominant paradigm in computational pathology (CPath), benefiting cancer diagnosis and prognosis. However, performance limitations arise from the absence of encoder fine-tuning for downstream tasks and disjoint optimization with MIL. While slide-level supervised end-to-end (E2E) learning is an intuitive solution to this issue, it faces challenges such as high computational demands and suboptimal results. These limitations motivate us to revisit E2E learning. We argue that prior work neglects inherent E2E optimization challenges, leading to performance disparities compared to traditional two-stage methods. In this paper, we pioneer the elucidation of optimization challenge caused by sparse-attention MIL and propose a novel MIL called ABMILX. It mitigates this problem
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.zh_title: 重新审视计算病理中切片级监督的端到端学习
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.summary: 针对计算病理主流“离线特征提取+MIL聚合”范式的性能局限，重新审视切片级监督端到端学习及其计算成本挑战。
key_points: 主流范式为预训练编码器加MIL聚合
离线范式缺乏编码器下游微调
端到端面临高计算成本等挑战
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.zh_abstract: 用于离线特征提取的预训练编码器，随后接多实例学习（multiple instance learning，MIL）聚合器，已成为计算病理学（computational pathology，CPath）中的主导范式，有益于癌症诊断和预后。然而，由于未针对下游任务微调编码器以及与 MIL 的分离优化，性能限制随之出现。虽然切片级监督的端到端（end-to-end，E2E）学习是解决该问题的直观方案，但它面临高计算需求和次优结果等挑战。这些限制促使我们重新审视 E2E 学习。我们认为，先前工作忽视了固有的 E2E 优化挑战，导致与传统两阶段方法相比存在性能差异。在本文中，我们率先阐明由稀疏注意力 MIL 引起的优化挑战，并提出一种名为 ABMILX 的新型 MIL。它缓解了这一问题

1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.title: SonoGym: High Performance Simulation for Challenging Surgical Tasks with Robotic Ultrasound
1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.abstract: Ultrasound (US) is a widely used medical imaging modality due to its real-time capabilities, non-invasive nature, and cost-effectiveness. Robotic ultrasound can further enhance its utility by reducing operator dependence and improving access to complex anatomical regions. For this, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and imitation learning (IL) have shown potential for autonomous navigation, their use in complex surgical tasks such as anatomy reconstruction and surgical guidance remains limited -- largely due to the lack of realistic and efficient simulation environments tailored to these tasks. We introduce SonoGym, a scalable simulation platform for complex robotic ultrasound tasks that enables parallel simulation across tens to hundreds of environments. 1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.zh_title: SonoGym：机器人超声复杂手术任务高性能仿真
1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.summary: 提出SonoGym仿真平台，支持机器人超声在解剖重建与手术引导等复杂任务中的学习研究。
key_points: 超声具实时、无创、低成本特点
机器人超声可降低操作者依赖

1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.zh_abstract: 超声（US）因其实时能力、非侵入性和成本效益，是一种广泛使用的医学成像模态。机器人超声可以通过减少操作者依赖并改善对复杂解剖区域的访问，进一步增强其效用。为此，尽管深度强化学习（DRL）和模仿学习（IL）已显示出在自主导航方面的潜力，但它们在诸如解剖重建和手术引导等复杂外科任务中的应用仍然有限——这在很大程度上是由于缺乏针对这些任务定制的真实且高效的仿真环境。我们介绍了 SonoGym，一个用于复杂机器人超声任务的可扩展仿真平台，它能够跨数十到数百个环境进行并行仿真。我们的框架支持通过 both a phys 对来自 CT 衍生的解剖 3D 模型的 US 数据进行真实且实时的仿真

68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.title: Protein Inverse Folding From Structure Feedback
68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.abstract: The inverse folding problem, aiming to design amino acid sequences that fold into desired three-dimensional structures, is pivotal for various biotechnological applications. Here, we introduce a novel approach leveraging Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to fine-tune an inverse folding model using feedback from a protein folding model. Given a target protein structure, we begin by sampling candidate sequences from the inverse-folding model, then predict the three-dimensional structure of each sequence with the folding model to generate pairwise structural-preference labels. These labels are used to fine-tune the inverse-folding model under the DPO objective. 68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.zh_title: 基于结构反馈的蛋白质逆向折叠
68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.summary: 利用直接偏好优化结合蛋白质折叠模型反馈微调逆向折叠模型，提升序列设计效果。
key_points: 用 DPO 微调逆向折叠模型

68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.zh_abstract: 逆折叠问题旨在设计可折叠成所需三维结构的氨基酸序列，对多种生物技术应用至关重要。在此，我们介绍了一种新方法，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）并使用蛋白质折叠模型的反馈来微调逆折叠模型。给定目标蛋白质结构，我们首先从逆折叠模型中采样候选序列，然后用折叠模型预测每个序列的三维结构，以生成成对结构偏好标签。这些标签用于在DPO目标下微调逆折叠模型。我们在CATH 4.2测试集上的结果表明，DPO微调不仅提高了基线模型的序列恢复率，还使平均TM-Score从0.77显著提高到0.81，表明增强的st

4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.title: CellVerse: Do Large Language Models Really Understand Cell Biology?
4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of modeling single-cell data as natural languages and the potential of leveraging powerful large language models (LLMs) for understanding cell biology. However, a comprehensive evaluation of LLMs' performance on language-driven single-cell analysis tasks still remains unexplored. Motivated by this challenge, we introduce CellVerse, a unified language-centric question-answering benchmark that integrates four types of single-cell multi-omics data and encompasses three hierarchical levels of single-cell analysis tasks: cell type annotation (cell-level), drug response prediction (drug-level), and perturbation analysis (gene-level). Going beyond this, we systematically evaluate the performance across 14 open-source and closed-source LLMs ranging from 160M to 671B on CellVerse. 4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.zh_title: CellVerse：大语言模型真的理解细胞生物学吗
4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.summary: 研究提出以语言为中心的单细胞多组学问答基准CellVerse，用于系统评估大语言模型在细胞生物学任务上的表现。

4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.zh_abstract: 近期研究表明，将单细胞数据建模为自然语言是可行的，并且利用强大的大型语言模型（LLMs）理解细胞生物学具有潜力。然而，对LLMs在语言驱动的单细胞分析任务上性能的全面评估仍未得到探索。受这一挑战启发，我们提出了CellVerse，一个统一的以语言为中心的问答基准，它整合了四种单细胞多组学数据，并涵盖三个层级的单细胞分析任务：细胞类型注释（细胞级）、药物反应预测（药物级）和扰动分析（基因级）。更进一步，我们在CellVerse上系统评估了14个开源和闭源LLMs的性能，这些LLMs从160M到671B不等。值得注意的是，实验结果表明：（1）现有的专业

17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.title: Is Limited Participant Diversity Impeding EEG-based Machine Learning?
17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.abstract: The application of machine learning (ML) to electroencephalography (EEG) has great potential to advance both neuroscientific research and clinical applications. However, the generalisability and robustness of EEG-based ML models often hinge on the amount and diversity of training data. It is common practice to split EEG recordings into small segments, thereby increasing the number of samples substantially compared to the number of individual recordings or participants. We conceptualise this as a multi-level data generation process and investigate the scaling behaviour of model performance with respect to the overall sample size and the participant diversity through large-scale empirical studies. We then use the same framework to investigate the effectiveness of different ML strategies designed to address limited data problems: data augmentations and self-supervised learning. Our findings
17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.zh_title: 参与者多样性不足是否制约基于脑电的机器学习
17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.summary: 该研究指出脑电机器学习模型的泛化性与稳健性受训练数据规模与多样性限制，并提出将长记录切分为小片段会掩盖参与者多样性问题。
key_points: 脑电机器学习依赖训练数据量与多样性

17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.zh_abstract: 将机器学习（ML）应用于脑电图（EEG）在推进神经科学研究和临床应用方面具有巨大潜力。然而，基于EEG的ML模型的泛化性和稳健性通常取决于训练数据的数量和多样性。常见做法是将EEG记录分割成小段，从而与单个记录或参与者的数量相比大幅增加样本数量。我们将此概念化为一个多级数据生成过程，并通过大规模实证研究考察模型性能相对于总体样本量和参与者多样性的缩放行为。然后，我们使用同一框架来考察旨在解决数据有限问题的不同ML策略的有效性：数据增强和自监督学习。我们的发现

0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal models have significantly improved vision-language (VL) alignment in radiology. However, existing approaches struggle to effectively utilize complex radiology reports for learning and offer limited interpretability through attention probability visualizations. To address these challenges, we introduce $\textbf{RadZero}$, a novel framework for VL alignment in chest X-ray with zero-shot multi-task capability. A key component of our approach is $\textbf{VL-CABS}$ ($\textbf{V}$ision-$\textbf{L}$anguage $\textbf{C}$ross-$\textbf{A}$ttention $\textbf{B}$ased on $\textbf{S}$imilarity), which aligns text embeddings with local image features for interpretable, fine-grained VL reasoning. 0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.zh_title: RadZero：放射学可解释视觉-语言对齐零样本框架
0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.summary: 提出RadZero框架，用于胸片视觉-语言对齐，具备零样本多任务能力并提升注意力可视化可解释性。

0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.zh_abstract: 近期多模态模型的进展显著改善了放射学中的视觉-语言（VL）对齐。然而，现有方法难以有效利用复杂的放射学报告进行学习，并且通过注意力概率可视化提供的可解释性有限。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了 $\textbf{RadZero}$，一种用于胸部X射线中VL对齐的新型框架，具有零样本多任务能力。我们方法的一个关键组件是 $\textbf{VL-CABS}$（基于相似性的视觉-语言交叉注意力，$\textbf{V}$ision-$\textbf{L}$anguage $\textbf{C}$ross-$\textbf{A}$ttention $\textbf{B}$ased on $\textbf{S}$imilarity），它将文本嵌入与局部图像特征对齐，以实现可解释的、细粒度的VL推理。RadZero利用大型语言模型从放射学报告中提取简洁的语义句子，并采用多正例对比训练来有效捕捉关系

b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.title: Simulating Viva Voce Examinations to Evaluate Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Models
b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.abstract: Clinical reasoning in medicine is a hypothesis-driven process where physicians refine diagnoses from limited information through targeted history, physical examination, and diagnostic investigations. In contrast, current medical benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) primarily assess knowledge recall through single-turn questions, where complete clinical information is provided upfront. To address this gap, we introduce VivaBench, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates sequential clinical reasoning in LLM agents. Our dataset consists of 1762 physician-curated clinical vignettes structured as interactive scenarios that simulate a (oral) examination in medical training, requiring agents to actively probe for relevant findings, select appropriate investigations, and synthesize information across multiple steps to reach a diagnosis. b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.zh_title: 以模拟口试评估大语言模型的临床推理能力
b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.summary: 提出多轮基准VivaBench，通过模拟临床口试、逐轮追问评估大语言模型的序贯临床推理。

b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.zh_abstract: 医学中的临床推理是一个假设驱动的过程，医生通过有针对性的病史采集、体格检查和诊断性检查，从有限的信息中完善诊断。相比之下，当前针对大语言模型（LLMs）的医学基准主要通过单轮问题评估知识回忆，这些问题预先提供了完整的临床信息。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 VivaBench，这是一个多轮基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体中的序列临床推理。我们的数据集包含 1762 个由医生整理的临床案例，构建为交互式场景，模拟医学培训中的（口头）考试，要求智能体主动探测相关发现、选择适当的检查，并在多个步骤中综合信息以得出诊断。虽然当前 LLMs 在诊断方面表现出能力

7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.title: Reinforcement Learning for Out-of-Distribution Reasoning in LLMs: An Empirical Study on Diagnosis-Related Group Coding
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.abstract: Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) codes are essential for hospital reimbursement and operations but require labor-intensive assignment. Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with DRG coding due to the out-of-distribution (OOD) nature of the task: pretraining corpora rarely contain private clinical or billing data. We introduce DRG-Sapphire, which uses large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) for automated DRG coding from clinical notes. Built on Qwen2.5-7B and trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using rule-based rewards, DRG-Sapphire introduces a series of RL enhancements to address domain-specific challenges not seen in previous mathematical tasks. Our model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the MIMIC-IV benchmark and generates physician-validated reasoning for DRG assignments, significantly enhancing explainability. Our study further sheds light on broader challenges
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.zh_title: 强化学习用于DRG编码的分布外推理实证
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.summary: NeurIPS 2025 研究提出 DRG-Sapphire，基于 Qwen2.5-7B 与大模型强化学习，从临床文本自动完成 DRG 编码。
key_points: DRG编码关系医院报销，人工分配耗时
预训练语料缺私有临床与账单数据，属分布外

7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.zh_abstract: 诊断相关组（Diagnosis-Related Group，DRG）代码对于医院报销和运营至关重要，但需要劳动密集型的分配工作。大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）在 DRG 编码方面表现吃力，因为该任务具有分布外（out-of-distribution，OOD）性质：预训练语料库很少包含私有临床或账单数据。我们介绍 DRG-Sapphire，它使用大规模强化学习（reinforcement learning，RL）从临床笔记中进行自动 DRG 编码。DRG-Sapphire 基于 Qwen2.5-7B 构建，并使用基于规则的奖励通过组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization，GRPO）训练，引入了一系列 RL 增强，以应对先前数学任务中未见的领域特定挑战。我们的模型在 MIMIC-IV 基准上达到最先进准确率，并为 DRG 分配生成经医生验证的推理，显著增强了可解释性。我们的研究进一步揭示了更广泛的挑战

30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.title: FGBench: A Dataset and Benchmark for Molecular Property Reasoning at Functional Group-Level in Large Language Models
30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have gained significant attention in chemistry. However, most existing datasets center on molecular-level property prediction and overlook the role of fine-grained functional group (FG) information. Incorporating FG-level data can provide valuable prior knowledge that links molecular structures with textual descriptions, which can be used to build more interpretable, structure-aware LLMs for reasoning on molecule-related tasks. Moreover, LLMs can learn from such fine-grained information to uncover hidden relationships between specific functional groups and molecular properties, thereby advancing molecular design and drug discovery. Here, we introduce FGBench, a dataset comprising 625K molecular property reasoning problems with functional group information. 30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.zh_title: FGBench：官能团级分子性质推理数据集与基准
30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.summary: FGBench提供官能团级分子性质推理数据集与基准，用于评估大语言模型的分子相关推理能力。

30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型 (Large Language Models, LLMs) 在化学领域已引起了广泛关注。然而，大多数现有数据集集中于分子层面的性质预测，忽视了细粒度官能团 (functional group, FG) 信息的作用。纳入 FG 层面的数据可以提供有价值的先验知识，将分子结构与文本描述联系起来，这可用于构建更具可解释性、结构感知的 LLMs，以对分子相关任务进行推理。此外，LLMs 可以从这种细粒度信息中学习，以揭示特定官能团与分子性质之间的隐藏关系，从而推进分子设计与药物发现。在此，我们介绍了 FGBench，一个包含 625K 个带有官能团信息的分子性质推理问题的数据集。官能团在分子内被精确注释和定位，这确保了该数据集的

c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.title: CPSea: Large-scale cyclic peptide-protein complex dataset for machine learning in cyclic peptide design
c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.abstract: Cyclic peptides exhibit better binding afﬁnity and proteolytic stability compared to their linear counterparts. However, the development of cyclic peptide de-sign models is hindered by the scarcity of data. To address this, we introduce CPSea ( C yclic P eptide Sea ), a dataset of 2.71 million cyclic peptide-receptor complexes, curated through systematic mining of the AlphaFold Database (AFDB). Our pipeline extracts compact domains from AFDB, identiﬁes cyclization sites using the β -carbon (C β ) distance thresholds, and applies multi-stage ﬁltering to ensure structure ﬁdelity and binding compatibility. Compared with experimental data of cyclic peptides, CPSea shows similar distributions in metrics on structure ﬁdelity and wet-lab compatibility. c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.zh_title: CPSea：环肽-蛋白复合物大规模数据集

9963e88a148d1f9f1886031070902898e299bb12.abstract: Generating diverse, all-atom conformational ensembles of dynamic proteins such as G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) is critical for understanding their function, yet most generative models simplify atomic detail or ignore conformational diversity altogether. 9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.title: PathVQ: Reforming Computational Pathology Foundation Model for Whole Slide Image Analysis via Vector Quantization
9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.abstract: Computational pathology and whole-slide image (WSI) analysis are pivotal in cancer diagnosis and prognosis. However, the ultra-high resolution of WSIs presents significant modeling challenges. Recent advancements in pathology foundation models have improved performance, yet most approaches rely on [CLS] token representation of tile ViT as slide-level inputs (16x16 pixels is refereed as patch and 224x224 pixels as tile). This discards critical spatial details from patch tokens, limiting downstream WSI analysis tasks. We find that leveraging all spatial patch tokens benefits WSI analysis but incurs nearly 200x higher storage and training costs (e.g., 196 tokens in ViT$_{224}$). To address this, we introduce vector quantized (VQ) distillation on patch feature, which efficiently compresses spatial patch tokens using discrete indices and a decoder. Our method reduces token dimensionality from
9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.zh_title: PathVQ：以向量量化改造病理基础模型分析全切片图像
9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.summary: 提出 PathVQ，通过向量量化重构病理基础模型表示，保留 patch 级空间细节以提升全切片图像分析表现。

8a5cdd76649664d586fc26c9edac41745d1db00e.title: CXReasonBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Structured Diagnostic Reasoning in Chest X-rays
8a5cdd76649664d586fc26c9edac41745d1db00e.abstract: Recent progress in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) has enabled promising applications in medical tasks, such as report generation and visual question answering. However, existing benchmarks focus mainly on the final diagnostic answer, offering limited insight into whether models engage in clinically meaningful reasoning. To address this, we present CheXStruct and CXReasonBench, a structured pipeline and benchmark built on the publicly available MIMIC-CXR-JPG dataset. CheXStruct automatically derives a sequence of intermediate reasoning steps directly from chest X-rays, such as segmenting anatomical regions, deriving anatomical landmarks and diagnostic measurements, computing diagnostic indices, and applying clinical thresholds. CXReasonBench leverages this pipeline to evaluate whether models can perform clinically valid reasoning steps and to what extent they can learn from structur
8a5cdd76649664d586fc26c9edac41745d1db00e.zh_title: CXReasonBench：胸片结构化诊断推理基准
8a5cdd76649664d586fc26c9edac41745d1db00e.summary: 提出CheXStruct流程与CXReasonBench基准，评估胸部X光中的结构化诊断推理能力。
key_points: 现有基准主要关注最终诊断答案
基于公开MIMIC-CXR-JPG数据集构建
考察模型推理是否具临床意义
8a5cdd76649664d586fc26c9edac41745d1db00e.zh_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的近期进展使医学任务中的有前景应用成为可能，例如报告生成和视觉问答。然而，现有基准主要关注最终诊断答案，对模型是否进行具有临床意义的推理所提供的洞察有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CheXStruct 和 CXReasonBench，一个基于公开可用的 MIMIC-CXR-JPG 数据集构建的结构化流程与基准。CheXStruct 直接从胸部 X 射线中自动推导一系列中间推理步骤，例如分割解剖区域、推导解剖标志和诊断测量值、计算诊断指标以及应用临床阈值。CXReasonBench 利用该流程来评估模型能否执行临床上有效的推理步骤，以及它们能在多大程度上从 struct 中学习。

7d95530334974973e832f7910032a7ff99e1dd13.title: An Investigation of Memorization Risk in Healthcare Foundation Models
7d95530334974973e832f7910032a7ff99e1dd13.abstract: Foundation models trained on large-scale de-identified electronic health records (EHRs) hold promise for clinical applications. However, their capacity to memorize patient information raises important privacy concerns. In this work, we introduce a suite of black-box evaluation tests to assess privacy-related memorization risks in foundation models trained on structured EHR data. Our framework includes methods for probing memorization at both the embedding and generative levels, and aims to distinguish between model generalization and harmful memorization in clinically relevant settings. We contextualize memorization in terms of its potential to compromise patient privacy, particularly for vulnerable subgroups. We validate our approach on a publicly available EHR foundation model and release an open-source toolkit to facilitate reproducible and collaborative privacy assessments in healthc
7d95530334974973e832f7910032a7ff99e1dd13.zh_title: 医疗基础模型的记忆风险评估
7d95530334974973e832f7910032a7ff99e1dd13.summary: 提出一套黑盒测试方法，评估基于去标识化结构化电子病历训练的基础模型的隐私记忆风险。
key_points: 针对结构化EHR训练的基础模型
在嵌入与生成两个层面探测记忆

7d95530334974973e832f7910032a7ff99e1dd13.zh_abstract: 在大规模去标识化电子健康记录（EHR）上训练的基础模型在临床应用方面具有前景。然而，其记忆患者信息的能力引发了重要的隐私担忧。在这项工作中，我们引入一套黑盒评估测试，以评估在结构化 EHR 数据上训练的基础模型中与隐私相关的记忆风险。我们的框架包括在嵌入层面和生成层面探查记忆的方法，旨在区分临床相关场景中的模型泛化与有害记忆。我们将记忆置于其可能损害患者隐私的背景中加以考量，尤其是对脆弱亚群。我们在一个公开可用的 EHR 基础模型上验证了我们的方法，并发布了一个开源工具包，以促进 healthc 中可重复和协作的隐私评估

6f8c98e244ad8ea88a1bd69086e76c60905c554f.title: CURV: Coherent Uncertainty-Aware Reasoning in Vision-Language Models for X-Ray Report Generation
6f8c98e244ad8ea88a1bd69086e76c60905c554f.abstract: Vision-language models have been explored for radiology report generation with promising results. Yet, uncertainty elaborated in findings and the reasoning process for reaching clinical impressions are seldom explicitly modeled, reducing the clinical accuracy and trustworthiness of the generated reports. We present CURV, a novel framework that alleviates the limitations through integrated awareness of uncertainty and explicit reasoning capabilities. Our approach consists of three key components: (1) an uncertainty modeling mechanism that teaches the model to recognize and express appropriate levels of diagnostic confidence, (2) a structured reasoning framework that generates intermediate explanatory steps connecting visual findings to clinical impressions, and (3) a reasoning coherence reward that ensures logical consistency among findings, reasoning, and impressions. We implement CURV t
6f8c98e244ad8ea88a1bd69086e76c60905c554f.zh_title: CURV：X光报告生成的一致性不确定性推理
6f8c98e244ad8ea88a1bd69086e76c60905c554f.summary: 提出CURV框架，在视觉语言模型中整合不确定性感知与显式推理，用于X光报告生成，以提升临床准确性与可信度。

6f8c98e244ad8ea88a1bd69086e76c60905c554f.zh_abstract: 视觉-语言模型已被探索用于放射学报告生成，并取得了有前景的结果。然而，所见中阐述的不确定性以及为达到临床印象的推理过程很少被显式建模，这降低了生成报告的临床准确性和可信度。我们提出 CURV，一个新颖框架，通过整合的不确定性感知与显式推理能力来缓解这些局限。我们的方法由三个关键部分组成：（1）一种不确定性建模机制，教导模型识别并表达适当水平的诊断置信度，（2）一个结构化推理框架，生成连接视觉所见与临床印象的中间解释步骤，（3）一种推理一致性奖励，确保所见、推理和印象之间的逻辑一致性。我们实现 CURV t

6c24df5364ebf0ef3abf4280de6273f74952f60b.title: Zero-shot protein stability prediction by inverse folding models: a free energy interpretation
6c24df5364ebf0ef3abf4280de6273f74952f60b.abstract: Inverse folding models have proven to be highly effective zero-shot predictors of protein stability. Despite this success, the link between the amino acid preferences of an inverse folding model and the free-energy considerations underlying thermodynamic stability remains incompletely understood. A better understanding would be of interest not only from a theoretical perspective, but also potentially provide the basis for stronger zero-shot stability prediction. In this paper, we take steps to clarify the free-energy foundations of inverse folding models. Our derivation reveals the standard practice of likelihood ratios as a simplistic approximation and suggests several paths towards better estimates of the relative stability. We empirically assess these approaches and demonstrate that considerable gains in zero-shot performance can be achieved with fairly simple means.
6c24df5364ebf0ef3abf4280de6273f74952f60b.zh_title: 逆折叠模型零样本预测蛋白质稳定性的自由能解释
6c24df5364ebf0ef3abf4280de6273f74952f60b.summary: 从自由能角度解释逆折叠模型的氨基酸偏好，为更强的零样本稳定性预测提供理论基础。
key_points: 逆折叠模型可零样本预测蛋白质稳定性
模型偏好与热力学稳定性关联尚不清晰

6c24df5364ebf0ef3abf4280de6273f74952f60b.zh_abstract: 逆折叠模型已被证明是蛋白质稳定性的高效零样本预测器。尽管取得了这一成功，但逆折叠模型的氨基酸偏好与热力学稳定性所依据的自由能考量之间的联系仍未得到完全理解。更好的理解不仅从理论角度令人关注，而且可能为更强的零样本稳定性预测提供基础。在本文中，我们采取措施阐明逆折叠模型的自由能基础。我们的推导表明，将似然比作为标准做法是一种过于简化的近似，并提出了若干通向更好估计相对稳定性的途径。我们实证评估了这些方法，并证明以相当简单的手段即可在零样本性能上取得可观收益。

67444983345bf101d0d5d17d55fc5d8fd774ef02.title: Magical: Medical Lay Language Generation via Semantic Invariance and Layperson-tailored Adaptation
67444983345bf101d0d5d17d55fc5d8fd774ef02.abstract: Medical Lay Language Generation (MLLG) plays a vital role in improving the accessibility of complex scientific content for broader audiences. Recent literature to MLLG commonly employ parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) using paired expert-lay language datasets. However, LoRA struggles with the challenges posed by multi-source heterogeneous MLLG datasets. Specifically, through a series of exploratory experiments, we reveal that standard LoRA fail to meet the requirement for semantic fidelity and diverse lay-style generation in MLLG task. To address these limitations, we propose Magical, an asymmetric LoRA architecture tailored for MLLG under heterogeneous data scenarios. 67444983345bf101d0d5d17d55fc5d8fd774ef02.zh_title: Magical：语义不变与通俗适配的医学通俗语言生成
67444983345bf101d0d5d17d55fc5d8fd774ef02.summary: 提出Magical方法，通过语义不变性与面向普通读者的适配，改进多源异构数据下的医学通俗语言生成。

67444983345bf101d0d5d17d55fc5d8fd774ef02.zh_abstract: 医学通俗语言生成（Medical Lay Language Generation, MLLG）在提高复杂科学内容对更广泛受众的可及性方面发挥着至关重要的作用。近期针对 MLLG 的文献通常采用参数高效微调方法，如低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA），使用配对专家-通俗语言数据集来微调大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）。然而，LoRA 难以应对多源异构 MLLG 数据集带来的挑战。具体而言，通过一系列探索性实验，我们揭示标准 LoRA 无法满足 MLLG 任务中对语义保真度和多样化通俗风格生成的要求。为解决这些局限，我们提出 Magical，一种在异构数据场景下为 MLLG 量身定制的非对称 LoRA 架构。Magical 采用一个共享矩阵 $A$ 进行抽象式摘要，并使用多个隔离矩阵 $B$ 进行多样化通俗风格生成

3389cce6c0a1f8b98a8cc9157e428f0f17e879f4.title: Improving the Generation and Evaluation of Synthetic Data for Downstream Medical Causal Inference
3389cce6c0a1f8b98a8cc9157e428f0f17e879f4.abstract: Causal inference is essential for developing and evaluating medical interventions, yet real-world medical datasets are often difficult to access due to regulatory barriers. This makes synthetic data a potentially valuable asset that enables these medical analyses, along with the development of new inference methods themselves. Generative models can produce synthetic data that closely approximate real data distributions, yet existing methods do not consider the unique challenges that downstream causal inference tasks, and specifically those focused on treatments, pose. We establish a set of desiderata that synthetic data containing treatments should satisfy to maximise downstream utility: preservation of (i) the covariate distribution, (ii) the treatment assignment mechanism, and (iii) the outcome generation mechanism. 3389cce6c0a1f8b98a8cc9157e428f0f17e879f4.zh_title: 改进面向下游医学因果推断的合成数据生成与评估
3389cce6c0a1f8b98a8cc9157e428f0f17e879f4.summary: 针对医学因果推断中真实数据难以获取，提出改进合成数据生成与评估方法，以支持下游医学因果推断。

3389cce6c0a1f8b98a8cc9157e428f0f17e879f4.zh_abstract: 因果推断对于开发和评估医学干预至关重要，然而由于监管障碍，真实世界的医学数据集往往难以获取。这使得合成数据成为一种潜在有价值的资产，它能够支持这些医学分析，以及新的推断方法本身的开发。生成模型可以生成与真实数据分布高度近似的合成数据，但现有方法没有考虑下游因果推断任务——特别是那些聚焦于治疗的任务——所带来的独特挑战。我们建立了一组期望条件，即包含治疗的合成数据为最大化下游效用应满足的条件：保留 (i) 协变量分布，(ii) 治疗分配机制，以及 (iii) 结果生成机制。基于这些期望条件，我们提出一组评估指标，以...

2e863fa92c3f6af8221d2a5536bf7a7fa57b3218.title: Atomic Diffusion Models for Small Molecule Structure Elucidation from NMR Spectra
2e863fa92c3f6af8221d2a5536bf7a7fa57b3218.abstract: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is a cornerstone technique for determining the structures of small molecules and is especially critical in the discovery of novel natural products and clinical therapeutics. Yet, interpreting NMR spectra remains a time-consuming, manual process requiring extensive domain expertise. We introduce ChefNMR (CHemical Elucidation From NMR), an end-to-end framework that directly predicts an unknown molecule's structure solely from its 1D NMR spectra and chemical formula. We frame structure elucidation as conditional generation from an atomic diffusion model built on a non-equivariant transformer architecture. To model the complex chemical groups found in natural products, we generated a dataset of simulated 1D NMR spectra for over 111,000 natural products. ChefNMR predicts the structures of challenging natural product compounds with an unsurpassed a
2e863fa92c3f6af8221d2a5536bf7a7fa57b3218.zh_title: ChefNMR：由 NMR 谱解析小分子结构的原子扩散模型
2e863fa92c3f6af8221d2a5536bf7a7fa57b3218.summary: 提出端到端框架 ChefNMR，仅由 1D NMR 谱与化学式直接预测未知小分子结构。

2e863fa92c3f6af8221d2a5536bf7a7fa57b3218.zh_abstract: 核磁共振（NMR）波谱学是确定小分子结构的基石技术，在发现新型天然产物和临床治疗药物方面尤为关键。然而，解读 NMR 谱仍然是一个耗时的手动过程，需要广泛的领域专业知识。我们提出 ChefNMR（CHemical Elucidation From NMR，基于 NMR 的化学解析），一个端到端框架，仅根据未知分子的 1D NMR 谱和化学式直接预测其结构。我们将结构解析表述为由原子扩散模型进行的条件生成，该模型建立在非等变 Transformer 架构之上。为了对天然产物中存在的复杂化学基团建模，我们生成了一个包含超过 111,000 种天然产物的模拟 1D NMR 谱数据集。ChefNMR 预测具有挑战性的天然产物化合物的结构，具有无与伦比的...

2b2e20068f38f4ca7e46e9267306eb7fe9ee471f.title: Sampling 3D Molecular Conformers with Diffusion Transformers
2b2e20068f38f4ca7e46e9267306eb7fe9ee471f.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated strong performance in generative modeling, particularly in image synthesis, making them a compelling choice for molecular conformer generation. However, applying DiTs to molecules introduces novel challenges, such as integrating discrete molecular graph information with continuous 3D geometry, handling Euclidean symmetries, and designing conditioning mechanisms that generalize across molecules of varying sizes and structures. We propose DiTMC, a framework that adapts DiTs to address these challenges through a modular architecture that separates the processing of 3D coordinates from conditioning on atomic connectivity. To this end, we introduce two complementary graph-based conditioning strategies that integrate seamlessly with the DiT architecture. These are combined with different attention mechanisms, including both standard non-equivaria
2b2e20068f38f4ca7e46e9267306eb7fe9ee471f.summary: 提出DiTMC，将扩散Transformer用于3D分子构象生成，需融合离散分子图与连续3D几何并处理欧氏对称性。

2b2e20068f38f4ca7e46e9267306eb7fe9ee471f.zh_abstract: 扩散 Transformer（DiTs）在生成建模中表现出强大性能，尤其是在图像合成方面，这使其成为分子构象生成的引人注目的选择。然而，将 DiTs 应用于分子会带来新的挑战，例如将离散的分子图信息与连续的 3D 几何结构相整合、处理欧几里得对称性，以及设计能够在大小和结构各异的分子间泛化的条件机制。我们提出 DiTMC，一个通过模块化架构调整 DiTs 以应对这些挑战的框架，该架构将 3D 坐标的处理与基于原子连接性的条件作用分离。为此，我们引入两种互补的基于图的条件策略，它们能与 DiT 架构无缝集成。这些策略与不同的注意力机制结合，包括标准的非等变...

15002ad246a9b2562a6935a56568452ee62643b7.title: Offline Guarded Safe Reinforcement Learning for Medical Treatment Optimization Strategies
15002ad246a9b2562a6935a56568452ee62643b7.abstract: When applying offline reinforcement learning (RL) in healthcare scenarios, the out-of-distribution (OOD) issues pose significant risks, as inappropriate generalization beyond clinical expertise can result in potentially harmful recommendations. While existing methods like conservative Q-learning (CQL) attempt to address the OOD issue, their effectiveness is limited by only constraining action selection by suppressing uncertain actions. This action-only regularization imitates clinician actions that prioritize short-term rewards, but it fails to regulate downstream state trajectories, thereby limiting the discovery of improved long-term treatment strategies. 15002ad246a9b2562a6935a56568452ee62643b7.zh_title: 离线受保护安全强化学习用于医疗治疗优化
15002ad246a9b2562a6935a56568452ee62643b7.summary: 针对离线强化学习在医疗中的分布外风险，提出离线受保护安全强化学习方法用于治疗策略优化。

15002ad246a9b2562a6935a56568452ee62643b7.zh_abstract: 在医疗场景中应用离线强化学习（RL）时，分布外（OOD）问题会带来重大风险，因为超越临床专业知识的不当泛化可能导致潜在有害的建议。虽然保守Q学习（CQL）等现有方法试图解决OOD问题，但其有效性有限，仅通过抑制不确定动作来约束动作选择。这种仅动作的正则化模仿了优先考虑短期回报的临床医生动作，但未能调节下游状态轨迹，从而限制了发现改进的长期治疗策略。为了在确保状态-动作轨迹保持分布内的同时安全地改进超越临床医生建议的策略，我们提出了离线守护安全强化学习（Offline Guarded Safe Reinforcement Learning，OGSRL），一个理论上有根据的

93c05bc39e17c9b9e6c3ad0aa616dd2bb5d16c24.title: PRING: Rethinking Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction from Pairs to Graphs
93c05bc39e17c9b9e6c3ad0aa616dd2bb5d16c24.abstract: Deep learning-based computational methods have achieved promising results in predicting protein-protein interactions (PPIs). However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on isolated pairwise evaluations, overlooking a model's capability to reconstruct biologically meaningful PPI networks, which is crucial for biology research. To address this gap, we introduce PRING, the first comprehensive benchmark that evaluates protein-protein interaction prediction from a graph-level perspective. PRING curates a high-quality, multi-species PPI network dataset comprising 21,484 proteins and 186,818 interactions, with well-designed strategies to address both data redundancy and leakage. 938f39683d116a719952b3353058f69792689db2.title: TEMPO: Temporal Multi-scale Autoregressive Generation of Protein Conformational Ensembles
938f39683d116a719952b3353058f69792689db2.abstract: Understanding the dynamic behavior of proteins is critical to elucidating their functional mechanisms, yet generating realistic, temporally coherent trajectories of protein ensembles remains a significant challenge. In this work, we introduce a novel hierarchical autoregressive framework for modeling protein dynamics that leverages the intrinsic multi-scale organization of molecular motions. Unlike existing methods that focus on generating static conformational ensembles or treat dynamic sampling as an independent process, our approach characterizes protein dynamics as a Markovian process. 938f39683d116a719952b3353058f69792689db2.zh_title: TEMPO：蛋白质构象系综的时间多尺度自回归生成

388d3875fd7f159779620506f0bcb8a0c087295b.title: Scalable and Cost-Efficient de Novo Template-Based Molecular Generation
388d3875fd7f159779620506f0bcb8a0c087295b.abstract: Template-based molecular generation offers a promising avenue for drug design by ensuring generated compounds are synthetically accessible through predefined reaction templates and building blocks. In this work, we tackle three core challenges in template-based GFlowNets: (1) minimizing synthesis cost, (2) scaling to large building block libraries, and (3) effectively utilizing small fragment sets. We propose Recursive Cost Guidance, a backward policy framework that employs auxiliary machine learning models to approximate synthesis cost and viability. 388d3875fd7f159779620506f0bcb8a0c087295b.zh_title: 可扩展低成本模板式全新分子生成

34804749733efeeb9cc7861eb9e37cbd443d865f.title: SMMILE: An Expert-Driven Benchmark for Multimodal Medical In-Context Learning
34804749733efeeb9cc7861eb9e37cbd443d865f.abstract: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) remains underexplored despite significant potential for domains such as medicine. Clinicians routinely encounter diverse, specialized tasks requiring adaptation from limited examples, such as drawing insights from a few relevant prior cases or considering a constrained set of differential diagnoses. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown advances in medical visual question answering (VQA), their ability to learn multimodal tasks from context is largely unknown. We introduce SMMILE, the first expert-driven multimodal ICL benchmark for medical tasks. Eleven medical experts curated problems, each including a multimodal query and multimodal in-context examples as task demonstrations. SMMILE encompasses 111 problems (517 question-image-answer triplets) covering 6 medical specialties and 13 imaging modalities. We further introduce SMMILE+
34804749733efeeb9cc7861eb9e37cbd443d865f.zh_title: SMMILE：专家驱动的多模态医学上下文学习基准
34804749733efeeb9cc7861eb9e37cbd443d865f.summary: NeurIPS 2025 提出专家驱动的多模态医学上下文学习基准 SMMILE，评估多模态大模型从少量示例中适应医学任务的能力。
key_points: 专家驱动构建多模态医学ICL基准

34804749733efeeb9cc7861eb9e37cbd443d865f.zh_abstract: 尽管多模态上下文学习（ICL）在医学等领域具有巨大潜力，但其仍未得到充分探索。临床医生经常遇到多样化的专业任务，这些任务需要从有限示例中进行适应，例如从少数相关既往病例中获取见解，或考虑一组受限的鉴别诊断。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在医学视觉问答（VQA）方面已显示出进展，但它们从上下文中学习多模态任务的能力在很大程度上仍未知。我们推出 SMMILE，首个由专家驱动的用于医学任务的多模态 ICL 基准。十一位医学专家策划了问题，每个问题都包括一个多模态查询以及作为任务演示的多模态上下文示例。SMMILE 包含 111 个问题（517 个问题-图像-答案三元组），涵盖 6 个医学专科和 13 种成像模态。我们进一步推出 SMMILE+

d31c18fc2cf802ea1e8af425156faafee7698466.title: Ctrl-DNA: Controllable Cell-Type-Specific Regulatory DNA Design via Constrained RL
d31c18fc2cf802ea1e8af425156faafee7698466.abstract: Designing regulatory DNA sequences that achieve precise cell-type-specific gene expression is crucial for advancements in synthetic biology, gene therapy and precision medicine. Although transformer-based language models (LMs) can effectively capture patterns in regulatory DNA, their generative approaches often struggle to produce novel sequences with reliable cell-specific activity. Here, we introduce Ctrl-DNA, a novel constrained reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for designing regulatory DNA sequences with controllable cell-type specificity. By formulating regulatory sequence design as a biologically informed constrained optimization problem, we apply RL to autoregressive genomic LMs, enabling the models to iteratively refine sequences that maximize regulatory activity in targeted cell types while constraining off-target effects. d31c18fc2cf802ea1e8af425156faafee7698466.zh_title: Ctrl-DNA：可控细胞类型特异性调控DNA设计
d31c18fc2cf802ea1e8af425156faafee7698466.summary: 提出约束强化学习框架Ctrl-DNA，设计具有可靠细胞特异性活性的新型调控DNA序列。

a975ba742c61af322f7c44267c2667ff10a839d0.title: GeneFlow: Translation of Single-cell Gene Expression to Histopathological Images via Rectified Flow
a975ba742c61af322f7c44267c2667ff10a839d0.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies can be used to align transcriptomes with histopathological morphology, presenting exciting new opportunities for biomolecular discovery. Using ST data, we construct a novel framework, GeneFlow, to map transcriptomics onto paired cellular images. Rectified flow with high-order ODE solvers creates a continuous, bijective mapping between transcriptomics and image manifolds, addressing the many-to-one relationship inherent in this problem. 93140c93d9f1b066c2eb08e8643fe6b464e9d750.abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence has significantly advanced medical image segmentation. 54db11492eaa0effc7391b901cce377b525bd2e9.title: Investigating and Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Medical Knowledge Injection through Internal Knowledge Augmentation Learning
54db11492eaa0effc7391b901cce377b525bd2e9.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are expected to possess comprehensive medical knowledge to support real-world clinical applications. While domain-specific fine-tuning effectively injects medical knowledge into LLMs, it often causes catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge and instruction-following capabilities. 54db11492eaa0effc7391b901cce377b525bd2e9.summary: 研究LLM医学知识微调导致的灾难性遗忘，揭示邻近依赖遗忘模式并提出内部知识增强学习方法。

53a723d546c1a7672c582b230e7059e8866cf783.title: MoodAngels: A Retrieval-augmented Multi-agent Framework for Psychiatry Diagnosis
53a723d546c1a7672c582b230e7059e8866cf783.abstract: The application of AI in psychiatric diagnosis faces significant challenges, including the subjective nature of mental health assessments, symptom overlap across disorders, and privacy constraints limiting data availability. To address these issues, we present MoodAngels, the first specialized multi-agent framework for mood disorder diagnosis. Our approach combines granular-scale analysis of clinical assessments with a structured verification process, enabling more accurate interpretation of complex psychiatric data. 41fb913114d88dd52a4907b66987f777c7ba7588.title: Aligning Evaluation with Clinical Priorities: Calibration, Label Shift, and Error Costs
41fb913114d88dd52a4907b66987f777c7ba7588.abstract: Machine learning-based decision support systems are increasingly deployed in clinical settings, where probabilistic scoring functions are used to inform and prioritize patient management decisions. However, widely used scoring rules, such as accuracy and AUC-ROC, fail to adequately reflect key clinical priorities, including calibration, robustness to distributional shifts, and sensitivity to asymmetric error costs. In this work, we propose a principled yet practical evaluation framework for selecting calibrated thresholded classifiers that explicitly accounts for the uncertainty in class prevalences and domain-specific cost asymmetries often found in clinical settings. Building on the theory of proper scoring rules, particularly the Schervish representation, we derive an adjusted variant of cross-entropy (log score) that averages cost-weighted performance over clinically relevant ranges
41fb913114d88dd52a4907b66987f777c7ba7588.zh_title: 面向临床优先级的评估：校准、标签漂移与错误代价
41fb913114d88dd52a4907b66987f777c7ba7588.summary: 提出面向临床优先级的评估框架，指出准确率与AUC-ROC难以反映校准、分布漂移与不对称错误代价，并用于模型选择。
key_points: 准确率与AUC-ROC难反映临床优先级
关注校准、分布漂移与错误代价
提出兼顾原则性与实用性的评估框架
41fb913114d88dd52a4907b66987f777c7ba7588.zh_abstract: 基于机器学习的决策支持系统正越来越多地部署于临床环境，其中概率评分函数被用于为患者管理决策提供信息并确定优先级。然而，广泛使用的评分规则（如准确率和 AUC-ROC）未能充分反映关键的临床优先事项，包括校准度、对分布偏移的鲁棒性以及对非对称错误代价的敏感性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个既具原则性又实用的评估框架，用于选择经校准的阈值化分类器，该框架明确考虑了临床环境中常见的类别患病率不确定性和领域特定的代价不对称性。基于恰当评分规则理论，特别是 Schervish 表示，我们推导出交叉熵（对数评分）的一种调整变体，该变体在临床相关范围内对代价加权性能进行平均

1bffc209461d41754bc3941dfef21fd89412d979.title: Adaptive Frontier Exploration on Graphs with Applications to Network-Based Disease Testing
1bffc209461d41754bc3941dfef21fd89412d979.abstract: We study a sequential decision-making problem on a $n$-node graph $\mathcal{G}$ where each node has an unknown label from a finite set $\mathbf{\Omega}$, drawn from a joint distribution $\mathcal{P}$ that is Markov with respect to $\mathcal{G}$. At each step, selecting a node reveals its label and yields a label-dependent reward. The goal is to adaptively choose nodes to maximize expected accumulated discounted rewards. We impose a frontier exploration constraint, where actions are limited to neighbors of previously selected nodes, reflecting practical constraints in settings such as contact tracing and robotic exploration. We design a Gittins index-based policy that applies to general graphs and is provably optimal when $\mathcal{G}$ is a forest. Our implementation runs in $\mathcal{O}(n^2 \cdot |\mathbf{\Omega}|^2)$ time while using $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot |\mathbf{\Omega}|^2)$ oracle cal
1bffc209461d41754bc3941dfef21fd89412d979.zh_title: 图上的自适应前沿探索：用于网络疾病检测
1bffc209461d41754bc3941dfef21fd89412d979.summary: 研究图上的序贯决策：节点标签未知且依图马尔可夫，在前沿探索约束下自适应选点以最大化折扣奖励，应用于网络疾病检测。
key_points: 节点标签未知，联合分布对图马尔可夫
每步选点揭示标签并获得依赖标签奖励
施加前沿探索约束，用于网络疾病检测
1bffc209461d41754bc3941dfef21fd89412d979.zh_abstract: 我们研究一个在 $n$ 节点图 $\mathcal{G}$ 上的序贯决策问题，其中每个节点具有来自有限集合 $\mathbf{\Omega}$ 的未知标签，该标签抽取自关于 $\mathcal{G}$ 为马尔可夫的联合分布 $\mathcal{P}$。在每一步，选择一个节点会揭示其标签并产生依赖于标签的奖励。目标是自适应地选择节点以最大化期望累积折扣奖励。我们施加一个前沿探索约束，其中动作限于先前已选择节点的邻居，这反映了诸如接触者追踪和机器人探索等场景中的实际约束。我们设计了一种基于 Gittins 指数的策略，该策略适用于一般图，并且当 $\mathcal{G}$ 是森林时可证明最优。我们的实现运行时间为 $\mathcal{O}(n^2 \cdot |\mathbf{\Omega}|^2)$，同时使用 $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot |\mathbf{\Omega}|^2)$ 次预言机 cal

19a77edaac6d65e123dda6b3229dd6962ebe23fc.title: Learning Relative Gene Expression Trends from Pathology Images in Spatial Transcriptomics
19a77edaac6d65e123dda6b3229dd6962ebe23fc.abstract: Gene expression estimation from pathology images has the potential to reduce the RNA sequencing cost. Point-wise loss functions have been widely used to minimize the discrepancy between predicted and absolute gene expression values. However, due to the complexity of the sequencing techniques and intrinsic variability across cells, the observed gene expression contains stochastic noise and batch effects, and estimating the absolute expression values accurately remains a significant challenge. To mitigate this, we propose a novel objective of learning relative expression patterns rather than absolute levels. We assume that the relative expression levels of genes exhibit consistent patterns across independent experiments, even when absolute expression values are affected by batch effects and stochastic noise in tissue samples. Based on the assumption, we model the relation and propose a nov
19a77edaac6d65e123dda6b3229dd6962ebe23fc.zh_title: 从病理图像学习空间转录组的相对基因表达趋势
19a77edaac6d65e123dda6b3229dd6962ebe23fc.summary: 提出从病理图像学习相对基因表达趋势，以规避绝对表达值中的随机噪声与批次效应。
key_points: 绝对基因表达估计受随机噪声与批次效应困扰
改用相对基因表达趋势作为学习目标
目标在于降低RNA测序成本
19a77edaac6d65e123dda6b3229dd6962ebe23fc.zh_abstract: 从病理图像估计基因表达有潜力降低 RNA 测序成本。逐点损失函数已被广泛用于最小化预测基因表达值与绝对基因表达值之间的差异。然而，由于测序技术的复杂性以及细胞间的内在变异性，观测到的基因表达包含随机噪声和批次效应，准确估计绝对表达值仍然是一项重大挑战。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种新的目标：学习相对表达模式而非绝对水平。我们假设，即使绝对表达值受到组织样本中的批次效应和随机噪声影响，基因的相对表达水平在独立实验之间也表现出一致的模式。基于该假设，我们对这种关系进行建模，并提出了一种 nov

fd72215ef6fc89ad126aea53931947bfcb7e3336.title: ProSpero: Active Learning for Robust Protein Design Beyond Wild-Type Neighborhoods
fd72215ef6fc89ad126aea53931947bfcb7e3336.abstract: Designing protein sequences of both high fitness and novelty is a challenging task in data-efficient protein engineering. Exploration beyond wild-type neighborhoods often leads to biologically implausible sequences or relies on surrogate models that lose fidelity in novel regions. Here, we propose ProSpero, an active learning framework in which a frozen pre-trained generative model is guided by a surrogate updated from oracle feedback. By integrating fitness-relevant residue selection with biologically-constrained Sequential Monte Carlo sampling, our approach enables exploration beyond wild-type neighborhoods while preserving biological plausibility. We show that our framework remains effective even when the surrogate is misspecified. ProSpero consistently outperforms or matches existing methods across diverse protein engineering tasks, retrieving sequences of both high fitness and novel
fd72215ef6fc89ad126aea53931947bfcb7e3336.zh_title: ProSpero：超越野生型邻域的主动学习蛋白质设计
fd72215ef6fc89ad126aea53931947bfcb7e3336.summary: 提出ProSpero主动学习框架，用冻结的预训练生成模型配合代理模型更新，设计高适应度且新颖的蛋白质序列。
key_points: 冻结预训练生成模型由代理模型引导
代理模型依据oracle反馈迭代更新
结合适应度相关残基选择提升合理性
fd72215ef6fc89ad126aea53931947bfcb7e3336.zh_abstract: 设计兼具高适应度与新颖性的蛋白质序列是数据高效蛋白质工程中的一项挑战性任务。超出野生型邻域的探索通常会导致生物学上不可行的序列，或依赖于在新颖区域失去保真度的代理模型。在此，我们提出 ProSpero，一个主动学习框架，其中冻结的预训练生成模型由根据 oracle 反馈更新的代理模型引导。通过将适应度相关残基选择与生物学约束的序贯蒙特卡洛采样（Sequential Monte Carlo sampling）相结合，我们的方法能够在保持生物学合理性的同时，探索超出野生型邻域的范围。我们表明，即使代理模型被错误设定，我们的框架仍然有效。ProSpero 在多样化的蛋白质工程任务中始终优于或匹配现有方法，检索出兼具高适应度与新颖的序列

ef81a9423a3eec134f18001ba124809387d13f9a.zh_title: 基于扩散桥模型的蛋白质表面与骨架联合设计
ef81a9423a3eec134f18001ba124809387d13f9a.summary: 提出扩散桥模型，联合设计蛋白质表面与骨架结构。

e9051ce5ce02cc0f0f2d07b2fd602c1a06a6ad24.title: NOVA: A Benchmark for Rare Anomaly Localization and Clinical Reasoning in Brain MRI
e9051ce5ce02cc0f0f2d07b2fd602c1a06a6ad24.abstract: In many real-world applications, deployed models encounter inputs that differ from the data seen during training. Open-world recognition ensures that such systems remain robust as ever-emerging, previously unknown categories appear and must be addressed without retraining. Foundation and vision-language models are pre-trained on large and diverse datasets with the expectation of broad generalization across domains, including medical imaging. However, benchmarking these models on test sets with only a few common outlier types silently collapses the evaluation back to a closed-set problem, masking failures on rare or truly novel conditions encountered in clinical use. We therefore present NOVA , a challenging, real-life evaluation-only benchmark of ∼ 900 brain MRI scans that span 281 rare pathologies and heterogeneous acquisition protocols. Each case includes rich clinical narratives and d
e9051ce5ce02cc0f0f2d07b2fd602c1a06a6ad24.zh_title: NOVA：脑MRI罕见异常定位与临床推理基准
e9051ce5ce02cc0f0f2d07b2fd602c1a06a6ad24.summary: 提出NOVA基准，评估开放世界下模型对脑MRI罕见异常的定位与临床推理能力，关注基础与视觉语言模型泛化表现。
key_points: 面向脑MRI的罕见异常定位基准
关注开放世界与未见类别识别
评估基础模型与视觉语言模型泛化
论文载于NeurIPS 2025
e9051ce5ce02cc0f0f2d07b2fd602c1a06a6ad24.zh_abstract: 在许多现实世界应用中，部署的模型会遇到与训练期间所见数据不同的输入。开放世界识别确保此类系统在持续涌现、此前未知的类别出现时仍保持稳健，并且必须在不重新训练的情况下加以处理。基础模型和视觉-语言模型（vision-language models）在大型且多样化的数据集上预训练，期望能够跨领域广泛泛化，包括医学影像。然而，仅在包含少数常见异常类型的测试集上对这些模型进行基准测试，会悄然将评估退化为闭集问题，从而掩盖在临床使用中遇到的罕见或真正新颖条件下的失败。因此，我们提出 NOVA，一个具有挑战性的、真实场景的仅用于评估的基准，包含 ∼900 例脑 MRI 扫描，涵盖 281 种罕见病理和异质性采集协议。每个病例包括丰富的临床叙述以及 d

d2f0cf442617ddcf71ef8e180bc329d0f3b108f3.title: MedicalNarratives: Connecting Medical Vision and Language with Localized Narratives
d2f0cf442617ddcf71ef8e180bc329d0f3b108f3.abstract: Multi-modal models are data hungry. While datasets with natural images are abundant, medical image datasets can not afford the same luxury. To enable representation learning for medical images at scale, we turn to YouTube, a platform with a large reservoir of open-source medical pedagogical videos. We curate MedicalNarratives, a dataset 4.7M medical image-text pairs, with 1M samples containing dense annotations in the form of spatial traces (and bounding boxes), and 118K videos centered on the trace event (with aligned text), enabling spatiotemporal grounding beyond single frames. Similar to $\textit{think-aloud}$ studies where instructors speak while hovering their mouse cursor movements over relevant image regions, 1M images in MedicalNarratives contains localized mouse traces in image pixels, creating a spatial and temporal association between the text and pixels. d2f0cf442617ddcf71ef8e180bc329d0f3b108f3.zh_title: MedicalNarratives：医学图像-文本叙事数据集
d2f0cf442617ddcf71ef8e180bc329d0f3b108f3.summary: 构建含470万医学图像-文本对的数据集，其中100万条具空间轨迹与框标注，素材源自YouTube教学视频。
key_points: 共470万医学图像-文本对
100万条含空间轨迹与边界框标注
数据来自YouTube开源医学教学视频
d2f0cf442617ddcf71ef8e180bc329d0f3b108f3.zh_abstract: 多模态模型对数据需求很大。虽然自然图像数据集很丰富，但医学图像数据集却无法享受同样的奢侈。为了大规模实现医学图像的表征学习，我们转向YouTube，一个拥有大量开源医学教学视频的平台。我们整理了MedicalNarratives，一个包含470万医学图像-文本对的数据集，其中100万样本包含以空间轨迹（和边界框）形式存在的密集标注，以及11.8万以轨迹事件为中心的视频（带有对齐文本），从而能够超越单帧的时空定位。类似于出声思考（think-aloud）研究，即教师在相关图像区域悬停鼠标光标移动时进行讲述，MedicalNarratives中的100万张图像包含图像像素中的局部鼠标轨迹，在文本和像素之间创建了空间和时间关联。为了评估 util

bcc38fafabd965d24b290d4b804d48be88673360.title: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning-Guided Diffusion Models for 3D De Novo Molecular Design
bcc38fafabd965d24b290d4b804d48be88673360.abstract: Designing de novo 3D molecules with desirable properties remains a fundamental challenge in drug discovery and molecular engineering. While diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generating high-quality 3D molecular structures, they often struggle to effectively control complex multi-objective constraints critical for real-world applications. In this study, we propose an uncertainty-aware Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework to guide the optimization of 3D molecular diffusion models toward multiple property objectives while enhancing the overall quality of the generated molecules. Our method leverages surrogate models with predictive uncertainty estimation to dynamically shape reward functions, facilitating balance across multiple optimization objectives. We comprehensively evaluate our framework across three benchmark datasets and multiple diffusion model archite
bcc38fafabd965d24b290d4b804d48be88673360.zh_title: 不确定性感知强化学习引导扩散模型用于3D分子设计
bcc38fafabd965d24b290d4b804d48be88673360.summary: 提出不确定性感知强化学习框架，引导3D分子扩散模型优化多目标约束，服务药物发现。
key_points: 扩散模型难以控制多目标约束
引入不确定性感知的RL引导优化
面向药物发现的3D从头分子设计
bcc38fafabd965d24b290d4b804d48be88673360.zh_abstract: 设计具有所需性质的从头3D分子仍然是药物发现和分子工程中的一个基本挑战。虽然扩散模型在生成高质量3D分子结构方面表现出显著能力，但它们往往难以有效控制对现实世界应用至关重要的复杂多目标约束。在本研究中，我们提出了一种不确定性感知的强化学习（RL）框架，以指导3D分子扩散模型朝着多个性质目标进行优化，同时提高生成分子的整体质量。我们的方法利用具有预测不确定性估计的代理模型来动态塑造奖励函数，促进多个优化目标之间的平衡。我们在三个基准数据集和多个扩散模型 archite 上全面评估了我们的框架。

89504705bbe6b981fe04618049aa5ee50d81188e.title: Timely Clinical Diagnosis through Active Test Selection
89504705bbe6b981fe04618049aa5ee50d81188e.abstract: There is growing interest in using machine learning (ML) to support clinical diagnosis, but most approaches rely on static, fully observed datasets and fail to reflect the sequential, resource-aware reasoning clinicians use in practice. Diagnosis remains complex and error prone, especially in high-pressure or resource-limited settings, underscoring the need for frameworks that help clinicians make timely and cost-effective decisions. We propose ACTMED (Adaptive Clinical Test selection via Model-based Experimental Design), a diagnostic framework that integrates Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) with large language models (LLMs) to better emulate real-world diagnostic reasoning. At each step, ACTMED selects the test expected to yield the greatest reduction in diagnostic uncertainty for a given patient. LLMs act as flexible simulators, generating plausible patient state distributions and s
89504705bbe6b981fe04618049aa5ee50d81188e.zh_title: ACTMED：通过主动检验选择实现及时临床诊断
89504705bbe6b981fe04618049aa5ee50d81188e.summary: 提出ACTMED框架，利用机器学习在资源受限场景下自适应选择临床检验项目以支持及时、低成本诊断。
key_points: 现有ML诊断多依赖静态完整数据集
未反映临床序贯、资源感知的决策过程
面向高压或资源有限环境设计
89504705bbe6b981fe04618049aa5ee50d81188e.zh_abstract: 越来越多的人对使用机器学习（ML）支持临床诊断感兴趣，但大多数方法依赖静态、完全观测的数据集，未能反映临床医生在实践中使用的序列化、资源感知推理。诊断仍然复杂且容易出错，尤其是在高压力或资源有限的环境中，这凸显了需要能够帮助临床医生做出及时且具成本效益决策的框架。我们提出 ACTMED（Adaptive Clinical Test selection via Model-based Experimental Design），一个诊断框架，它将贝叶斯实验设计（BED）与大语言模型（LLMs）相结合，以更好地模拟真实世界诊断推理。在每一步，ACTMED 选择预期能为给定患者带来诊断不确定性最大降低的检测。LLMs 充当灵活的模拟器，生成合理的患者状态分布以及 s

66f76ebbb99ff44073e783f2a35cf12f7772d039.title: EDBench: Large-Scale Electron Density Data for Molecular Modeling
66f76ebbb99ff44073e783f2a35cf12f7772d039.abstract: Existing molecular machine learning force fields (MLFFs) generally focus on the learning of atoms, molecules, and simple quantum chemical properties (such as energy and force), but ignore the importance of electron density (ED) $\rho(r)$ in accurately understanding molecular force fields (MFFs). ED describes the probability of finding electrons at specific locations around atoms or molecules, which uniquely determines all ground state properties (such as energy, molecular structure, etc.) of interactive multi-particle systems according to the Hohenberg-Kohn theorem. However, the calculation of ED relies on the time-consuming first-principles density functional theory (DFT) which leads to the lack of large-scale ED data and limits its application in MLFFs. In this paper, we introduce EDBench, a large-scale, high-quality dataset of ED designed to advance learning-based research at the elec
66f76ebbb99ff44073e783f2a35cf12f7772d039.zh_title: EDBench：面向分子建模的大规模电子密度数据
66f76ebbb99ff44073e783f2a35cf12f7772d039.summary: 发布大规模电子密度数据EDBench，弥补现有分子机器学习力场忽视电子密度的不足。
key_points: 现有MLFF多忽略电子密度
电子密度决定基态性质
提供大规模电子密度数据
66f76ebbb99ff44073e783f2a35cf12f7772d039.zh_abstract: 现有的分子机器学习力场（MLFFs）通常关注原子、分子和简单量子化学性质（如能量和力）的学习，但忽略了电子密度（ED）$\rho(r)$ 在准确理解分子力场（MFFs）中的重要性。ED 描述了在原子或分子周围特定位置找到电子的概率，根据 Hohenberg-Kohn 定理，它唯一确定了相互作用多粒子系统的所有基态性质（如能量、分子结构等）。然而，ED 的计算依赖于耗时的第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT），这导致缺乏大规模 ED 数据，并限制了其在 MLFFs 中的应用。在本文中，我们介绍了 EDBench，一个大规模、高质量的 ED 数据集，旨在推动基于学习的研究在电子……

6496b8db95a56a535ebcdba202a675f483633cae.title: Towards Doctor-Like Reasoning: Medical RAG Fusing Knowledge with Patient Analogy through Textual Gradients
6496b8db95a56a535ebcdba202a675f483633cae.abstract: Existing medical RAG systems mainly leverage knowledge from medical knowledge bases, neglecting the crucial role of experiential knowledge derived from similar patient cases – a key component of human clinical reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose DoctorRAG , a RAG framework that emulates doctor-like reasoning by integrating both explicit clinical knowledge and implicit case-based experience. DoctorRAG enhances retrieval precision by first allocating conceptual tags for queries and knowledge sources, together with a hybrid retrieval mechanism from both relevant knowledge and patient. In addition, a Med-TextGrad module using multi-agent textual gradients is integrated to ensure that the final output adheres to the retrieved knowledge and patient query. Comprehensive experiments on multilingual, multitask datasets demonstrate that DoctorRAG significantly out-performs strong baseline RA
6496b8db95a56a535ebcdba202a675f483633cae.zh_title: DoctorRAG：融合知识与患者类比的医疗RAG
6496b8db95a56a535ebcdba202a675f483633cae.summary: 提出DoctorRAG，融合显性临床知识与相似病例经验，模拟医生推理以提升医疗RAG检索精度。
key_points: 融合临床知识与病例经验
为查询分配概念标签以提精度
模拟医生式推理过程
6496b8db95a56a535ebcdba202a675f483633cae.zh_abstract: 现有医学 RAG 系统主要利用来自医学知识库的知识，忽视了源自相似患者病例的经验知识的关键作用——这是人类临床推理的关键组成部分。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 DoctorRAG，一个 RAG 框架，通过整合显性临床知识和隐性基于病例的经验来模拟医生式推理。DoctorRAG 通过首先为查询和知识源分配概念标签，以及来自相关知识和患者的混合检索机制，提升检索精度。此外，集成使用多智能体文本梯度的 Med-TextGrad 模块，以确保最终输出遵循检索知识和患者查询。在多语言、多任务数据集上的综合实验表明，DoctorRAG 显著优于强基线 RA

5797be5aaf17f92d630ab307edbf19af4e17d295.title: Controllable 3D Molecular Generation for Structure-Based Drug Design Through Bayesian Flow Networks and Gradient Integration
5797be5aaf17f92d630ab307edbf19af4e17d295.abstract: Recent advances in Structure-based Drug Design (SBDD) have leveraged generative models for 3D molecular generation, predominantly evaluating model performance by binding affinity to target proteins. However, practical drug discovery necessitates high binding affinity along with synthetic feasibility and selectivity, critical properties that were largely neglected in previous evaluations. To address this gap, we identify fundamental limitations of conventional diffusion-based generative models in effectively guiding molecule generation toward these diverse pharmacological properties. We propose CByG, a novel framework extending Bayesian Flow Network into a gradient-based conditional generative model that robustly integrates property-specific guidance. Additionally, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation scheme incorporating practical benchmarks for binding affinity, synthetic feasibility
5797be5aaf17f92d630ab307edbf19af4e17d295.zh_title: 贝叶斯流网络与梯度积分的可控三维分子生成
5797be5aaf17f92d630ab307edbf19af4e17d295.summary: 结合贝叶斯流网络与梯度积分实现可控三维分子生成，服务于基于结构的药物设计。
key_points: 指出扩散生成模型的既有局限
兼顾亲和力、可合成性与选择性
面向基于结构的药物设计
5797be5aaf17f92d630ab307edbf19af4e17d295.zh_abstract: 基于结构的药物设计（Structure-based Drug Design, SBDD）的最新进展已利用生成模型进行 3D 分子生成，主要通过与靶标蛋白的结合亲和力来评估模型性能。然而，实际药物发现不仅需要高结合亲和力，还需要合成可行性（synthetic feasibility）和选择性（selectivity），这些关键性质在以往的评估中被很大程度上忽视。为弥补这一空白，我们指出了传统基于扩散的生成模型在有效引导分子生成朝向这些多样药理性质方面的根本局限。我们提出 CByG，一个将贝叶斯流网络（Bayesian Flow Network）扩展为基于梯度的条件生成模型的新框架，能够稳健地整合性质特异性引导。此外，我们引入了一个综合评价方案，纳入针对结合亲和力、合成可行性的实用基准

3f5e3a9a2f32f5ce6d4add325188bb5c157ec6b2.title: CIDD: Collaborative Intelligence for Structure-Based Drug Design Empowered by LLMs
3f5e3a9a2f32f5ce6d4add325188bb5c157ec6b2.abstract: Structure-guided molecular generation is pivotal in early-stage drug discovery, enabling the design of compounds tailored to specific protein targets. However, despite recent advances in 3D generative modeling, particularly in improving docking scores, these methods often produce uncommon and intrinsically unreasonable molecular structures that deviate from drug-like chemical space. To quantify this issue, we propose a novel metric, the Molecule Reasonable Ratio (MRR), which measures structural rationality and reveals a critical gap between existing models and real-world approved drugs. To address this, we introduce the Collaborative Intelligence Drug Design (CIDD) framework, the first approach to unify the 3D interaction modeling capabilities of generative models with the general knowledge and reasoning power of large language models (LLMs). By leveraging LLM-based Chain-of-Thought reas
3f5e3a9a2f32f5ce6d4add325188bb5c157ec6b2.zh_title: CIDD：大模型赋能的结构导向药物设计协同智能
3f5e3a9a2f32f5ce6d4add325188bb5c157ec6b2.summary: 提出 CIDD，利用大模型协同进行结构导向分子生成，并提出合理分子比例 MRR 指标。
key_points: 3D 生成模型常产出不合理分子结构
提出 MRR 量化分子结构合理性
面向特定蛋白靶点的化合物设计
3f5e3a9a2f32f5ce6d4add325188bb5c157ec6b2.zh_abstract: 基于结构的分子生成在早期药物发现中至关重要，能够设计针对特定蛋白质靶标定制的化合物。然而，尽管 3D 生成建模最近取得了进展，尤其是在改善对接分数方面，这些方法常常产生不常见且本质上不合理的分子结构，偏离类药化学空间。为了量化这一问题，我们提出了一种新指标——分子合理比率（Molecule Reasonable Ratio, MRR），它衡量结构合理性，并揭示了现有模型与实际获批药物之间的关键差距。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了协作智能药物设计（Collaborative Intelligence Drug Design, CIDD）框架，这是首个将生成模型的 3D 相互作用建模能力与大语言模型（LLMs）的通用知识和推理能力统一起来的方法。通过利用基于 LLM 的思维链推理……

32c3da79317a3373312b9a6b47339fe62c0a6bcc.title: ChromFound: Towards A Universal Foundation Model for Single-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Data
32c3da79317a3373312b9a6b47339fe62c0a6bcc.abstract: The advent of single-cell Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (scATAC-seq) offers an innovative perspective for deciphering regulatory mechanisms by assembling a vast repository of single-cell chromatin accessibility data. While foundation models have achieved significant success in single-cell transcriptomics, there is currently no foundation model for scATAC-seq that supports zero-shot high-quality cell identification and comprehensive multi-omics analysis simultaneously. Key challenges lie in the high dimensionality and sparsity of scATAC-seq data, as well as the lack of a standardized schema for representing open chromatin regions (OCRs). Here, we present ChromFound, a foundation model tailored for scATAC-seq. ChromFound utilizes a hybrid architecture and genome-aware tokenization to effectively capture genome-wide long contexts and regulatory signals from dyn
32c3da79317a3373312b9a6b47339fe62c0a6bcc.zh_title: ChromFound：单细胞染色质可及性通用基础模型
32c3da79317a3373312b9a6b47339fe62c0a6bcc.summary: 提出面向scATAC-seq数据的通用基础模型，支持零样本高质量细胞识别与多组学分析。
key_points: 面向scATAC-seq的基础模型
支持零样本细胞识别
兼顾多组学分析
32c3da79317a3373312b9a6b47339fe62c0a6bcc.zh_abstract: 单细胞转座酶可及性染色质测序（scATAC-seq）的出现，通过汇集大量单细胞染色质可及性数据，为解析调控机制提供了创新视角。虽然基础模型在单细胞转录组学中取得了显著成功，但目前尚无针对 scATAC-seq 的基础模型能同时支持零样本高质量细胞识别和全面的多组学分析。关键挑战在于 scATAC-seq 数据的高维度和稀疏性，以及缺乏表示开放染色质区域（OCRs）的标准化模式。在此，我们提出 ChromFound，一个专为 scATAC-seq 量身定制的基础模型。ChromFound 利用混合架构和基因组感知的标记化，有效捕获全基因组长上下文和来自 dyn 的调控信号。

20afd0292752afcb985314eda1ece89117edbd2e.title: MolVision: Molecular Property Prediction with Vision Language Models
20afd0292752afcb985314eda1ece89117edbd2e.abstract: Molecular property prediction is a fundamental task in computational chemistry with critical applications in drug discovery and materials science. While recent works have explored Large Language Models (LLMs) for this task, they primarily rely on textual molecular representations such as SMILES/SELFIES, which can be ambiguous and structurally less informative. In this work, we introduce MolVision, a novel approach that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by integrating both molecular structure as images and textual descriptions to enhance property prediction. We construct a benchmark spanning ten diverse datasets, covering classification, regression and description tasks. 20afd0292752afcb985314eda1ece89117edbd2e.zh_title: MolVision：视觉语言模型用于分子性质预测
20afd0292752afcb985314eda1ece89117edbd2e.summary: 提出MolVision，结合分子结构与视觉语言模型，用于分子性质预测。
key_points: 分子性质预测用于药物发现
现有LLM依赖SMILES/SELFIES文本
MolVision整合分子结构信息
20afd0292752afcb985314eda1ece89117edbd2e.zh_abstract: 分子性质预测是计算化学中的一项基础任务，在药物发现和材料科学中具有关键应用。虽然近期工作探索了大型语言模型（LLMs）用于此任务，但它们主要依赖文本分子表示，如 SMILES/SELFIES，这些表示可能具有歧义且结构信息较少。在这项工作中，我们引入了 MolVision，一种利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的新方法，通过将分子结构作为图像和文本描述相结合来增强性质预测。我们构建了一个涵盖十个不同数据集的基准，包括分类、回归和描述任务。在零样本、少样本和微调设置下评估九种不同的 VLMs，我们发现视觉信息提高了预测性能，特别是当与高效微调策略如 such 结合时。

16d79ec45bc1a3d7d5a07168ab3158e9348324be.title: UniZyme: A Unified Protein Cleavage Site Predictor Enhanced with Enzyme Active-Site Knowledge
16d79ec45bc1a3d7d5a07168ab3158e9348324be.abstract: Enzyme-catalyzed protein cleavage is essential for many biological functions. Accurate prediction of cleavage sites can facilitate various applications such as drug development, enzyme design, and a deeper understanding of biological mechanisms. However, most existing models are restricted to an individual enzyme, which neglects shared knowledge of enzymes and fails to generalize to novel enzymes. Thus, we introduce a unified protein cleavage site predictor named UniZyme, which can generalize across diverse enzymes. To enhance the enzyme encoding for the protein cleavage site prediction, UniZyme employs a novel biochemically-informed model architecture along with active-site knowledge of proteolytic enzymes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniZyme achieves high accuracy in predicting cleavage sites across a range of proteolytic enzymes, including unseen enzymes. The code is availa
16d79ec45bc1a3d7d5a07168ab3158e9348324be.zh_title: UniZyme：融合酶活性位点知识的蛋白切割位点预测器
16d79ec45bc1a3d7d5a07168ab3158e9348324be.summary: 提出UniZyme，融合酶活性位点知识统一预测蛋白质切割位点。
key_points: 酶催化蛋白切割具有重要功能
现有模型多限于单个酶
UniZyme可泛化至新酶
16d79ec45bc1a3d7d5a07168ab3158e9348324be.zh_abstract: 酶催化的蛋白质切割对许多生物功能至关重要。准确预测切割位点可以促进多种应用，如药物开发、酶设计以及对生物机制的深入理解。然而，大多数现有模型仅限于单个酶，这忽略了酶的共享知识，并且无法泛化到新酶。因此，我们引入了一个统一的蛋白质切割位点预测器，名为 UniZyme，它可以在多种酶之间泛化。为了增强蛋白质切割位点预测的酶编码，UniZyme 采用了一种新颖的基于生物化学信息的模型架构以及蛋白水解酶的活性位点知识。大量实验表明，UniZyme 在预测一系列蛋白水解酶（包括未见过的酶）的切割位点方面达到了高准确度。代码是 availa

0da66d1df1d50329140f3564f3313fe90e33ec22.title: Multimodal Disease Progression Modeling via Spatiotemporal Disentanglement and Multiscale Alignment
0da66d1df1d50329140f3564f3313fe90e33ec22.abstract: Longitudinal multimodal data, including electronic health records (EHR) and sequential chest X-rays (CXRs), is critical for modeling disease progression, yet remains underutilized due to two key challenges: (1) redundancy in consecutive CXR sequences, where static anatomical regions dominate over clinically-meaningful dynamics, and (2) temporal misalignment between sparse, irregular imaging and continuous EHR data. We introduce $\texttt{DiPro}$, a novel framework that addresses these challenges through region-aware disentanglement and multi-timescale alignment. First, we disentangle static (anatomy) and dynamic (pathology progression) features in sequential CXRs, prioritizing disease-relevant changes.
