0da66d1df1d50329140f3564f3313fe90e33ec22.zh_title: 时空解耦与多尺度对齐的多模态疾病进展建模
0da66d1df1d50329140f3564f3313fe90e33ec22.summary: 提出DiPro框架，利用电子病历与连续胸片序列建模疾病进展，应对冗余与时序错位。
key_points: 缓解连续胸片序列中的信息冗余
处理稀疏影像与连续EHR的时序错位
融合EHR与胸片的多模态纵向数据
0da66d1df1d50329140f3564f3313fe90e33ec22.zh_abstract: 纵向多模态数据，包括电子健康记录（EHR）和连续胸部 X 射线（CXRs），对于建模疾病进展至关重要，但由于两个关键挑战仍未得到充分利用：(1) 连续 CXR 序列中的冗余，其中静态解剖区域压过具有临床意义的动态变化；(2) 稀疏、不规则的影像与连续 EHR 数据之间的时间错位。我们引入了 $\texttt{DiPro}$，这是一个新颖的框架，通过区域感知解耦和多时间尺度对齐来应对这些挑战。首先，我们解耦连续 CXR 中的静态（解剖）和动态（病理进展）特征，优先考虑疾病相关变化。其次，我们通过局部（成对区间级）和全局（全序列）同步，将这些静态和动态 CXR 特征与异步 EHR 数据进行分层对齐，以建模一致性……

fd970371501aa08a7e41d45f60b875b3b0dcbb70.title: The Boundaries of Fair AI in Medical Image Prognosis: A Causal Perspective
fd970371501aa08a7e41d45f60b875b3b0dcbb70.abstract: As machine learning (ML) algorithms are increasingly used in medical image analysis, concerns have emerged about their potential biases against certain social groups. Although many approaches have been proposed to ensure the fairness of ML models, most existing works focus only on medical image diagnosis tasks, such as image classification and segmentation, and overlooked prognosis scenarios, which involve predicting the likely outcome or progression of a medical condition over time. To address this gap, we introduce FairTTE, the first comprehensive framework for assessing fairness in time-to-event (TTE) prediction in medical imaging. FairTTE encompasses a diverse range of imaging modalities and TTE outcomes, integrating cutting-edge TTE prediction and fairness algorithms to enable systematic and fine-grained analysis of fairness in medical image prognosis. fd970371501aa08a7e41d45f60b875b3b0dcbb70.zh_title: 医学影像预后中公平 AI 的边界：因果视角

bfca403ebf125fb68edcb47b109911665573b9ab.title: DermaCon-IN: A Multi-concept Annotated Dermatological Image Dataset of Indian Skin Disorders for Clinical AI Research
bfca403ebf125fb68edcb47b109911665573b9ab.abstract: Artificial intelligence is poised to augment dermatological care by enabling scalable image-based diagnostics. Yet, the development of robust and equitable models remains hindered by datasets that fail to capture the clinical and demographic complexity of real-world practice. This complexity stems from region-specific disease distributions, wide variation in skin tones, and the underrepresentation of outpatient scenarios from non-Western populations. We introduce DermaCon-IN, a prospectively curated dermatology dataset comprising 5,450 clinical images from 3,002 patients across outpatient clinics in South India. Each image is annotated by board-certified dermatologists with 245 distinct diagnoses, structured under a hierarchical, aetiology-based taxonomy adapted from Rook's classification. The dataset captures a wide spectrum of dermatologic conditions and tonal variation commonly seen i
bfca403ebf125fb68edcb47b109911665573b9ab.zh_title: DermaCon-IN：印度皮肤疾病多概念标注图像数据集
bfca403ebf125fb68edcb47b109911665573b9ab.summary: NeurIPS 2025 提出面向临床 AI 研究的印度皮肤疾病多概念标注皮肤图像数据集，覆盖不同肤色与非西方门诊场景。
key_points: 现有数据集缺乏真实临床与人口学复杂性
聚焦区域特异疾病分布与宽泛肤色差异
旨在支持更公平稳健的皮肤影像模型
bfca403ebf125fb68edcb47b109911665573b9ab.zh_abstract: 人工智能有望通过实现可扩展的基于图像的诊断来增强皮肤科诊疗。然而，稳健且公平的模型的开发仍然受到数据集的阻碍，这些数据集未能捕捉真实世界实践的临床和人口学复杂性。这种复杂性源于区域特异性的疾病分布、皮肤色调的广泛差异，以及非西方人群门诊场景的代表性不足。我们推出 DermaCon-IN，这是一个前瞻性策划的皮肤病学数据集，包含来自印度南部门诊诊所的 3,002 名患者的 5,450 张临床图像。每张图像均由委员会认证的皮肤科医生标注，共有 245 种不同诊断，并按照改编自 Rook 分类法的基于病因的分层分类体系进行组织。该数据集涵盖了广泛的皮肤病病种以及常见于 i 的色调变化

9f05359bbe1f36be9be708d7d8c27b3a179d0f57.title: Semantic and Visual Crop-Guided Diffusion Models for Heterogeneous Tissue Synthesis in Histopathology
9f05359bbe1f36be9be708d7d8c27b3a179d0f57.abstract: Synthetic data generation in histopathology faces unique challenges: preserving tissue heterogeneity, capturing subtle morphological features, and scaling to unannotated datasets. We present a latent diffusion model that generates realistic heterogeneous histopathology images through a novel dual-conditioning approach combining semantic segmentation maps with tissue-specific visual crops. Unlike existing methods that rely on text prompts or abstract visual embeddings, our approach preserves critical morphological details by directly incorporating raw tissue crops from corresponding semantic regions. For annotated datasets (i.e., Camelyon16, Panda), we extract patches ensuring 20-80% tissue heterogeneity. 9f05359bbe1f36be9be708d7d8c27b3a179d0f57.zh_title: 语义与视觉裁剪引导的病理异质组织合成扩散模型
9f05359bbe1f36be9be708d7d8c27b3a179d0f57.summary: NeurIPS 2025 提出语义分割图与组织视觉裁剪双重条件的潜扩散模型，生成真实的异质性病理图像。
key_points: 病理合成需保留组织异质性与细微形态
方法不依赖文本提示或抽象视觉嵌入
面向未标注数据集的规模化生成
9f05359bbe1f36be9be708d7d8c27b3a179d0f57.zh_abstract: 组织病理学中的合成数据生成面临独特挑战：保留组织异质性、捕捉细微形态学特征以及扩展到未标注数据集。我们提出一种潜在扩散模型（latent diffusion model），通过一种新颖的双重条件方法（dual-conditioning approach），将语义分割图（semantic segmentation maps）与组织特异性视觉裁剪（tissue-specific visual crops）相结合，生成逼真的异质性组织病理学图像。与依赖文本提示或抽象视觉嵌入的现有方法不同，我们的方法通过直接纳入来自相应语义区域的原始组织裁剪，保留关键的形态学细节。对于已标注数据集（即 Camelyon16、Panda），我们提取确保 20-80% 组织异质性的图像块。对于未标注数据（即 TCGA），我们引入一种自监督扩展，使用基础模型嵌入（foundation model embeddings）将全切片图像（whole-slide images）聚类为 100 种组织类型，自动生成

98ed06913f33765bce74bfa15bf70af386f0836a.title: VQ-Seg: Vector-Quantized Token Perturbation for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
98ed06913f33765bce74bfa15bf70af386f0836a.abstract: Consistency learning with feature perturbation is a widely used strategy in semi-supervised medical image segmentation. However, many existing perturbation methods rely on dropout, and thus require a careful manual tuning of the dropout rate, which is a sensitive hyperparameter and often difficult to optimize and may lead to suboptimal regularization. To overcome this limitation, we propose VQ-Seg, the first approach to employ vector quantization (VQ) to discretize the feature space and introduce a novel and controllable Quantized Perturbation Module (QPM) that replaces dropout. Our QPM perturbs discrete representations by shuffling the spatial locations of codebook indices, enabling effective and controllable regularization. To mitigate potential information loss caused by quantization, we design a dual-branch architecture where the post-quantization feature space is shared by both imag
98ed06913f33765bce74bfa15bf70af386f0836a.zh_title: VQ-Seg：向量量化扰动用于半监督医学图像分割
98ed06913f33765bce74bfa15bf70af386f0836a.summary: 提出VQ-Seg，首次用向量量化离散化特征空间产生扰动，替代需手动调参的dropout一致性学习。
key_points: 首次将向量量化用于特征扰动
规避dropout率敏感超参数调参
面向半监督医学图像分割
98ed06913f33765bce74bfa15bf70af386f0836a.zh_abstract: 带有特征扰动的一致性学习是半监督医学图像分割中广泛使用的策略。然而，许多现有的扰动方法依赖 dropout，因此需要仔细手动调整 dropout 率；这是一个敏感的超参数，通常难以优化，并可能导致次优的正则化。为克服这一局限，我们提出 VQ-Seg，这是首个采用向量量化（VQ）来离散化特征空间的方法，并引入了一种新颖且可控的量化扰动模块（QPM）来替代 dropout。我们的 QPM 通过打乱码本索引的空间位置来扰动离散表示，从而实现有效且可控的正则化。为减轻量化可能造成的信息损失，我们设计了一种双分支架构，其中量化后的特征空间由 both imag 共享

91011bb8d1f4a8aaa3ceb6155b0b0c036c195751.title: Repurposing AlphaFold3-like Protein Folding Models for Antibody Sequence and Structure Co-design
91011bb8d1f4a8aaa3ceb6155b0b0c036c195751.abstract: Diffusion models hold great potential for accelerating antibody design, but their performance is so far limited by the number of antibody-antigen complexes used for model training. Meanwhile, AlphaFold3-like protein folding models, pre-trained on a large corpus of crystal structures, have acquired a broad understanding of biomolecular interaction. Based on this insight, we develop a new antigen-conditioned antibody design model by adapting the diffusion module of AlphaFold3-like models for sequence-structure co-diffusion. Specifically, we extend their structure diffusion module with a sequence diffusion head and fine-tune the entire protein folding model for antibody sequence-structure co-design. Our benchmark results show that sequence-structure co-diffusion models not only surpass state-of-the-art antibody design methods in performance but also maintain structure prediction accuracy co
91011bb8d1f4a8aaa3ceb6155b0b0c036c195751.zh_title: 复用AlphaFold3类折叠模型进行抗体序列与结构协同设计
91011bb8d1f4a8aaa3ceb6155b0b0c036c195751.summary: 将在大规模晶体结构上预训练的AlphaFold3类折叠模型扩散模块改造为抗原条件抗体设计模型，缓解抗体-抗原复合物训练数据不足。
key_points: 扩散模型抗体设计受复合物训练数据量限制
AlphaFold3类模型已具备分子相互作用理解
改造其扩散模块实现序列与结构协同设计
91011bb8d1f4a8aaa3ceb6155b0b0c036c195751.zh_abstract: 扩散模型在加速抗体设计方面具有巨大潜力，但迄今为止其性能受到用于模型训练的抗体-抗原复合物数量的限制。与此同时，类似 AlphaFold3 的蛋白质折叠模型已在一大批晶体结构上预训练，获得了对生物分子相互作用的广泛理解。基于这一见解，我们通过改造类似 AlphaFold3 模型的扩散模块以进行序列-结构共同扩散，开发了一种新的抗原条件化抗体设计模型。具体而言，我们用一个序列扩散头扩展其结构扩散模块，并微调整个蛋白质折叠模型以进行抗体序列-结构协同设计。我们的基准结果表明，序列-结构共同扩散模型不仅在性能上超越了最先进的抗体设计方法，而且还保持了结构预测准确性 co

8d0c3386130f31e215422ffa80c4ac69af192098.title: RAD: Towards Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Clinical Diagnosis
8d0c3386130f31e215422ffa80c4ac69af192098.abstract: Clinical diagnosis is a highly specialized discipline requiring both domain expertise and strict adherence to rigorous guidelines. While current AI-driven medical research predominantly focuses on knowledge graphs or natural text pretraining paradigms to incorporate medical knowledge, these approaches primarily rely on implicitly encoded knowledge within model parameters, neglecting task-specific knowledge required by diverse downstream tasks. To address this limitation, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Diagnosis (RAD), a novel framework that explicitly injects external knowledge into multimodal models directly on downstream tasks. 8d0c3386130f31e215422ffa80c4ac69af192098.zh_title: RAD：可信检索增强的多模态临床诊断
8d0c3386130f31e215422ffa80c4ac69af192098.summary: 提出检索增强方法RAD，为多模态临床诊断引入任务相关知识，弥补仅依赖模型参数隐式编码知识的不足。
key_points: 现有方法多依赖参数内隐式医学知识
忽视下游任务所需的特定知识
以检索增强提升临床诊断可信度
8d0c3386130f31e215422ffa80c4ac69af192098.zh_abstract: 临床诊断是一门高度专业化的学科，既需要领域专业知识，也需要严格遵守严谨的指南。尽管当前人工智能驱动的医学研究主要侧重于知识图谱或自然文本预训练范式以纳入医学知识，但这些方法主要依赖模型参数中隐式编码的知识，忽视了下游任务多样所需的特定任务知识。为解决这一局限，我们提出检索增强诊断（Retrieval-Augmented Diagnosis, RAD），一种新颖框架，直接将外部知识显式注入多模态模型以用于下游任务。具体而言，RAD 通过三个关键机制运作：从多个医学来源检索和精炼以疾病为中心的知识；一种指南增强对比损失，其约束多模态特征与指南 kn 之间的潜在距离

814776737f5f880c15a21c75d06e1ae89e8f7ebd.title: HiPoNet: A Multi-View Simplicial Complex Network for High Dimensional Point-Cloud and Single-Cell data
814776737f5f880c15a21c75d06e1ae89e8f7ebd.abstract: In this paper, we propose HiPoNet, an end-to-end differentiable neural network for regression, classification, and representation learning on high-dimensional point clouds. Our work is motivated by single-cell data which can have very high-dimensionality --exceeding the capabilities of existing methods for point clouds which are mostly tailored for 3D data. Moreover, modern single-cell and spatial experiments now yield entire cohorts of datasets (i.e., one data set for every patient), necessitating models that can process large, high-dimensional point-clouds at scale. Most current approaches build a single nearest-neighbor graph, discarding important geometric and topological information. In contrast, HiPoNet models the point-cloud as a set of higher-order simplicial complexes, with each particular complex being created using a reweighting of features. This method thus generates multiple
814776737f5f880c15a21c75d06e1ae89e8f7ebd.zh_title: HiPoNet：高维点云与单细胞数据的多视图单纯复形网络
814776737f5f880c15a21c75d06e1ae89e8f7ebd.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出端到端可微的HiPoNet，用于高维点云的回归、分类与表征学习，动机来自高维单细胞数据。

6f1e938a8675fb31c0e17c222f6ef2fe3d6ba8c6.title: Hierarchical Information Aggregation for Incomplete Multimodal Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
6f1e938a8675fb31c0e17c222f6ef2fe3d6ba8c6.abstract: Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) poses a significant health threat to the aging population, underscoring the critical need for early diagnosis to delay disease progression and improve patient quality of life. Recent advances in heterogeneous multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) have facilitated comprehensive joint diagnosis, yet practical clinical scenarios frequently encounter incomplete modalities due to factors like high acquisition costs or radiation risks. Moreover, traditional convolution-based architecture face inherent limitations in capturing long-range dependencies and handling heterogeneous medical data efficiently. 6f1e938a8675fb31c0e17c222f6ef2fe3d6ba8c6.zh_title: 不完整多模态AD诊断的层次信息聚合
6f1e938a8675fb31c0e17c222f6ef2fe3d6ba8c6.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出层次信息聚合方法，应对临床中模态缺失下的多模态阿尔茨海默病诊断。
key_points: 早期诊断有助延缓AD疾病进展
临床常因成本或辐射导致模态缺失
以层次信息聚合应对不完整模态
6f1e938a8675fb31c0e17c222f6ef2fe3d6ba8c6.zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer’s Disease, AD）对老龄人口构成重大健康威胁，凸显了早期诊断以延缓疾病进展并改善患者生活质量的迫切需求。近期异质多模态人工智能（AI）的进展促进了全面的联合诊断，然而实际临床场景常因高采集成本或辐射风险等因素而遇到模态不完整的问题。此外，传统基于卷积的架构在捕获长程依赖和高效处理异质医学数据方面面临固有局限。为应对这些挑战，在我们提出的异质多模态诊断框架（heterogeneous multimodal diagnostic framework, HAD）中，我们开发了一种基于多视图希尔伯特曲线的 Mamba 模块和一个分层空间特征提取模块，以同时捕获局部空间特征和全局 dep

5836c9f8d10dd40085682c660e8f18d94d9681a0.title: SpecMER: Fast Protein Generation with K-mer Guided Speculative Decoding
5836c9f8d10dd40085682c660e8f18d94d9681a0.abstract: Autoregressive models have transformed protein engineering by enabling the generation of novel protein sequences beyond those found in nature. However, their sequential inference introduces significant latency, limiting their utility in high-throughput protein screening. Speculative decoding accelerates generation by employing a lightweight draft model to sample tokens, which a larger target model then verifies and refines. Yet, in protein sequence generation, draft models are typically agnostic to the structural and functional constraints of the target protein, leading to biologically implausible outputs and a shift in the likelihood distribution of generated sequences. We introduce SpecMER (Speculative Decoding via k-mer Guidance), a novel framework that incorporates biological, structural, and functional priors using k-mer motifs extracted from multiple sequence alignments. By scoring
5836c9f8d10dd40085682c660e8f18d94d9681a0.zh_title: SpecMER：K-mer引导推测解码加速蛋白质生成
5836c9f8d10dd40085682c660e8f18d94d9681a0.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出K-mer引导的推测解码，缓解自回归蛋白质序列生成的推理延迟。
key_points: 自回归模型序列推理延迟高
推测解码用轻量草稿模型采样
草稿模型通常与任务无关
5836c9f8d10dd40085682c660e8f18d94d9681a0.zh_abstract: 自回归模型通过能够生成自然界中不存在的全新蛋白质序列，改变了蛋白质工程。然而，其顺序推理引入了显著的延迟，限制了其在高通量蛋白质筛选中的效用。推测解码通过采用轻量级草稿模型来采样 token，然后由更大的目标模型进行验证和细化，从而加速生成。然而，在蛋白质序列生成中，草稿模型通常对目标蛋白质的结构和功能约束不敏感，导致生物学上不可行的输出以及生成序列的似然分布发生偏移。我们提出了 SpecMER（Speculative Decoding via k-mer Guidance），这是一个新颖的框架，利用从多序列比对中提取的 k-mer 基序纳入生物学、结构和功能先验。通过评分

309f863ad9c6c2bb707e022f4e2abab95bceb557.title: Automatic Auxiliary Task Selection and Adaptive Weighting Boost Molecular Property Prediction
309f863ad9c6c2bb707e022f4e2abab95bceb557.abstract: Recent studies in Machine Learning (ML) for biological research focus on investigating molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery. However, limited labeled molecular data often hampers the performance of ML models. A common strategy to mitigate data scarcity is leveraging auxiliary learning tasks to provide additional supervision, but selecting effective auxiliary tasks requires substantial domain expertise and manual effort, and their inclusion does not always guarantee performance gains. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Automatic Auxiliary Task Selection (A UT A U T), a fully automated framework that seamlessly retrieves auxiliary tasks using large language models and adaptively integrates them through a novel gradient alignment weighting mechanism. By automatically emphasizing auxiliary tasks aligned with the primary objective, A UT A U T significantly enhances predic
309f863ad9c6c2bb707e022f4e2abab95bceb557.zh_title: 自动辅助任务选择与自适应加权提升分子性质预测
309f863ad9c6c2bb707e022f4e2abab95bceb557.summary: 针对分子性质预测中标签稀缺问题，提出自动选择辅助任务与自适应加权方法，提升预测性能。
key_points: 分子标签数据稀缺限制模型性能
自动选择有效辅助任务
自适应加权提升预测
309f863ad9c6c2bb707e022f4e2abab95bceb557.zh_abstract: 最近针对生物研究的机器学习（ML）研究聚焦于探究分子特性以加速药物发现。然而，有限的标注分子数据常常阻碍ML模型的性能。缓解数据稀缺的一种常见策略是利用辅助学习任务提供额外监督，但选择有效的辅助任务需要大量领域专业知识和人工努力，而且纳入这些任务并不总能保证性能提升。为克服这些挑战，我们提出自动辅助任务选择（Automatic Auxiliary Task Selection，A UT A U T），这是一个全自动框架，利用大语言模型无缝检索辅助任务，并通过一种新颖的梯度对齐加权机制自适应地整合这些任务。通过自动强调与主要目标对齐的辅助任务，A UT A U T 显著提升预测

166b5a44f9a20dd8ab72add744712e2b4edf2ac4.title: Unified all-atom molecule generation with neural fields
166b5a44f9a20dd8ab72add744712e2b4edf2ac4.abstract: Generative models for structure-based drug design are often limited to a specific modality, restricting their broader applicability. To address this challenge, we introduce FuncBind, a framework based on computer vision to generate target-conditioned, all-atom molecules across atomic systems. FuncBind uses neural fields to represent molecules as continuous atomic densities and employs score-based generative models with modern architectures adapted from the computer vision literature. This modality-agnostic representation allows a single unified model to be trained on diverse atomic systems, from small to large molecules, and handle variable atom/residue counts, including non-canonical amino acids. FuncBind achieves competitive in silico performance in generating small molecules, macrocyclic peptides, and antibody complementarity-determining region loops, conditioned on target structures.
166b5a44f9a20dd8ab72add744712e2b4edf2ac4.zh_title: 基于神经场的统一全原子分子生成框架
166b5a44f9a20dd8ab72add744712e2b4edf2ac4.summary: 提出FuncBind，用神经场表示连续原子密度，实现跨原子系统的目标条件全原子分子生成。
key_points: 借鉴计算机视觉架构构建生成框架
神经场将分子表示为连续原子密度
采用得分生成模型实现目标条件生成
166b5a44f9a20dd8ab72add744712e2b4edf2ac4.zh_abstract: 基于结构的药物设计的生成模型通常局限于特定模态，限制了其更广泛的适用性。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 FuncBind，一个基于计算机视觉的框架，用于跨原子系统生成靶标条件化的全原子分子。FuncBind 使用神经场将分子表示为连续原子密度，并采用基于评分的生成模型，其现代架构改编自计算机视觉文献。这种模态无关的表示允许单个统一模型在不同原子系统（从小分子到大分子）上训练，并处理可变的原子/残基数量，包括非经典氨基酸。FuncBind 在生成小分子、大环肽和抗体互补决定区环方面取得了具有竞争力的计算机模拟性能，并以靶标结构为条件。

162a640920d2fd274b72ad8b67cd6c03317731cb.title: PolypSense3D: A Multi-Source Benchmark Dataset for Depth-Aware Polyp Size Measurement in Endoscopy
162a640920d2fd274b72ad8b67cd6c03317731cb.abstract: Accurate polyp sizing during endoscopy is crucial for cancer risk assessment but is hindered by subjective methods and inadequate datasets lacking integrated 2D appearance, 3D structure, and real-world size information. We introduce PolypSense3D , the first multi-source benchmark dataset specifically targeting depth-aware polyp size measurement. It uniquely integrates over 43,000 frames from virtual simulations, physical phantoms, and clinical sequences, providing synchronized RGB, dense/sparse depth, segmentation masks, camera parameters, and millimeter-scale size labels derived via a novel forceps-assisted in-vivo annotation technique. To establish its value, we benchmark state-of-the-art segmentation and depth estimation models. Results quantify significant domain gaps between simulated/phantom and clinical data and reveal substantial error propagation from perception stages to final
162a640920d2fd274b72ad8b67cd6c03317731cb.zh_title: PolypSense3D：深度感知息肉尺寸测量基准数据集
162a640920d2fd274b72ad8b67cd6c03317731cb.summary: 发布首个面向深度感知息肉尺寸测量的多源基准数据集，整合超4.3万帧。
key_points: 整合仿真、体模与临床三类来源
提供同步RGB与稠密/稀疏深度
面向内镜息肉尺寸测量任务
162a640920d2fd274b72ad8b67cd6c03317731cb.zh_abstract: 内窥镜检查期间准确的息肉尺寸测量对于癌症风险评估至关重要，但受到主观方法以及缺乏整合的二维外观、三维结构和真实世界尺寸信息的数据集不足的阻碍。我们提出 PolypSense3D，这是首个专门针对深度感知息肉尺寸测量的多源基准数据集。它独特地整合了来自虚拟仿真、物理体模和临床序列的超过43,000帧，提供同步的RGB、密集/稀疏深度、分割掩膜、相机参数，以及通过一种新颖的镊子辅助的体内标注技术获得的毫米级尺寸标签。为确立其价值，我们对最先进的分割和深度估计模型进行了基准测试。结果量化了模拟/体模数据与临床数据之间的显著域差距，并揭示了从感知阶段到最终

09c071dbbd0583c88b0e6cb2005cb98f2b4542f6.title: Template-Guided 3D Molecular Pose Generation via Flow Matching and Differentiable Optimization
09c071dbbd0583c88b0e6cb2005cb98f2b4542f6.abstract: Predicting the 3D conformation of small molecules within protein binding sites is a key challenge in drug design. When a crystallized reference ligand (template) is available, it provides geometric priors that can guide 3D pose prediction. We present a two-stage method for ligand conformation generation guided by such templates. In the first stage, we introduce a molecular alignment approach based on flow-matching to generate 3D coordinates for the ligand, using the template structure as a reference. In the second stage, a differentiable pose optimization procedure refines this conformation based on shape and pharmacophore similarities, internal energy, and, optionally, the protein binding pocket. 09c071dbbd0583c88b0e6cb2005cb98f2b4542f6.zh_title: 模板引导的3D分子构象生成：流匹配与可微优化
09c071dbbd0583c88b0e6cb2005cb98f2b4542f6.summary: 提出两阶段方法，结合流匹配与可微优化，在模板引导下生成配体三维构象。

e6bbcc9450a651c9f77cdddfc6b2cfc43a3a449d.abstract: Deep learning has emerged as a pivotal tool for accelerating research in the life sciences, with the low-level processing of biomedical images (e.g., registration, fusion, restoration, super-resolution) being one of its most critical applications. e16e6d2e9bf83e2091d840b1fee5f07c59f01570.abstract: U-shaped networks output logits at multiple spatial scales, each capturing a different blend of coarse context and fine detail. Yet, training still treats these logits in isolation - either supervising only the final, highest-resolution logits or applying deep supervision with identical loss weights at every scale - without exploring mixed-scale combinations. c0e66700cd3692e46df23e8c3bd512fe2eabeef2.abstract: Drug recommendation systems aim to identify optimal drug combinations for patient care, balancing therapeutic efficacy and safety. Advances in large-scale longitudinal EHRs have enabled learning-based approaches that leverage patient histories such as diagnoses, procedures, and previously prescribed drugs, to model complex patient-drug relationships. Yet, many existing solutions overlook standard clinical practices that favor certain drugs for specific conditions and fail to fully integrate the influence of molecular substructures on drug efficacy and safety. In response, we propose SubRec , a unified framework that integrates representation learning across both patient and drug spaces. Specifically, SubRec introduces a conditional information bottleneck to extract core drug substructures most relevant to patient conditions, thereby enhancing interpretability and clinical alignment. b6640f039075f5da3e132e6eb370608e9bf1961d.abstract: Inverse protein folding addresses the challenge of designing amino acid sequences that fold into a predetermined tertiary structure, bridging geometric and evolutionary constraints to advance protein engineering. 74e0848756eb1d054773cc1b154bbf4af457fe59.abstract: Retinal vessel segmentation is critical for medical diagnosis, yet existing models often struggle to generalize across domains due to appearance variability, limited annotations, and complex vascular morphology. 1a92375423451a79b0f375c754991e65606c33f4.abstract: Dynamic functional brain networks (DFBNs) are powerful tools in neuroscience research. e9ee0a9d27674a9cff6e2af3081ee20acafaad7b.title: Equi-mRNA: Protein Translation Equivariant Encoding for mRNA Language Models
e9ee0a9d27674a9cff6e2af3081ee20acafaad7b.abstract: The growing importance of mRNA therapeutics and synthetic biology highlights the need for models that capture the latent structure of synonymous codon (different triplets encoding the same amino acid) usage, which subtly modulates translation efficiency and gene expression. e94094d3d64083c3ad08d38006869c7a2fe6cf9b.abstract: Geometric molecule generative models have found expanding applications across various scientific domains, but their generation inefficiency has become a critical bottleneck. b7e1c345d76983aafb19a864975d1ab84d6866b6.title: Beyond Average Value Function in Precision Medicine: Maximum Probability-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Survival Analysis
b7e1c345d76983aafb19a864975d1ab84d6866b6.abstract: Constructing multistage optimal decisions for alternating recurrent event data is critically important in medical and healthcare research. 9d4a8a5a7810c72c7702ed5536b49ffbef783e82.title: D2SA: Dual-Stage Distribution and Slice Adaptation for Efficient Test-Time Adaptation in MRI Reconstruction
9d4a8a5a7810c72c7702ed5536b49ffbef783e82.abstract: Variations in Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanners and acquisition protocols cause distribution shifts that degrade reconstruction performance on unseen data. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a promising solution to address this discrepancies. However, previous single-shot TTA approaches are inefficient due to repeated training and suboptimal distributional models. Self-supervised learning methods may risk over-smoothing in scarce data scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Dual-Stage Distribution and Slice Adaptation (D2SA) via MRI implicit neural representation (MR-INR) to improve MRI reconstruction performance and efficiency, which features two stages. 99b6895a017d6e8e8c7bfb12ff47740abfe73fe1.title: SHF: Symmetrical Hierarchical Forest with Pretrained Vision Transformer Encoder for High-Resolution Medical Segmentation

94e0f32585561b282476388c5acfc8a54cff44cd.abstract: Oligonucleotide therapeutics offer great potential to address previously undrug-gable targets and enable personalized medicine. However, their progress is often hindered by insufficient safety and efficacy profiles. Predictive modeling and machine learning could significantly accelerate oligonucleotide drug discovery by identifying suboptimal compounds early on, but their application in this area lags behind other modalities. 8fbf486e28f9389fa2b8ab92ba221e8f015228b6.abstract: The scarcity of annotated medical imaging data has driven significant progress in semi-supervised learning to alleviate reliance on expensive expert labeling. 8370ca8377784b943a1c93b8e31ceb1dbfe99ddd.title: Pancakes: Consistent Multi-Protocol Image Segmentation Across Biomedical Domains
8370ca8377784b943a1c93b8e31ceb1dbfe99ddd.abstract: A single biomedical image can be meaningfully segmented in multiple ways, depending on the desired application. 7170f496b291274c0fbd91e7f95ec499095524d4.title: Detecting Data Deviations in Electronic Health Records
7170f496b291274c0fbd91e7f95ec499095524d4.abstract: Data deviations in electronic health records (EHR) refer to discrepancies between recorded entries and a patient’s actual physiological state, indicating a decline in EHR data fidelity. 48bf45fd151818390d9f43cb7e0f287c82fc9712.title: PSBench: a large-scale benchmark for estimating the accuracy of protein complex structural models
48bf45fd151818390d9f43cb7e0f287c82fc9712.abstract: Predicting protein complex structures is essential for protein function analysis, protein design, and drug discovery. While AI methods like AlphaFold can predict accurate structural models for many protein complexes, reliably estimating the quality of these predicted models (estimation of model accuracy, or EMA) for model ranking and selection remains a major challenge. A key barrier to developing effective machine learning-based EMA methods is the lack of large, diverse, and well-annotated datasets for training and evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce PSBench, a benchmark suite comprising four large-scale, labeled datasets generated during the 15th and 16th community-wide Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction (CASP15 and CASP16). 3a3e0c797b4c448b3589a4a5b544b2fcccafab90.abstract: Brain disorders have been consistently associated with abnormalities in specific brain regions or neural circuits. Identifying key brain regional activities and functional connectivity patterns is essential for discovering more precise neurobiological biomarkers. However, previous studies have primarily emphasized alterations in functional connectivity while overlooking abnormal neuronal population activity within brain regions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel Local-Global Coupling Spiking Graph Transformer (LGC-SGT) that jointly models both inter-regional connectivity differences and deviations in neuronal population firing rates within brain regions, enabling a dual-perspective neuropathological analysis. In this work, we introduce OphNet-3D, the first extensive RGB-D dynamic 3D reconstruction dataset for ophthalmic surgery, comprising 41 sequences from 40 surgeons and totaling 7.1 million frames, with fine-grained annotations of 12 surgical phases, 10 instrument categories, dense MANO hand meshes, and full 6-DoF instrument poses. 21ca71f72232613093d4212c22376bc9350e579a.title: Single GPU Task Adaptation of Pathology Foundation Models for Whole Slide Image Analysis
21ca71f72232613093d4212c22376bc9350e579a.abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have emerged as powerful tools for analyzing whole slide images (WSIs). However, adapting these pretrained PFMs for specific clinical tasks presents considerable challenges, primarily due to the availability of only weak (WSI-level) labels for gigapixel images, necessitating multiple instance learning (MIL) paradigm for effective WSI analysis. 1959c1d46b6fa8879afa94da8c7854efd7cf36f9.abstract: Safe deployment of machine learning (ML) models in safety-critical domains such as medical imaging requires detecting inputs with characteristics not seen during training, known as out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, to prevent unreliable predictions. Effective OOD detection after deployment could benefit from access to the training data, enabling direct comparison between test samples and the training data distribution to identify differences. State-of-the-art OOD detection methods, however, either discard the training data after deployment or assume that test samples and training data are centrally stored together, an assumption that rarely holds in real-world settings. 15df6c6e465a25890df86370734733841cfb179e.title: Enhancing Bioactivity Prediction via Spatial Emptiness Representation of Protein-ligand Complex and Union of Multiple Pockets
15df6c6e465a25890df86370734733841cfb179e.abstract: Predicting the bioactivity of candidate ligands remains a central challenge in drug discovery. Ligands and endogenous substrates often compete for the same binding sites on target proteins, and the extent to which a ligand can modulate protein function depends not only on its binding but also on how effectively it occupies the relevant pocket. However, most existing methods focus narrowly on local interactions within protein–ligand complexes and neglect spatial emptiness—the unoccupied regions within the binding site that may permit endogenous molecules to engage or interfere. Such unfilled space can diminish the ligand’s functional impact, regardless of binding affinity. eca0d5a560c791ac41822046760eaf70a13a207b.abstract: Accurately modeling the target-drug complex at atom level presents a significant challenge in the computer-aided drug design. Traditional methods that rely solely on rigid transformations often fail to capture the adaptive interactions between targets and drugs, particularly during substantial conformational changes in targets upon ligand binding, which becomes especially critical when learning target-drug interactions in drug design. 733af532328e02ef706ca3d823c6be8149c5413b.abstract: Medical image segmentation based on neural networks is pivotal in promoting digital health equity. The attention mechanism increasingly serves as a key component in modern neural networks, as it enables the network to focus on regions of interest, thus improving the segmentation accuracy in medical images. However, current attention mechanisms confront an accuracy-complexity trade-off paradox: accuracy gains demand higher computational costs, while reducing complexity sacrifices model accuracy. Such a contradiction inherently restricts the real-world deployment of attention mechanisms in resource-limited settings, thus exacerbating healthcare disparities. 51aa08867c85ec5de638bd24377afc3be3d6b7a0.abstract: Designing protein binders targeting specific sites, which requires to generate realistic and functional interaction patterns, is a fundamental challenge in drug discovery. Current structure-based generative models are limited in generating nterfaces with sufficient rationality and interpretability. In this paper, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion for Aligned interface (RADiAnce), a new framework that leverages known interfaces to guide the design of novel binders. By unifying retrieval and generation in a shared contrastive latent space, our model efficiently identifies relevant interfaces for a given binding site and seamlessly integrates them through a conditional latent diffusion generator, enabling cross-domain interface transfer. However, current models overfit to existing oversimplified datasets that does not represent naturally occurring and biologically relevant proteins with modifications. In this work, we curate a complete and modification-aware version of the widely used DAVIS dataset by incorporating 4,032 kinase-ligand pairs involving substitutions, insertions, deletions, and phosphorylation events. This enriched dataset enables benchmarking of predictive models under biologically realistic conditions. 3ec75ecbf938f475e1871dc70dc102ce70d629db.title: STARC-9: A Large-scale Dataset for Multi-Class Tissue Classification for CRC Histopathology
3ec75ecbf938f475e1871dc70dc102ce70d629db.abstract: Multi-class tissue-type classification of colorectal cancer (CRC) histopathologic images is a significant step in the development of downstream machine learning models for diagnosis and treatment planning. However, publicly available CRC datasets used to build tissue classifiers often suffer from insufficient morphologic diversity, class imbalance, and low-quality image tiles, limiting downstream model performance and generalizability. To address this research gap, we introduce STARC-9 (STAnford coloRectal Cancer), a large-scale dataset for multi-class tissue classification. STARC-9 comprises 630,000 histopathologic image tiles uniformly sampled across nine clinically relevant tissue classes (each represented by 70,000 tiles), systematically extracted from hematoxylin & eosin-stained whole-slide images (WSI) from 200 CRC patients at the Stanford University School of Medicine. 36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.title: Generating Multi-Table Time Series EHR from Latent Space with Minimal Preprocessing
36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.abstract: Electronic Health Records (EHR) are time-series relational databases that record patient interactions and medical events over time, serving as a critical resource for healthcare research and applications. However, privacy concerns and regulatory restrictions limit the sharing and utilization of such sensitive data, necessitating the generation of synthetic EHR datasets. Unlike previous EHR synthesis methods, which typically generate medical records consisting of expert-chosen features (e.g. a few vital signs or structured codes only), we introduce RawMed, the first framework to synthesize multi-table, time-series EHR data that closely resembles raw EHRs. Using text-based representation and compression techniques, RawMed captures complex structures and temporal dynamics with minimal preprocessing. 36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.zh_title: 从潜空间生成多表时间序列电子病历数据

20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.title: Democratizing Clinical Risk Prediction with Cross-Cohort Cross-Modal Knowledge Transfer
20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.abstract: Clinical risk prediction plays a crucial role in early disease detection and personalized intervention. While recent models increasingly incorporate multimodal data, their development typically assumes access to large-scale, multimodal datasets and substantial computational resources. In practice, however, most clinical sites operate under resource constraints, with access limited to EHR data alone and insufficient capacity to train complicated models. This gap highlights the urgent need to democratize clinical risk prediction by enabling effective deployment in data-and resource-limited local clinical settings. In this work, we propose a cross-cohort cross-modal knowledge transfer framework that leverages the multimodal model trained on a nationwide cohort and adapts it to local cohorts with only EHR data. 20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.zh_title: 跨队列跨模态知识迁移实现临床风险预测普惠

18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.title: Towards Multiscale Graph-based Protein Learning with Geometric Secondary Structural Motifs
18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning protein structures by capturing spatial relationships at the residue level. However, existing GNN-based methods often face challenges in learning multiscale representations and modeling long-range dependencies efficiently. In this work, we propose an efficient multiscale graph-based learning framework tailored to proteins. Our proposed framework contains two crucial components: (1) It constructs a hierarchical graph representation comprising a collection of fine-grained subgraphs, each corresponding to a secondary structure motif (e.g., $\alpha$-helices, $\beta$-strands, loops), and a single coarse-grained graph that connects these motifs based on their spatial arrangement and relative orientation. ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.title: MedXpertQA: Benchmarking Expert-Level Medical Reasoning and Understanding
ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.abstract: We introduce MedXpertQA, a highly challenging and comprehensive benchmark to evaluate expert-level medical knowledge and advanced reasoning. MedXpertQA includes 4,460 questions spanning 17 specialties and 11 body systems. It includes two subsets, Text for text evaluation and MM for multimodal evaluation. Notably, MM introduces expert-level exam questions with diverse images and rich clinical information, including patient records and examination results, setting it apart from traditional medical multimodal benchmarks with simple QA pairs generated from image captions. MedXpertQA applies rigorous filtering and augmentation to address the insufficient difficulty of existing benchmarks like MedQA, and incorporates specialty board questions to improve clinical relevance and comprehensiveness. c618b27700eff3f59abaaa926922369b95ec7f78.title: HealthGPT: A Medical Large Vision-Language Model for Unifying Comprehension and Generation via Heterogeneous Knowledge Adaptation
c618b27700eff3f59abaaa926922369b95ec7f78.abstract: We present HealthGPT, a powerful Medical Large Vision-Language Model (Med-LVLM) that integrates medical visual comprehension and generation capabilities within a unified autoregressive paradigm. Our bootstrapping philosophy is to progressively adapt heterogeneous comprehension and generation knowledge to pre-trained large language models (LLMs). This is achieved through a novel heterogeneous low-rank adaptation (H-LoRA) technique, which is complemented by a tailored hierarchical visual perception approach and a three-stage learning strategy. To effectively learn the HealthGPT, we devise a comprehensive medical domain-specific comprehension and generation dataset called VL-Health. Experimental results demonstrate exceptional performance and scalability of HealthGPT in medical visual unified tasks. Our project can be accessed at https://github.com/DCDmllm/HealthGPT.

c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.title: All-atom Diffusion Transformers: Unified generative modelling of molecules and materials
c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.abstract: Diffusion models are the standard toolkit for generative modelling of 3D atomic systems. However, for different types of atomic systems -- such as molecules and materials -- the generative processes are usually highly specific to the target system despite the underlying physics being the same. We introduce the All-atom Diffusion Transformer (ADiT), a unified latent diffusion framework for jointly generating both periodic materials and non-periodic molecular systems using the same model: (1) An autoencoder maps a unified, all-atom representations of molecules and materials to a shared latent embedding space; and (2) A diffusion model is trained to generate new latent embeddings that the autoencoder can decode to sample new molecules or materials. c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.zh_abstract: 扩散模型是3D原子系统生成建模的标准工具包。然而，对于不同类型的原子系统——例如分子和材料——尽管底层物理相同，生成过程通常仍高度特定于目标系统。我们引入了全原子扩散Transformer（All-atom Diffusion Transformer, ADiT），这是一个统一的潜在扩散框架，用于使用同一模型联合生成周期性材料和非周期性分子系统：（1）自编码器将分子和材料的统一全原子表示映射到共享潜在嵌入空间；（2）训练扩散模型以生成新的潜在嵌入，自编码器可将其解码以采样新分子或材料。在MP20、QM9和GEOM-DRUGS数据集上的实验表明，联合训练的ADiT生成的分子和材料既逼真又有效，以及材料

42535556d6fa176751774b7084f3b282093b026d.title: MedRAX: Medical Reasoning Agent for Chest X-ray
42535556d6fa176751774b7084f3b282093b026d.abstract: Chest X-rays (CXRs) play an integral role in driving critical decisions in disease management and patient care. While recent innovations have led to specialized models for various CXR interpretation tasks, these solutions often operate in isolation, limiting their practical utility in clinical practice. We present MedRAX, the first versatile AI agent that seamlessly integrates state-of-the-art CXR analysis tools and multimodal large language models into a unified framework. MedRAX dynamically leverages these models to address complex medical queries without requiring additional training. 40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.title: GenMol: A Drug Discovery Generalist with Discrete Diffusion
40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.abstract: Drug discovery is a complex process that involves multiple stages and tasks. 40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.zh_title: GenMol：面向药物发现的离散扩散通用模型

6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.title: Medical Large Language Model Benchmarks Should Prioritize Construct Validity
6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.abstract: Medical large language models (LLMs) research often makes bold claims, from encoding clinical knowledge to reasoning like a physician. These claims are usually backed by evaluation on competitive benchmarks; a tradition inherited from mainstream machine learning. But how do we separate real progress from a leaderboard flex? Medical LLM benchmarks, much like those in other fields, are arbitrarily constructed using medical licensing exam questions. For these benchmarks to truly measure progress, they must accurately capture the real-world tasks they aim to represent. In this position paper, we argue that medical LLM benchmarks should (and indeed can) be empirically evaluated for their construct validity. In the psychological testing literature,"construct validity"refers to the ability of a test to measure an underlying"construct", that is the actual conceptual target of evaluation. By draw
6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.zh_title: 医学大模型基准应优先考虑构念效度
6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.summary: ICML 2025论文指出医学LLM基准多基于执照考试题构建，主张优先考虑构念效度以衡量真实进展。
key_points: 医学LLM评估常依赖竞争性基准
基准多由执照考试题任意构建
需优先关注构念效度
6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.zh_abstract: 医学大型语言模型（LLMs）研究常常提出大胆主张，从编码临床知识到像医生一样推理。这些主张通常以在竞争性基准上的评估为依据；这是一种继承自主流机器学习的传统。但是，我们如何将真正的进展与排行榜上的炫技区分开来？医学LLM基准测试与其他领域的基准测试非常相似，都是使用医师执照考试问题任意构建的。要使这些基准测试真正衡量进展，它们必须准确捕捉其旨在代表的真实世界任务。在这篇立场论文中，我们认为医学LLM基准测试应当（而且确实可以）对其构念效度（construct validity）进行实证评估。在心理测试文献中，“构念效度”（construct validity）指测验测量潜在“构念”（construct）的能力，即评估的实际概念目标。通过绘制

ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.title: Learning-Order Autoregressive Models with Application to Molecular Graph Generation
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.abstract: Autoregressive models (ARMs) have become the workhorse for sequence generation tasks, since many problems can be modeled as next-token prediction. While there appears to be a natural ordering for text (i.e., left-to-right), for many data types, such as graphs, the canonical ordering is less obvious. To address this problem, we introduce a variant of ARM that generates high-dimensional data using a probabilistic ordering that is sequentially inferred from data. This model incorporates a trainable probability distribution, referred to as an order-policy, that dynamically decides the autoregressive order in a state-dependent manner. To train the model, we introduce a variational lower bound on the log-likelihood, which we optimize with stochastic gradient estimation. We demonstrate experimentally that our method can learn meaningful autoregressive orderings in image and graph generation. On
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.zh_title: 学习顺序自回归模型及其分子图生成应用
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.summary: 提出以可训练的概率顺序替代固定顺序的自回归模型，适用于图等无自然序列顺序的数据，并应用于分子图生成。
key_points: 自回归模型依赖文本式自然顺序假设
图等数据类型缺乏公认规范顺序
用可从数据推断的概率顺序生成高维数据
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.zh_abstract: 自回归模型（Autoregressive Models, ARMs）已成为序列生成任务的主力，因为许多问题可以建模为下一标记预测。虽然文本似乎存在自然顺序（即从左到右），但对于许多数据类型，例如图，其规范顺序则不那么明显。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 ARM 的一个变体，它使用从数据中顺序推断的概率排序来生成高维数据。该模型包含一个可训练的概率分布，称为顺序策略（order-policy），它以依赖于状态的方式动态决定自回归顺序。为了训练模型，我们引入了对数似然上的变分下界，并使用随机梯度估计对其进行优化。我们通过实验证明，我们的方法可以在图像和图生成中学习有意义的自回归顺序。在

7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.title: Beyond Sensor Data: Foundation Models of Behavioral Data from Wearables Improve Health Predictions
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.abstract: Wearable devices record physiological and behavioral signals that can improve health predictions. While foundation models are increasingly used for such predictions, they have been primarily applied to low-level sensor data, despite behavioral data often being more informative due to their alignment with physiologically relevant timescales and quantities. We develop foundation models of such behavioral signals using over 2.5B hours of wearable data from 162K individuals, systematically optimizing architectures and tokenization strategies for this unique dataset. Evaluated on 57 health-related tasks, our model shows strong performance across diverse real-world applications including individual-level classification and time-varying health state prediction. The model excels in behavior-driven tasks like sleep prediction, and improves further when combined with representations of raw sensor
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.zh_title: 超越传感器数据：可穿戴行为数据基础模型提升健康预测
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.summary: 基于16.2万人超25亿小时可穿戴数据构建行为信号基础模型，用于提升健康预测。
key_points: 现有基础模型多用于低层传感器数据
行为数据与生理相关时间尺度更契合
使用25亿小时、16.2万人数据训练
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.zh_abstract: 可穿戴设备记录能够改善健康预测的生理和行为信号。虽然基础模型越来越多地用于此类预测，但它们主要应用于低级传感器数据，尽管行为数据通常信息更丰富，因为它们与生理相关的时间尺度和数量保持一致。我们使用来自 162K 个体的超过 2.5B 小时的可穿戴数据开发了此类行为信号的基础模型，并针对这一独特数据集系统地优化了架构和标记化策略。在 57 项健康相关任务上评估，我们的模型在包括个体级分类和时变健康状态预测在内的多样化现实应用中表现出强大性能。该模型在睡眠预测等行为驱动任务中表现出色，并且当与原始传感器表示结合时进一步提升

6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.title: Reward-Guided Iterative Refinement in Diffusion Models at Test-Time with Applications to Protein and DNA Design
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.abstract: To fully leverage the capabilities of diffusion models, we are often interested in optimizing downstream reward functions during inference. While numerous algorithms for reward-guided generation have been recently proposed due to their significance, current approaches predominantly focus on single-shot generation, transitioning from fully noised to denoised states. We propose a novel framework for inference-time reward optimization with diffusion models inspired by evolutionary algorithms. Our approach employs an iterative refinement process consisting of two steps in each iteration: noising and reward-guided denoising. This sequential refinement allows for the gradual correction of errors introduced during reward optimization. Besides, we provide a theoretical guarantee for our framework. Finally, we demonstrate its superior empirical performance in protein and cell-type-specific regula
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.zh_title: 奖励引导扩散模型迭代优化用于蛋白质与DNA设计
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.summary: 提出推理时奖励优化框架，受进化算法启发对扩散模型迭代精炼，应用于蛋白质与DNA设计。
key_points: 测试时奖励引导的扩散模型迭代精炼
受进化算法启发的推理框架
应用于蛋白质与DNA序列设计
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.zh_abstract: 为了充分利用扩散模型（diffusion models）的能力，我们通常希望在推理过程中优化下游奖励函数。尽管由于其重要性，最近提出了许多用于奖励引导生成的算法，但当前方法主要集中于单次生成，即从完全加噪状态过渡到去噪状态。受进化算法（evolutionary algorithms）启发，我们提出了一种利用扩散模型进行推理时奖励优化的新框架。我们的方法采用迭代细化过程，每次迭代包含两个步骤：加噪和奖励引导的去噪。这种顺序细化允许逐步纠正奖励优化过程中引入的误差。此外，我们为我们的框架提供了理论保证。最后，我们展示了其在蛋白质和细胞类型特异性调控（regula）方面优越的实证性能。

20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.title: CLIMB: Data Foundations for Large Scale Multimodal Clinical Foundation Models
20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.abstract: Recent advances in clinical AI have enabled remarkable progress across many clinical domains. However, existing benchmarks and models are primarily limited to a small set of modalities and tasks, which hinders the development of large-scale multimodal methods that can make holistic assessments of patient health and well-being. To bridge this gap, we introduce Clinical Large-Scale Integrative Multimodal Benchmark (CLIMB), a comprehensive clinical benchmark unifying diverse clinical data across imaging, language, temporal, and graph modalities. CLIMB comprises 4.51 million patient samples totaling 19.01 terabytes distributed across 2D imaging, 3D video, time series, graphs, and multimodal data. 20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.zh_title: CLIMB：大规模多模态临床基础模型的数据基础
20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.summary: 提出整合多来源临床数据的综合性多模态基准 CLIMB，推动大规模临床基础模型研究。
key_points: 现有临床基准模态与任务覆盖有限
CLIMB 统一多类临床数据与任务
面向患者整体健康的多模态评估
20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.zh_abstract: 临床AI的近期进展已在许多临床领域取得了显著进步。然而，现有的基准和模型主要局限于少量模态和任务，这阻碍了能够对患者健康和福祉进行整体评估的大规模多模态方法的发展。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了临床大规模整合多模态基准（Clinical Large-Scale Integrative Multimodal Benchmark, CLIMB），这是一个综合性的临床基准，统一了跨越影像、语言、时间序列和图模态的多样临床数据。CLIMB包含451万患者样本，总计19.01太字节，分布在2D影像、3D视频、时间序列、图和多模态数据中。通过广泛的实证评估，我们证明多任务预训练显著提高了研究不足领域的性能，在超声中实现了高达29%的提升，以及在……中提升了23%

da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.title: From Token to Rhythm: A Multi-Scale Approach for ECG-Language Pretraining
da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.abstract: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) play a vital role in monitoring cardiac health and diagnosing heart diseases. However, traditional deep learning approaches for ECG analysis rely heavily on large-scale manual annotations, which are both time-consuming and resource-intensive to obtain. To overcome this limitation, self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising alternative, enabling the extraction of robust ECG representations that can be efficiently transferred to various downstream tasks. While previous studies have explored SSL for ECG pretraining and multi-modal ECG-language alignment, they often fail to capture the multi-scale nature of ECG signals. As a result, these methods struggle to learn generalized representations due to their inability to model the hierarchical structure of ECG data. da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.zh_title: ECG-语言多尺度预训练方法
da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.summary: 提出多尺度ECG-语言预训练方法，利用自监督学习减少标注依赖，提升下游任务迁移能力。
key_points: 多尺度ECG-语言预训练
自监督学习减少标注依赖
提升下游任务迁移能力
da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.zh_abstract: 心电图（Electrocardiograms, ECGs）在监测心脏健康和诊断心脏疾病中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，传统用于心电图分析的深度学习方法严重依赖大规模人工标注，而获取这些标注既耗时又耗费资源。为克服这一局限，自监督学习（self-supervised learning, SSL）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，能够提取可高效迁移至各种下游任务的稳健心电图表示。尽管先前研究已探索将 SSL 用于心电图预训练和多模态心电图-语言对齐，但它们往往未能捕捉心电图信号的多尺度特性。因此，这些方法由于无法建模心电图数据的层次结构，难以学习泛化表示。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 MELP，一种新颖的多尺度心电图-语言预训练（Multi-scale ECG-Language Pretraining, MELP

0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.title: Multimodal Medical Code Tokenizer
0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.abstract: Foundation models trained on patient electronic health records (EHRs) require tokenizing medical data into sequences of discrete vocabulary items. Existing tokenizers treat medical codes from EHRs as isolated textual tokens. However, each medical code is defined by its textual description, its position in ontological hierarchies, and its relationships to other codes, such as disease co-occurrences and drug-treatment associations. Medical vocabularies contain more than 600,000 codes with critical information for clinical reasoning. We introduce MedTok, a multimodal medical code tokenizer that uses the text descriptions and relational context of codes. MedTok processes text using a language model encoder and encodes the relational structure with a graph encoder. 0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.zh_title: 多模态医学编码分词器
0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.summary: 提出多模态医学编码分词器，将EHR医学编码的文本描述、本体层级与编码间关系一并纳入分词。
key_points: 现有分词器将医学编码视为孤立文本token

0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.zh_abstract: 在患者电子健康记录（EHRs）上训练的基础模型需要将医学数据标记化为离散词汇项序列。现有分词器将来自 EHRs 的医学代码视为孤立的文本标记。然而，每个医学代码由其文本描述、在本体层级中的位置以及与其他代码的关系（如疾病共现和药物治疗关联）所定义。医学词表包含超过 600,000 个代码，这些代码含有对临床推理至关重要的信息。我们提出了 MedTok，一种多模态医学代码分词器，它使用代码的文本描述和关系上下文。MedTok 使用语言模型编码器处理文本，并使用图编码器编码关系结构。然后，它将两种模态量化为统一的标记空间，保留模态特定信息和跨模态信息。我们……

d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.title: Protein Structure Tokenization: Benchmarking and New Recipe
d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.abstract: Recent years have witnessed a surge in the development of protein structural tokenization methods, which chunk protein 3D structures into discrete or continuous representations. Structure tokenization enables the direct application of powerful techniques like language modeling for protein structures, and large multimodal models to integrate structures with protein sequences and functional texts. Despite the progress, the capabilities and limitations of these methods remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified evaluation framework. We first introduce StructTokenBench, a framework that comprehensively evaluates the quality and efficiency of structure tokenizers, focusing on fine-grained local substructures rather than global structures, as typical in existing benchmarks. d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.zh_title: 蛋白质结构Token化：基准评测与新方案
d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.summary: 系统评测现有蛋白质结构Token化方法的能力与局限，并提出新的结构Token化方案。

d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.zh_abstract: 近年来，蛋白质结构分词（tokenization）方法的发展激增，这些方法将蛋白质3D结构切分成离散或连续表示。结构分词使得诸如蛋白质结构语言建模之类的强大技术以及大型多模态模型能够直接应用，以将结构与蛋白质序列和功能文本整合。尽管取得了进展，由于缺乏统一的评估框架，这些方法的能力与局限性仍鲜为人知。我们首先提出 StructTokenBench，这是一个全面评估结构分词器质量与效率的框架，关注细粒度局部子结构而非现有基准中典型的全局结构。我们的评估表明，没有任何单一模型在所有基准测试视角上都占主导地位。对码本（codebook）的观察

724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.title: An All-Atom Generative Model for Designing Protein Complexes
724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.abstract: Proteins typically exist in complexes, interacting with other proteins or biomolecules to perform their specific biological roles. Research on single-chain protein modeling has been extensively and deeply explored, with advancements seen in models like the series of ESM and AlphaFold2. Despite these developments, the study and modeling of multi-chain proteins remain largely uncharted, though they are vital for understanding biological functions. Recognizing the importance of these interactions, we introduce APM (All-Atom Protein Generative Model), a model specifically designed for modeling multi-chain proteins. 724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.zh_title: 用于设计蛋白质复合物的全原子生成模型
724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.summary: 提出面向多链蛋白质复合物的全原子生成模型，以建模蛋白质相互作用。
key_points: 蛋白质常以复合物形式发挥功能
单链蛋白建模已有ESM与AlphaFold2等进展

724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.zh_abstract: 蛋白质通常以复合物形式存在，与其他蛋白质或生物分子相互作用以执行其特定的生物学功能。单链蛋白质建模研究已被广泛而深入地探索，ESM 系列和 AlphaFold2 等模型取得了进展。尽管有这些发展，多链蛋白质的研究与建模在很大程度上仍属未知领域，但它们对于理解生物学功能至关重要。认识到这些相互作用的重要性，我们提出了 APM（All-Atom Protein Generative Model，全原子蛋白质生成模型），一种专门为多链蛋白质建模而设计的模型。通过整合原子级信息并利用多链蛋白质数据，APM 能够精确建模链间相互作用，并从零开始设计具有结合能力的蛋白质复合物。它还为多链

07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.title: Aligning Protein Conformation Ensemble Generation with Physical Feedback
07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.abstract: Protein dynamics play a crucial role in protein biological functions and properties, and their traditional study typically relies on time-consuming molecular dynamics (MD) simulations conducted in silico. Recent advances in generative modeling, particularly denoising diffusion models, have enabled efficient accurate protein structure prediction and conformation sampling by learning distributions over crystallographic structures. However, effectively integrating physical supervision into these data-driven approaches remains challenging, as standard energy-based objectives often lead to intractable optimization. In this paper, we introduce Energy-based Alignment (EBA), a method that aligns generative models with feedback from physical models, efficiently calibrating them to appropriately balance conformational states based on their energy differences. Experimental results on the MD ensembl
07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.zh_title: 以物理反馈对齐蛋白质构象系综生成
07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.summary: 针对扩散模型构象采样难以融入物理监督的问题，提出与物理反馈对齐的蛋白质构象系综生成方法。

e3ae92ee97a0183e853fedac9bdc1dbac8884fb1.title: UniMoMo: Unified Generative Modeling of 3D Molecules for De Novo Binder Design
e3ae92ee97a0183e853fedac9bdc1dbac8884fb1.abstract: The design of target-specific molecules such as small molecules, peptides, and antibodies is vital for biological research and drug discovery. Existing generative methods are restricted to single-domain molecules, failing to address versatile therapeutic needs or utilize cross-domain transferability to enhance model performance. In this paper, we introduce Unified generative Modeling of 3D Molecules (UniMoMo), the first framework capable of designing binders of multiple molecular domains using a single model. In particular, UniMoMo unifies the representations of different molecules as graphs of blocks, where each block corresponds to either a standard amino acid or a molecular fragment. 13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.title: Predicting mutational effects on protein binding from folding energy
13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.abstract: Accurate estimation of mutational effects on protein-protein binding energies is an open problem with applications in structural biology and therapeutic design. Several deep learning predictors for this task have been proposed, but, presumably due to the scarcity of binding data, these methods underperform computationally expensive estimates based on empirical force fields. In response, we propose a transfer-learning approach that leverages advances in protein sequence modeling and folding stability prediction for this task. The key idea is to parameterize the binding energy as the difference between the folding energy of the protein complex and the sum of the folding energies of its binding partners. We show that using a pre-trained inverse-folding model as a proxy for folding energy provides strong zero-shot performance, and can be fine-tuned with (1) copious folding energy measurement
13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.zh_title: 由折叠能预测突变对蛋白结合的影响

13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.zh_abstract: 准确估计突变对蛋白质-蛋白质结合能的影响是一个未解决的问题，在结构生物学和治疗设计中具有应用。针对该任务，已有若干深度学习预测器被提出，但大概由于结合数据的稀缺，这些方法的表现不及基于经验力场的计算成本高昂的估计。作为回应，我们提出一种迁移学习方法，利用蛋白质序列建模和折叠稳定性预测方面的进展来完成该任务。关键思想是将结合能参数化为蛋白质复合物的折叠能与其结合伙伴的折叠能之和之间的差值。我们表明，使用预训练的逆向折叠模型作为折叠能的代理可提供强大的零样本性能，并可用以下数据进行微调：（1）大量的折叠能测量

31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Multimodal Protein Language Models
31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.abstract: Multimodal protein language models (PLMs) integrate sequence and token-based structural information, serving as a powerful foundation for protein modeling, generation, and design. However, the reliance on tokenizing 3D structures into discrete tokens causes substantial loss of fidelity about fine-grained structural details and correlations. In this paper, we systematically elucidate the design space of multimodal PLMs to overcome their limitations. We identify tokenization loss and inaccurate structure token predictions by the PLMs as major bottlenecks. To address these, our proposed design space covers improved generative modeling, structure-aware architectures and representation learning, and data exploration. 31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.zh_title: 多模态蛋白质语言模型设计空间解析

31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.zh_abstract: 多模态蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）整合了序列与基于 token 的结构信息，为蛋白质建模、生成和设计提供了强大的基础。然而，依赖将 3D 结构 token 化为离散 token 会导致细粒度结构细节及关联的保真度大幅损失。在本文中，我们系统性地阐明了多模态 PLMs 的设计空间以克服其局限性。我们将 token 化损失以及 PLMs 对结构 token 的不准确预测识别为主要瓶颈。为解决这些问题，我们提出的设计空间涵盖改进的生成建模、结构感知架构与表示学习以及数据探索。我们的进展朝向更细粒度的监督，表明基于 token 的多模态 PLMs 能够实现稳健的结构建模。有效的设计方法显著

7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.title: Compositional Flows for 3D Molecule and Synthesis Pathway Co-design
7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.abstract: Many generative applications, such as synthesis-based 3D molecular design, involve constructing compositional objects with continuous features. Here, we introduce Compositional Generative Flows (CGFlow), a novel framework that extends flow matching to generate objects in compositional steps while modeling continuous states. Our key insight is that modeling compositional state transitions can be formulated as a straightforward extension of the flow matching interpolation process. We further build upon the theoretical foundations of generative flow networks (GFlowNets), enabling reward-guided sampling of compositional structures. We apply CGFlow to synthesizable drug design by jointly designing the molecule's synthetic pathway with its 3D binding pose. 7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.zh_title: 组合生成流：三维分子与合成路径协同设计

7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.zh_abstract: 许多生成式应用，例如基于合成的 3D 分子设计，涉及构建具有连续特征的组合式对象。在此，我们介绍 Compositional Generative Flows（CGFlow），这是一个新颖的框架，扩展了流匹配，以在建模连续状态的同时按组合步骤生成对象。我们的关键见解是，建模组合状态转移可以被表述为流匹配插值过程的直接扩展。我们进一步建立在生成流网络（GFlowNets）的理论基础之上，实现对组合结构的奖励引导采样。我们将 CGFlow 应用于可合成药物设计，通过联合设计分子的合成路径及其 3D 结合构象。我们的方法在 LIT-PCBA 基准的所有 15 个靶标上实现了最先进的结合亲和力，并在 sampl 上取得了 5.8$\times$ 的提升

4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.title: Raptor: Scalable Train-Free Embeddings for 3D Medical Volumes Leveraging Pretrained 2D Foundation Models
4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.abstract: Current challenges in developing foundational models for volumetric imaging data, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), stem from the computational complexity of training state-of-the-art architectures in high dimensions and curating sufficiently large datasets of volumes. To address these challenges, we introduce Raptor (Random Planar Tensor Reduction), a train-free method for generating semantically rich embeddings for volumetric data. Raptor leverages a frozen 2D foundation model, pretrained on natural images, to extract visual tokens from individual cross-sections of medical volumes. These tokens are then spatially compressed using random projections, significantly reducing computational complexity while retaining semantic information. 4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.zh_title: Raptor：免训练的3D医学体数据嵌入方法

4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.zh_abstract: 当前为体积成像数据（例如磁共振成像（MRI））开发基础模型所面临的挑战，源于在高维中训练最先进架构的计算复杂性以及策划足够大的体积数据集。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 Raptor（Random Planar Tensor Reduction），这是一种无需训练的方法，用于为体积数据生成语义丰富的嵌入。Raptor 利用一个在自然图像上预训练的冻结 2D 基础模型，从医学体积的各个横截面提取视觉 token。然后使用随机投影对这些 token 进行空间压缩，在保留语义信息的同时显著降低计算复杂性。在十项多样化的医学体积任务上的广泛实验验证了 Raptor 优于最先进方法的性能，包括那些

374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.title: All-atom inverse protein folding through discrete flow matching
374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.abstract: The recent breakthrough of AlphaFold3 in modeling complex biomolecular interactions, including those between proteins and ligands, nucleotides, or metal ions, creates new opportunities for protein design. In so-called inverse protein folding, the objective is to find a sequence of amino acids that adopts a target protein structure. Many inverse folding methods struggle to predict sequences for complexes that contain non-protein components, and perform poorly with complexes that adopt multiple structural states. To address these challenges, we present ADFLIP (All-atom Discrete FLow matching Inverse Protein folding), a generative model based on discrete flow-matching for designing protein sequences conditioned on all-atom structural contexts. 374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.zh_abstract: AlphaFold3 最近在建模复杂生物分子相互作用（包括蛋白质与配体、核苷酸或金属离子之间的相互作用）方面取得的突破，为蛋白质设计创造了新机遇。在所谓的逆蛋白质折叠中，目标是找到一种采用目标蛋白质结构的氨基酸序列。许多逆折叠方法难以预测包含非蛋白质组分的复合物的序列，并且在采用多种结构状态的复合物上表现不佳。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 ADFLIP（All-atom Discrete FLow matching Inverse Protein folding），这是一种基于离散流匹配的生成模型，用于以全原子结构上下文为条件设计蛋白质序列。ADFLIP 在序列生成过程中逐步纳入预测的氨基酸侧链作为结构上下文，并能够设计动态

7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.title: ReQFlow: Rectified Quaternion Flow for Efficient and High-Quality Protein Backbone Generation
7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.abstract: Protein backbone generation plays a central role in de novo protein design and is significant for many biological and medical applications. Although diffusion and flow-based generative models provide potential solutions to this challenging task, they often generate proteins with undesired designability and suffer computational inefficiency. In this study, we propose a novel rectified quaternion flow (ReQFlow) matching method for fast and high-quality protein backbone generation. In particular, our method generates a local translation and a 3D rotation from random noise for each residue in a protein chain, which represents each 3D rotation as a unit quaternion and constructs its flow by spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) in an exponential format. We train the model by quaternion flow (QFlow) matching with guaranteed numerical stability and rectify the QFlow model to accelerate its inf
7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.zh_title: ReQFlow：校正四元数流用于高效蛋白质骨架生成

key_points: 蛋白质骨架生成是从头设计核心环节

83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.title: Retrieval-augmented systems can be dangerous medical communicators
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.abstract: Patients have long sought health information online, and increasingly, they are turning to generative AI to answer their health-related queries. Given the high stakes of the medical domain, techniques like retrieval-augmented generation and citation grounding have been widely promoted as methods to reduce hallucinations and improve the accuracy of AI-generated responses and have been widely adopted into search engines. This paper argues that even when these methods produce literally accurate content drawn from source documents sans hallucinations, they can still be highly misleading. Patients may derive significantly different interpretations from AI-generated outputs than they would from reading the original source material, let alone consulting a knowledgeable clinician. Through a large-scale query analysis on topics including disputed diagnoses and procedure safety, we support our arg
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.zh_title: 检索增强系统可能是危险的医疗传播者
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.summary: 论文指出检索增强与引用接地即便内容字面准确，仍可能构成危险的医疗信息传播。
key_points: 检索增强与引用接地被广泛采用

83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.zh_abstract: 患者长期以来一直在网上寻求健康信息，并且越来越多地转向生成式 AI 来回答其健康相关查询。鉴于医学领域的高风险性，检索增强生成和引文溯源等技术已被广泛宣传为减少幻觉并提高 AI 生成回答准确性的方法，并已被广泛采用到搜索引擎中。本文认为，即使这些方法产生了从源文档中抽取的、没有幻觉的字面准确内容，它们仍可能具有高度误导性。患者可能从 AI 生成的输出中得到与阅读原始源材料时显著不同的解读，更不用说咨询知识渊博的临床医生了。通过对包括有争议诊断和操作安全性在内的主题进行大规模查询分析，我们支持我们的论点。

dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.abstract: Protein Language Models (PLMs), pre-trained on extensive evolutionary data from natural proteins, have emerged as indispensable tools for protein design. While powerful, PLMs often struggle to produce proteins with precisely specified functionalities or properties due to inherent challenges in controlling their outputs. In this work, we investigate the potential of Activation Steering, a technique originally developed for controlling text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), to direct PLMs toward generating protein sequences with targeted properties. We propose a simple yet effective method that employs activation editing to steer PLM outputs, and extend this approach to protein optimization through a novel editing site identification module. dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.zh_title: 蛋白质语言模型的激活引导

975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.title: CFP-Gen: Combinatorial Functional Protein Generation via Diffusion Language Models
975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.abstract: Existing PLMs generate protein sequences based on a single-condition constraint from a specific modality, struggling to simultaneously satisfy multiple constraints across different modalities. In this work, we introduce CFP-Gen, a novel diffusion language model for Combinatorial Functional Protein GENeration. CFP-Gen facilitates the de novo protein design by integrating multimodal conditions with functional, sequence, and structural constraints. Specifically, an Annotation-Guided Feature Modulation (AGFM) module is introduced to dynamically adjust the protein feature distribution based on composable functional annotations, e.g., GO terms, IPR domains and EC numbers. Meanwhile, the Residue-Controlled Functional Encoding (RCFE) module captures residue-wise interaction to ensure more precise control. 26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.title: Flexibility-Conditioned Protein Structure Design with Flow Matching
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.abstract: Recent advances in geometric deep learning and generative modeling have enabled the design of novel proteins with a wide range of desired properties. However, current state-of-the-art approaches are typically restricted to generating proteins with only static target properties, such as motifs and symmetries. In this work, we take a step towards overcoming this limitation by proposing a framework to condition structure generation on flexibility, which is crucial for key functionalities such as catalysis or molecular recognition. We first introduce BackFlip, an equivariant neural network for predicting per-residue flexibility from an input backbone structure. Relying on BackFlip, we propose FliPS, an SE(3)-equivariant conditional flow matching model that solves the inverse problem, that is, generating backbones that display a target flexibility profile. In our experiments, we show that Fli
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.zh_title: 基于流匹配的柔性条件蛋白质结构设计
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.summary: 提出以柔性为条件的蛋白质结构生成框架，突破仅生成静态目标属性蛋白质的限制。

以柔性为条件驱动结构生成

26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.zh_abstract: 近期几何深度学习（geometric deep learning）和生成建模（generative modeling）的进展使得设计具有广泛所需性质的新型蛋白质成为可能。然而，当前最先进的方法通常局限于生成仅具有静态目标性质（如基序（motifs）和对称性（symmetries））的蛋白质。在这项工作中，我们朝着克服这一局限迈出一步，提出一个框架，将结构生成以灵活性（flexibility）为条件，这对催化（catalysis）或分子识别（molecular recognition）等关键功能至关重要。我们首先引入 BackFlip，一个等变神经网络（equivariant neural network），用于从输入主链结构预测逐残基灵活性（per-residue flexibility）。依赖 BackFlip，我们提出 FliPS，一个 SE(3)-等变条件流匹配模型（SE(3)-equivariant conditional flow matching model），解决逆问题，即生成显示目标灵活性谱（target flexibility profile）的主链。在我们的实验中，我们表明 Fli

e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.title: Protriever: End-to-End Differentiable Protein Homology Search for Fitness Prediction
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.abstract: Retrieving homologous protein sequences is essential for a broad range of protein modeling tasks such as fitness prediction, protein design, structure modeling, and protein-protein interactions. Traditional workflows have relied on a two-step process: first retrieving homologs via Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSA), then training models on one or more of these alignments. However, MSA-based retrieval is computationally expensive, struggles with highly divergent sequences or complex insertions&deletions patterns, and operates independently of the downstream modeling objective. We introduce Protriever, an end-to-end differentiable framework that learns to retrieve relevant homologs while simultaneously training for the target task. e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.zh_title: Protriever：面向适应度预测的端到端可微蛋白同源搜索
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.summary: 提出Protriever，以端到端可微的同源序列检索替代传统MSA两步流程，用于蛋白质适应度预测。
key_points: 同源序列检索对适应度预测等蛋白建模任务重要
传统流程先做MSA再训练模型，计算代价高
MSA检索难以处理高度歧异序列与复杂插入缺失
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.zh_abstract: 检索同源蛋白质序列对于广泛的蛋白质建模任务至关重要，例如适应度预测、蛋白质设计、结构建模和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。传统工作流程依赖于两步过程：首先通过多序列比对（MSA）检索同源物，然后在一个或多个这些比对上训练模型。然而，基于 MSA 的检索计算成本高昂，难以处理高度分化的序列或复杂的插入和缺失模式，并且独立于下游建模目标运行。我们引入了 Protriever，一个端到端可微分框架，它学习检索相关的同源物，同时针对目标任务进行训练。当应用于蛋白质适应度预测时，与依赖基于 MSA 的同源物检索的基于序列的模型相比，Protriever 达到了最先进的性能

291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.title: CombiMOTS: Combinatorial Multi-Objective Tree Search for Dual-Target Molecule Generation
291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.abstract: Dual-target molecule generation, which focuses on discovering compounds capable of interacting with two target proteins, has garnered significant attention due to its potential for improving therapeutic efficiency, safety and resistance mitigation. Existing approaches face two critical challenges. First, by simplifying the complex dual-target optimization problem to scalarized combinations of individual objectives, they fail to capture important trade-offs between target engagement and molecular properties. Second, they typically do not integrate synthetic planning into the generative process. This highlights a need for more appropriate objective function design and synthesis-aware methodologies tailored to the dual-target molecule generation task. 291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.zh_title: CombiMOTS：双靶点分子生成的组合多目标树搜索

291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.zh_abstract: 双靶点分子生成，其重点在于发现能够与两种靶标蛋白相互作用的化合物，因其在提高治疗效率、安全性和缓解耐药性方面的潜力而获得了广泛关注。现有方法面临两个关键挑战。首先，通过将复杂的双靶点优化问题简化为各个目标的标量化组合，它们未能捕捉靶标结合与分子性质之间的重要权衡。其次，它们通常没有将合成规划整合到生成过程中。这凸显了对更适合双靶点分子生成任务的目标函数设计以及合成感知方法的需求。在这项工作中，我们提出 CombiMOTS，一种生成双靶点分子的帕累托蒙特卡洛树搜索 (Pareto Monte Carlo Tree Search, PMCTS) 框架。CombiMOTS 被设

1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.title: Piloting Structure-Based Drug Design via Modality-Specific Optimal Schedule
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.abstract: Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) is crucial for identifying bioactive molecules. Recent deep generative models are faced with challenges in geometric structure modeling. A major bottleneck lies in the twisted probability path of multi-modalities -- continuous 3D positions and discrete 2D topologies -- which jointly determine molecular geometries. By establishing the fact that noise schedules decide the Variational Lower Bound (VLB) for the twisted probability path, we propose VLB-Optimal Scheduling (VOS) strategy in this under-explored area, which optimizes VLB as a path integral for SBDD. Our model effectively enhances molecular geometries and interaction modeling, achieving state-of-the-art PoseBusters passing rate of 95.9% on CrossDock, more than 10% improvement upon strong baselines, while maintaining high affinities and robust intramolecular validity evaluated on held-out test set
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.zh_title: 模态特定最优调度推进基于结构的药物设计
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.summary: ICML 2025 提出 VLB 最优调度方法，改进基于结构的药物设计中连续3D与离散2D的联合几何建模。
key_points: 基于结构的药物设计用于发现生物活性分子

噪声调度决定扭曲概率路径的变分下界
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.zh_abstract: 基于结构的药物设计（Structure-Based Drug Design, SBDD）对于识别具有生物活性的分子至关重要。近期深度生成模型在几何结构建模方面面临挑战。一个主要瓶颈在于多模态——连续的三维位置和离散的二维拓扑——的扭曲概率路径，这两者共同决定分子几何结构。通过确立噪声调度决定扭曲概率路径的变分下界（Variational Lower Bound, VLB）这一事实，我们在这个尚未充分探索的领域提出 VLB 最优调度（VLB-Optimal Scheduling, VOS）策略，该策略将 VLB 作为路径积分进行优化以用于 SBDD。我们的模型有效增强了分子几何结构和相互作用建模，在 CrossDock 上达到最先进的 PoseBusters 通过率 95.9%，较强基线提升超过 10%，同时在留出测试集上评估时保持高亲和力和稳健的分子内有效性

0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.title: Pretraining Generative Flow Networks with Inexpensive Rewards for Molecular Graph Generation
0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have recently emerged as a suitable framework for generating diverse and high-quality molecular structures by learning from rewards treated as unnormalized distributions. Previous works in this framework often restrict exploration by using predefined molecular fragments as building blocks, limiting the chemical space that can be accessed. In this work, we introduce Atomic GFlowNets (A-GFNs), a foundational generative model leveraging individual atoms as building blocks to explore drug-like chemical space more comprehensively. We propose an unsupervised pre-training approach using drug-like molecule datasets, which teaches A-GFNs about inexpensive yet informative molecular descriptors such as drug-likeliness, topological polar surface area, and synthetic accessibility scores. 0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.zh_title: 原子级GFlowNet预训练用于分子图生成
0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.summary: 提出Atomic GFlowNets，以单个原子为构建单元预训练生成流网络，突破片段化探索对化学空间的限制。

0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.zh_abstract: 生成流网络（Generative Flow Networks, GFlowNets）最近已成为一种合适的框架，通过从被视为未归一化分布的奖励中学习，生成多样且高质量的分子结构。该框架中先前的工作通常通过使用预定义分子片段作为构建块来限制探索，从而限制了可访问的化学空间。在这项工作中，我们引入原子生成流网络（Atomic GFlowNets, A-GFNs），这是一种基础生成模型，利用单个原子作为构建块，以更全面地探索类药化学空间。我们提出一种使用类药分子数据集的无监督预训练方法，该方法教会 A-GFNs 了解廉价但信息丰富的分子描述符，如类药性、拓扑极性表面积和合成可及性分数。这些性质作为代理奖励，引导 A-GFNs 朝向 ch 的区域

ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.title: Energy-Based Flow Matching for Generating 3D Molecular Structure
ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.abstract: Molecular structure generation is a fundamental problem that involves determining the 3D positions of molecules'constituents. It has crucial biological applications, such as molecular docking, protein folding, and molecular design. Recent advances in generative modeling, such as diffusion models and flow matching, have made great progress on these tasks by modeling molecular conformations as a distribution. In this work, we focus on flow matching and adopt an energy-based perspective to improve training and inference of structure generation models. Our view results in a mapping function, represented by a deep network, that is directly learned to \textit{iteratively} map random configurations, i.e. samples from the source distribution, to target structures, i.e. points in the data manifold. ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.zh_abstract: 分子结构生成是一个基本问题，涉及确定分子组成成分的3D位置。它具有关键的生物学应用，例如分子对接、蛋白质折叠和分子设计。生成建模的最新进展，例如扩散模型和流匹配，通过将分子构象建模为分布，在这些任务上取得了巨大进展。在这项工作中，我们关注流匹配，并采用基于能量的视角来改进结构生成模型的训练和推理。我们的观点导致了一个映射函数，由深度网络表示，该函数被直接学习以迭代地将随机配置（即来自源分布的样本）映射到目标结构（即数据流形中的点）。这产生了一个概念上简单且经验上有效的流匹配设置，该设置是理论上的

fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.title: Position: Beyond Assistance - Reimagining LLMs as Ethical and Adaptive Co-Creators in Mental Health Care
fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.abstract: This position paper argues for a fundamental shift in how Large Language Models (LLMs) are integrated into the mental health care domain. We advocate for their role as co-creators rather than mere assistive tools. While LLMs have the potential to enhance accessibility, personalization, and crisis intervention, their adoption remains limited due to concerns about bias, evaluation, over-reliance, dehumanization, and regulatory uncertainties. To address these challenges, we propose two structured pathways: SAFE-i (Supportive, Adaptive, Fair, and Ethical Implementation) Guidelines for ethical and responsible deployment, and HAAS-e (Human-AI Alignment and Safety Evaluation) Framework for multidimensional, human-centered assessment. SAFE-i provides a blueprint for data governance, adaptive model engineering, and real-world integration, ensuring LLMs align with clinical and ethical standards. H

fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.zh_abstract: 本立场论文主张，在大语言模型（LLMs）融入心理健康护理领域的方式上需要进行根本性转变。我们倡导将其角色定位为共同创造者，而非单纯的辅助工具。尽管 LLMs 有潜力增强可及性、个性化和危机干预，但由于对偏见、评估、过度依赖、非人性化和监管不确定性的担忧，其采用仍然有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出两条结构化路径：SAFE-i（支持性、适应性、公平和合乎伦理的实施）指南，用于合乎伦理且负责任的部署；以及 HAAS-e（人类-人工智能对齐与安全评估）框架，用于多维、以人为本的评估。SAFE-i 为数据治理、自适应模型工程和现实世界整合提供了蓝图，确保 LLMs 符合临床和伦理标准。H
