732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.title: A Variational Perspective on Generative Protein Fitness Optimization
732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.abstract: The goal of protein fitness optimization is to discover new protein variants with enhanced fitness for a given use. The vast search space and the sparsely populated fitness landscape, along with the discrete nature of protein sequences, pose significant challenges when trying to determine the gradient towards configurations with higher fitness. Our method embeds protein sequences in a continuous latent space to enable efficient sampling from the fitness distribution and combines a (learned) flow matching prior over sequence mutations with a fitness predictor to guide optimization towards sequences with high fitness. 46b14f4c6ee1f0c885573322e37b0f7fa52d44ff.abstract: Fast and accurate generation of molecular conformers is desired for downstream computational chemistry and drug discovery tasks. Currently, training and sampling state-of-the-art diffusion or flow-based models for conformer generation require significant computational resources. 370c70836fd27d2801e6310c0ce70f994a270626.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on various medical benchmarks, but their capabilities across different cognitive levels remain underexplored. Using this framework, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art general and medical LLMs from six prominent families: Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, GPT, and DeepSeek. cac6d7f0b878d37dcc5b5f931f765c6428bfc4be.abstract: Cell instance segmentation is critical to analyzing biomedical images, yet accurately distinguishing tightly touching cells remains a persistent challenge. In this paper, we propose a novel cell instance segmentation method inspired by the four-color theorem. 8a31d635cab73b14e64347130d688de12294947f.title: NeuroTree: Hierarchical Functional Brain Pathway Decoding for Mental Health Disorders
8a31d635cab73b14e64347130d688de12294947f.abstract: Mental disorders are among the most widespread diseases globally. Analyzing functional brain networks through functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is crucial for understanding mental disorder behaviors. Although existing fMRI-based graph neural networks (GNNs) have demonstrated significant potential in brain network feature extraction, they often fail to characterize complex relationships between brain regions and demographic information in mental disorders. To overcome these limitations, we propose a learnable NeuroTree framework that integrates a k-hop AGE-GCN with neural ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and contrastive masked functional connectivity (CMFC) to enhance similarities and dissimilarities of brain region distance. 7bbcb90352dad827f40448141d2fcee56d3030f6.abstract: Molecular pretrained representations (MPR) has emerged as a powerful approach for addressing the challenge of limited supervised data in applications such as drug discovery and material design. While early MPR methods relied on 1D sequences and 2D graphs, recent advancements have incorporated 3D conformational information to capture rich atomic interactions. However, these prior models treat molecules merely as discrete atom sets, overlooking the space surrounding them. We argue from a physical perspective that only modeling these discrete points is insufficient. We first present a simple yet insightful observation: naively adding randomly sampled virtual points beyond atoms can surprisingly enhance MPR performance. 7bbcb90352dad827f40448141d2fcee56d3030f6.zh_title: 超越原子：以3D空间建模增强分子预训练表征

4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.title: Distribution-aware Fairness Learning in Medical Image Segmentation From A Control-Theoretic Perspective
4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.abstract: Ensuring fairness in medical image segmentation is critical due to biases in imbalanced clinical data acquisition caused by demographic attributes (e.g., age, sex, race) and clinical factors (e.g., disease severity). Furthermore, we integrate dMoE into multiple network architectures, demonstrating its broad applicability across diverse medical image analysis tasks. f271a65d845eeb0c824717c656e5fbc6e5f384be.abstract: Recently, diffusion- and flow-based generative models of protein structures have emerged as a powerful tool for de novo protein design. Here, we develop Proteina, a new large-scale flow-based protein backbone generator that utilizes hierarchical fold class labels for conditioning and relies on a tailored scalable transformer architecture with up to 5x as many parameters as previous models. To meaningfully quantify performance, we introduce a new set of metrics that directly measure the distributional similarity of generated proteins with reference sets, complementing existing metrics. e778e55a5f7deb0ca9213a26550f69550fce3c65.title: Multi-domain Distribution Learning for De Novo Drug Design
e778e55a5f7deb0ca9213a26550f69550fce3c65.abstract: We introduce DrugFlow, a generative model for structure-based drug design that integrates continuous flow matching with discrete Markov bridges, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in learning chemical, geometric, and physical aspects of three-dimensional protein-ligand data. We endow DrugFlow with an uncertainty estimate that is able to detect out-of-distribution samples. To further enhance the sampling process towards distribution regions with desirable metric values, we propose a joint preference alignment scheme applicable to both flow matching and Markov bridge frameworks. Furthermore, we extend our model to also explore the conformational landscape of the protein by jointly sampling side chain angles and molecules.

e778e55a5f7deb0ca9213a26550f69550fce3c65.zh_abstract: 我们提出 DrugFlow，一种基于结构的药物设计的生成模型，它将连续流匹配（continuous flow matching）与离散马尔可夫桥（discrete Markov bridges）相结合，在学习三维蛋白质-配体数据的化学、几何和物理方面展现出最先进的性能。我们为 DrugFlow 赋予了一个不确定性估计（uncertainty estimate），能够检测分布外样本（out-of-distribution samples）。为了进一步将采样过程导向具有理想指标值的分布区域，我们提出了一种联合偏好对齐方案（joint preference alignment scheme），适用于流匹配和马尔可夫桥框架。此外，我们扩展了模型，通过联合采样侧链角度和分子，也探索蛋白质的构象景观（conformational landscape）。

2e11cab3eebac51f3f66f2bb53d60df8c004428c.abstract: 3D molecule generation is crucial for drug discovery and material design. While prior efforts focus on 3D diffusion models for their benefits in modeling continuous 3D conformers, they overlook the advantages of 1D SELFIES-based Language Models (LMs), which can generate 100% valid molecules and leverage the billion-scale 1D molecule datasets. To combine these advantages for 3D molecule generation, we propose a foundation model -- NExT-Mol: 3D Diffusion Meets 1D Language Modeling for 3D Molecule Generation. NExT-Mol uses an extensively pretrained molecule LM for 1D molecule generation, and subsequently predicts the generated molecule's 3D conformers with a 3D diffusion model. We enhance NExT-Mol's performance by scaling up the LM's model size, refining the diffusion neural architecture, and applying 1D to 3D transfer learning. Notably, our 1D molecule LM significantly outperforms baseline
2e11cab3eebac51f3f66f2bb53d60df8c004428c.summary: 提出基础模型NExT-Mol，结合3D扩散与1D SELFIES语言建模优势，用于三维分子生成。

b9c3ab56eef1e4f50b422730ec42357ac206969d.abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection using deep learning has garnered significant research attention due to its broad applicability, particularly in medical imaging where labeled anomalous data are scarce. While earlier approaches leverage generative models like autoencoders and generative adversarial networks (GANs), they often fall short due to overgeneralization. Recent methods explore various strategies, including memory banks, normalizing flows, self-supervised learning, and knowledge distillation, to enhance discrimination. Among these, knowledge distillation, particularly reverse distillation, has shown promise. Following this paradigm, we propose a novel scale-aware contrastive reverse distillation model that addresses two key limitations of existing reverse distillation methods: insufficient feature discriminability and inability to handle anomaly scale variations. b9c3ab56eef1e4f50b422730ec42357ac206969d.zh_title: 尺度感知对比反向蒸馏的无监督医学异常检测

b4d19a909aabe7b67a3970b58eda917dd737725f.title: ProtComposer: Compositional Protein Structure Generation with 3D Ellipsoids
b4d19a909aabe7b67a3970b58eda917dd737725f.abstract: We develop ProtComposer to generate protein structures conditioned on spatial protein layouts that are specified via a set of 3D ellipsoids capturing substructure shapes and semantics. At inference time, we condition on ellipsoids that are hand-constructed, extracted from existing proteins, or from a statistical model, with each option unlocking new capabilities. Hand-specifying ellipsoids enables users to control the location, size, orientation, secondary structure, and approximate shape of protein substructures. Conditioning on ellipsoids of existing proteins enables redesigning their substructure's connectivity or editing substructure properties. fe65fd3a2d633a18e6e92b58986a3123b5aeeb3c.title: Self-Supervised Diffusion MRI Denoising via Iterative and Stable Refinement
fe65fd3a2d633a18e6e92b58986a3123b5aeeb3c.abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), including diffusion MRI (dMRI), serves as a ``microscope'' for anatomical structures and routinely mitigates the influence of low signal-to-noise ratio scans by compromising temporal or spatial resolution. However, these compromises fail to meet clinical demands for both efficiency and precision. Consequently, denoising is a vital preprocessing step, particularly for dMRI, where clean data is unavailable. In this paper, we introduce Di-Fusion, a fully self-supervised denoising method that leverages the latter diffusion steps and an adaptive sampling process. Unlike previous approaches, our single-stage framework achieves efficient and stable training without extra noise model training and offers adaptive and controllable results in the sampling process. 1ae54bd533deab3dd33b5c81417b8f22fecf9d77.title: UniMatch: Universal Matching from Atom to Task for Few-Shot Drug Discovery
1ae54bd533deab3dd33b5c81417b8f22fecf9d77.abstract: Drug discovery is crucial for identifying candidate drugs for various diseases.However, its low success rate often results in a scarcity of annotations, posing a few-shot learning problem. Existing methods primarily focus on single-scale features, overlooking the hierarchical molecular structures that determine different molecular properties. To address these issues, we introduce Universal Matching Networks (UniMatch), a dual matching framework that integrates explicit hierarchical molecular matching with implicit task-level matching via meta-learning, bridging multi-level molecular representations and task-level generalization. Specifically, our approach explicitly captures structural features across multiple levels, such as atoms, substructures, and molecules, via hierarchical pooling and matching, facilitating precise molecular representation and comparison. bbdc99cc9dea5f78d80e6223d343ab52d35914df.abstract: Structure-based drug discovery, encompassing the tasks of protein-ligand docking and pocket-aware 3D drug design, represents a core challenge in drug discovery. However, traditional drug development methods are costly and inefficient. While foundation models have shown promise in antibiotic discovery, current mainstream efforts still fall short of fully leveraging the potential of multimodal molecular data. Recent studies suggest that contrastive learning frameworks utilizing multimodal data exhibit excellent performance in representation learning across various domains. e94a232ec9b2b6183ca87b9fffab2fedc7fe54de.zh_title: CL-MFAP：对比学习多模态分子性质预测基础模型

adeeca58f2a1c26e4241889e45068e15b2ba3527.title: Recognize Any Surgical Object: Unleashing the Power of Weakly-Supervised Data
adeeca58f2a1c26e4241889e45068e15b2ba3527.abstract: We present RASO, a foundation model designed to Recognize Any Surgical Object, offering robust open-set recognition capabilities across a broad range of surgical procedures and object classes, in both surgical images and videos. RASO leverages a novel weakly-supervised learning framework that generates tag-image-text pairs automatically from large-scale unannotated surgical lecture videos, significantly reducing the need for manual annotations. Our scalable data generation pipeline gathers 2,200 surgical procedures and produces 3.6 million tag annotations across 2,066 unique surgical tags. Our experiments show that RASO achieves improvements of 2.9 mAP, 4.5 mAP, 10.6 mAP, and 7.2 mAP on four standard surgical benchmarks, respectively, in zero-shot settings, and surpasses state-of-the-art models in supervised surgical action recognition tasks. 7eb8d8a9b20a1311c3799af028fbd3a5be0d707e.title: Robust Root Cause Diagnosis using In-Distribution Interventions
7eb8d8a9b20a1311c3799af028fbd3a5be0d707e.abstract: Diagnosing the root cause of an anomaly in a complex interconnected system is a pressing problem in today's cloud services and industrial operations. We propose In-Distribution Interventions (IDI), a novel algorithm that predicts root cause as nodes that meet two criteria: 1) **Anomaly:** root cause nodes should take on anomalous values; 2) **Fix:** had the root cause nodes assumed usual values, the target node would not have been anomalous. Prior methods of assessing the fix condition rely on counterfactuals inferred from a Structural Causal Model (SCM) trained on historical data. But since anomalies are rare and fall outside the training distribution, the fitted SCMs yield unreliable counterfactual estimates. 7563ad5fe50442b3cd98770dc2364ffe680065db.abstract: Exploring chemical space to find novel molecules that simultaneously satisfy multiple properties is crucial in drug discovery. However, existing methods often struggle with trading off multiple properties due to the conflicting or correlated nature of chemical properties. To tackle this issue, we introduce InversionGNN framework, an effective yet sample-efficient dual-path graph neural network (GNN) for multi-objective drug discovery. In the direct prediction path of InversionGNN, we train the model for multi-property prediction to acquire knowledge of the optimal combination of functional groups. Then the learned chemical knowledge helps the inversion generation path to generate molecules with required properties. fc27afde448f0df789160afa4c7ac751b81a0fee.abstract: Zero-shot medical detection can further improve detection performance without relying on annotated medical images even upon the fine-tuned model, showing great clinical value. Recent studies leverage grounded vision-language models (GLIP) to achieve this by using detailed disease descriptions as prompts for the target disease name during the inference phase. However, these methods typically treat prompts as equivalent context to the target name, making it difficult to assign specific disease knowledge based on visual information, leading to a coarse alignment between images and target descriptions. fc27afde448f0df789160afa4c7ac751b81a0fee.zh_title: 提示即知识库：结构化表征提升零样本医学检测

ab9a8817e542a4b1431496e49aa07b79de780b46.title: The Case for Cleaner Biosignals: High-fidelity Neural Compressor Enables Transfer from Cleaner iEEG to Noisier EEG
ab9a8817e542a4b1431496e49aa07b79de780b46.abstract: All data modalities are not created equal, even when the signal they measure comes from the same source. In the case of the brain, two of the most important data modalities are the scalp electroencephalogram (EEG), and the intracranial electroencephalogram (iEEG). They are used by human experts, supported by deep learning (DL) models, to accomplish a variety of tasks, such as seizure detection and motor imagery classification. Although the differences between EEG and iEEG are well understood by human experts, the performance of DL models across these two modalities remains under-explored. To help characterize the importance of clean data on the performance of DL models, we propose BrainCodec, a high-fidelity EEG and iEEG neural compressor. 50a97e4c5caa4c72b56220bc120bb6ce7e2e451c.title: Rethinking the generalization of drug target affinity prediction algorithms via similarity aware evaluation
50a97e4c5caa4c72b56220bc120bb6ce7e2e451c.abstract: Drug-target binding affinity prediction is a fundamental task for drug discovery. It has been extensively explored in literature and promising results are reported. However, in this paper, we demonstrate that the results may be misleading and cannot be well generalized to real practice. The core observation is that the canonical randomized split of a test set in conventional evaluation leaves the test set dominated by samples with high similarity to the training set. The performance of models is severely degraded on samples with lower similarity to the training set but the drawback is highly overlooked in current evaluation. As a result, the performance can hardly be trusted when the model meets low-similarity samples in real practice. 13d8054b93c45d6858f27d10171e6e3506bb1a15.abstract: The dynamic nature of proteins, influenced by ligand interactions, is essential for comprehending protein function and progressing drug discovery. Traditional structure-based drug design (SBDD) approaches typically target binding sites with rigid structures, limiting their practical application in drug development. While molecular dynamics simulation can theoretically capture all the biologically relevant conformations, the transition rate is dictated by the intrinsic energy barrier between them, making the sampling process computationally expensive. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, we propose to use generative modeling for SBDD considering conformational changes of protein pockets. 7cd40761785edac59568417638b25f0407a935db.abstract: Protein family design emerges as a promising alternative by combining the advantages of de novo protein design and mutation-based directed evolution.In this paper, we propose ProfileBFN, the Profile Bayesian Flow Networks, for specifically generative modeling of protein families. Empirical results show that ProfileBFN has a profound understanding of proteins. When generating diverse and novel family proteins, it can accurately capture the structural characteristics of the family. 0c77c73b78c1fab21ee1f3c48037e0beba81f062.title: Group Ligands Docking to Protein Pockets
0c77c73b78c1fab21ee1f3c48037e0beba81f062.abstract: Molecular docking is a key task in computational biology that has attracted increasing interest from the machine learning community. While existing methods have achieved success, they generally treat each protein-ligand pair in isolation. Inspired by the biochemical observation that ligands binding to the same target protein tend to adopt similar poses, we propose \textsc{GroupBind}, a novel molecular docking framework that simultaneously considers multiple ligands docking to a protein. This is achieved by introducing an interaction layer for the group of ligands and a triangle attention module for embedding protein-ligand and group-ligand pairs. By integrating our approach with diffusion-based docking model, we set a new S performance on the PDBBind blind docking benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed molecular docking paradigm.

0c77c73b78c1fab21ee1f3c48037e0beba81f062.zh_abstract: 分子对接是计算生物学中的一项关键任务，已引起机器学习界日益增长的兴趣。尽管现有方法已取得成功，但它们通常将每个蛋白质-配体对孤立看待。受以下生化观察的启发：与同一靶蛋白结合的配体倾向于采取相似的姿态，我们提出 GroupBind，这是一种新颖的分子对接框架，可同时考虑多个配体与一个蛋白质对接。这是通过为配体组引入交互层，以及为嵌入蛋白质-配体和组-配体对引入三角注意力模块来实现的。通过将我们的方法与基于扩散的对接模型相结合，我们在 PDBBind 盲对接基准上设定了新的 S 性能，证明了我们提出的分子对接范式的有效性。

05efaf072e77a3cd0dd061ca9f940098826bf168.abstract: Recent advances in protein backbone generation have achieved promising results under structural, functional, or physical constraints. However, existing methods lack the flexibility for precise topology control, limiting navigation of the backbone space. We present ProtPainter, a diffusion-based approach for generating protein backbones conditioned on 3D curves. ProtPainter follows a two-stage process: curve-based sketching and sketch-guided backbone generation. For the first stage, we propose CurveEncoder, which predicts secondary structure annotations from a curve to parametrize sketch generation. For the second stage, the sketch guides the generative process in Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Modeling (DDPM) to generate backbones. 2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.title: Knowledgeable Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers for Personalized Medicine
2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.abstract: The goal of personalized medicine is to discover a treatment regimen that optimizes a patient’s clinical outcome based on their personal genetic and environmental factors. However, candidate treatments cannot be arbitrarily administered to the patient to assess their efficacy; we often instead have access to an in silico surrogate model that approximates the true fitness of a proposed treatment. Unfortunately, such surrogate models have been shown to fail to generalize to previously unseen patient-treatment combinations. We hypothesize that domain-specific prior knowledge—such as medical textbooks and biomedical knowledge graphs—can provide a meaningful alternative signal of the fitness of proposed treatments. 2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.zh_title: 知识型语言模型作黑箱优化器用于个性化医疗

2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.zh_abstract: 个性化医疗的目标是发现一种治疗方案，根据患者个人的遗传和环境因素优化其临床结局。然而，候选治疗不能任意施用于患者以评估其疗效；我们通常转而使用一种计算机模拟替代模型，该模型近似所提出治疗的真实适应度。不幸的是，此类替代模型已被证明无法泛化到先前未见过的患者-治疗组合。我们假设领域特定的先验知识——例如医学教科书和生物医学知识图谱——能够为所提出治疗的适应度提供有意义的替代信号。为此，我们提出了基于 LLM 的、以知识先验进行熵引导优化（LLM-based Entropy-guided Optimization with kNowledgeable priors, LEON），这是一种基于数学原理的方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为 b

551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.title: Enhanced Contrastive Learning with Multi-view Longitudinal Data for Chest X-ray Report Generation
551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.abstract: Automated radiology report generation offers an effective solution to alleviate radiologists’ workload. However, most existing methods focus primarily on single or fixed-view images to model current disease conditions, which limits diagnostic accuracy and overlooks disease progression. Although some approaches utilize longitudinal data to track disease progression, they still rely on single images to analyze current visits. To address these issues, we propose enhanced contrastive learning with Multi-view Longitudinal data to facilitate chest X-ray Report Generation, named MLRG. Specifically, we introduce a multi-view longitudinal contrastive learning method that integrates spatial information from current multi-view images and temporal information from longitudinal data. This method also utilizes the inherent spatiotemporal information of radiology reports to supervise the pre-training o
551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.zh_title: 多视角纵向数据增强对比学习生成胸片报告

3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.title: nnWNet: Rethinking the Use of Transformers in Biomedical Image Segmentation and Calling for a Unified Evaluation Benchmark
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.abstract: Semantic segmentation is a crucial prerequisite in clinical applications and computer-aided diagnosis. With the development of deep neural networks, biomedical image segmentation has achieved remarkable success. Encoder-Decoder architectures that integrate convolutions and transformers are gaining attention for their potential to capture both global and local features. However, current designs face the contradiction that these two features cannot be continuously transmitted. In addition, some models lack a unified and standardized evaluation benchmark, leading to significant discrepancies in the experimental setup. In this study, we review and summarize these architectures and analyze their contradictions in design. 3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.zh_title: nnWNet：重新思考生物医学图像分割中的Transformer
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.summary: 提出nnWNet重新思考Transformer在生物医学图像分割中的使用，并呼吁统一评估基准。
key_points: 语义分割是临床与计算机辅助诊断前提
编解码器融合卷积与Transformer受关注
全局与局部特征当前无法持续传递
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.zh_abstract: 语义分割是临床应用和计算机辅助诊断中的重要前提。随着深度神经网络的发展，生物医学图像分割已取得显著成功。整合卷积和 transformer 的 Encoder-Decoder 架构因其同时捕获全局和局部特征的潜力而受到关注。然而，当前设计面临矛盾：这两种特征无法被连续传递。此外，一些模型缺乏统一且标准化的评估基准，导致实验设置存在显著差异。在本研究中，我们回顾并总结这些架构，并分析其设计中的矛盾。我们修改 UNet 并提出 WNet，以结合 transformer 和卷积，有效解决传递问题。WNet 捕获长程依赖和局部细节

afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.title: BIOMEDICA: An Open Biomedical Image-Caption Archive, Dataset, and Vision-Language Models Derived from Scientific Literature
afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.abstract: The development of vision-language models (VLMs) is driven by large-scale and diverse multi-modal datasets. However, progress toward generalist biomedical VLMs is limited by the lack of annotated, publicly accessible datasets across biology and medicine. Existing efforts are limited to narrow domains, missing the full diversity of biomedical knowledge encoded in scientific literature. To address this gap, we introduce BIOMEDICA: a scalable, open-source framework to extract, annotate, and serialize the entirety of the PubMed Central Open Access subset into an easy-to-use, publicly accessible dataset. Our framework produces a comprehensive archive with over 24 million unique image-text pairs from over 6 million articles. afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.zh_title: BIOMEDICA：开放生物医学图像-文本档案与模型

afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）的发展由大规模且多样的多模态数据集驱动。然而，通用生物医学 VLMs 的进展受限于生物学和医学领域缺乏带标注、可公开访问的数据集。现有工作局限于狭窄领域，遗漏了科学文献中编码的生物医学知识的完整多样性。为填补这一空白，我们引入 BIOMEDICA：一个可扩展的开源框架，用于提取、标注并序列化 PubMed Central Open Access 子集的全部内容，将其转化为易于使用、可公开访问的数据集。我们的框架产生了一个综合档案，包含来自超过 600 万篇文章的超过 2400 万个独特图像-文本对。还额外提供元数据和专家指导的标注。我们通过发布 BMC-CLIP 来证明我们资源的实用性和可访问性，BMC-CLIP 是一套 CLIP 风格的

d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.title: MM-OR: A Large Multimodal Operating Room Dataset for Semantic Understanding of High-Intensity Surgical Environments
d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.abstract: Operating rooms (ORs) are complex, high-stakes environments requiring precise understanding of interactions among medical staff, tools, and equipment for enhancing surgical assistance, situational awareness, and patient safety. Current datasets fall short in scale, realism and do not capture the multimodal nature of OR scenes, limiting progress in OR modeling. To this end, we introduce MM-OR, a realistic and large-scale multimodal spatiotemporal OR dataset, and the first dataset to enable multimodal scene graph generation. MM-OR captures comprehensive OR scenes containing RGB-D data, detail views, audio, speech transcripts, robotic logs, and tracking data and is annotated with panoptic segmentations, semantic scene graphs, and downstream task labels. d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.zh_title: MM-OR：大型多模态手术室数据集

d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.zh_abstract: 手术室（ORs）是复杂、高风险的环境，需要精确理解医务人员、工具和设备之间的交互，以增强手术辅助、态势感知和患者安全。当前数据集在规模、真实性方面存在不足，且未能捕捉手术室场景的多模态特性，限制了手术室建模的进展。为此，我们引入 MM-OR，一个真实且大规模的多模态时空手术室数据集，也是首个能够实现多模态场景图生成的数据集。MM-OR 捕获包含 RGB-D 数据、细节视图、音频、语音转录文本、机器人日志和跟踪数据的全面手术室场景，并标注有全景分割、语义场景图和下游任务标签。此外，我们提出 MM2SG，首个用于场景图生成的多模态大型视觉语言模型，并且通过大量实验，

88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.title: Noise-Consistent Siamese-Diffusion for Medical Image Synthesis and Segmentation
88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized medical image segmentation, yet its full potential remains constrained by the paucity of annotated datasets. While diffusion models have emerged as a promising approach for generating synthetic image-mask pairs to augment these datasets, they paradoxically suffer from the same data scarcity challenges they aim to mitigate. Traditional mask-only models frequently yield low-fidelity images due to their inability to adequately capture morphological intricacies, which can critically compromise the robustness and reliability of segmentation models. To alleviate this limitation, we introduce Siamese-Diffusion, a novel dual-component model comprising Mask-Diffusion and Image-Diffusion. 88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.zh_title: 噪声一致孪生扩散用于医学图像合成与分割

88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.zh_abstract: 深度学习已经彻底改变了医学图像分割，但其全部潜力仍受限于标注数据集的缺乏。尽管扩散模型已成为生成合成图像-掩膜对以扩充这些数据集的一种有前景的方法，但矛盾的是，它们也遭受着其旨在缓解的同样数据稀缺挑战。传统的仅掩膜模型由于无法充分捕捉形态学复杂性，常常生成低保真图像，这可能严重损害分割模型的鲁棒性和可靠性。为缓解这一局限，我们引入 Siamese-Diffusion，一种新颖的双组件模型，包含 Mask-Diffusion 和 Image-Diffusion。在训练期间，在这些组件之间引入噪声一致性损失（Noise Consistency Loss），以在参数空间中增强 Mask-Diffusion 的形态保真度。在采样期间，o

be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.title: MIMO: A medical vision language model with visual referring multimodal input and pixel grounding multimodal output
be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.abstract: Currently, medical vision language models are widely used in medical vision question answering tasks. However, existing models are confronted with two issues: for input, the model only relies on text instructions and lacks direct understanding of visual clues in the image; for output, the model only gives text answers and lacks connection with key areas in the image. To address these issues, we propose a unified medical vision language model MIMO, with visual referring Multimodal Input and pixel grounding Multimodal Output. MIMO can not only combine visual clues and textual instructions to understand complex medical images and semantics, but can also ground medical terminologies in textual output within the image. be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.zh_title: MIMO：视觉指代与像素定位的医学视觉语言模型
be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.summary: 提出统一医学视觉语言模型MIMO，支持视觉指代多模态输入与像素定位多模态输出。

b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.title: Patient-Level Anatomy Meets Scanning-Level Physics: Personalized Federated Low-Dose CT Denoising Empowered by Large Language Model
b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.abstract: Reducing radiation doses benefits patients, but the resultant low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) images often suffer from clinically unacceptable noise and artifacts. While deep learning (DL) has shown promise in LDCT reconstruction, it requires large-scale data collection from multiple clients, raising privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) has been introduced to mitigate these privacy concerns; however, current methods are typically tailored to specific scanning protocols, which limits their generalizability and makes them less effective for unseen protocols. To address these issues, we propose SCANPhysFed, a novel SCanning- and ANatomy-level personalized Physics-Driven Federated learning paradigm for LDCT reconstruction. b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.zh_title: 患者级解剖与扫描级物理结合：大模型赋能个性化联邦低剂量CT去噪

f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.title: DyCON: Dynamic Uncertainty-aware Consistency and Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.abstract: Semi-supervised learning in medical image segmentation leverages unlabeled data to reduce annotation burdens through consistency learning. However, current methods struggle with class imbalance and high uncertainty from pathology variations, leading to inaccurate segmentation in 3D medical images. To address these challenges, we present DyCON, a Dynamic Uncertainty-aware Consistency and Contrastive Learning framework that enhances the generalization of consistency methods with two complementary losses: Uncertainty-aware Consistency Loss (UnCL) and Focal Entropy-aware Contrastive Loss (FeCL). UnCL enforces global consistency by dynamically weighting the contribution of each voxel to the consistency loss based on its uncertainty, preserving high-uncertainty regions instead of filtering them out. f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.summary: CVPR 2025 提出 DyCON 框架，用动态不确定性感知的一致性与对比学习缓解类别不平衡与高不确定性，改善 3D 医学图像分割。

9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.title: Show and Segment: Universal Medical Image Segmentation via In-Context Learning
9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.abstract: Medical image segmentation remains challenging due to the vast diversity of anatomical structures, imaging modalities, and segmentation tasks. While deep learning has made significant advances, current approaches struggle to generalize as they require task-specific training or fine-tuning on unseen classes. We present Iris, a novel In-context Reference Image guided Segmentation framework that enables flexible adaptation to novel tasks through the use of reference examples without fine-tuning. At its core, Iris features a lightweight context task encoding module that distills task-specific information from reference context image-label pairs. This rich context embedding information is used to guide the segmentation of target objects. 9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.zh_title: Iris：基于上下文学习的通用医学图像分割框架
9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.summary: CVPR 2025 提出 Iris 框架，通过参考示例的上下文学习适配新分割任务，无需微调。

9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割仍然具有挑战性，因为解剖结构、成像模式和分割任务多种多样。尽管深度学习取得了重大进展，但当前的方法难以泛化，因为它们需要针对特定任务进行训练或在未见类别上进行微调。我们提出了Iris，一种新颖的上下文参考图像引导分割框架，它通过使用参考示例而无需微调，能够灵活地适应新任务。其核心是，Iris具有一个轻量级的上下文任务编码模块，从参考上下文图像-标签对中提取特定任务信息。这些丰富的上下文嵌入信息用于指导目标对象的分割。通过将任务编码与推理解耦，Iris支持从单样本推理和上下文示例集成到对象级上下文示例等多种策略。

b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.title: MedUnifier: Unifying Vision-and-Language Pre-training on Medical Data with Vision Generation Task using Discrete Visual Representations
b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.abstract: Despite significant progress in Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP), current approaches predominantly emphasize feature extraction and cross-modal comprehension, with limited attention to generating or transforming visual content. This gap hinders the model’s ability to synthesize coherent and novel visual representations from textual prompts, thereby reducing the effectiveness of multi-modal learning. In this work, we propose MedUnifier, a unified VLP framework tailored for medical data. MedUnifier seamlessly integrates text-grounded image generation capabilities with multi-modal learning strategies, including image-text contrastive alignment, image-text matching and image-grounded text generation. b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.zh_title: MedUnifier：以离散视觉表示统一医学视觉语言预训练与生成

b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.zh_abstract: 尽管视觉-语言预训练（VLP）取得了重大进展，但当前方法主要强调特征提取和跨模态理解，对生成或转换视觉内容的关注有限。这一差距阻碍了模型从文本提示合成连贯且新颖的视觉表示的能力，从而降低了多模态学习的有效性。在这项工作中，我们提出了MedUnifier，一个为医学数据量身定制的统一VLP框架。MedUnifier无缝地将基于文本的图像生成能力与多模态学习策略相结合，包括图像-文本对比对齐、图像-文本匹配和基于图像的文本生成。与依赖于连续视觉表示的传统方法不同，我们的方法采用视觉向量量化，这不仅促进了更连贯的学习策略，用于cr

a0f243d9e014e68f9b13552161067c3cfea1d44b.title: OpenMIBOOD: Open Medical Imaging Benchmarks for Out-Of-Distribution Detection
a0f243d9e014e68f9b13552161067c3cfea1d44b.abstract: The growing reliance on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in critical domains such as healthcare demands robust mechanisms to ensure the trustworthiness of these systems, especially when faced with unexpected or anomalous inputs. This paper introduces the Open Medical Imaging Benchmarks for Out-Of-Distribution Detection (OpenMI-BOOD), a comprehensive framework for evaluating out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods specifically in medical imaging contexts. OpenMIBOOD includes three benchmarks from diverse medical domains, encompassing 14 datasets divided into covariate-shifted in-distribution, near-OOD, and far-OOD categories. We evaluate 24 post-hoc methods across these benchmarks, providing a standardized reference to advance the development and fair comparison of OOD detection methods. a0f243d9e014e68f9b13552161067c3cfea1d44b.summary: 提出医学影像分布外检测基准框架，包含三个基准，评估AI系统在异常输入下的可信度。

a0f243d9e014e68f9b13552161067c3cfea1d44b.zh_abstract: 医疗等关键领域对人工智能（AI）日益增长的依赖，要求有稳健机制来确保这些系统的可信性，尤其是在面对意外或异常输入时。本文介绍了用于分布外检测的开放医学影像基准（Open Medical Imaging Benchmarks for Out-Of-Distribution Detection，OpenMI-BOOD），这是一个专门在医学影像背景下评估分布外（OOD）检测方法的综合框架。OpenMIBOOD 包含来自不同医学领域的三个基准，涵盖 14 个数据集，分为协变量偏移的分布内、近 OOD 和远 OOD 类别。我们在这些基准上评估了 24 种事后（post-hoc）方法，为推进 OOD 检测方法的开发和公平比较提供了标准化参考。结果表明，来自自然图像领域的大规模 OOD 基准的发现并不能迁移

7c3f1d187dee36485755d23e22cf0c50f0a18ab7.abstract: Foundational models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) are gaining traction in medical imaging segmentation, supporting multiple downstream tasks. However, such models are supervised in nature, still relying on large annotated datasets or prompts supplied by experts. Conventional techniques such as active learning to alleviate such limitations are limited in scope and still necessitate continuous human involvement and complex domain knowledge for label refinement or establishing reward ground truth. To address these challenges, we propose an enhanced Segment Anything Model (SAM) framework that utilizes annotation-efficient prompts generated in a fully unsupervised fashion, while still capturing essential semantic, location, and shape information through contrastive language-image pretraining and visual question answering. 3ecb8447b2c2bd1c0a890ca2425cae26c2b1df51.title: dFLMoE: Decentralized Federated Learning via Mixture of Experts for Medical Data Analysis
3ecb8447b2c2bd1c0a890ca2425cae26c2b1df51.abstract: Federated learning has wide applications in the medical field. It enables knowledge sharing among different healthcare institutes while protecting patients’ privacy. However, existing federated learning systems are typically centralized, requiring clients to upload client-specific knowledge to a central server for aggregation. This centralized approach would integrate the knowledge from each client into a centralized server, and the knowledge would be already undermined during the centralized integration before it reaches back to each client. Besides, the centralized approach also creates a dependency on the central server, which may affect training stability if the server malfunctions or connections are unstable. 3ecb8447b2c2bd1c0a890ca2425cae26c2b1df51.zh_title: dFLMoE：专家混合的去中心化联邦学习医学数据分析

967288dcb37c2577c8b47510536ae40586b2ce81.abstract: The development of large-scale image-text pair datasets has significantly advanced self-supervised learning in Vision-Language Processing (VLP). However, directly applying general-domain architectures such as CLIP to medical data presents challenges, particularly in handling negations and addressing the inherent data imbalance of medical datasets. To address these issues, we propose a novel approach that integrates clinically-enhanced dynamic soft labels and medical graphical alignment, thereby improving clinical comprehension and improving the applicability of contrastive loss in medical contexts. Furthermore, we introduce negation-based hard negatives to deepen the model’s understanding of the complexities of clinical language. 967288dcb37c2577c8b47510536ae40586b2ce81.zh_title: 将CLIP引入临床：动态软标签与否定感知学习

967288dcb37c2577c8b47510536ae40586b2ce81.zh_abstract: 大规模图像-文本对数据集的发展显著推进了视觉-语言处理（Vision-Language Processing, VLP）中的自监督学习。然而，将 CLIP 等通用领域架构直接应用于医学数据会带来挑战，尤其是在处理否定表述以及应对医学数据集固有的数据不平衡方面。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种新方法，该方法整合了临床增强的动态软标签与医学图形对齐，从而提升临床理解并改善对比损失在医学语境中的适用性。此外，我们引入基于否定的难负样本，以加深模型对临床语言复杂性的理解。我们的方法易于集成到医学 CLIP 训练流程中，并在多项任务上取得最先进性能，包括零样本、微调

8eebdc15895eb880d3e92d4103eeaf7bf57cc588.title: LesionLocator: Zero-Shot Universal Tumor Segmentation and Tracking in 3D Whole-Body Imaging
8eebdc15895eb880d3e92d4103eeaf7bf57cc588.abstract: In this work, we present LesionLocator, a framework for zero-shot longitudinal lesion tracking and segmentation in 3D medical imaging, establishing the first end-to-end model capable of 4D tracking with dense spatial prompts. Our model leverages an extensive dataset of 23,262 annotated medical scans, as well as synthesized longitudinal data across diverse lesion types. The diversity and scale of our dataset significantly enhances model generalizability to real-world medical imaging challenges and addresses key limitations in longitudinal data availability. LesionLocator outperforms all existing promptable models in lesion segmentation by nearly 10 dice points, reaching human-level performance, and achieves state-of-the-art results in lesion tracking, with superior lesion retrieval and segmentation accuracy. 734b8beb568c22b492506885600e8f0ac8c367ff.title: Multi-modal Medical Diagnosis via Large-small Model Collaboration
734b8beb568c22b492506885600e8f0ac8c367ff.abstract: Recent advances in medical AI have shown a clear trend towards large models in healthcare. However, developing large models for multi-modal medical diagnosis remains challenging due to a lack of sufficient modal-complete medical data. Most existing multi-modal diagnostic models are relatively small and struggle with limited feature extraction capabilities. Our framework first employs a mixture-of-modality-experts (MoME) architecture to combine features extracted from multiple single-modal medical large models, and then introduces a novel adaptive co-learning mechanism to collaborate with a multi-modal small model. 734b8beb568c22b492506885600e8f0ac8c367ff.zh_title: 大小模型协作的多模态医学诊断框架

dcf7fac663ef10057c549d16e8a648c6660db987.abstract: Large pretrained visual foundation models exhibit impressive general capabilities. However, the extensive prior knowledge inherent in these models can sometimes be a double-edged sword when adapting them to downstream tasks in specific domains. In the context of semi-supervised medical image segmentation with domain shift, foundation models like MedSAM tend to make overconfident predictions, some of which are incorrect. The error accumulation hinders the effective utilization of unlabeled data and limits further improvements. In this paper, we introduce a Synergistic training framework for Foundation and Conventional models (SynFoC) to address the issue. dcf7fac663ef10057c549d16e8a648c6660db987.summary: 提出基础模型与传统模型互助的方法，用于混合域半监督医学图像分割，缓解预测过度自信导致的误差累积。
key_points: 面向域偏移下的医学图像分割
基础模型预测过度自信且含错误
互助机制以利用无标注数据
dcf7fac663ef10057c549d16e8a648c6660db987.zh_abstract: 大型预训练视觉基础模型展现出令人印象深刻的通用能力。然而，当将这些模型适配到特定领域的下游任务时，其固有的广泛先验知识有时可能是一把双刃剑。在存在域偏移的半监督医学图像分割背景下，诸如 MedSAM 之类的基础模型往往会产生过度自信的预测，其中一些预测是错误的。错误累积阻碍了未标注数据的有效利用，并限制了进一步的改进。在本文中，我们引入了一个基础模型与传统模型协同训练框架（SynFoC）来解决该问题。我们观察到，从零开始训练的传统模型有能力纠正基础模型高置信度的错误预测，而基础模型可以在早期训练中用高质量的伪标签对其进行监督。

b8d978f72167f62a03ff3e12c982fb4ff5638b53.title: Incomplete Multi-modal Brain Tumor Segmentation via Learnable Sorting State Space Model
b8d978f72167f62a03ff3e12c982fb4ff5638b53.abstract: Brain tumor segmentation plays a crucial role in clinical diagnosis, yet the frequent unavailability of certain MRI modalities poses a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the Learnable Sorting State Space Model (LS3M), a novel framework designed to maximize the utilization of available modalities for brain tumor segmentation. LS3M excels at efficiently modeling long-range dependencies based on the Mamba design, while incorporating differentiable permutation matrices that reorder input sequences based on modality-specific characteristics. This dynamic reordering ensures that critical spatial inductive biases and long-range semantic correlations inherent in 3D brain MRI are preserved, which is crucial for imcomplete multi-modal brain tumor segmentation. b8d978f72167f62a03ff3e12c982fb4ff5638b53.zh_title: 可学习排序状态空间模型用于不完整多模态脑肿瘤分割
b8d978f72167f62a03ff3e12c982fb4ff5638b53.summary: 提出LS3M框架，基于Mamba高效建模长程依赖并引入可微置换矩阵重排，以最大化利用可用MRI模态。
key_points: 应对部分MRI模态缺失场景
基于Mamba建模长程依赖
引入可微置换矩阵重排序
b8d978f72167f62a03ff3e12c982fb4ff5638b53.zh_abstract: 脑肿瘤分割在临床诊断中起着至关重要的作用，然而某些 MRI 模态的经常不可用构成了重大挑战。在本文中，我们介绍可学习排序状态空间模型（LS3M），一种新颖框架，旨在最大化利用可用模态进行脑肿瘤分割。LS3M 擅长基于 Mamba 设计高效建模长程依赖，同时纳入可微排列矩阵，这些矩阵根据模态特定特征对输入序列重新排序。这种动态重排序确保了 3D 脑 MRI 中固有的关键空间归纳偏置和长程语义相关性得以保留，这对于不完整多模态脑肿瘤分割至关重要。一旦使用生成的排列矩阵对输入序列重新排序，序列状态空间模型（S3M）块 mod

6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.title: Interactive Medical Image Analysis with Concept-based Similarity Reasoning
6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.abstract: The ability to interpret and intervene model decisions is important for the adoption of computer-aided diagnosis methods in clinical workflows. Recent concept-based methods link the model predictions with interpretable concepts and modify their activation scores to interact with the model. However, these concepts are at the image level, which hinders the model from pinpointing the exact patches the concepts are activated. Alternatively, prototype-based methods learn representations from training image patches and compare these with test image patches, using the similarity scores for final class prediction. However, interpreting the underlying concepts of these patches can be challenging and often necessitates post-hoc guesswork. 6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.zh_title: 基于概念相似度推理的交互式医学图像分析
6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.summary: CVPR 2025论文提出基于概念的相似度推理方法，使医学图像分析模型的决策可解释、可交互干预。
key_points: 可解释与可干预性影响临床采用
原概念方法停留在图像级别
提出的方法可定位概念激活区域
面向交互式医学图像分析
6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.zh_abstract: 解释和干预模型决策的能力对于计算机辅助诊断方法在临床工作流中的采用非常重要。最近基于概念的方法将模型预测与可解释的概念联系起来，并修改其激活分数以与模型交互。然而，这些概念处于图像级别，这阻碍了模型精确定位概念被激活的确切图像块。作为替代，基于原型的方法从训练图像块中学习表示，并将这些表示与测试图像块进行比较，使用相似性分数进行最终类别预测。然而，解释这些图像块背后的概念可能具有挑战性，并且通常需要事后猜测。为了解决这个问题，本文引入了新颖的基于概念的相似性推理网络（Concept-based Similarity Reasoning network, CSR），它提供了 (i) 具有内在 co

257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.title: DeformCL: Learning Deformable Centerline Representation for Vessel Extraction in 3D Medical Image
257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.abstract: In the field of 3D medical imaging, accurately extracting and representing the blood vessels with curvilinear structures holds paramount importance for clinical diagnosis. Previous methods have commonly relied on discrete representation like mask, often resulting in local fractures or scattered fragments due to the inherent limitations of the per-pixel classification paradigm. In this work, we introduce DeformCL, a new continuous representation based on Deformable Centerlines, where centerline points act as nodes connected by edges that capture spatial relationships. Compared with previous representations, DeformCL offers three key advantages: natural connectivity, noise robustness, and interaction facility. We present a comprehensive training pipeline structured in a cascaded manner to fully exploit these favorable properties of DeformCL. Extensive experiments on four 3D vessel segmenta
257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.zh_title: DeformCL：3D医学图像血管提取的可变形中心线表征
257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.summary: 提出基于可变形中心线的连续表征DeformCL，用于3D医学图像中的血管提取。
key_points: 血管曲线结构提取对临床诊断重要
离散掩码表征易致局部断裂与碎片
以连续中心线表征替代逐像素分类
257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.zh_abstract: 在3D医学成像领域，准确提取和表示具有曲线结构的血管对于临床诊断至关重要。先前的方法通常依赖于像掩膜这样的离散表示，由于逐像素分类范式的固有局限性，常常导致局部断裂或碎片散落。在这项工作中，我们引入了DeformCL，一种基于可变形中心线（Deformable Centerlines）的新连续表示，其中中心线点充当由边连接的节点，边捕获空间关系。与先前的表示相比，DeformCL提供了三个关键优势：自然的连通性、噪声鲁棒性和交互便利性。我们提出了一个以级联方式结构化的综合训练流程，以充分利用DeformCL的这些有利特性。在四个3D血管分割

acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.title: A Semantic Knowledge Complementarity based Decoupling Framework for Semi-supervised Class-imbalanced Medical Image Segmentation
acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.abstract: The limited data annotations have made semi-supervised learning (SSL) increasingly popular in medical image analysis. However, the use of pseudo labels in SSL degrades the performance of decoders that heavily rely on high-accuracy annotations. This issue is particularly pronounced in class-imbalanced multi-organ segmentation tasks, where small organs may be under-segmented or even ignored. In this paper, we propose SKCDF, a semantic knowledge complementarity based decoupling framework for multi-organ segmentation in class-imbalanced medical images. SKCDF decouples the data flow based on the responsibilities of the encoder and decoder during model training to make the model effectively learn semantic features, while mitigating the negative impact of unlabeled data on the semantic segmentation task. acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.zh_title: SKCDF：语义知识互补解耦的半监督类不平衡医学图像分割框架
acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.summary: CVPR 2025 提出 SKCDF 解耦框架，用语义知识互补缓解半监督伪标签在类不平衡多器官分割中的小器官漏分问题。
key_points: 伪标签会拖累依赖高精度标注的解码器
类不平衡下小器官易欠分割或被忽略
提出语义知识互补的解耦框架 SKCDF
acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.zh_abstract: 有限的数据标注使半监督学习（SSL）在医学图像分析中日益流行。然而，在 SSL 中使用伪标签会降低严重依赖高精度标注的解码器的性能。这个问题在类别不平衡的多器官分割任务中尤为明显，其中小器官可能被分割不足甚至被忽略。在本文中，我们提出 SKCDF，一种基于语义知识互补的解耦框架，用于类别不平衡医学图像中的多器官分割。SKCDF 在模型训练期间根据编码器和解码器的职责解耦数据流，使模型能够有效学习语义特征，同时减轻未标注数据对语义分割任务的负面影响。我们还设计了一个语义知识互补模块，采用标注数据来引导

032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.title: Cross-Modal Interactive Perception Network with Mamba for Lung Tumor Segmentation in PET-CT Images
032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.abstract: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally. PET-CT is crucial for imaging lung tumors, providing essential metabolic and anatomical information, while it faces challenges such as poor image quality, motion artifacts, and complex tumor morphology. Deep learning-based models are expected to address these problems, however, existing small-scale and private datasets limit significant performance improvements for these methods. Hence, we introduce a large-scale PET-CT lung tumor segmentation dataset, termed PCLT20K, which comprises 21, 930 pairs of PET-CT images from 605 patients. Furthermore, we propose a cross-modal interactive perception network with Mamba (CIPA) for lung tumor segmentation in PET-CT images. 032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.zh_title: 基于Mamba的跨模态交互感知网络用于PET-CT肺肿瘤分割
032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.summary: 提出跨模态交互感知网络，利用Mamba进行PET-CT肺肿瘤分割，并引入大规模数据集应对数据限制。
key_points: PET-CT对肺癌成像重要，但图像质量等有挑战
现有小规模私有数据集限制深度学习性能
引入大规模PET-CT肺肿瘤数据集
032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.zh_abstract: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。PET-CT 对肺部肿瘤成像至关重要，可提供必要的代谢和解剖信息，但其面临图像质量差、运动伪影和肿瘤形态复杂等挑战。基于深度学习的模型有望解决这些问题，然而，现有小规模和私有数据集限制了这些方法取得显著性能提升。因此，我们引入一个大规模 PET-CT 肺部肿瘤分割数据集，称为 PCLT20K，它包含来自 605 名患者的 21, 930 对 PET-CT 图像。此外，我们提出一种带有 Mamba 的跨模态交互感知网络（cross-modal interactive perception network with Mamba, CIPA），用于 PET-CT 图像中的肺部肿瘤分割。具体而言，我们设计了一个通道级校正模块（channel-wise rectification module, CRM），该模块在多模态特征上实现通道状态空间块，以学习相关的 repr

f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.title: Fast and Accurate Gigapixel Pathological Image Classification with Hierarchical Distillation Multi-Instance Learning
f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.abstract: Although multi-instance learning (MIL) has succeeded in pathological image classification, it faces the challenge of high inference costs due to processing numerous patches from gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs). To address this, we propose HDMIL, a hierarchical distillation multi-instance learning framework that achieves fast and accurate classification by eliminating irrelevant patches. HD-MIL consists of two key components: the dynamic multi-instance network (DMIN) and the lightweight instance pre-screening network (LIPN). DMIN operates on high-resolution WSIs, while LIPN operates on the corresponding low-resolution counterparts. During training, DMIN are trained for WSI classification while generating attention-score-based masks that indicate irrelevant patches. f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.zh_title: 层次蒸馏多实例学习用于病理图像分类
f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.summary: 提出HD-MIL框架，通过剔除无关切片实现千兆像素病理图像快速准确分类。
key_points: 病理全切片图像推理成本高
HD-MIL含动态多实例网络
层次蒸馏去除无关图像块
f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.zh_abstract: 尽管多实例学习（MIL）在病理图像分类中取得了成功，但由于需要处理千兆像素全切片图像（WSIs）中的大量图像块，它面临高推理成本的挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出 HDMIL，一个分层蒸馏多实例学习框架，通过消除不相关的图像块来实现快速准确的分类。HD-MIL 由两个关键组件组成：动态多实例网络（DMIN）和轻量级实例预筛选网络（LIPN）。DMIN 在高分辨率 WSIs 上运行，而 LIPN 在相应的低分辨率对应图像上运行。在训练期间，DMIN 被训练用于 WSI 分类，同时生成基于注意力分数的掩码，以指示不相关的图像块。这些掩码随后指导 LIPN 的训练，以预测每个低分辨率图像块的相关性。在测试期间，LIPN f

8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.title: Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of deep learning-based methods in medical image segmentation, their use in clinical practice remains limited for two main reasons. First, obtaining a large medical dataset with precise annotations to train segmentation models is challenging. Secondly, most current segmentation techniques generate a single deterministic segmentation mask for each image. However, in real-world scenarios, there is often significant uncertainty regarding what defines the "correct" segmentation, and various expert annotators might provide different segmentations for the same image. To tackle both of these problems, we propose Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation (AmbiSSL). 8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.zh_title: 标注模糊性感知的半监督医学图像分割
8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.summary: 针对医学图像分割中精确标注获取困难与单一确定性掩码忽视“正确分割”不确定性的问题，提出标注模糊性感知的半监督分割方法。
key_points: 大规模精确标注获取困难
现有方法仅输出单一确定掩码
关注分割定义本身的不确定性
8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.zh_abstract: 尽管基于深度学习的方法在医学图像分割方面取得了显著进展，但其在临床实践中的应用仍然有限，主要有两个原因。首先，获取具有精确标注的大型医学数据集以训练分割模型具有挑战性。其次，当前大多数分割技术为每张图像生成单一确定性分割掩膜。然而，在真实场景中，对于什么定义“正确”的分割往往存在显著不确定性，不同专家标注者可能对同一张图像提供不同的分割。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出标注歧义感知半监督医学图像分割（Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation，AmbiSSL）。AmbiSSL 结合少量多标注者标注数据和大量未标注数据，以生成多样且合理的分割图。我们的方法由 t

623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.title: Multi-Resolution Pathology-Language Pre-training Model with Text-Guided Visual Representation
623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.abstract: In Computational Pathology (CPath), the introduction of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has opened new avenues for research, focusing primarily on aligning image-text pairs at a single magnification level. However, this approach might not be sufficient for tasks like cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, and survival analysis due to the limited level of detail that a single-resolution image can provide. Addressing this, we propose a novel multi-resolution paradigm leveraging Whole Slide Images (WSIs) to extract histology patches at multiple resolutions and generate corresponding textual descriptions through advanced CPath VLM. We introduce visual-textual alignment at multiple resolutions as well as cross-resolution alignment to establish more effective text-guided visual representations. 623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.zh_title: 多分辨率病理-语言预训练与文本引导视觉表征
623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.summary: 提出多分辨率病理-语言预训练模型，利用文本引导视觉表征，提升癌症亚型分类等任务。
key_points: 多分辨率范式处理全切片图像
文本引导视觉表征对齐
面向癌症亚型分类等任务
623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.zh_abstract: 在计算病理学（Computational Pathology, CPath）中，视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）的引入开辟了新的研究途径，主要集中在单一放大倍数水平下对齐图像-文本对。然而，由于单一分辨率图像所能提供的细节水平有限，这种方法对于癌症亚型分类、组织表型分析和生存分析等任务可能并不足够。针对这一点，我们提出一种新颖的多分辨率范式，利用全切片图像（Whole Slide Images, WSIs）在多个分辨率下提取组织学图像块，并通过先进的 CPath VLM 生成相应的文本描述。我们引入多分辨率下的视觉-文本对齐以及跨分辨率对齐，以建立更有效的文本引导视觉表示。使用多模态编码器的跨分辨率对齐增强了模型 cap 的能力

d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.title: AeSPa : Attention-guided Self-supervised Parallel imaging for MRI Reconstruction
d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.abstract: This study introduces a novel zero-shot scan-specific self-supervised reconstruction method for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to reduce scan times. Conventional supervised reconstruction methods require large amounts of fully-sampled reference data, which is often impractical to obtain and can lead to artifacts by overly emphasizing learned patterns. Existing zero-shot scan-specific methods have attempted to overcome this data dependency but show limited performance due to insufficient utilization of k-space information and constraints derived from MRI forward model. To address these limitations, we introduce a framework utilizing all acquired k-space measurements for both network inputs and training targets. d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.zh_title: AeSPa：注意力引导自监督并行MRI重建
d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.summary: 提出零样本、针对单次扫描的自监督MRI重建方法，旨在缩短扫描时间并减少数据依赖。
key_points: 零样本、扫描特异的自监督重建

d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.zh_abstract: 本研究介绍了一种用于磁共振成像（MRI）的新型零样本、扫描特异性自监督重建方法，以减少扫描时间。传统的监督重建方法需要大量完全采样的参考数据，而这些数据通常难以获得，并且可能因过度强调学习到的模式而导致伪影。现有的零样本扫描特异性方法曾试图克服这种数据依赖，但由于未充分利用 k 空间信息以及源自 MRI 前向模型的约束，其性能有限。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了一个框架，利用所有采集到的 k 空间测量值同时作为网络输入和训练目标。虽然该框架存在训练不稳定的问题，但我们通过三个关键组件解决了这些挑战：一个注意力引导的 k 空间选择机制（Attention-guided K-space Selective Mechanism, AKSM），其能够 prov

cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.title: Towards All-in-One Medical Image Re-Identification
cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.abstract: Medical image re-identification (MedReID) is underexplored so far, despite its critical applications in personalized healthcare and privacy protection. In this paper, we introduce a thorough benchmark and a unified model for this problem. First, to handle various medical modalities, we propose a novel Continuous Modality-based Parameter Adapter (ComPA). ComPA condenses medical content into a continuous modality representation and dynamically adjusts the modality-agnostic model with modalityspecific parameters at runtime. cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.zh_title: 面向通用医学图像重识别的基准与统一模型
cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.summary: 构建医学图像重识别基准并提出统一模型，含连续模态参数适配器ComPA以应对多种医学模态。

cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.zh_abstract: 医学图像重识别（MedReID）迄今为止仍未得到充分探索，尽管其在个性化医疗和隐私保护中具有关键应用。在本文中，我们为该问题引入了一个全面的基准和一个统一模型。首先，为了处理各种医学模态，我们提出了一种新颖的基于连续模态的参数适配器（ComPA）。ComPA 将医学内容浓缩为连续模态表示，并在运行时用模态特定参数动态调整模态无关模型。这使单个模型能够自适应地学习和处理多样化的模态数据。此外，我们通过将模型与一组预训练的医学基础模型在差异特征方面对齐，将医学先验整合到我们的模型中。与单图像特征相比，建模图像间差异更适合重识别问题，该问题涉及

d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.title: DART: Disease-aware Image-Text Alignment and Self-correcting Re-alignment for Trustworthy Radiology Report Generation
d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.abstract: The automatic generation of radiology reports has emerged as a promising solution to reduce a time-consuming task and accurately capture critical disease-relevant findings in X-ray images. Previous approaches for radiology report generation have shown impressive performance. However, there remains significant potential to improve accuracy by ensuring that retrieved reports contain disease-relevant findings similar to those in the X-ray images and by refining generated reports. In this study, we propose a Disease-aware image-text Alignment and self-correcting Re-alignment for Trustworthy radiology report generation (DART) framework. In the first stage, we generate initial reports based on image-to-text retrieval with disease-matching, embedding both images and texts in a shared embedding space through contrastive learning. This approach ensures the retrieval of reports with similar diseas
d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.zh_title: DART：面向可信放射报告生成的疾病感知对齐
d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.summary: 提出 DART，通过疾病感知的图像-文本对齐与自校正重对齐，生成更可信的放射报告。
key_points: 面向X线影像的报告自动生成

d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.zh_abstract: 放射学报告的自动生成已成为一种有前景的解决方案，可减少耗时的任务并准确捕获X射线图像中关键的疾病相关发现。以往的放射学报告生成方法已展现出令人印象深刻的性能。然而，通过确保检索到的报告包含与X射线图像中相似的疾病相关发现，并细化生成的报告，仍有显著潜力可提高准确性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于可信放射学报告生成的疾病感知图像-文本对齐与自校正重对齐（Disease-aware image-text Alignment and self-correcting Re-alignment for Trustworthy radiology report generation, DART）框架。在第一阶段，我们基于带有疾病匹配的图像到文本检索生成初始报告，通过对比学习将图像和文本嵌入共享的嵌入空间。这种方法确保检索到具有相似疾病的报告

1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.title: SACB-Net: Spatial-Awareness Convolutions for Medical Image Registration
1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.abstract: Deep learning-based image registration methods have shown state-of-the-art performance and rapid inference speeds. Despite these advances, many existing approaches fall short in capturing spatially varying information in non-local regions of feature maps due to the reliance on spatially-shared convolution kernels. This limitation leads to suboptimal estimation of deformation fields. In this paper, we propose a 3D Spatial-Awareness Convolution Block (SACB) to enhance the spatial information within feature representations. Our SACB estimates the spatial clusters within feature maps by leveraging feature similarity and subsequently parameterizes the adaptive convolution kernels across diverse regions. 29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-Vqa) is a challenging task that requires a deep understanding of both medical images and textual questions. Although recent works leveraging Medical Vision-Language Pre-Training (Med-Vlp) have shown strong performance on the Med-Vqa task, there is still no unified solution for modality alignment, and the issue of hard negatives remains underexplored. Additionally, commonly used knowledge fusion techniques for Med-Vqa may introduce irrelevant information. 29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.zh_title: 医学VQA的表示对齐、难负样本挖掘与知识融合

24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.title: Test-Time Domain Generalization via Universe Learning: A Multi-Graph Matching Approach for Medical Image Segmentation
24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.abstract: Despite domain generalization (DG) has significantly addressed the performance degradation of pre-trained models caused by domain shifts, it often falls short in real-world deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA), which adjusts a learned model using unlabeled test data, presents a promising solution. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to deliver strong performance in medical image segmentation, primarily because they overlook the crucial prior knowledge inherent to medical images. To address this challenge, we incorporate morphological information and propose a framework based on multi-graph matching. Specifically, we introduce learnable universe embeddings that integrate morphological priors during multi-source training, along with novel unsupervised test-time paradigms for domain adaptation. 24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.zh_title: 多图匹配的测试时域泛化医学图像分割
24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.summary: 提出基于Universe Learning的多图匹配方法，实现医学图像分割的测试时域泛化。
key_points: 域偏移导致预训练模型性能下降

24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.zh_abstract: 尽管领域泛化（DG）已显著解决了由领域偏移引起的预训练模型性能下降问题，但在实际部署中往往表现不佳。测试时自适应（TTA）通过使用未标记的测试数据调整学习到的模型，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，大多数现有的TTA方法在医学图像分割中难以提供强大性能，主要是因为它们忽略了医学图像固有的关键先验知识。为了应对这一挑战，我们结合形态学信息，提出了一个基于多图匹配的框架。具体而言，我们引入了可学习的全域嵌入，在多源训练期间整合形态学先验，以及用于领域自适应的新型无监督测试时范式。这种方法保证了多匹配中的循环一致性，同时使模型能

0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.title: HistoFS: Non-IID Histopathologic Whole Slide Image Classification via Federated Style Transfer with RoI-Preserving
0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.abstract: Federated learning for pathological whole slide image (WSI) classification allows multiple clients to train a global multiple instance learning (MIL) model without sharing their privacy-sensitive WSIs. To accommodate the non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) feature shifts, cross-client style transfer has been popularly used but is subject to two fundamental issues: (1) WSI contains multiple morphological structures, each corresponding to a distinct style. (2) Performing style transfer may potentially shift the region of interests (RoIs) in the augmented WSIs. To address these challenges, we propose HistoFS, a federated learning framework for computational pathology on non-i.i.d. feature shifts in WSI classification. 0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.zh_title: HistoFS：非独立同分布病理全切片联邦分类
0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.summary: 提出HistoFS方法，通过联邦风格迁移与感兴趣区域保留，解决非独立同分布病理全切片图像分类问题。

0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.zh_abstract: 用于病理全切片图像（whole slide image, WSI）分类的联邦学习允许多个客户端在不共享其隐私敏感的 WSI 的情况下训练一个全局多示例学习（multiple instance learning, MIL）模型。为适应非独立同分布（non-independent and identically distributed, non-i.i.d.）的特征偏移，跨客户端风格迁移已被广泛使用，但它存在两个基本问题：（1）WSI 包含多种形态结构，每种结构对应一种不同的风格。（2）执行风格迁移可能会在增强后的 WSI 中移动感兴趣区域（region of interests, RoIs）。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HistoFS，一种用于计算病理学的联邦学习框架，针对 WSI 分类中的 non-i.i.d. 特征偏移。具体而言，我们引入伪袋风格（pseudo bag styles），其捕获单个 WSI 内的多种风格变化。此外，引入了一个真实性模块

460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.title: Multi-modal Topology-embedded Graph Learning for Spatially Resolved Genes Prediction from Pathology Images with Prior Gene Similarity Information
460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.abstract: The rapid development of spatial transcriptomics (ST) allows researchers to measure the spatial-level gene expression in tissues. Although powerful, the cost for collecting the ST data is expensive, and thus several studies aim to predict gene expression in ST by utilizing their corresponding H/E stained pathology images. The existing ST based gene expression prediction models either adopt the pre-trained networks or rely on the handcrafted features to describe the pathology images, which still lack a systematic way to combine them together to define a spot-level representation that can reflect the topological profiles of different spots. 460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics, ST）的快速发展使研究人员能够测量组织中的空间水平基因表达。尽管功能强大，但收集 ST 数据的成本高昂，因此一些研究旨在利用其对应的 H/E 染色病理图像来预测 ST 中的基因表达。现有的基于 ST 的基因表达预测模型要么采用预训练网络，要么依赖手工设计的特征来描述病理图像，仍缺乏一种系统化的方式将它们结合起来，以定义能够反映不同 spot 拓扑轮廓的 spot 级表示。另一方面，所有基于 ST 的基因预测模型都独立地处理每个基因的预测任务，忽视了探索它们之间潜在相互关系有助于提高 ind 的预测性能这一事实。

2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.title: Multi-modal Contrastive Learning with Negative Sampling Calibration for Phenotypic Drug Discovery
2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery presents a promising strategy for identifying first-in-class drugs by bypassing the need for specific drug targets. Recent advances in cell-based phenotypic screening tools, including Cell Painting and the LINCS L1000, provide essential cellular data that capture biological responses to compounds. While the integration of the multi-modal data enhances the use of contrastive learning (CL) methods for molecular phenotypic representation, these approaches treat all negative pairs equally, failing to discriminate molecules with similar phenotypes. 2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.zh_title: 面向表型药物发现的多模态对比学习与负采样校准

2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.zh_abstract: 表型药物发现通过绕过对特定药物靶点的需求，为识别首创药物（first-in-class drugs）提供了一种有前景的策略。基于细胞的表型筛选工具（包括 Cell Painting 和 LINCS L1000）的最新进展提供了捕获化合物生物反应的关键细胞数据。虽然多模态数据的整合增强了对比学习（contrastive learning, CL）方法在分子表型表示中的应用，但这些方法平等对待所有负样本对，无法区分具有相似表型的分子。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一个基础框架 MINER，它基于单模态解耦表示动态估计样本对作为负样本对的可能性。此外，我们的方法结合了混合融合策略，以有效整合多模态数据，即使在……情况下

fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.title: KMD: Koopman Multi-modality Decomposition for Generalized Brain Tumor Segmentation under Incomplete Modalities
fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), with modalities including T1, T2, T1ce, and Flair, providing complementary information critical for sub-region analysis, is widely used for brain tumor diagnosis. However, clinical practice often suffers from varying degrees of incompleteness of necessary modalities due to reasons such as susceptibility to artifacts. It significantly impairs segmentation model performance. Given the limited available modalities at hand, existing approaches attempt to project them into a shared latent space. However, they ignore decomposing the modality-shared and modality-specific information and failed to construct the relationship among different modalities. Such deficiency limits the effectiveness of the segmentation performance, particularly at the time when the amount of data in each modality is different. In this paper, we propose the plug-and-play Koopman Multi-mo
fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.zh_title: KMD：模态不完整下的脑肿瘤分割

fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.zh_abstract: 磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）具有包括 T1、T2、T1ce 和 Flair 在内的模态，提供对子区域分析至关重要的互补信息，被广泛用于脑肿瘤诊断。然而，临床实践常因易受伪影影响等原因而遭受必要模态不同程度的不完整。这显著损害分割模型性能。鉴于手头可用模态有限，现有方法尝试将它们投影到共享潜在空间。然而，它们忽略了分解模态共享信息和模态特异信息，也未能构建不同模态之间的关系。这种缺陷限制了分割性能的有效性，尤其是在每个模态的数据量不同时。在本文中，我们提出即插即用的 Koopman Multi-mo

18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.title: CSC-PA: Cross-image Semantic Correlation via Prototype Attentions for Single-network Semi-supervised Breast Tumor Segmentation
18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.abstract: Accurate automatic breast ultrasound (BUS) image segmentation is essential for early breast cancer screening and diagnosis. However, it remains challenging owing to (1) breast lesions of various scale and shape, (2) ambiguous boundaries caused by speckle noise and artifacts, and (3) the scarcity of high-quality annotations. Most existing semi-supervised methods employ the mean-teacher architecture, which merely learns semantic information within a single image and heavily relies on the performance of the teacher model. Therefore, we present a novel cross-image semantic correlation semi-supervised framework, named CSC-PA, to improve the performance of BUS image segmentation. 18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.zh_title: CSC-PA：原型注意力跨图像语义关联的乳腺肿瘤分割
18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.summary: 该研究提出CSC-PA方法，用于单网络半监督乳腺超声肿瘤分割。

933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.title: Boost the Inference with Co-Training: A Depth-Guided Mutual Learning Framework for Semi-Supervised Medical Polyp Segmentation
933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.abstract: Semi-Supervised polyp segmentation has made significant progress in recent years as a potential solution for computer-assisted treatment. Since depth images can provide extra information other than RGB images to help segment these problematic areas, depth-assisted polyp segmentation has gained much attention. However, the utilization of depth information is still worth studying. The existing RGB-D segmentation methods rely on depth data in the inference stage, limiting their clinical applications. To tackle this problem, we propose a semi-supervised polyp segmentation framework based on the mean teacher architecture. 8e7efac2d4a0bfa66a3683fce863cfa8acf0120b.title: Unified Medical Lesion Segmentation via Self-referring Indicator

However, due to their cross-fusion designs, existing ICL-based unified segmentation models fail to accurately localize lesions with low-matched reference sets. Considering that the query itself can be regarded as a high-matched reference, which better indicates the target, we design a self-referencing mechanism that adaptively extracts self-referring indicator vectors from the query based on coarse predictions, thus effectively overcoming the negative impact caused by low-match reference sets. 39bacf40ae5061c241ea6f513b67da0bf80c9ff2.abstract: Co-Training has achieved significant success in the field of semi-supervised learning(SSL); however, the homogenization phenomenon, which arises from multiple models tending towards similar decision boundaries, remains inadequately addressed. To tackle this issue, we propose a novel algorithm called β-FFT from the perspectives of data processing and training structure. In data processing, we apply diverse augmentations to input data and feed them into two sub-networks. To balance the training instability caused by different augmentations during consistency learning, we introduce a nonlinear interpolation technique based on the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). fbda82b30954d60fe81f62906b542695ac7f8673.abstract: In clinical practice, panoramic dental radiography is a widely employed imaging technique that can provide a detailed and comprehensive view of dental structures and surrounding tissues for identifying various oral anomalies. However, due to the complexity of oral anomalies and the scarcity of available data, existing research still suffers from substantial challenges in automated oral anomaly detection. To this end, this paper presents a new hospital-scale panoramic X-ray benchmark, namely "OralXrays-91", which consists of 12,688 panoramic X-ray images with 84,113 meticulously annotated instances across nine common oral anomalies. 9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.title: EffiDec3D: An Optimized Decoder for High-Performance and Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation
9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.abstract: Recent 3D deep networks such as SwinUNETR, Swin-Unetrv2, and 3D UX-Net have shown promising performance by leveraging self-attention and large-kernel convolutions to capture the volumetric context. However, their substantial computational requirements limit their use in real-time and resource-constrained environments. The high #FLOPs and #Params in these networks stem largely from complex decoder designs with high-resolution layers and excessive channel counts. In this paper, we propose EffiDec3D, an optimized 3D decoder that employs a channel reduction strategy across all decoder stages, which sets the number of channels to the minimum needed for accurate feature representation. 144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) systems benefit the interpretation of medical images containing critical clinical information. However, the challenge of noisy labels and limited high-quality datasets remains underexplored. 144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答 (Med-VQA) 系统有助于解释包含关键临床信息的医学图像。然而，噪声标签和有限的高质量数据集这一挑战仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这个问题，我们通过使用语义设计的噪声类型模拟人类错误标注，建立了 Med-VQA 中噪声标签的第一个基准。更重要的是，我们引入了 DiN 框架，该框架利用扩散模型来处理 Med-VQA 中的噪声标签。与直接预测答案的主流基于分类的 VQA 方法不同，我们的答案扩散器 (Answer Diffuser, AD) 模块采用由粗到细的过程，利用扩散模型细化答案候选以提高准确性。答案条件生成器 (Answer Condition Generator, ACG) 通过将答案嵌入与融合图像- 相结合来生成任务特定的条件信息，进一步增强了这一过程。

a10a2364c7be00185bb9c2d3f9c85e3736df12c1.abstract: Deep learning has achieved significant advancements in medical image segmentation, but existing models still face challenges in accurately segmenting lesion regions. The main reason is that some lesion regions in medical images have unclear boundaries, irregular shapes, and small tissue density differences, leading to label ambiguity. However, the existing model treats all data equally without taking quality differences into account in the training process, resulting in noisy labels negatively impacting model training and unstable feature representations. In this paper, a data-driven alternating learning (DALE) paradigm is proposed to optimize the model’s training process, achieving stable and high-precision segmentation. 6c9e7e8374023b8743388235ebf61eb37ab72004.abstract: We explore Generalizable Tumor Segmentation, aiming to train a single model for zero-shot tumor segmentation across diverse anatomical regions. 304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.title: BioX-CPath: Biologically-driven Explainable Diagnostics for Multistain IHC Computational Pathology
304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.abstract: The development of biologically interpretable and explainable models remains a key challenge in computational pathology, particularly for multistain immunohistochemistry (IHC) analysis. c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.abstract: Diagnosing diseases through histopathology whole slide images (WSIs) is fundamental in modern pathology but is challenged by the gigapixel scale and complexity of WSIs. Trained histopathologists overcome this challenge by navigating the WSI, looking for relevant patches, taking notes, and compiling them to produce a final holistic diagnostic. Traditional AI approaches, such as multiple instance learning and transformer-based models, fail short of such a holistic, iterative, multi-scale diagnostic procedure, limiting their adoption in the real-world. We introduce PathFinder, a multi-modal, multi-agent framework that emulates the decision-making process of expert pathologists. PathFinder integrates four AI agents—the Triage Agent, Navigation Agent, Description Agent, and Diagnosis Agent—that collaboratively navigate WSIs, gather evidence, and provide comprehensive diagnoses with natural la
c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.zh_title: PathFinder：病理诊断多模态多智能体系统
c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.summary: 提出面向组织病理全切片图像的多模态多智能体诊断系统PathFinder，模拟病理医生的迭代诊断流程。
key_points: 针对全切片图像吉像素级复杂度
多智能体迭代、多尺度诊断流程
弥补多实例学习等方法的局限
c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.zh_abstract: 通过组织病理学全切片图像（WSIs）诊断疾病是现代病理学的基础，但受到WSIs千兆像素级规模和复杂性的挑战。训练有素的组织病理学家通过浏览WSI、寻找相关图像块、做笔记并汇总这些笔记以产生最终的整体诊断来克服这一挑战。传统AI方法，如多实例学习和基于Transformer的模型，未能达到这种整体性、迭代式、多尺度的诊断流程，限制了它们在真实世界中的采用。我们提出PathFinder，一个多模态、多智能体框架，模拟专家病理学家的决策过程。PathFinder整合四个AI智能体——分诊智能体（Triage Agent）、导航智能体（Navigation Agent）、描述智能体（Description Agent）和诊断智能体（Diagnosis Agent）——它们协同浏览WSIs、收集证据，并提供具有自然语言的全面诊断

6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.title: RadGPT: Constructing 3D Image-Text Tumor Datasets
6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.abstract: Cancers identified in CT scans are usually accompanied by detailed radiology reports, but publicly available $C T$ datasets often lack these essential reports. This absence limits their usefulness for developing accurate report generation AI. To address this gap, we present AbdomenAtlas 3.0, the first public, high-quality abdominal CT dataset with detailed, expert-reviewed radiology reports. All reports are paired with per-voxel masks and they describe liver, kidney and pancreatic tumors. AbdomenAtlas 3.0 has 9,262 triplets of CT, mask and report-3,955 with tumors. These CT scans come from 17 public datasets. Besides creating the reports for these datasets, we expanded their number of tumor masks by $4.2 \times$, identifying 3,011 new tumor cases. 6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.zh_title: RadGPT：构建三维图像-文本肿瘤数据集
6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.summary: 构建首个公开高质量腹部CT图像-文本数据集AbdomenAtlas 3.0，含专家审核报告与肿瘤掩码。

6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.zh_abstract: CT 扫描中发现的癌症通常伴有详细的放射学报告，但公开可用的 CT 数据集往往缺乏这些必要的报告。这种缺失限制了它们在开发准确的报告生成 AI 方面的实用性。为了解决这一空白，我们提出了 AbdomenAtlas 3.0，这是第一个公开的、高质量的腹部 CT 数据集，带有详细的、专家评审的放射学报告。所有报告都与逐体素掩膜配对，并描述肝脏、肾脏和胰腺肿瘤。AbdomenAtlas 3.0 有 9,262 个 CT、掩膜和报告的三元组——其中 3,955 个含有肿瘤。这些 CT 扫描来自 17 个公共数据集。除了为这些数据集创建报告外，我们将它们的肿瘤掩膜数量扩大了 4.2 倍，识别出 3,011 个新肿瘤病例。值得注意的是，AbdomenAtlas 3.0 中的报告比传统的人工报告更标准化，且生成速度更快。它们提供了细节

10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.title: Derm1M: A Million-Scale Vision-Language Dataset Aligned with Clinical Ontology Knowledge for Dermatology
10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.abstract: The emergence of vision-language models has transformed medical AI, enabling unprecedented advances in diagnostic capability and clinical applications. However, progress in dermatology has lagged behind other medical domains due to the lack of standard image-text pairs. Existing dermatological datasets are limited in both scale and depth, offering only single-label annotations across a narrow range of diseases instead of rich textual descriptions, and lacking the crucial clinical context needed for real-world applications. To address these limitations, we present Derm1M, the first large-scale vision-language dataset for dermatology, comprising 1,029,761 image-text pairs. Built from diverse educational resources and structured around a standard ontology collaboratively developed by experts, Derm1M provides comprehensive coverage for over 390 skin conditions across four hierarchical levels
10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.zh_title: Derm1M：百万级皮肤科视觉-语言数据集
10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.summary: 构建百万规模并对齐临床本体知识的皮肤科图文数据集，弥补现有数据在规模与标注深度上的不足。
key_points: 百万级图文对，含丰富文本描述
对齐临床本体知识与临床语境

10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型的出现改变了医学 AI，在诊断能力和临床应用方面实现了前所未有的进步。然而，由于缺乏标准的图像-文本对，皮肤病学的进展落后于其他医学领域。现有的皮肤病学数据集在规模和深度上都有限，仅提供针对狭窄疾病范围的单标签注释，而非丰富的文本描述，并且缺乏实际应用所需的关键临床背景。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 Derm1M，这是首个用于皮肤病学的大规模视觉语言数据集，包含 1,029,761 个图像-文本对。Derm1M 基于多样化的教育资源构建，并围绕专家协作开发的标准本体进行组织，在四个层级上为超过 390 种皮肤状况提供了全面覆盖
